**26:7** Ma' wa ku yiliko'ob le luum, jayp'éel ki'ichpam ka'ap'éel ba'al To'on k jóok'saj ichil tulakal u jejelaasilo'ob?

Have they not seen the earth, and how many beautiful pairs We produced therein?

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

**26:8** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:9** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Most surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:10** Ka' a Yuumtsil tu t'aanaj Moses: Bineen ti' le maako'ob aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the tyrannical people.

وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**26:11** U maako'ob Pharaoh. Ma' wa kun saajko'ob?

The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear?”

قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

**26:12** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, kin saajkik u p'ektiko'ob teen.

He said, “My Lord, I fear they will reject me.

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

**26:13** Yeetel in ich puksi'ik'al ku kala'antal, yeetel in aak' ma' ku t'aan yaayaj, beey tuuno' tuuxt Aaron.

And I become stressed, and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron too.

وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ

**26:14** Yeetel yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel kuuch yook'ol teen, beey tuuno' kin saajkik u kinsiko'ob teen.

And they have a charge against me, so I fear they will kill me.”

وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

**26:15** Tu ya'alaj: Ma'. Bine'ex, ka'ap'éele'ex, yeetel K chiikulo'on. To'on yaan To'on yeetene'ex, K u'uyik.

He said, “No. Go, both of you, with Our proofs. We will be with you, listening.

قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

**26:16** Bine'ex ti' Pharaoh, yeetel a'ale'ex: To'on u tuuxtbilo'on u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Go to Pharaoh, and say, ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the Worlds.

فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:17** Tuuxt yeetel to'on u Paalalo'ob Israel.

Let the Children of Israel go with us.'“

أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**26:18** Tu ya'alaj: Ma' wa To'on k kananaj teech ichil to'on bey paal, yeetel ta p'ataj ichil to'on ya'ab ja'abo'ob a kuxtal?

He said, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed among us for many of your years?

قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

**26:19** Yeetel ta beetaj le a meyaj a beetmajo', yeetel teech ma' ki'iki' t'aanilech.

And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful.”

وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**26:20** Tu ya'alaj: Tin beetaj, ka' teen jun tul ti' le aj saatal beelo'ob.

He said, “I did it then, when I was of those astray.

قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

**26:21** Beey tuuno' tin púuts'aj ti' te'ex ka' tin saajkaje'ex. Ka' in Yuumtsil tu ts'aaj teen na'at yeetel tu beetaj teen jun tul ti' le tuuxtbilo'ob.

And I fled from you when I feared you; but my Lord gave me wisdom, and made me one of the messengers.

فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:22** Yeetel lela' junp'eel uts a k'a'ajsik teen — tumen ta beetaj a palilo'ob u Paalalo'ob Israel.

Is that the favor you taunt me with, although you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”

وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**26:23** Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Yeetel ba'ax le Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob?

Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of the Worlds?”

قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:24** Tu ya'alaj: U Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil ichile'ob, wa a k'aat a woksike'ex a woole'ex jaaj.

He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you are aware.”

قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

**26:25** Tu ya'alaj ti' le maaxo'ob tu baak': A wu'uyike'ex waaj?

He said to those around him, “Do you not hear?”

قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

**26:26** Tu ya'alaj: A Yuumtsile'ex yeetel u Yuumtsil a úuchben taatao'ob.

He said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of old.”

قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**26:27** Tu ya'alaj: A tuuxtbile'ex, le tuuxta'ab ti' te'ex, ma' na'at.

He said, “This messenger of yours, who is sent to you, is crazy.”

قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

**26:28** Tu ya'alaj: U Yuumtsil Lak'in yeetel Chik'in yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil ichile'ob, wa yaan a na'ate'ex.

He said, “Lord of the East and the West, and everything between them, if you understand.”

قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**26:29** Tu ya'alaj: Wa a ch'a'ik uláak' k'uj u láak' teen, kun in ts'aikech ichil le kala'ano'ob.

He said, “If you accept any god other than me, I will make you a prisoner.”

قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

**26:30** Tu ya'alaj: Kex wa tin taasaj teech junp'eel ba'al ku beetik a woksik a wool jaaj?

He said, “What if I bring you something convincing?”

قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍ مُّبِينٍ

**26:31** Tu ya'alaj: Taas lelo', wa teech jaaj a t'aan.

He said, “Bring it, if you are being truthful.”

قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

**26:32** Beey tuuno' tu pulaj u xa'ay che', yeetel ila', junp'eel kan chiika'an.

So he cast his staff; and it was a serpent, plain to see.

فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

**26:33** Yeetel tu joots'aj u k'ab; yeetel ku yila'al sak, ti' le aj ilajo'ob.

And he pulled his hand; and it was white, for all to see.

وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

**26:34** Tu ya'alaj ti' le aj nojochilo'ob tu baak': Lela' jun tul aj tuus na'at.

He said to the dignitaries around him, “This is a skilled magician.

قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

**26:35** Ku k'aatik u jok'sike'ex ti' a luume'ex yeetel u tuus, beey tuuno' ba'ax a ts'aike'ex t'aan?

He intends to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you recommend?”

يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

**26:36** Tu ya'alajo'ob: P'at u pa'atik leti' yeetel u suuku'un, yeetel tuuxt máaxo'ob ku much'iko'ob maako'ob ti' le kaajo'ob.

They said, “Delay him and his brother, and send recruiters to the cities.

قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

**26:37** Kun u taaso'ob teech tulakal aj tuus yaan u na'at.

To bring you every experienced magician.”

يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ

**26:38** Beey tuuno' le aj tuuso'ob much'besa'abo'ob ichil junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an k'iinil.

So the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day.

فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

**26:39** Yeetel a'ala'ab ti' le maako'ob: Kun a much'kine'ex xan waaj?

And it was said to the people, “Are you all gathered?

وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ

**26:40** Uti'al K ts'ayik le aj tuuso'ob, wa letio'ob le aj náajalo'ob?

That we may follow the magicians, if they are the winners.”

لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

**26:41** Ka' le aj tuuso'ob k'ucho'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob ti' Pharaoh: Yaan wa to'on junp'eel bo'olil, wa to'on le aj náajalo'ob?

When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us, if we are the winners?”

فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

**26:42** Tu ya'alaj: Jaaj, yeetel kun a p'atalo'ob ichil le maaxo'ob naats' ti' teen.

He said, “Yes, and you will be among those favored.”

قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

**26:43** Moses tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Pule'ex le ba'ax a pulike'ex.

Moses said to them, “Present what you intend to present.”

قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

**26:44** Beey tuuno' tu pulajo'ob u suumo'ob yeetel u che'o'ob, yeetel tu ya'alajo'ob: Tumen u nojbe'enil Pharaoh, to'on kun náajalo'on.

So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the winners.”

فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

**26:45** Ka' Moses tu pulaj u xa'ay che', yeetel kaaj u luuk'ik u tuuso'ob.

Then Moses threw his staff, and behold, it began swallowing their trickery.

فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

**26:46** Beey tuuno' le aj tuuso'ob tu xoolano'ob.

And the magicians fell down prostrating.

فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ

**26:47** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K oksik k ool ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds.

قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:48** U Yuumtsil Moses yeetel Aaron.

The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

**26:49** Tu ya'alaj: A okso'ob a woole'ex ti' leti' taanil in ts'aik cha'abil te'ex? Lela' jaaj junp'eel tuus tuukul a beetmaje'ex ichil le kaaj utia'al a jok'sike'ex u maako'ob ti'. Kun a wojele'ex jaaj. Kun in k'upik a k'abe'ex yeetel a wooke'ex ti' jejelaas paacho'ob, yeetel kun in k'aaxike'ex tulakal yook'ol che'ob.

He said, “Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon know. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.”

قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**26:50** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Mina'an k'aas. Ti' k Yuumtsil k suut.

They said, “No problem. To our Lord we will return.

قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

**26:51** K paajik k Yuumtsil u sa'atesik to'on k sipilo'ob, tumen to'on le maaxo'ob yaax tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

We are eager for our Lord to forgive us our sins, since we are the first of the believers.”

إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:52** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj t'aan ti' Moses: Bineen aak'ab yeetel In palilo'ob; jaaj kun ts'aybila'ake'ex.

And We inspired Moses: “Travel with My servants by night. You will be followed.”

۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

**26:53** Ka' Pharaoh tu tuuxtaj aj much'iko'ob ti' le kaajo'ob:

Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities.

فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

**26:54** Lela'ob junp'eel chan muuch' maako'ob.

“These are a small gang.

إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ

**26:55** Yeetel ku beetiko'ob u k'uxil to'on.

And they are enraging us.

وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ

**26:56** Ba'ale' to'on noj muuch'on, k kanantik k baaj.

But we are a vigilant multitude.”

وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ

**26:57** Beey tuuno' To'on k luk'saj letio'ob ti' pak'alo'ob yeetel ja' ku jóok'ol ti' luum.

So We drove them out of gardens and springs.

فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**26:58** Yeetel ayikalilo'ob yeetel ki'ichpam otocho'ob.

And treasures and noble dwellings.

وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

**26:59** Yeetel bey úuchik. Yeetel To'on k beetaj u Paalalo'ob Israel u ch'a'iko'ob letio'ob bey u ti'alo'ob.

So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them.

كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**26:60** Beey tuuno' tu ts'ayajo'ob letio'ob ka' líik' k'in.

And they pursued them at sunrise.

فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ

**26:61** Ka' le ka'ap'eel muuch'o'ob tu yilajo'ob u laak', u yetelo'ob Moses tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on náajalta'abon.

When the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, “We are being overtaken.”

فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

**26:62** Tu ya'alaj: Ma'! In Yuumtsil yeetel teen; Leti' kun chiikbesik in beel.

He said, “No; my Lord is with me, He will guide me.”

قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

**26:63** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj t'aan ti' Moses: Jaats' le k'aak'náabo' yeetel a xa'ay che'. Beey tuuno' tu ja'at u baaj; jujun jaats bey junp'eel noj wiits.

We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff.” Whereupon it parted, and each part was like a huge hill.

فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**26:64** Yeetel To'on k naats'besaj le u laak'o'ob.

And there We brought the others near.

وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

**26:65** Yeetel To'on k luk'saj Moses yeetel le maaxo'ob yeetel leti', tulakal much'bil.

And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

**26:66** Ka' To'on k bulbultaj ichil ja' le u laak'o'ob.

Then We drowned the others.

ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

**26:67** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

In that there is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:68** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:69** Yeetel tsikbes ti' letio'ob u tsikbalil Abraham.

And relate to them the story of Abraham.

وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

**26:70** Ka' tu ya'alaj ti' u taata yeetel u maako'ob: Ba'ax a kultike'ex?

When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**26:71** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K kultik beetbil ba'alo'ob, yeetel láayli' k p'atal ti' letio'ob.

They said, “We worship idols, and we remain devoted to them.”

قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ

**26:72** Tu ya'alaj: Ku yu'ubike'ex waaj ka' a payalchi'tike'ex?

He said, “Do they hear you when you pray?

قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ

**26:73** Wa ku ts'aiko'ob uts ti' te'ex, wa ku beetiko'ob k'aas ti' te'ex?

Or do they benefit you, or harm you?”

أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ

**26:74** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ba'ale' To'on k kaxtaj k úuchben taatao'ob ku beetiko'ob bey lelo'.

They said, “But we found our ancestors doing so.”

قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

**26:75** Tu ya'alaj: A tuukultaje'ex waaj ba'ax a kultike'ex?

He said, “Have you considered what you worship.

قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

**26:76** Te'ex yeetel a úuchben taatao'ob?

You and your ancient ancestors?

أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ

**26:77** Letio'ob in p'eko'ob, cheen ma' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

They are enemies to me, but not so the Lord of the Worlds.

فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:78** Leti' máax tu beetaj teen, yeetel ku chiikbesik in beel.

He who created me, and guides me.

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ

**26:79** Leti' máax ku ts'aik teen janal, yeetel ku ts'aik teen ja' u yuk'ul.

He who feeds me, and waters me.

وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ

**26:80** Yeetel ka' kin k'oja'antal, Leti' ku ts'akik teen.

And when I get sick, He heals me.

وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

**26:81** Yeetel Leti' máax kun beetik in kiimil, ka' u ts'aik teen kuxtal.

He who makes me die, and then revives me.

وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ

**26:82** Leti' máax kin paajik u sa'atesik in sipilo'ob ichil u k'iinil le xooko'.

He who, I hope, will forgive my sins on the Day of the Reckoning.”

وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

**26:83** In Yuumtsil, ts'aajen na'at, yeetel okoon ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

“My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.

رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**26:84** Yeetel ts'aajen junp'eel uts k'aaba' ichil le maako'ob kun taalo'ob paat.

And give me a reputation of truth among the others.

وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**26:85** Yeetel beeteen jun tul ti' le maaxo'ob kun u ch'a'ob bey u ti'alo'ob le Pak'al Ki' Oolal.

And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**26:86** Yeetel sa'ates in taata — leti' jun tul ti' le aj saatal beelo'ob.

And forgive my father—he was one of the misguided.

وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

**26:87** Yeetel ma' a subbes teen ichil u k'iinil ken lik'sa'ako'ob.

And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.

وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ

**26:88** Le k'iin mix ayikalil mix paalalo'ob kun u aanto'ob.

The Day when neither wealth nor children will help.

يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

**26:89** Cheen le maax ku taal ti' Allah yeetel junp'eel puksi'ik'al toh.

Except for him who comes to God with a sound heart.”

إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

**26:90** Yeetel le Pak'alo' kun naats'besa'al ti' le aj toh oolo'ob.

And Paradise will be brought near for the righteous.

وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

**26:91** Yeetel Mitnal kun e'esa'al ti' le aj saatal beelo'ob.

And the Blaze will be displayed to the deviators.

وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ

**26:92** Yeetel kun a'ala'al ti' letio'ob: Tu'ux yaan le maaxo'ob a kultike'ex ka'achij?

And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship?”

وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

**26:93** U laak' ti' Allah? Je'el wa u aantik te'ex, wa u aantik u baajo'ob?

Besides God? Can they help you, or help themselves?”

مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

**26:94** Beey tuuno' kun pulbilo'ob ichil, letio'ob yeetel le aj saatal beelo'ob.

Then they will be toppled into it, together with the seducers.

فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ

**26:95** Yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob Kisin, tulakal much'bil.

And the soldiers of Satan, all of them.

وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ

**26:96** Kun u ya'alo'ob, ka' ku keext'aaniko'ob ichil le Mitnalo':

They will say, as they feud in it.

قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ

**26:97** Tumen Allah, to'on yaan ka'achij ichil saatal beel chiika'an.

“By God, We were in evident error.

تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**26:98** Tumen To'on k ts'aaj te'ex bey u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

For equating you with the Lord of the Worlds.

إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:99** Mix máak tu sa'atesaj k beel cheen le aj kebano'ob.

No one misled us except the sinners.

وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

**26:100** Bejla'e' mina'an ti' to'on máax ku t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal to'on.

Now we have no intercessors.

فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ

**26:101** Yeetel mina'an ti' to'on jun tul yeetel jaaj.

And no sincere friend.

وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ

**26:102** Wa cheen je'el k ka' suuto'on, kun k p'atal ichil le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

If only we could have another chance, we would be among the faithful.”

فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:103** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:104** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:105** U maako'ob Noah tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob.

The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers.

كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:106** Ka' u suuku'uno'ob Noah tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

Their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**26:107** Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj ti' te'ex.

I am to you a faithful messenger.

إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**26:108** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:109** Ma' kin k'aatik te'ex mix junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal. In bo'olil cheen ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:110** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.”

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:111** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K oksik wa k ool ti' teech, ka' le maaxo'ob maas ch'eenebilo'ob ku ts'ayiko'ob teech?

They said, “Shall we believe in you, when it is the lowliest who follow you?”

۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ

**26:112** Tu ya'alaj: Mina'an in ojelil ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'achij.

He said, “What do I know about what they do?

قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**26:113** U xooko'ob cheen ti' in Yuumtsil, wa je'el a wu'uyike'ex.

Their account rests only with my Lord, if you have sense.

إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

**26:114** Yeetel ma' kun in jok'sik le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And I am not about to drive away the believers.

وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:115** Teen cheen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan saasil.

I am only a clear warner.”

إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**26:116** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa ma' a p'atik, oo Noah, kun ch'inbila'akech yeetel tuunich.

They said, “If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned.”

قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

**26:117** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, in maako'ob tu p'ektajo'ob teen.

He said, “My Lord, my people have denied me.

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ

**26:118** Beey tuuno' xot t'aan ichil teen yeetel letio'ob yeetel junp'eel xot t'aan ts'ookbesaj, yeetel luk's teen yeetel le aj oksaj oolo'ob yeeten teen.

So judge between me and them decisively, and deliver me and the believers who are with me.

فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:119** Beey tuuno' To'on k luk'saj leti' yeetel le maaxo'ob yeetel leti' ichil le noj cheemo' kuuchan.

So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark.

فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

**26:120** Ka' To'on k bulbultaj ichil ja' le maaxo'ob p'ato'ob.

Then We drowned the rest.

ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

**26:121** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

In that is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:122** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:123** Aad tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob.

Aad disbelieved the messengers.

كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:124** Ka' u suuku'uno'ob Hud tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

When their brother Hud said to them, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**26:125** Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj ti' te'ex.

I am to you a faithful messenger.

إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**26:126** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:127** Ma' kin k'aatik te'ex mix junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal. In bo'olil cheen ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:128** A beetike'ex waaj junp'eel noj chiikul yook'ol tulakal wiits utia'al baaxal?

Do you build a monument on every height for vanity's sake?

أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ

**26:129** Yeetel a beetike'ex najilo'ob chich, a paajike'ex a kuxtale'ex mina'an xuulul?

And you set up fortresses, hoping to live forever?

وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ

**26:130** Yeetel ka' a jaatse'ex, a jaats bey aj ma' toh oolo'ob nojo'ob.

And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?

وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ

**26:131** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:132** Saajkune'ex Leti' máax tu ts'aaj te'ex tulakal ba'ax a wojele'ex.

And reverence Him, who supplied you with everything you know.

وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**26:133** Tu ts'aaj te'ex ba'alche'ob yeetel paalalo'ob.

He supplied you with livestock and children.

أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ

**26:134** Yeetel pak'alo'ob yeetel ja' ku jóok'ol ti' luum.

And gardens and springs.

وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**26:135** Kin saajkik ti' te'ex u yaayajil junp'eel K'iin nojbe'en.

I fear for you the punishment of an awesome Day.”

إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**26:136** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Junp'éelili' ti' to'on, wa a ts'aik t'aan to'on wa ma' a ts'aiki'.

They said, “It is the same for us, whether you lecture us, or do not lecture.

قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

**26:137** Lela' mina'an u laak' cheen u kuxtal le úuchben maako'ob.

This is nothing but morals of the ancients.

إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**26:138** Yeetel to'on ma' kun k'uchbesa'ak k'aas.

And we will not be punished.”

وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

**26:139** Beey tuuno' tu p'ektajo'ob leti', yeetel To'on k k'aasbesaj letio'ob. Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:140** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:141** Thamood tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob.

Thamood disbelieved the messengers.

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:142** Ka' u suuku'uno'ob Saleh tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

When their brother Saleh said to them, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**26:143** Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj ti' te'ex.

I am to you a faithful messenger.

إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**26:144** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:145** Ma' kin k'aatik te'ex mix junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal. In bo'olil cheen ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:146** Kun a p'atalo'ob waaj kananil ichil le ba'ax yaan waye'?

Will you be left secure in what is here?

أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ

**26:147** Ichil pak'alo'ob yeetel ja' ku jóok'ol ti' luum.

In gardens and springs?

فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**26:148** Yeetel pak'alo'ob janal yeetel palmerao'ob u yooch ma' chich.

And fields, and palm-trees whose fruits are delicious?

وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ

**26:149** Yeetel a ch'a'ache'extik otocho'ob ti' wiitso'ob, yeetel na'at.

And you skillfully carve houses in the mountains?

وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ

**26:150** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:151** Yeetel ma' a yu'ubike'ex u t'aan le maaxo'ob ku sen xa'ak'tiko'ob.

And do not obey the command of the extravagant.

وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

**26:152** Máaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob k'aasil ichil luum, yeetel ma' tu beetiko'ob toh.

Who spread turmoil on earth, and do not reform.”

ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

**26:153** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Teech jun tul ti' le maaxo'ob tuusa'ano'ob.

They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched.

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ

**26:154** Teech cheen jun tul wiinik bey to'on, beey tuuno' taas junp'eel chiikul, wa teech jaaj a t'aan.

You are nothing but a man like us. So bring us a sign, if you are truthful.

مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

**26:155** Tu ya'alaj: Lela' junp'eel camello ko'olel; ti' leti' jun jaats u yuk'ul, yeetel ti' te'ex jun jaats a wuk'ule'ex ichil junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an.

He said, “This is a she-camel; she has her turn of drinking, and you have your turn of drinking—on a specified day.

قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

**26:156** Yeetel ma' a tuuch'ule'ex yeetel k'aas, ma' u ch'a'ike'ex u yaayajil junp'eel K'iin nojbe'en.

And do not touch her with harm, lest the punishment of a great day seizes you.”

وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**26:157** Ba'ale' tu kinsajo'ob leti', yeetel p'ato'ob yeetel ok'om oolal.

But they slaughtered her, and became full of remorse.

فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ

**26:158** Beey tuuno' le yaayajil tu ch'a'aj letio'ob. Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:159** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:160** U maako'ob Lot tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob.

The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers.

كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:161** Ka' u suuku'uno'ob Lot tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

When their brother Lot said to them, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**26:162** Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj ti' te'ex.

I am to you a faithful messenger.

إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**26:163** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:164** Ma' kin k'aatik te'ex mix junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal. In bo'olil cheen ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:165** A taale'ex waaj ti' xiibo'ob ichil tulakal maako'ob?

Do you approach the males of the world?

أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:166** Yeetel a p'atike'ex le ba'ax a Yuumtsil tu beetaj ti' te'ex ti' a ko'olelo'ob? Te'ex maako'ob a xéet'ike'ex le toh beelo'.

And forsake the wives your Lord created for you? Indeed, you are intrusive people.”

وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

**26:167** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa ma' a p'atik, oo Lot, kun jok'sa'akech.

They said, “Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be expelled.”

قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ

**26:168** Tu ya'alaj: Teen kin p'ektik a meyaje'ex.

He said, “I certainly deplore your conduct.”

قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ

**26:169** In Yuumtsil, luk's teen yeetel in laak'tsilo'ob ti' le ba'ax ku beetiko'ob.

“My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”

رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ

**26:170** Beey tuuno' To'on k luk'saj leti' yeetel u laak'tsilo'ob, tulakal much'bil.

So We saved him and his family, altogether.

فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

**26:171** Cheen junp'eel úuchben ko'olel p'at paat.

Except for an old woman among those who tarried.

إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

**26:172** Ka' To'on k k'aasbesaj le u laak'o'ob.

Then We destroyed the others.

ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

**26:173** Yeetel To'on k k'aaxaj cháak' ja' yook'ol letio'ob. K'aas u cháak' ja'il le maaxo'ob taanil k'a'aya'ano'ob.

And We rained down on them a rain. Dreadful is the rain of those forewarned.

وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

**26:174** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:175** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:176** Le maako'ob ichil le K'aaxo' tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob.

The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.

كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**26:177** Ka' Shuayb tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

When Shuaib said to them, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**26:178** Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj ti' te'ex.

I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**26:179** Beey tuuno' saajkune'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ubike'ex in t'aan.

So fear God, and obey me.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**26:180** Ma' kin k'aatik te'ex mix junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal. In bo'olil cheen ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:181** Ts'aike'ex le p'iis chuuka'an, yeetel ma' a p'atalo'ob ichil le aj saatalo'ob.

Give full measure, and do not cheat.

۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

**26:182** Yeetel p'iisike'ex yeetel junp'eel p'iis toh.

And weigh with accurate scales.

وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ

**26:183** Yeetel ma' a tookike'ex ti' maako'ob u ba'alo'ob, yeetel ma' a ts'aike'ex k'aasil ichil luum.

And do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not work corruption in the land.

وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

**26:184** Yeetel saajkune'ex Leti' máax tu beetaje'ex yeetel le úuchben maako'obo'.

And fear Him who created you and the masses of old.”

وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**26:185** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Teech jun tul ti' le maaxo'ob tuusa'ano'ob.

They said, “You are one of those bewitched.

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ

**26:186** Teech cheen jun tul wiinik bey to'on, yeetel k tuklik teech jun tul aj tuus.

And you are nothing but a man like us; and we think that you are a liar.

وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

**26:187** Beey tuuno' beet u líikil xóot'o'ob ti' ka'an yook'ol to'on, wa teech jaaj a t'aan.

So bring down on us pieces from the sky, if you are truthful.”

فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

**26:188** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil jach ku yojel ba'ax a beetike'ex.

He said, “My Lord is Well Aware of what you do.”

قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

**26:189** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob leti', beey tuuno' u yaayajil u K'iinil le Bo'oy tu ch'a'aj letio'ob. Lelo' u yaayajil junp'eel K'iin nojbe'en.

But they denied him. So the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them. It was the punishment of a great day.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**26:190** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**26:191** Yeetel a Yuumtsil Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**26:192** Yeetel leti' junp'eel e'esa'ab taal ti' u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**26:193** Le Pixan Jaaj tu ye'esaj leti'.

The Honest Spirit came down with it.

نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ

**26:194** Yook'ol a puksi'ik'al, utia'al a p'atal jun tul ti' le aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

Upon your heart, that you may be one of the warners.

عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ

**26:195** Ichil junp'eel t'aan arabiia saasil.

In a clear Arabic tongue.

بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ

**26:196** Yeetel leti' yaan ichil le kili'ich ju'uno'ob ti' le úuchben maako'ob.

And it is in the scriptures of the ancients.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**26:197** Ma' wa junp'eel chiikul ti' letio'ob tumen le aj na'ato'ob ichil u Paalalo'ob Israel ku k'ajóoltiko'ob leti'?

Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?

أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**26:198** Wa To'on k e'esaj yook'ol jun tul ma' arabiia.

Had We revealed it to one of the foreigners.

وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ

**26:199** Yeetel tu xookaj ti' letio'ob, ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' leti'.

And he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.

فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:200** Bey To'on k okojbesik leti' ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le aj kebano'ob.

Thus We make it pass through the hearts of the guilty.

كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**26:201** Ma' kun u okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' tak ken ku yiliko'ob le yaayajil ku yaajbesik.

They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment.

لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

**26:202** Kun taal ti' letio'ob seeba'an, ka' letio'ob ma' u yojeelo'ob.

It will come to them suddenly, while they are unaware.

فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**26:203** Ka' kun u ya'alo'ob: Ts'aabil wa to'on pa'atalil?

Then they will say, “Are we given any respite?”

فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ

**26:204** Ku kaxtiko'ob waaj u séebbesiko'ob K yaayajil?

Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?

أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

**26:205** A wilaj waaj — wa To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ki' oolal ichil ja'abo'ob.

Have you considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for some years.

أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ

**26:206** Ka' le ba'ax promesa'ab ti' letio'ob taal ti' letio'ob.

Then there comes to them what they were promised.

ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

**26:207** U ki' oolalo'ob ma' kun u aantik letio'ob.

Of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments?

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

**26:208** To'on ma' k k'aasbesaj mix junp'eel kaaj wa mina'an ti' aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

Never did We destroy a town, but it had warners.

وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

**26:209** Bey junp'eel k'a'ajsaj — yeetel To'on mix bik'in aj ma' toh oolon.

As a reminder—We are never unjust.

ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

**26:210** Yeetel le kisino'ob ma' tu ye'esajo'ob leti'.

It was not the devils that revealed it.

وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ

**26:211** Ma' u ti'al leti'ob, mix yaan u muuk'o'ob ti' lelo'.

It is not in their interests, nor in their power.

وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

**26:212** Letio'ob kala'ano'ob ti' u'uyaj.

They are barred from hearing.

إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ

**26:213** Beey tuuno' ma' a k'aatik mix uláak' k'uj u laak' ti' Allah, ma' a p'atal ichil le maaxo'ob k'uchbesa'ano'ob k'aas.

So do not pray to another god with God, else you will be of those tormented.

فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

**26:214** Yeetel k'a'aybes a'almajt'aan ti' a laak'tsilo'ob maas naats'.

And warn your close relatives.

وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ

**26:215** Yeetel e'es a ch'a' oolal ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob ku ts'ayiko'ob teech.

And lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you.

وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**26:216** Wa ma' tu yu'ubiko'ob a t'aan, a'ale: Teen mina'an in kuuch ichil ba'ax a beetike'ex.

And if they disobey you, say, “I am innocent of what you do.”

فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

**26:217** Yeetel ts'a a k'ub oolal yook'ol le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

And put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful.

وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

**26:218** Máax ku yilik teech ka' a líik'il.

He Who sees you when you rise.

ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

**26:219** Yeetel a péeksilo'ob ichil le maaxo'ob ku xoolano'ob.

And your devotions amidst the worshipers.

وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

**26:220** Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Na'at.

He is indeed the Hearer, the Aware.

إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**26:221** In tsikbesik wa te'ex yook'ol máax ku éemelo'ob le kisino'ob?

Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ

**26:222** Ku éemelo'ob yook'ol tulakal aj tuus aj keban.

They descend upon every sinful liar.

تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

**26:223** Ku ts'aiko'ob xikin, yeetel u ya'abil letio'ob aj tuuso'ob.

They give ear, and most of them are liars.

يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَـٰذِبُونَ

**26:224** Yeetel le aj ts'íib t'aan ki'ichpamo'ob — le aj saatal beelo'ob ku ts'ayiko'ob letio'ob.

And as for the poets—the deviators follow them.

وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ

**26:225** Ma' wa a wilik tumen ku xíimbalo'ob ichil tulakal jáal ja'ob?

Do you not see how they ramble in every style?

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

**26:226** Yeetel tumen ku ya'aliko'ob ba'ax ma' ku beetiko'ob.

And how they say what they do not do?

وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ

**26:227** Cheen le maaxo'ob tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob, tu beeto'ob meyajo'ob toh, ku k'a'ajsiko'ob Allah ya'ab, yeetel ku náajalo'ob ka' ts'o'ok u beetbilo'ob ma' toh. Yeetel le aj ma' toh oolo'ob kun u yojelo'ob tu'ux kun suutbesa'ako'ob.

Except for those who believe, and do good deeds, and remember God frequently, and defend themselves after they are wronged. As for those who do wrong, they will know by what overturning they will be overturned.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

## 27. The Ants

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**27:1** Ta, Seen. Lela'ob u chiikulo'ob le Quran, junp'eel aanalte' ku chiikbesik ba'alo'ob.

Ta, Seen. These are the Signs of the Quran—a book that makes things clear.

طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

**27:2** Chiikbesajil beel yeetel uts tsikbal ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Guidance and good news for the believers.

هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**27:3** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob le payalchi'o', ku ts'aiko'ob siibal sáansamal, yeetel jaaj u yojelo'ob le u laak' kuxtalo'.

Those who observe the prayers, and give charity regularly, and are certain of the Hereafter.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

**27:4** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le u laak' kuxtalo': To'on k beetaj u meyajo'ob bey uts ti' letio'ob, beey tuuno' ku xíimbalo'ob ma' yaan u beelo'ob.

As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter: We made their deeds appear good to them, so they wander aimlessly.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

**27:5** Letio'ob le maaxo'ob kun k'amik le k'aas yaayajil, yeetel ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' letio'ob le maas ku sa'atalo'ob ichil tulakal.

It is they who will receive the grievous punishment—and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ

**27:6** Teech ku k'amik le Quran ti' jun tul Aj Na'at Tulakal, Aj Ojel Tulakal.

You are receiving the Quran from an All-Wise, All-Knowing.

وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

**27:7** Ka' Moses tu ya'alaj ti' u láako'ob: Tu yilaj junp'eel k'aak'. Kun in taas te'ex tsikbal ti' leti', wa kun in taas te'ex junp'eel xóot' k'aak' ku jóok'ol, utia'al a k'íinankile'ex.

When Moses said to his family, “I have glimpsed a fire. I will bring you some news from it; or bring you a firebrand, that you may warm yourselves.”

إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

**27:8** Ka' k'uch ti' leti', tu t'aana'al: Ki'ichpam le máax yaan ichil le k'aak'o', yeetel le máax yaan tu bak'pach, yeetel ki'ichpam Allah, u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Then, when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is He who is within the fire, and He who is around it, and glorified be God, Lord of the Worlds.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**27:9** Moses, Teen Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

O Moses, it is I, God, the Almighty, the Wise.

يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**27:10** Puul a xuulub. Ka' tu yilaj ku níikil bey wa jun tul jinn, tu sutaj u paach ma' tu paakat paach. Moses, ma' a saajkil; le tuuxtbilo'ob ma' ku saajko'ob tu taan Teen.

Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it quivering, as though it were a demon, he turned around not looking back. “O Moses, do not fear; the messengers do not fear in My presence.

وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

**27:11** Ba'ale' máax tu beetaj k'aas, ka tu helaj uts tu kúuchil k'aas, Teen Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

But whoever has done wrong, and then substituted goodness in place of evil. I am Forgiving and Merciful.

إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**27:12** Ook a k'ab ichil a búukil, kun jóok'ol sak, mina'an u k'oja'anil — ichil bolonp'eel chiikulo'ob ti' Pharaoh yeetel u maako'ob, tumen letio'ob maako'ob aj kebano'ob.

Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish—among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are immoral people.”

وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَـٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

**27:13** Ka' K chiikulo'on e'esik saasil k'ucho'ob ti' letio'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' tuus saasil.

Yet when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is obvious witchcraft.”

فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**27:14** Tu p'ektajo'ob letio'ob, kex u pixano'ob jaaj u yojelo'ob, tumen k'aas oolal yeetel nojbe'enil. Il bey u ts'ook u kuxtal le aj k'aasbesajo'ob.

And they rejected them, although their souls were certain of them, out of wickedness and pride. So see how the outcome was for the mischief-makers.

وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

**27:15** To'on k ts'aaj ti' David yeetel Solomon na'at. Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, le máax tu ya'abiltajo'on yook'ol ya'ab u palilo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And We gave David and Solomon knowledge. They said, “Praise God, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**27:16** Solomon tu ch'a'aj u kúuchil David. Tu ya'alaj: Maako'ob, To'on e'esa'abik t'aan ch'íich'o'ob, yeetel ts'aabil ti' to'on ti' tulakal ba'al. Lela' jaaj junp'eel ki'ichpam siibal.

And Solomon succeeded David. He said, “O people, we were taught the language of birds, and we were given from everything. This is indeed a real blessing.”

وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**27:17** Ti' Solomon muuch'ulo'ob u aj ba'atelilo'ob: jinno'ob, wiiniko'ob, yeetel ch'íich'o'ob — tulakal p'ataano'ob ichil ma'alob jets'.

To the service of Solomon were mobilized his troops of sprites, and men, and birds—all held in strict order.

وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

**27:18** Tak ka' k'ucho'ob yook'ol u Jáal Ja'il Siniko'ob, jun tul sinik tu ya'alaj: Siniko'ob, oko'ex ta wotochile'ex, ma' u yaajbesike'ex Solomon yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Until, when they came upon the Valley of Ants, an ant said, “O ants! Go into your nests, lest Solomon and his troops crush you without noticing.”

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**27:19** Tu che'ejtaj yeetel tu beetaj che'ej tumen u t'aano'ob, tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, chiikbes in beel utia'al in ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan ti' a siibalo'ob ta ts'aaj teen yeetel in taata'ob, yeetel utia'al in beetik uts meyajo'ob ku ya'ankuntik Teech. Ooksen teen, tumen a yatzil, ichil u muuch' a palilo'ob aj toh oolo'ob.

He smiled and laughed at her words, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for the blessings you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good works that please You. And admit me, by Your grace, into the company of Your virtuous servants.”

فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**27:20** Tu xíixtaj le ch'íich'o'ob, tu ya'alaj: Ba'ax teen ma' kin wilik le abubilla? Wa yaan ichil le ma' k'ucho'obo'?

Then he inspected the birds, and said, “Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?

وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ

**27:21** Kun in ts'aik ti' leti' junp'eel chich yaayajil, wa kun in kinsik leti', wa ma' tu taasik teen junp'eel utsil a'albal jaaj.

I will punish him most severely, or slay him, unless he gives me a valid excuse.”

لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

**27:22** Ma' tu xáantal ya'ab. Tu ya'alaj: Tin wóojeltaj ba'ax ma' a wóojeli'. Tin taasaj teech ti' Sheba junp'eel tsikbal jaaj.

But he did not stay for long. He said, “I have learnt something you did not know. I have come to you from Sheba, with reliable information.

فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ

**27:23** Tin kaxtaj jun tul ko'olel ku jalbesik yook'ol letio'ob, ts'aabil ti' leti' ti' tulakal ba'al, yeetel yaan ti' leti' junp'eel noj ts'am.

I found a woman ruling over them, and she was given of everything, and she has a magnificent throne.

إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ

**27:24** Tin kaxtaj leti' yeetel u maako'ob ku kultiko'ob le k'iin, ma' Allah. Kisin tu beetaj u meyajo'ob bey uts ti' letio'ob, tu luk'saj letio'ob ti' le beel, beey tuuno' ma' ku chiikbesa'al u beelo'ob.

I found her and her people worshiping the sun, instead of God. Satan made their conduct appear good to them, and diverted them from the path, so they are not guided.

وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

**27:25** Wa cheen ku kultiko'ob Allah, máax ku jóok'sik saasil le ba'ax ta'aka'an ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel ku yojel ba'ax a ta'akike'ex yeetel ba'ax a e'esike'ex.

If only they would worship God, who brings to light the mysteries of the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

**27:26** Allah — mina'an k'uj cheen Leti', u Yuumil le Noj Ts'amo'.

God—There is no god but He, the Lord of the Sublime Throne.”

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩

**27:27** Tu ya'alaj: Kun k ilik, wa ta a'alaj jaaj, wa teech jun tul aj tuus.

He said, “We will see, whether you have spoken the truth, or whether you are a liar.

۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

**27:28** Bin yeetel le in ju'unila', ts'a ti' letio'ob; ka luk' taanilo'ob, il ba'ax kun u sutiko'ob.

Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them; then withdraw from them, and see how they respond.”

ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَـٰبِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ

**27:29** Tu ya'alaj: Aj tsikbalilo'ob, ts'aabil teen junp'eel ju'un uts oolal.

She said, “O Counselors, a gracious letter was delivered to me.

قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَـٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ

**27:30** Leti' ti' Solomon, yeetel leti': Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

It is from Solomon, and it is, ‘In the Name of God, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

**27:31** Ma' a nojbe'etike'ex teen, taale'ex ti' teen ichil u ts'aik a baa'ex ti' Allah.

Do not defy me, and come to me submissively.’”

أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

**27:32** Tu ya'alaj: Aj tsikbalilo'ob, ts'aake'ex teen tsikbal ichil le ba'ala'. Mix bik'in kin beetik xot t'aan wa ma' yane'ex teen.

She said, “O counselors, advise me in this matter of mine. I never make a decision unless you are present.”

قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ

**27:33** Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on maako'ob yaan k muuk', yeetel noj sajakil, ba'ale' le xot t'aan a ti'al, beey tuuno' il ba'ax a k'aat a a'alik.

They said, “We are a people of might and great courage, but the decision is yours, so consider what you wish to command.”

قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ

**27:34** Tu ya'alaj: Ka' ajawilo'ob ku oko'ob junp'eel kaaj, ku k'aasbesiko'ob, ku beetiko'ob u maako'ob nojbe'en bey p'ekbilo'ob. Beey ku beetiko'ob láayli'.

She said, “When kings enter a city, they devastate it, and subjugate its dignified people. Thus they always do.

قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

**27:35** Kin túuxtik ti' letio'ob junp'eel siibal, kun in ilik ba'ax kun u sutiko'ob le maaxo'ob túuxta'ano'ob.

I am sending them a gift, and will see what the envoys bring back.”

وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

**27:36** Ka' k'uch ti' Solomon, tu ya'alaj: A ts'aike'ex teen taak'in? Ba'ax Allah tu ts'aaj teen maas uts ti' ba'ax tu ts'aaj te'ex. Cheen te'exe' ku ki'imaktal a woole'ex yeetel a siibale'ex.

When he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you supplying me with money? What God has given me is better than what He has given you. It is you who delight in your gift.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ

**27:37** Suut ti' letio'ob. Kun k taal yook'ol letio'ob yeetel aj ba'atelilo'ob ma' béeytal u yáantiko'ob, kun k jóok'sik letio'ob teelo', p'ekbilo'ob yeetel ch'eenebilo'ob.

Go back to them. We will come upon them with troops they cannot resist; and we will expel them from there, disgraced and humiliated.”

ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ

**27:38** Tu ya'alaj: Noj máako'ob, máax ichile'ex kun taasik teen u ts'am ka'ach ma' ku taalo'ob ti' teen ichil u ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob ti' Allah?

He said, “O notables, which one of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?”

قَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

**27:39** Jun tul chich jinn tu ya'alaj: Kun in taasik ti' teech ka'ach ma' ka líikech ti' a kúuchil. Teen chich yeetel jaaj utia'al beetik.

An imp of the sprites said, “I will bring it to you before you rise from your seat. I am strong and reliable enough to do it.”

قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ

**27:40** Le máax yaan ti' na'at ti' le Aanalte'o' tu ya'alaj: Kun in taasik ti' teech ka'ach ma' u suut a wich ti' teech. Ka' tu yilaj jets'a'an tu taan, tu ya'alaj: Lela' ti' u yatzil in Yuumtsil, utia'al u ts'aik teen prueba, wa kin ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan wa ma'. Máax ku ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan, ku ts'aik ti' u baaj; ba'ale' máax ma' tu ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan — in Yuumtsil mina'an u k'áat ti' mixba'al, Aj Siibal Ool.

He who had knowledge from the Book said, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” And when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is from the grace of my Lord, to test me, whether I am grateful or ungrateful. He who is grateful, his gratitude is to his own credit; but he who is ungrateful—my Lord is Independent and Generous.”

قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ

**27:41** Tu ya'alaj: Hele'ex u ts'am ti' leti', kun k ilik wa kun chiikbesa'ak u beel, wa ku p'atal ichil le ma' chiikbesa'an u beelo'obo'.

He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided, or remains one of the misguided.”

قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

**27:42** Ka' k'uch, a'ala'ab ti' leti': Bey a ts'ama'? Tu ya'alaj: Bey wa leti'ile'. To'one' ts'aabil na'at ka'ach ma' leti', yeetel To'on k ts'aaj k baaj ti' Allah.

When she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.” “We were given knowledge before her, and we were submissive.”

فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ

**27:43** Ba'ale' tu kala'antaj ba'ax ku kultik tu tséel Allah; leti' ichil junp'eel kaaj aj ma' oksaj oolo'ob.

But she was prevented by what she worshiped besides God; she belonged to a disbelieving people.

وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَـٰفِرِينَ

**27:44** A'ala'ab ti' leti': Ookeen ichil le noj naj. Ka' tu yilaj, tu tuukultaj bey junp'eel noj ja', tu jóok'saj u nook' tu yooko'ob. Tu ya'alaj: Leti' junp'eel noj naj beeta'an yeetel vidrio. Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, tin beetaj k'aas ti' in baaj, tin ts'aaj in baaj, yeetel Solomon, ti' Allah, u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

It was said to her, “Go inside the palace.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond, and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a palace paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have done wrong to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon, to God, Lord of the Worlds.”

قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**27:45** To'on k túuxtaj ti' Thamood u sucu'un Saleh: Kulte'ex Allah. Ba'ale' letio'ob ka'ap'eel muuch'o'ob ku ba'ateliko'ob.

And We sent to Thamood their brother Saleh: “Worship God.” But they became two disputing factions.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

**27:46** Tu ya'alaj: In maako'ob, ba'ax teen a séeb beetike'ex k'aas ma' uts? Wa cheen ka a k'áate'ex ka' Allah u sa'ates a sipile'ex, utia'al ka' a k'ame'ex yatzil.

He said, “O my people, why are you quick to do evil rather than good? If only you would seek God’s forgiveness, so that you may be shown mercy.”

قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

**27:47** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K tuukultik teech bey k'aas chiikul, yeetel le maaxo'ob yéetenech. Tu ya'alaj: A chiikule'ex yeetel Allah. Jaaj, te'exe' junp'eel kaaj ku ts'aabal prueba te'ex.

They said, “We consider you an ill omen, and those with you.” He said, “Your omen is with God. In fact, you are a people being tested.”

قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَـٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ

**27:48** Ichil le kaajo' yaan bolon tul máako'ob junp'eel muuch' ku k'aasbesiko'ob ichil le luum, ma' tu beetiko'ob uts.

In the city was a gang of nine who made mischief in the land and did no good.

وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

**27:49** Tu ya'alajo'ob: A'ale'ex tumen Allah ichile'ex ka' k jats'ik leti' yeetel u láako'ob ak'ab, ka ka' k a'alik ti' u aj kanan: Ma' k ilaj u kíimil u láako'ob, yeetel To'on aj jaajo'on.

They said, “Swear by God to one another that we will attack him and his family by night, and then tell his guardian, 'We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are being truthful.'“

قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

**27:50** Tu tuukultajo'ob junp'eel tuukul, To'on k tuukultaj junp'eel tuukul, ba'ale' ma' tu yojelo'ob.

They planned a plan, and We planned a plan, but they did not notice.

وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**27:51** Il bey úuch u ts'ook u tuukulo'ob; To'on k k'aasbesaj letio'ob yeetel u maako'ob, tulakal.

So note the outcome of their planning; We destroyed them and their people, altogether.

فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**27:52** Lela'ob u yotocho'ob, saatalo'ob, tumen u k'aas oolalo'ob. Yaan jaaj junp'eel chiikul ichil lelo' ti' maako'ob ku yojelo'ob.

Here are their homes, in ruins, on account of their iniquities. Surely in this is a sign for people who know.

فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ

**27:53** To'on k a'antaj le maaxo'ob tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh.

And We saved those who believed and were pious.

وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ

**27:54** Yeetel Lot, ka' tu ya'alaj ti' u maako'ob: A beetike'ex le k'aas meyaj yeetel a wiche'ex jóok'aano'ob?

And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit lewdness with open eyes?

وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

**27:55** A taale'ex ti' wiiniko'ob yeetel k'áat óol, ma' ko'olelo'ob? Jaaj, te'exe' maako'ob mina'an a na'ate'ex.

Do you lust after men instead of women? You are truly ignorant people.”

أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ

**27:56** Ba'ale' mixba'al u núuk u maako'ob cheen u ya'aliko'ob: Jóok'se'ex u láako'ob Lot ti' a kaajile'ex. Letio'ob maako'ob k'áal oolo'ob.

But the only response of his people was to say, “Expel the family of Lot from your town. They are purist people.”

۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ

**27:57** Beey tuuno' To'on k a'antaj leti' yeetel u láako'ob, cheen ma' u atan, máax To'on k jets'aj kun p'atal ichil le ku suunajo'ob paach.

So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be among the laggards.

فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَـٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

**27:58** To'on k k'axaj yook'ol letio'ob junp'eel k'áax ja'. K'aas le k'áax ja' ti' le maaxo'ob taanil k'a'aya'ano'ob.

And We rained upon them a rain. Miserable was the rain of those forewarned.

وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

**27:59** A'ale: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, yeetel jets' óolal yook'ol u palilo'ob tu yéeyaj. Maas uts Allah, wa ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob tu tséel?

Say, “Praise God, and peace be upon His servants whom He has selected. Is God better, or what they associate?”

قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**27:60** Wa máax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, tu k'axaj ja' te'ex ti' ka'an? Yeetel leti' To'on k jóok'sik pak'alo'ob yaan ki'ichpam, máax u che'o'ob ma' béeytal a jóok'sike'ex. Yaan wa u laak' k'uj yeetel Allah? Ba'ale' letio'ob junp'eel kaaj ku beetiko'ob bey p'éel.

Or, who created the heavens and the earth, and rains down water from the sky for you? With it We produce gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have produced. Is there another god with God? But they are a people who equate.

أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ

**27:61** Wa máax tu beetaj le luum utia'al kuxtal, tu beetaj ja'ob ku xíimbal ichil, tu jets'aj wits'o'ob yook'ol, tu jets'aj junp'eel ba'al ku xóotik ichil le ka'ap'eel k'aak'nabo'ob? Yaan wa u laak' k'uj yeetel Allah? Ba'ale' u ya'abil ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Or, who made the earth habitable, and made rivers flow through it, and set mountains on it, and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there another god with God? But most of them do not know.

أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَـٰلَهَآ أَنْهَـٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**27:62** Wa máax ku núukik le máax yaan u k'áat óol ka' ku payalchi'tik Leti', ku luk'sik le k'aas, ku beetik te'ex aj ch'a' kúuchil ichil luum? Yaan wa u laak' k'uj yeetel Allah? Jach jump'íit a k'a'ajsike'ex.

Or, who answers the one in need when he prays to Him, and relieves adversity, and makes you successors on earth? Is there another god with God? How hardly you pay attention.

أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

**27:63** Wa máax ku chiikbesik a beele'ex ichil u éek'joch'e'enil luum yeetel k'aak'nab, yeetel máax ku túuxtik iik'o'ob bey tsikbalilo'ob u yatzil? Yaan wa u laak' k'uj yeetel Allah? Jach ka'anal Allah, yook'ol ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob tu tséel.

Or, who guides you through the darkness of land and sea, and who sends the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there another god with God? Most exalted is God, above what they associate.

أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**27:64** Wa máax ku káajsik le beetbil, ka tu suutbesaj, yeetel máax ku ts'aik te'ex kuxtal ti' ka'an yeetel luum? Yaan wa u laak' k'uj yeetel Allah? A'ale: Taase'ex a chiikule'ex, wa te'exe' aj jaaje'ex.

Or, who originates the creation and then repeats it, and who gives you livelihood from the sky and the earth? Is there another god with God? Say, “Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.”

أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**27:65** A'ale: Mix máax ichil ka'ano'ob wa luum ku yojel le ma' ila'ano' cheen Allah; ma' tu yojelo'ob bik'in kun líik'sa'ako'ob.

Say, “No one in the heavens or on earth knows the future except God; and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”

قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

**27:66** Jaaj, u na'ato'ob ti' le u laak' kuxtalo' keetbesa'ano'ob. Jaaj, yaan tuukul ka'ap'eel ti' letio'ob. Jaaj, ch'opo'ob ti' leti'.

In fact, their knowledge of the Hereafter is confused. In fact, they are in doubt about it. In fact, they are blind to it.

بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ

**27:67** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Ka' To'on k p'ataj bey luum, yeetel k ch'iibalo'ob, kun jóok'sa'ako'on?

Those who disbelieve say, “When we have become dust, and our ancestors, shall we be brought out?

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ

**27:68** Promesaa'ab ti' to'on lelo' ka'ach, to'on yeetel k ch'iibalo'ob — lela'ob mixba'al cheen u tsikbalilo'ob le úuchbeno'ob.

We were promised that before, we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”

لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**27:69** A'ale: Xíimbale'ex ichil luum, ile'ex bey úuch u ts'ook le aj kebano'ob.

Say, travel through the earth, and observe the fate of the guilty.”

قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**27:70** Ma' a ok'om ooltal yook'ol letio'ob, ma' kala'antal a puksi'ik'al tumen ba'ax ku tuukultiko'ob.

But do not grieve over them, and do not be troubled by what they plot.

وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

**27:71** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Bik'in le promesa, wa te'exe' aj jaaje'ex?

And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”

وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**27:72** A'ale: Je'el u béeytal wa jun jaats ti' ba'ax a séeb k'áatike'ex ts'o'ok u naats'tal te'ex.

Say, “Perhaps some of what you are impatient for has drawn near.”

قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

**27:73** A Yuumtsil Aj Siibal ti' wiiniko'ob, ba'ale' u ya'abil ma' tu ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan.

Your Lord is gracious towards humanity, but most of them are not thankful.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**27:74** A Yuumtsil ku yojel ba'ax u puksi'ik'alo'ob ku ta'akiko'ob, yeetel ba'ax ku e'esiko'ob.

And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal.

وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

**27:75** Mix junp'eel ba'ax ta'aka'an ichil ka'an yeetel luum, cheen ichil junp'eel Aanalte' ku chiikbesik.

There is no mystery in the heaven and the earth, but it is in a Clear Book.

وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ

**27:76** Le Quranla' ku tsikbaltik ti' u Paalalo'ob Israel u ya'abil ba'ax ku keext'aaniko'ob yook'ol.

This Quran relates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

**27:77** Leti' chiikbesajil beel yeetel yatzil ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**27:78** A Yuumtsil kun xot t'aan ichil letio'ob tumen u na'at. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ojel Tulakal.

Your Lord will judge between them by His wisdom. He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**27:79** Beey tuuno' ts'a a wóol ti' Allah. Teech yook'ol le jaaj ku chiikbesik.

So rely on God. You are upon the clear truth.

فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ

**27:80** Ma' béeytal a beetik u yu'ubo'ob le kíimeno'ob, mix a beetik u yu'ubo'ob le kóoko'ob le t'aan wa ku sutiko'ob u paacho'ob ku puuts'ulo'ob.

You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call if they turn their backs and flee.

إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

**27:81** Mix béeytal a chiikbesik u beel le ch'opo'ob ti' u sa'atalo'ob. Ma' béeytal a beetik u yu'ub máax cheen le maaxo'ob ku okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' K chiikulo'on; letio'ob musulmano'ob.

Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can make no one listen, except those who believe in Our verses; for they are Muslims.

وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

**27:82** Ka' le T'aan ku yúuchul yook'ol letio'ob, kun k jóok'sik ti' letio'ob ti' luum jun tul ba'alche' kun t'aan ti' letio'ob, tumen wiiniko'ob ma' jaaj u yojelo'ob K chiikulo'on.

And when the Word has fallen on them, We will bring out for them from the earth a creature which will say to them that the people are uncertain of Our revelations.

۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ

**27:83** Ichil le K'iin ken To'on k muuch'ik ti' tulakal kaaj junp'eel muuch' ichil le maaxo'ob tu p'ektajo'ob K chiikulo'on, ku kala'antalo'ob.

On the Day when We gather from every community a group of those who rejected Our revelations; and they will be restrained.

وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

**27:84** Tak ka' k'ucho'ob, kun ya'alik: A p'ektaje'ex In chiikulo'ob ma' ta na'ate'ex letio'ob yeetel na'at? Wa ba'ax ka a beetike'ex ka'ach?

Until, when they arrive, He will say, “Did you reject My revelations without comprehending them? Or what is it you were doing?”

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**27:85** Le T'aan kun yúuchul yook'ol letio'ob tumen u k'aas beetiko'ob, ma' kun t'aano'ob.

The Word will come down upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak.

وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

**27:86** Ma' wa tu yiliko'ob To'on k beetaj le ak'ab utia'al u je'elelo'ob ichil, yeetel le k'iin utia'al ila'ak? Yaan jaaj chiikulo'ob ichil lelo' ti' maako'ob ku okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

Do they not see that We made the night for them to rest therein, and the day for visibility? Surely in that are signs for people who believe.

أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**27:87** Ichil le K'iin ken t'aba'ak le trompeta, tulakal máax ichil ka'ano'ob yeetel luum kun saajko'ob, cheen máax Allah ku k'aat; tulakal kun taalo'ob tu taan ichil ch'eenebil.

On the Day when the Trumpet is blown, everyone in the heavens and the earth will be horrified, except whomever God wills; and everyone will come before Him in humility.

وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ

**27:88** A wilik le wits'o'ob, a tuukultik jets'a'ano'ob, ba'ale' ku máano'ob bey u máan muyalo'ob — u meyaj Allah, máax tu beetaj tulakal ba'al ma'alob jaaj. Leti' Aj Ojel Tulakal ti' ba'ax a beetike'ex.

And you see the mountains, and imagine them fixed, yet they pass, as the passing of the clouds—the making of God, who has perfected everything. He is fully Informed of what you do.

وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

**27:89** Máax ku taasik junp'eel uts meyaj kun k'amik maas uts ti' leti' — yeetel letio'ob kun p'atalo'ob kananil ichil u saajkil le K'iino'.

Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it—and they will be safe from the horrors of that Day.

مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ

**27:90** Ba'ale' máax ku taasik k'aas — u taano'ob kun pich'a'ako'ob ichil le K'aak'. Kun bo'ota'ake'ex wa ma' cheen utia'al ba'ax a beetmaje'ex ka'ach?

But whoever brings evil—their faces will be tumbled into the Fire. Will you be rewarded except for what you used to do?

وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**27:91** A'almajt'aan teen in kultik u Yuumtsil le kaaja', máax tu beetaj kili'ich, yeetel Leti' u ti'al tulakal ba'al; a'almajt'aan teen in p'atal ichil le musulmano'ob.

“I was commanded to worship the Lord of this town, who has sanctified it, and to Whom everything belongs; and I was commanded to be of those who submit.

إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**27:92** Yeetel in tsikbaltik le Quran. Máax ku chiikbesa'al u beel — ku chiikbesa'al utia'al u baaj. Máax ku sa'atal, A'ale: Teen cheen jun tul ichil le aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

And to recite the Quran.” Whoever is guided—is guided to his own advantage. And whoever goes astray, then say, “I am one of the warners.”

وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ

**27:93** A'ale: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah; Leti' kun e'esik te'ex u chiikulo'ob, kun a wóojelte'ex letio'ob. A Yuumtsil ma' tu tu'ubisik ba'ax a beetike'ex.

And say, “Praise belongs to God; He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.”

وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

## 28. The Narrations

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**28:1** Ta, Seen, Meem.

Ta, Seen, Meem.

طسٓمٓ

**28:2** Lela'ob u chiikulo'ob le Aanalte' ku chiikbesik.

These are the Verses of the Clear Book.

تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

**28:3** To'on k tsikbaltik teech ti' u tsikbalil Moses yeetel Pharaoh — ichil jaaj — ti' maako'ob ku okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

We narrate to you from the history of Moses and Pharaoh—in truth—for people who believe.

نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**28:4** Pharaoh tu nojbe'etaj u baaj ichil le luum, tu t'ooxaj u maako'ob ichil muuch'o'ob. Tu yaajbesaj junp'eel muuch' ichilo'ob, ku kinsik u paalalo'ob xiib, ku p'atiko'ob kuxtal u paalalo'ob ko'olel. Leti' jaaj jun tul aj k'aasbesaj.

Pharaoh exalted himself in the land, and divided its people into factions. He persecuted a group of them, slaughtering their sons, while sparing their daughters. He was truly a corrupter.

إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةً مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

**28:5** Ba'ale' To'on k k'aat k ts'aik uts ti' le maaxo'ob yaajbesa'ano'ob ichil le luum, k beetik letio'ob aj jalbeso'ob, k beetik letio'ob le aj ch'a' paachilo'ob.

But We desired to favor those who were oppressed in the land, and to make them leaders, and to make them the inheritors.

وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
