**28:6** K jets'ik letio'ob ichil le luum; k e'esik ti' Pharaoh, Hamaan, yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob, le ba'ax ku saajkiko'ob ti' letio'ob.

And to establish them in the land; and to show Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops, the very thing they feared.

وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ

**28:7** To'on k e'esaj na'at ti' u na' Moses: Chu'uyens a paal; ka' a saajkil ti' leti', puul ichil le ja', ma' a saajkil, ma' a ok'om ooltal; To'on kun k suutbesik leti' ti' teech, k beetik leti' jun tul ichil le tuuxtbilo'ob.

We inspired the mother of Moses: “Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear, nor grieve; We will return him to you, and make him one of the messengers.”

وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**28:8** U láako'ob Pharaoh tu ch'a'ajo'ob leti', utia'al u p'atal ti' letio'ob bey aj p'ek yeetel ok'om oolal. Pharaoh, Hamaan, yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob aj kebano'ob.

Pharaoh’s household picked him up, to be an opponent and a sorrow for them. Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops were sinners.

فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰطِـِٔينَ

**28:9** U atan Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Junp'eel ki'imak óolal ti' in wich yeetel a wich. Ma' a kinsike'ex; je'el u béeytal u yáantik to'on, wa k ch'a'ik leti' bey k paal. Ba'ale' ma' tu yojelo'ob ba'ax kun úuchul.

Pharaoh’s wife said, “An eye's delight for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.” But they did not foresee.

وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**28:10** U puksi'ik'al u na' Moses tu p'ataj mina'an mixba'al ichil. Kux óol úuch u e'esik leti', wa ma' To'on k chichbesaj u puksi'ik'al, utia'al u p'atal aj oksaj ool.

The heart of Moses’ mother became vacant. She was about to disclose him, had We not steadied her heart, that she may remain a believer.

وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَـٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**28:11** Tu ya'alaj ti' u kiik: Ts'ay u paach. Tu yilaj leti' ti' náach, ma' tu yojelo'ob.

She said to his sister, “Trail him.” So she watched him from afar, and they were unaware.

وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**28:12** To'on k beetaj ma' cha'bil ti' leti' le chu'uyensajo'ob taanil. Tu ya'alaj: Kin a'alik te'ex junp'eel láako'ob ku kananko'ob leti' utia'al te'ex, ku kananko'ob leti' yeetel uts oolal?

We forbade him breastfeeding at first. So she said, “Shall I tell you about a family that can raise him for you, and will look after him?”

۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ

**28:13** Beey tuuno' To'on k suutbesaj leti' ti' u na', utia'al u ki'imaktal u wich, ma' u ok'om ooltal, u yojel u promesa Allah jaaj. Ba'ale' u ya'abil ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Thus We returned him to his mother, that she may be comforted, and not grieve, and know that God’s promise is true. But most of them do not know.

فَرَدَدْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**28:14** Ka' k'uch u ch'íijil, jets'a'an, To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' xot t'aan yeetel na'at. Beey To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

And when he reached his maturity, and became established, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward the virtuous.

وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**28:15** Jun k'iin tu ook ichil le kaaj, ma' ila'an tumen u maako'ob. Tu kaxtaj ka'ap'el wiiniko'ob ku ba'ateliko'ob — jun tul ti' u muuch', jun tul ti' u p'eko'ob. Le máax ti' u muuch' tu k'áataj u yáanta'al ti' le máax ti' u p'eko'ob; Moses tu looxaj leti', tu ts'o'okesaj u kuxtal. Tu ya'alaj: Lela' ti' u meyaj Kisin; leti' junp'eel aj p'ek ku sa'atik beel saasil.

Once he entered the city, unnoticed by its people. He found in it two men fighting—one of his own sect, and one from his enemies. The one of his sect solicited his assistance against the one from his enemies; so Moses punched him, and put an end to him. He said, “This is of Satan's doing; he is an enemy that openly misleads.”

وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَـٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَـٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَـٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّ مُّضِلٌّ مُّبِينٌ

**28:16** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, tin beetaj k'aas ti' in baaj, sa'ates in sipil. Tu sa'atesaj u sipil. Leti' Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.” So He forgave him. He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**28:17** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, tumen ta ts'aaj teen uts, mix bik'in kun in yáantik le aj kebano'ob.

He said, “My Lord, in as much as you have favored me, I will never be a supporter of the criminals.”

قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**28:18** U ja'atskab k'iinil, tu xíimbal ichil le kaaj, saajak yeetel ku paakat paach, ka' le máax tu k'áataj u yáanta'al sáamal tu awat ti' leti'. Moses tu ya'alaj ti': Teech saasil jun tul aj ba'atel.

The next morning, he went about in the city, fearful and vigilant, when the man who had sought his assistance the day before was shouting out to him. Moses said to him, “You are clearly a troublemaker.”

فَأَصْبَحَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ

**28:19** Ka' k'áat u jats'ik le máax u p'eko'ob ka'ap'éele'ob, tu ya'alaj: Moses, a k'aat a kinsiken, bey ta kinsaj jun tul máax sáamal? Cheen a k'aat p'atal bey aj nojbe'etik ichil luum, ma' a k'aat p'atal bey aj beetik jets' óolal.

As he was about to strike the one who was their enemy, he said, “O Moses, do you intend to kill me, as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a bully in the land, and do not want to be a peacemaker.”

فَلَمَّآ أَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَبْطِشَ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَتُرِيدُ أَن تَقْتُلَنِى كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۢا بِٱلْأَمْسِ ۖ إِن تُرِيدُ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِينَ

**28:20** Jun tul wiinik taal ti' u ts'ook le kaaj ku áalkab. Tu ya'alaj: Moses, le aj jalbeso'ob ku tuukultiko'ob a kinsile'ex, luk' teelo'; teen kin ts'aik teech uts tsikbal.

And a man came from the farthest part of the city running. He said, “O Moses, the authorities are considering killing you, so leave; I am giving you good advice.”

وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَٱخْرُجْ إِنِّى لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ

**28:21** Tu jóok'aj, saajak yeetel ku paakat paach. Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, luk's teen ti' le maako'ob aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

So he left, fearful and vigilant. He said, “My Lord, deliver me from the wrongdoing people.”

فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**28:22** Ka' tu bin tu paach Median, tu ya'alaj: Je'el u béeytal in Yuumtsil u chiikbesik in beel ti' le toh beel.

As he headed towards Median, he said, “Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the right way.”

وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

**28:23** Ka' k'uch ti' u ja'il Median, tu kaxtaj teelo' junp'eel muuch' wiiniko'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob ja', tu yilaj ka'ap'el ko'olelo'ob ku pa'atiko'ob tu tséel. Tu ya'alaj: Ba'ax a ba'ale'ex? Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ma' béeytal k ch'a'ik ja' tak ken luk'uko'ob le aj kanan tamano'ob, k taata jun tul nojo'ch máax jach úuchben.

And when he arrived at the waters of Median, he found there a crowd of people drawing water, and he noticed two women waiting on the side. He said, “What is the matter with you?” They said, “We cannot draw water until the shepherds depart, and our father is a very old man.”

وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ ۖ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا ۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِى حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُ ۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ

**28:24** Tu ch'a'aj ja' ti' letio'ob, ka tu sutaj u paach ti' le bo'oy, tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, teen óotsil ti' tulakal uts ka a ts'aik teen.

So he drew water for them, and then withdrew to the shade, and said, “My Lord, I am in dire need of whatever good you might send down to me.”

فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

**28:25** Jun tul ichil le ka'ap'el ko'olelo'ob taal ti' leti', ku xíimbal yeetel subtal oolal. Tu ya'alaj: In taata ku t'aanik teech, utia'al u bo'otik teech tumen ta ch'a'aj ja' ti' to'on. Ka' k'uch ti' leti', tu tsikbaltaj ti' leti' le tsikbal, tu ya'alaj: Ma' a saajkil, ta luk'sa'al ti' le maako'ob aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

Then, one of the two women approached him, walking bashfully. She said, “My father is calling you, to reward you for drawing water for us.” And when he came to him, and told him the story, he said, “Do not fear, you have escaped from the wrongdoing people.”

فَجَآءَتْهُ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا تَمْشِى عَلَى ٱسْتِحْيَآءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِى يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**28:26** Jun tul ichil le ka'ap'el ko'olelo'ob tu ya'alaj: Taata, meyajkunse; le maas uts aj meyaj ti' teech le chich yeetel jaaj.

One of the two women said, “Father, hire him; the best employee for you is the strong and trustworthy.”

قَالَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱسْتَـْٔجِرْهُ ۖ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ ٱسْتَـْٔجَرْتَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْأَمِينُ

**28:27** Tu ya'alaj: Kin k'aat in ts'aik teech kam nikte' yeetel jun tul ichil le ka'ap'el in paalalo'ob ko'olel, wa ka meyajtik teen waxakp'eel ja'ab. Wa ka chukbesik lajun, leti' a ti'al. Ma' kin k'aat in ts'aik teech talamil. Kun a kaxtiken, wa Allah ku k'aat, jun tul ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

He said, “I want to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, provided you work for me for eight years. But if you complete ten, that is up to you. I do not intend to impose any hardship on you. You will find me, God willing, one of the righteous.”

قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ٱبْنَتَىَّ هَـٰتَيْنِ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأْجُرَنِى ثَمَـٰنِىَ حِجَجٍ ۖ فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِندِكَ ۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ ۚ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**28:28** Tu ya'alaj: Ka p'atak bey ichil teen yeetel teech. Máakalmáak ichil le ka'ap'eel k'iin kin beetik, mix junp'eel k'aas kun úuchul teen; Allah testimonio yook'ol ba'ax k a'alik.

He said, “Let this be an agreement between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfill, there shall be no reprisal against me; and God is witness over what we say.”

قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ ۖ أَيَّمَا ٱلْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ عَلَىَّ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ

**28:29** Ka' Moses tu chukbesaj le k'iin, tu bin yeetel u láako'ob, tu yilaj junp'eel k'aak' tu tséel le Wits. Tu ya'alaj ti' u láako'ob: Pa'ate'ex waya', tu yilaj junp'eel k'aak'. Je'el u béeytal in taasik te'ex tsikbal teelo', wa junp'eel xóot' k'aak' ti' le k'aak'o', utia'al a k'íinankile'ex.

When Moses had completed the term, and departed with his family, he noticed a fire by the side of the Mount. He said to his family, “Stay here, I have glimpsed a fire. Perhaps I can bring you some information from there, or an ember from the fire, that you may warm yourselves.”

۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِۦٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

**28:30** Ka' k'uch teelo', tu t'aana'al ti' u noj tséel le jáal ja', ichil le ki'ichpam kuchil, ti' le che': Moses, Teen Allah, u Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

When he reached it, he was called from the right side of the valley, at the Blessed Spot, from the bush: “O Moses, it is I, God, the Lord of the Worlds.

فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ مِن شَـٰطِئِ ٱلْوَادِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ فِى ٱلْبُقْعَةِ ٱلْمُبَـٰرَكَةِ مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ أَن يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**28:31** Puul a xuulub. Ka' tu yilaj ku níikil bey wa jun tul jinn, tu sutaj u paach utia'al u puuts'ul, ma' tu paakat paach. Moses, taaleen táanil, ma' a saajkil; teech ichil le maaxo'ob yaan kananil.

Throw down your staff.” And when he saw it wiggling, as if it were possessed, he turned his back to flee, and did not look back. “O Moses, come forward, and do not fear, you are perfectly safe.

وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔامِنِينَ

**28:32** Ook a k'ab ichil a búukil, kun jóok'ol sak, mina'an u k'oja'anil. K'aax a k'ab ta tséel utia'al ma' a saajkil. Lela'ob ka'ap'eel chiikulo'ob ti' a Yuumtsil, ti' Pharaoh yeetel u noj máako'ob. Letio'ob jaaj maako'ob aj kebano'ob.

Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish. And press your arm to your side, against fear. These are two proofs from your Lord, to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. They are truly sinful people.”

ٱسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ وَٱضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهْبِ ۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرْهَـٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

**28:33** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, tin kinsaj jun tul ichilo'ob, kin saajkik u kinsiko'ob teen.

He said, “My Lord, I have killed one of them, and I fear they will kill me.

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

**28:34** In sucu'un Aaron, leti' maas uts u t'aan ti' teen, túuxt yeetel teen, utia'al u yáantiken, u jaajkuntik in t'aano'ob, tumen kin saajkik u p'ektiko'ob teen.

And my brother Aaron, he is more eloquent than me, so send him with me, to help me, and to confirm my words, for I fear they will reject me.”

وَأَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

**28:35** Tu ya'alaj: To'on kun k chichbesik a k'ab yeetel a sucu'un, To'on kun k ts'aik te'ex jalbesil, ma' kun u tuch'uliko'ob te'ex. Tumen K chiikulo'on, te'ex yeetel le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob te'ex kun p'atalo'ob aj náajalo'ob.

He said, “We will strengthen your arm with your brother, and We will give you authority, so they will not touch you. By virtue of Our signs, you and those who follow you will be the triumphant.”

قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَـٰنًا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا ۚ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

**28:36** Ka' Moses taal ti' letio'ob yeetel K chiikulo'on, saasilo'ob yeetel ku chiikbesiko'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' mixba'al cheen tuus beeta'an, mix bik'in To'on k u'uyaj beya' ti' k úuchben ch'iibalo'ob.

But when Moses came to them with Our signs, clear and manifest, they said, “This is nothing but fabricated magic, and We never heard of this from our ancestors of old.”

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّفْتَرًى وَمَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**28:37** Moses tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil maas ku yojel máax ku taasik chiikbesajil beel ti' Leti', yeetel máax kun yaan ti' u ts'ook u yotoch. Le aj ma' toh oolo'ob ma' kun náajalo'ob.

Moses said, “My Lord is well aware of him who brings guidance from Him, and him who will have the sequel of the abode. The wrongdoers will not succeed.”

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ مِنْ عِندِهِۦ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

**28:38** Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Noj máako'ob, ma' in wóojel mix k'uj ti' te'ex cheen teen. T'ab le luk utia'al teen, Hamaan, beet teen junp'eel noj naj ka'anal, utia'al in na'akal ti' u K'ujil Moses, kex kin tuukultik leti' aj tuus.

Pharaoh said, “O nobles, I know of no god for you other than me. So fire-up the bricks for me O Hamaan, and build me a tower, that I may ascend to the God of Moses, though I think he is a liar.”

وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرِى فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

**28:39** Leti' yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob tu nojbe'etajo'ob u baajo'ob ichil luum, mina'an jaaj ti'. Tu tuukultajo'ob ma' kun suutbesa'ako'ob ti' To'on.

He and his troops acted arrogantly in the land, with no justification. They thought they would not be returned to Us.

وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ

**28:40** To'on k ch'a'aj leti' yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob, k puulaj letio'ob ichil le k'aak'nab. Il bey úuch u ts'ook le aj yaajbesajo'ob.

So We seized him, and his troops, and We threw them into the sea. Observe, therefore, what was the end of the oppressors.

فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**28:41** To'on k beetaj letio'ob aj jalbeso'ob ku t'aaniko'ob ti' le K'aak'. Ichil u K'iinil Liksajil, ma' kun a'anta'ako'ob.

And We made them leaders calling to the Fire. And on Resurrection Day, they will not be saved.

وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

**28:42** To'on k ts'aaj paach letio'ob ichil le yook'ol kaabla' yeetel junp'eel p'ekbesaj. Ichil u K'iinil Liksajil, letio'ob ichil le p'ekbilo'ob.

And We pursued them in this world with a curse. And on Resurrection Day, they will be among the despised.

وَأَتْبَعْنَـٰهُمْ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَقْبُوحِينَ

**28:43** To'on k ts'aaj ti' Moses le kili'ich ju'uno' ka' To'on ts'o'ok k k'aasbesik le úuchben ch'iibalo'ob; bey junp'eel saasil ti' wiiniko'ob, chiikbesajil beel, yeetel yatzil, utia'al u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

We gave Moses the Scripture after We had annihilated the previous generations; as an illumination for mankind, and guidance, and mercy, so that they may remember.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**28:44** Ma' yanech ka'ach tu tséel chik'in, ka' To'on k a'almajt'aan ti' Moses, mix teech ichil le maaxo'ob tu yilajo'ob.

You were not on the Western Side when We decreed the command to Moses, nor were you among the witnesses.

وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ

**28:45** Ba'ale' To'on k jets'aj ya'ab ch'iibalo'ob, xáan úuch u kuxtalo'ob yook'ol letio'ob. Mix teech ichil u maako'ob Median, a tsikbaltik ti' letio'ob K chiikulo'on. Ba'ale' To'on láayli' k túuxtik tuuxtbilo'ob.

But We established many generations, and time took its toll on them. Nor were you among the people of Median, reciting Our revelations to them. But We kept sending messengers.

وَلَـٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

**28:46** Mix teech tu tséel le Wits ka' To'on k t'aanaj. Cheen bey yatzil ti' a Yuumtsil, utia'al a k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan ti' maako'ob mix jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan taal ti' letio'ob ka'ach ma' teech, utia'al u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

Nor were you by the side of the Mount when We proclaimed. Rather, it was a mercy from your Lord, that you may warn people who received no warner before you, so that they may take heed.

وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِن رَّحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**28:47** Wa ma' beyo', wa junp'eel talamil ku k'uchul ti' letio'ob tumen ba'ax u k'abo'ob tu beetajo'ob, kun u ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil, wa cheen ta túuxtaj ti' to'on jun tul tuuxtbil, k ts'ayik a chiikulo'ob, k p'atal ichil le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Otherwise, if a calamity befell them as a result of what their hands have perpetrated, they would say, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations, and been among the believers.”

وَلَوْلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**28:48** Ka' le jaaj taal ti' letio'ob ti' To'on, tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa cheen ts'aabil ti' leti' bey ba'ax ts'aabil ti' Moses ka'ach. Ma' wa tu p'ektajo'ob ba'ax ts'aabil ti' Moses úuchben? Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ka'ap'eel tuus ku yáantikubaajo'ob. Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on ma' k oksik k ool ti' ka'ap'éele'.

But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, “If only he was given the like of what was given to Moses.” Did they not disbelieve in what was given to Moses in the past? They said, “Two works of magic backing one another.” And they said, “We are disbelieving in both.”

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُوتِىَ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ قَالُوا۟ سِحْرَانِ تَظَـٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**28:49** A'ale: Taase'ex junp'eel kili'ich ju'un ti' Allah, maas ku chiikbesik beel ti' ka'ap'éele', kun in ts'ayik, wa te'exe' aj jaaje'ex.

Say, “Then bring a scripture from God, more conductive to guidance than both, and I will follow it, if you are truthful.”

قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَآ أَتَّبِعْهُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**28:50** Wa ma' tu núukiko'ob teech, ojel cheen ku ts'aiko'ob u k'áat óolo'ob. Máax maas saatal ti' máax ku ts'ayik u k'áat óol mina'an chiikbesajil beel ti' Allah? Allah ma' ku chiikbesik u beel le maako'ob aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

But if they fail to respond to you, know that they follow their fancies. And who is more lost than him who follows his fancy without guidance from God? God does not guide the unjust people.

فَإِن لَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكَ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**28:51** To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob le T'aan, utia'al u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

We have delivered the Word to them, that they may remember.

۞ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**28:52** Le maaxo'ob To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' ka'ach ma' leti', ku okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' leti'.

Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it believe in it.

ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ هُم بِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**28:53** Ka' ku tsikbalta'al ti' letio'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: K oksaj k ool ti' leti'; leti' le jaaj ti' k Yuumtsil; To'on musulmano'on ka'ach ma' leti'.

When it is recited to them, they say, “We have believed in it; it is the truth from our Lord; we were Muslims prior to it.”

وَإِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مُسْلِمِينَ

**28:54** Lela'ob kun ts'aabal ti' letio'ob u bo'olil ka'atéen, tumen p'ataano'ob chich óol; ku sutiko'ob k'aas yeetel uts; ti' ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob, ku ts'aiko'ob.

These will be given their reward twice, because they persevered; and they counter evil with good; and from Our provisions to them, they give.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

**28:55** Ka' ku yu'ubo'ob t'aan mina'an u yutsil, ku luk'ulo'ob ti', ku ya'aliko'ob: To'on k meyajo'on, te'ex a meyaje'ex; jets' óolal yook'ole'ex; ma' k k'aatik le mina'an na'ato'ob.

And when they hear vain talk, they avoid it, and say, “We have our deeds, and you have your deeds; peace be upon you; we do not desire the ignorant.”

وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ

**28:56** Ma' béeytal a chiikbesik u beel máax a yaabiltik, ba'ale' Allah ku chiikbesik u beel máax ku k'aat, Leti' le maas ku yojel ichil tulakal máaxo'ob chiikbesa'an u beelo'ob.

You cannot guide whom you love, but God guides whom He wills, and He knows best those who are guided.

إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

**28:57** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Wa k ts'ayik le chiikbesajil beel yéetech, kun ch'a'ako'on ti' k luum. Ma' wa To'on k jets'aj ti' letio'ob junp'eel Kili'ich Kuchil yaan kananil, tu'ux ku taasa'al tulakal jejelaas yich che'ob, bey kuxtal ti' To'on? Ba'ale' u ya'abil ma' tu yojelo'ob.

And they say, “If we follow the guidance with you, we will be snatched from our land.” Did We not establish for them a Safe Sanctuary, to which are brought all kinds of fruits, as provision from Ourselves? But most of them do not know.

وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَآ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا يُجْبَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رِّزْقًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**28:58** Jayp'éel kaajo'ob To'on k k'aasbesaj tumen ma' tu ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan ti' u kuxtalo'ob? Lela'ob u yotocho'ob, ma' kuxtalo'ob paach letio'ob, cheen jump'íit. To'on k p'ataj bey le Aj Ch'a' Paachilo'ob.

And how many a city did We destroy for turning unappreciative of its livelihood? Here are their homes, uninhabited after them, except for a few. And We became the Inheritors.

وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۭ بَطِرَتْ مَعِيشَتَهَا ۖ فَتِلْكَ مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَن مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ وَكُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ

**28:59** A Yuumtsil mix bik'in ku k'aasbesik kaajo'ob wa ma' ka'ax túuxtik ichil u noj kaaj jun tul tuuxtbil, ku tsikbaltik ti' letio'ob K chiikulo'on. Mix To'on aj k'aasbesaj kaajo'ob, cheen wa u maako'ob aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

Your Lord never destroys cities without first sending a messenger in their midst, reciting to them Our revelations. And We never destroy the cities, unless their people are wrongdoers.

وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبْعَثَ فِىٓ أُمِّهَا رَسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِى ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا وَأَهْلُهَا ظَـٰلِمُونَ

**28:60** Tulakal ba'ax ts'aabil te'ex cheen u ba'alil le kuxtal yook'ol kaabla', u ki'ichpam. Ba'ax yaan yeetel Allah maas uts, maas xáan kuxtal. Ma' wa a na'atike'ex?

Whatever thing you are given is but the material of this world, and its glitter. But what is with God is better, and longer lasting. Do you not comprehend?

وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا ۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

**28:61** Máax To'on k promesa ti' junp'eel uts promesa — kun u k'am — bey wa máax To'on k ts'aaj ti' ki'imak óolal ichil kuxtal yook'ol kaab, ba'ale' ichil u K'iinil Liksajil kun p'atal ichil le maaxo'ob taasa'ano'ob táanil?

Can someone to whom We have made a fine promise—which he will attain—be equal to someone to whom We have given enjoyments in this world, but who will be, on Resurrection Day, among the arraigned?

أَفَمَن وَعَدْنَـٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَـٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُ مَتَـٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

**28:62** Ichil le K'iin ken u t'aaniko'ob, kun ya'alik: Tu'ux In láako'ob ta ts'aike'ex tu tséel, máaxo'ob a a'alike'ex ka'ach?

On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”

وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ

**28:63** Le maaxo'ob u xot t'aan jaaj yook'ol letio'ob kun ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil, lela'ob le maaxo'ob To'on k sa'atesaj u beelo'ob. K sa'atesaj u beelo'ob bey To'on sa'atesa'ab. K k'aatik ka' a sa'ates k sipil; ma' To'on ku kultiko'ob ka'ach.

Those against whom the sentence is justified will say, “Our Lord, these are they whom we misled. We misled them, as we were misled. We beg Your forgiveness; it was not us they used to worship.”

قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَغْوَيْنَآ أَغْوَيْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا غَوَيْنَا ۖ تَبَرَّأْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِيَّانَا يَعْبُدُونَ

**28:64** A'ala'ab: T'aane'ex a láake'ex ta ts'aaje'ex tu tséel. Tu t'aanajo'ob letio'ob, ma' tu núukajo'ob ti' letio'ob. Tu yilajo'ob le yaayajil. Wa cheen chiikbesa'an u beelo'ob ka'ach.

And it will be said, “Call on your partners.” And they will call on them, but they will not respond to them. And they will see the suffering. If only they were guided.

وَقِيلَ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَهْتَدُونَ

**28:65** Ichil le K'iin ken u t'aaniko'ob, kun ya'alik: Ba'ax ta núukaje'ex ti' le Tuuxtbilo'ob?

On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “What did you answer the Messengers?”

وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبْتُمُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**28:66** Le tsikbalo'ob kun p'atalo'ob ch'opo'ob ti' letio'ob ichil le K'iino', ma' kun u k'áatiko'ob u baajo'ob.

They will be blinded by the facts on that Day, and they will not question each other.

فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**28:67** Ba'ale' máax ku sutik u yóol, ku oksik u yóol, ku beetik toh meyajo'ob, je'el u béeytal u p'atal ichil le aj náajalo'ob.

But he who repents, and believes, and does righteous deeds, may well be among the winners.

فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْلِحِينَ

**28:68** A Yuumtsil ku beetik ba'ax ku k'aat, ku yéeyik. Le yéeyaj ma' u ti'alo'ob. Ki'ichpam Allah, ka'anal Leti' yook'ol ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob tu tséel.

Your Lord creates whatever He wills, and He chooses. The choice is not theirs. Glory be to God, and exalted be He above the associations they make.

وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**28:69** A Yuumtsil ku yojel ba'ax u puksi'ik'alo'ob ku ta'akiko'ob, yeetel ba'ax ku e'esiko'ob.

And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal.

وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

**28:70** Leti' Allah. Mina'an k'uj cheen Leti'. U ti'al ki'iki' t'aan ichil le kuxtala' yeetel ichil le u laak' kuxtalo'. U ti'al le xot t'aan, ti' Leti' kun suutbesa'ake'ex.

And He is God. There is no god but He. To Him belongs all praise in this life, and in the next. And His is the decision, and to Him you will be returned.

وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**28:71** A'ale: Ta ile'ex? Wa Allah tu beetik le ak'ab láayli' yook'ole'ex tak u K'iinil Liksajil, máax k'uj tu tséel Allah kun taasik te'ex saasil? Ma' wa a u'uyike'ex?

Say, “Have you considered? Had God made the night perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than God will bring you illumination? Do you not hear?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ ۖ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ

**28:72** A'ale: Ta ile'ex? Wa Allah tu beetik le k'iin láayli' yook'ole'ex tak u K'iinil Liksajil, máax k'uj tu tséel Allah kun taasik te'ex ak'ab utia'al a je'elele'ex ichil? Ma' wa a wile'ex?

Say, “Have you considered? Had God made the day perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than God will bring you night to rest in? Do you not see?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**28:73** Ti' u yatzil Leti' tu beetaj te'ex le ak'ab yeetel le k'iin, utia'al a je'elele'ex ichil, a kaxtike'ex ti' u siibal, a ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan.

It is out of His mercy that He made for you the night and the day, that you may rest in it, and seek some of His bounty; and that you may give thanks.

وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

**28:74** Ichil le K'iin ken u t'aaniko'ob, kun ya'alik: Tu'ux In láako'ob ta ts'aike'ex tu tséel, máaxo'ob a a'alike'ex ka'ach?

On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”

وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ

**28:75** To'on kun k jóok'sik ti' tulakal kaaj jun tul testimonio, k a'alik: Taase'ex a chiikule'ex. Kun u yojelo'ob le jaaj u ti'al Allah, le ba'ax ku tuusbeetiko'ob ka'ach tu p'atiko'ob letio'ob.

And We will draw out from every community a witness, and say, “Produce your evidence.” Then they will realize that the truth is God’s, and those they used to invent have forsaken them.

وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

**28:76** Quaroon ichil u kaajil Moses, ba'ale' tu yaajbesaj letio'ob. To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' taak'ino'ob, máax u jobnelo'ob ku yaajbesiko'ob junp'eel muuch' wiiniko'ob chich muuk'. U maako'ob tu ya'alajo'ob ti': Ma' a ki'imak óoltal; Allah ma' u yaabiltik le aj ki'imak óolo'ob.

Quaroon belonged to the clan of Moses, but he oppressed them. We had given him treasures, the keys of which would weigh down a group of strong men. His people said to him, “Do not exult; God does not love the exultant.

۞ إِنَّ قَـٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْكُنُوزِ مَآ إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُۥ لَتَنُوٓأُ بِٱلْعُصْبَةِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُوَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ لَا تَفْرَحْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَرِحِينَ

**28:77** Kaxt le Otoch le u laak' kuxtalo' yeetel ba'ax Allah tu ts'aaj teech, ma' a tu'ubsik a jaats ti' le yook'ol kaabla'. Beet uts bey Allah tu beetaj uts ti' teech. Ma' a kaxtik k'aasbesaj ichil luum. Allah ma' u yaabiltik le aj kaax k'aasbesajo'ob.

But seek, with what God has given you, the Home of the Hereafter, and do not neglect your share of this world. And be charitable, as God has been charitable to you. And do not seek corruption in the land. God does not like the seekers of corruption.”

وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَآ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ ٱلْفَسَادَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

**28:78** Tu ya'alaj: Ts'aabil teen tulakal lela' tumen na'at yaan teen. Ma' wa tu yojel Allah tu k'aasbesaj ya'ab ch'iibalo'ob ka'ach ma' leti', máaxo'ob maas chich ti' leti', yaan maas ya'ab u taak'in? Ba'ale' le aj kebano'ob ma' kun k'áata'ako'ob yook'ol u sipilo'ob.

He said, “I was given all this on account of knowledge I possess.” Did he not know that God destroyed many generations before him, who were stronger than he, and possessed greater riches? But the guilty will not be asked about their sins.

قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِىٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا ۚ وَلَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

**28:79** Tu jóok'aj tu taan u maako'ob ichil u ki'ichpam. Le maaxo'ob ku k'áatiko'ob kuxtal yook'ol kaab tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa cheen to'on yaan bey ba'ax ts'aabil ti' Quaroon. Leti' jaaj jun tul yaan noj náajal.

And he went out before his people in his splendor. Those who desired the worldly life said, “If only we possessed the likes of what Quaroon was given. He is indeed very fortunate.”

فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ

**28:80** Le maaxo'ob ts'aabil na'at ti' tu ya'alajo'ob: Yaaj ti' te'ex! U bo'olil Allah maas uts ti' máax ku oksik u yóol ku beetik toh meyajo'ob. Mix máax ku k'amik leti' cheen le maaxo'ob p'ataano'ob chich óol.

But those who were given knowledge said, “Woe to you! The reward of God is better for those who believe and do righteous deeds.” Yet none attains it except the steadfast.

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ

**28:81** To'on k beetaj u laap'ik luum leti' yeetel u yotoch. Mina'an ti' leti' muuch' ku a'antik leti' tu tséel Allah, ma' béeytal u yáantik u baaj.

So We caused the earth to cave in on him and his mansion. He had no company to save him from God, and he could not defend himself.

فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ

**28:82** Le maaxo'ob tu k'áatajo'ob u p'atalo'ob tu kúuchil sáamal tu ya'alajo'ob: Jaaj, Allah ku yaankuntik u siibal ti' máax ku k'aat ichil u palilo'ob, ku xóotik ti' máax ku k'aat. Wa ma' Allah tu ts'aaj uts ti' to'on, je'el u laap'ik luum ti' to'on. Mix jaachil le maaxo'ob ma' ki'iki' t'aano'ob ma' kun náajalo'ob.

Those who had wished they were in his position the day before were saying, “Indeed, it is God who spreads the bounty to whomever He wills of His servants, and restricts it. Had God not been gracious to us, He would have caved in on us. No wonder the ungrateful never prosper.”

وَأَصْبَحَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا۟ مَكَانَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن مَّنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا ۖ وَيْكَأَنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

**28:83** Le Otoch le u laak' kuxtalo' — To'on k ts'aik ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu kaxtiko'ob nojbe'enil ichil luum, mix k'aasbesaj. Le ts'ook u ti'al le aj sajako'ob ti' Allah.

That Home of the Hereafter—We assign it for those who seek no superiority on earth, nor corruption. And the outcome is for the cautious.

تِلْكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا ۚ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

**28:84** Máax ku taasik junp'eel uts meyaj kun k'amik maas uts ti' leti'. Ba'ale' máax ku taasik k'aas — le aj k'aas meyajo'ob kun bo'ota'ako'ob cheen utia'al ba'ax ku beetmajo'ob ka'ach.

Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it. But whoever brings evil—the evildoers will be rewarded only according to what they used to do.

مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**28:85** Máax tu a'almajt'aan le Quran ti' teech kun suutbesik teech ti' Otoch. A'ale: In Yuumtsil le maas ku yojel ichil tulakal máax ku taal yeetel chiikbesajil beel, máax ichil saatal saasil.

He Who ordained the Quran for you will return you Home. Say, “My Lord knows best who comes with guidance, and who is in manifest error.”

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**28:86** Ma' ta pa'atik ka' a'ala'ak ti' teech le kili'ich ju'uno', cheen bey yatzil ti' a Yuumtsil. Ma' p'atal bey aj yáantik le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

You did not expect the Scripture to be transmitted to you, except as mercy from your Lord. Therefore, do not be a supporter of the disbelievers.

وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓا۟ أَن يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**28:87** Ma' a cha'ik u kala'antike'ex ti' u chiikulo'ob Allah ka' ts'o'ok u e'esa'al ti' teech. Payalchi' ti' a Yuumtsil, mix bik'in p'atal ichil le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob láak' tu tséel Allah.

And do not let them divert you from God’s revelations after they have been revealed to you. And pray to your Lord, and never be of the polytheists.

وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**28:88** Ma' a payalchi'tik yeetel Allah u laak' k'uj. Mina'an k'uj cheen Leti'. Tulakal ba'al ku sa'atal, cheen ma' u Taan Leti'. U ti'al le xot t'aan, ti' Leti' kun suutbesa'ake'ex.

And do not invoke with God any other god. There is no god but He. All things perish, except His presence. His is the judgment, and to Him you will be returned.

وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۘ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ ۚ لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

## 29. The Spider

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**29:1** Alif, Lam, Meem.

Alif, Lam, Meem.

الٓمٓ

**29:2** Tu tuukultajo'ob wa le maako'ob kun p'ata'alo'ob chen utia'al u ya'aliko'ob: K oksaj ool, ma' tu ts'a'abal prueba ti' letio'ob?

Have the people supposed that they will be left alone to say, “We believe,” without being put to the test?

أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ

**29:3** To'on k ts'aaj prueba ti' le maaxo'ob máano'ob taanil ti' letio'ob. Allah jaaj kun u yojel le aj jaajo'ob, yeetel jaaj kun u yojel le aj tuuso'ob.

We have tested those before them. God will surely know the truthful, and He will surely know the liars.

وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

**29:4** Wa le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob kebano'ob tu tuukultiko'ob je'el u tu'usiko'ob To'on? K'aas u xot t'aano'ob.

Or do those who commit sins think they can fool Us? Terrible is their opinion!

أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

**29:5** Max ku pa'atik u nupik u baaj yeetel Allah, u k'iinil jets'a'an Allah ku taal. Leti' le Aj U'uyaj Tulakal, le Aj Ojel Tulakal.

Whoever looks forward to the meeting with God—the appointed time of God is coming. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَـَٔاتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**29:6** Max ku ts'aik u muuk' utia'al Allah, chen utia'al u baaj ku ts'aik. Allah mina'an u k'aat ti' le yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Whoever strives, strives only for himself. God is Independent of the beings.

وَمَن جَـٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَـٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**29:7** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob: To'on k sa'atesik u kebano'ob, yeetel k ts'aik ti' letio'ob u bo'olil je'ex le maas uts ichil ba'ax ku beetiko'obo'.

Those who believe and do righteous deeds—We will remit their sins, and We will reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**29:8** To'on k a'almajt'aan ti' wiinik utia'al u beetik uts ti' u taata'ob. Ba'ale' wa ku ts'aiko'ob a muuk' utia'al a ts'aik yet-maak ti' Teen ba'ax mina'an a na'at ti', ma' a u'uyik u t'aano'ob. Ti' Teen a suutulo'ob; kun in a'al te'ex ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

We have advised the human being to be good to his parents. But if they urge you to associate with Me something you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. To Me is your return; and I will inform you of what you used to do.

وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا ۖ وَإِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**29:9** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob: To'on k ooksik letio'ob ichil u muuch' le aj toh oolo'ob.

Those who believe and do good works—We will admit them into the company of the righteous.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**29:10** Ichil le maako'ob yaan max ku ya'alik: K oksaj ool ti' Allah. Ba'ale' ka' ku yaayajbesa'al tumen Allah, ku p'iisik u yaayajbesajil maako'ob je'ex u yaayajil Allah. Wa ku taal aantaj ti' a Yuumtsil, ku ya'alik: Jaaj To'on ta wetele'ex. Ma' wa Allah ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maako'ob?

Among the people is he who says, “We have believed in God.” Yet when he is harmed on God’s account, he equates the people's persecution with God’s retribution. And if help comes from your Lord, he says, “We were actually with you.” Is not God aware of what is inside the hearts of the people?

وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**29:11** Allah jaaj ku yojel le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel jaaj ku yojel le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob.

God certainly knows those who believe, and He certainly knows the hypocrites.

وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ

**29:12** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: Bine'ex k beel, To'on k kuchik a kebane'ex. Mix bix je'el u kuchiko'ob mix junp'it u kebano'ob. Letio'ob aj tuuso'ob.

Those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Follow our way, and we will carry your sins.” In no way can they carry any of their sins. They are liars.

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَـٰيَـٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَـٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَـٰيَـٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

**29:13** Kun u kucho'ob u kuucho'ob, yeetel u laak' kuucho'ob yeetel u kuucho'ob. Kun k'aata'ak ti' letio'ob u K'iinil Liksajil yo'olal ba'ax ku beetiko'ob tuus ka'ach.

They will carry their own loads, and other loads with their own. And they will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning what they used to fabricate.

وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

**29:14** To'on k tuuxtaj Noah ti' u maako'ob, p'ataj ichil letio'ob mil ja'ab ma' chuka'an jo'ok'aal ja'ab. Ka le Noj Ja' tu ch'a'aj letio'ob, tumen letio'ob maako'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

We sent Noah to his people, and He stayed among them for a thousand years minus fifty years. Then the Deluge swept them; for they were wrongdoers.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ

**29:15** Ba'ale' To'on k to'okaj leti', yeetel u laako'ob le Cheemo', yeetel k beetaj leti' junp'eel chiikul ti' tulakal maako'ob.

But We saved him, together with the company of the Ark, and We made it a sign for all peoples.

فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**29:16** Yeetel Abraham, ka' tu ya'alaj ti' u maako'ob: Kultike'ex Allah, saajkune'ex Leti'. Lelo' maas uts te'ex, wa ka waj u yojel.

And Abraham, when he said to his people, “Worship God, and fear Him. That is better for you, if you only knew.

وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**29:17** Ka kultike'ex kultbil ba'alo'ob tu ts'eel Allah, ka beetike'ex tuus. Le maaxo'ob ka kultike'ex tu ts'eel Allah ma' je'el u ts'aiko'ob te'ex a kuxtale'ex. Kaxtike'ex a kuxtale'ex yeetel Allah, kultike'ex Leti', ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan ti' Leti'. Ti' Leti' kun suuna'ake'ex.

You worship idols besides God, and you fabricate falsehoods. Those you worship, instead of God, cannot provide you with livelihood. So seek your livelihood from God, and worship Him, and thank Him. To Him you will be returned.”

إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**29:18** Wa ma' ka okso'ob a woolo'ob, kaajo'ob taanil ti' te'ex ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob xan. Le Tuuxtbil chen u ti'al u k'a'ayik saasil.

If you disbelieve, communities before you have also disbelieved. The Messenger is only responsible for clear transmission.

وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**29:19** Ma' wa tu yilajo'ob bix Allah ku beetik u chuunul le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob, ka tu suutik u beetik? Lela' ma' talam ti' Allah.

Have they not seen how God originates the creation, and then reproduces it? This is easy for God.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

**29:20** A'ale: Xiimbale'ex yook'ol luum, ile'ex bix tu beetaj u chuunul le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob. Ka Allah kun u ts'a u laak' kuxtal. Allah Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Say, “Roam the earth, and observe how He originated the creation.” Then God will bring about the next existence. God has power over all things.”

قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**29:21** Ku yaayajbesik max ku k'aat, ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ti' max ku k'aat, ti' Leti' kun suuna'ake'ex.

He punishes whom He wills, and He grants mercy to whom He wills, and to Him you will be restored.

يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ

**29:22** Ma' je'el a puuts'ule'ex yook'ol luum mix ichil ka'an; mina'an te'ex aj kanan mix aj to'ok tu ts'eel Allah.

You cannot escape, on earth or in the heaven; and you have no protector and no savior besides God.

وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

**29:23** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ti' u chiikulo'ob Allah yeetel u nupik u baaj yeetel Leti', letio'ob tu sa'atajo'ob u pa'atik in yatzil. Ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel yaayajil chich.

Those who disbelieved in God’s signs and His encounter—these have despaired of My mercy. For them is a painful torment.

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**29:24** Ba'ale' chen u nuuk u maako'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: Kinsike'ex leti', wa eele'ex leti'. Ba'ale' Allah tu to'okaj leti' ti' le k'aak'o'. Jaaj ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

But the only response from his people was their saying, “Kill him, or burn him.” But God saved him from the fire. Surely in that are signs for people who believe.

فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**29:25** Tu ya'alaj: Ta ch'a'aje'ex kultbil ba'alo'ob tu ts'eel Allah, tumen a yaakunajile'ex a baaj ichil le kuxtal yook'ol kaaba'. Ba'ale' ka, u K'iinil Liksajil, kun a p'ekike'ex a baaj, kun a pooch'ile'ex a baaj. A kuchile'ex Mitnal, mina'an te'ex aj to'oko'ob.

And he said, “You have chosen idols instead of God, out of affection for one another in the worldly life. But then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will disown one another, and curse one another. Your destiny is Hell, and you will have no saviors.”

وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

**29:26** Ka Lot tu oksaj u yool ti' leti', tu ya'alaj: Teen kin luk'ul in bin ti' in Yuumtsil. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Then Lot believed in him, and said, “I am emigrating to my Lord. He is the Noble, the Wise.”

۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**29:27** To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' Isaac yeetel Jacob, k ts'aaj ichil u ch'iibalo'ob le profeta'il yeetel le Aanalte'o', k ts'aaj ti' leti' u bo'olil ichil le kuxtala'; ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' leti' ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

And We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and conferred on his descendants the Prophethood and the Book, and gave him his reward in this life; and in the Hereafter he will be among the upright.

وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**29:28** Yeetel Lot, ka' tu ya'alaj ti' u maako'ob: Ka beetike'ex junp'eel k'aas ma' beetbil taanil ti' te'ex tumen mix max ichil tulakal yook'ol kaab.

And Lot, when he said to his people, “You are committing an obscenity not perpetrated before you by anyone in the whole world.

وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**29:29** Ka taalike'ex ti' xiibo'ob, ka xotike'ex le beel, ka beetike'ex k'aas ichil a muuch'ule'ex. Ba'ale' chen u nuuk u maako'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: Taase'ex yook'ol to'on u yaayajil Allah, wa teech aj jaaj.

You approach men, and cut off the way, and commit lewdness in your gatherings.” But the only response from his people was to say, “Bring upon us God’s punishment, if you are truthful.”

أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

**29:30** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, aanteen yook'ol le maako'ob aj k'aasbesajo'ob.

He said, “My Lord, help me against the people of corruption.”

قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

**29:31** Ka' k k'a'ayilo'ob tu taaso'ob ti' Abraham le uts tsikbal, tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on kun k luk'sik u maako'ob le kaaja'; u maako'ob maako'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

And when Our envoys brought Abraham the good news, they said, “We are going to destroy the people of this town; its people are wrongdoers.”

وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَـٰلِمِينَ

**29:32** Tu ya'alaj: Ba'ale' Lot yaan teelo'. Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on maas k ojel max yaan teelo'. Kun k to'okik leti', yeetel u laako'ob, chen u atan p'ataal paachil.

He said, “Yet Lot is in it.” They said, “We are well aware of who is in it. We will save him, and his family, except for his wife, who will remain behind.”

قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا ۚ قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

**29:33** Ka, ka' k k'a'ayilo'ob k'ucho'ob ti' Lot, k'aas ts'aabilo'ob, leti' talamchaj yeetel chich ool tumen letio'ob. Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ma' a saajkil, ma' a tukul. Kun k to'okikech yeetel a laako'ob, chen a atan p'ataal paachil.

Then, when Our envoys came to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was troubled and distressed on their account. They said, “Do not fear, nor grieve. We will save you and your family, except for your wife, who will remain behind.”

وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

**29:34** Kun k ts'aik yook'ol u maako'ob le kaaja' junp'eel yaayajil ti' ka'an, tumen u k'aas oolalo'ob.

“We will bring down upon the people of this town a scourge from heaven, because of their wickedness.”

إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ

**29:35** To'on k p'ataj paachil junp'eel chiikul ku e'esik u saasil ti' leti', ti' maako'ob ku na'atiko'ob.

And We left behind a clear trace of it, for people who understand.

وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

**29:36** Yeetel ti' Median, u suku'un Shuaib. Tu ya'alaj: In maako'ob, kultike'ex Allah, pa'ate'ex u Ts'ook K'in, ma' a ximbalte'ex k'aasbesaj yook'ol luum.

And to Median, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship God and anticipate the Last Day, and do not spread corruption in the land.”

وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

**29:37** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob leti', le suulul tu ch'a'aj letio'ob, p'atajo'ob ma' peek ichil u yotocho'ob.

But they rejected him, so the tremor overtook them, and they were left motionless in their homes.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ

**29:38** Yeetel Aad yeetel Thamood. Jaajchaj te'ex ti' u yotocho'ob. Kisin tu beetaj u meyajo'ob bey uts ti' letio'ob, tu kalantaj letio'ob ti' le beel, kex je'el u yilo'obo'.

And Aad and Thamood. It has become clear to you from their dwellings. Satan embellished for them their deeds, barring them from the path, even though they could see.

وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

**29:39** Yeetel Quaroon, Pharaoh, yeetel Hamaan: Moses bin ti' letio'ob yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, ba'ale' tu beetajo'ob nojbe'enil yook'ol luum. Ma' je'el u taanilo'obo'.

And Quaroon, and Pharaoh, and Hamaan—Moses went to them with clear arguments, but they acted arrogantly in the land. And they could not get ahead.

وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ

**29:40** Tulakal To'on k ch'a'aj tumen u keban. Yaan max To'on k tuuxtaj yook'ol junp'eel k'axan iik'. Yaan max le Noj T'aan tu ch'a'aj. Yaan max k beetaj u luumil u yookol tu yanal. Yaan max k buulbesaj. Ma' Allah ku beetik k'aas ti' letio'ob, ba'ale' letio'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas ti' u baajo'ob.

Each We seized by his sin. Against some We sent a sandstorm. Some were struck by the Blast. Some We caused the ground to cave in beneath them. And some We drowned. It was not God who wronged them, but it was they who wronged their own selves.

فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

**29:41** U keetil le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob aj kanano'ob tu ts'eel Allah je'ex u keetil le amo'. Ku beetik junp'eel naj. Ba'ale' le maas mina'an u chichil ichil tulakal najo'ob leti' u naj le amo', wa tu yojelo'ob.

The likeness of those who take to themselves protectors other than God is that of the spider. It builds a house. But the most fragile of houses is the spider’s house. If they only knew.

مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

**29:42** Allah ku yojel ba'ax ku payalchi'tiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti'. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

God knows what they invoke besides Him. He is the Almighty, the Wise.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**29:43** Le keetilo'oba', To'on k ts'aik taanil ti' le maako'ob; mix max ku na'atik chen le aj na'ato'ob.

These examples—We put them forward to the people; but none grasps them except the learned.

وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَـٰلِمُونَ

**29:44** Allah tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel jaaj. Jaaj ichil lelo' yaan junp'eel chiikul ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

God created the heavens and the earth with truth. Surely in that is a sign for the believers.

خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**29:45** Xook le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' teech ti' le kili'ich ju'uno', beet le payalchi'o'. Le payalchi'o' ku kalantik ti' k'aas ba'alo'ob yeetel kebano'ob. U k'a'ajsaj Allah maas noj. Allah ku yojel ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Recite what is revealed to you of the Scripture, and perform the prayer. The prayer prevents indecencies and evils. And the remembrance of God is greater. And God knows what you do.

ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

**29:46** Ma' a ba'atel t'aano'ob yeetel Maako'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' chen ichil le maas uts bixil, chen le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas ichil letio'ob. A'ale'ex: K oksaj ool ti' le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' to'on, yeetel ti' le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' te'ex; k Allah yeetel a Allah chen Leti' laili', ti' Leti' k ts'aik k baaj.

And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in the best manner possible, except those who do wrong among them. And say, “We believe in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to you; and our God and your God is One; and to Him we are submissive.”

۞ وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ

**29:47** Beey xan, To'on k e'esaj ti' teech le kili'ich ju'uno'. Le maaxo'ob To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' leti', yaan ichil lelo'oba' ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' leti'. Mix max ku p'ektik k chiikulo'on chen le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

Likewise, We revealed to you the Scripture. Those to whom We gave the Scripture believe in it, and some of these believe in it. None renounce Our communications except the disbelievers.

وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَمِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

**29:48** Ma' ka xookik mix junp'eel ju'un taanil ti' lela', mix ta ts'iibtik yeetel a noj k'ab; wa beyo', le aj tuuso'ob tu tukulto'ob ka'ap'el ool.

You did not read any scripture before this, nor did you write it down with your right hand; otherwise the falsifiers would have doubted.

وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

**29:49** Jaaj, leti' chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maaxo'ob ts'aabilo'ob na'at. Mix max ku p'ektik k chiikulo'on chen le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

In fact, it is clear signs in the hearts of those given knowledge. No one renounce Our signs except the unjust.

بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَـٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٌ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

**29:50** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa chen junp'eel noj chiikul e'esa'ab ti' leti' ti' u Yuumtsil. A'ale: Le chiikulo'ob chen yeetel Allah, teen chen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan saasil.

And they said, “If only a miracle from his Lord was sent down to him.” Say, “Miracles are only with God, and I am only a clear warner.”

وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**29:51** Ma' wa ku p'iisik ti' letio'ob To'on k e'esaj ti' teech le kili'ich ju'uno', ku xooka'al ti' letio'ob? Ichil lelo' yaan yatzil yeetel junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' maako'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Does it not suffice them that We revealed to you the Scripture, which is recited to them? In that is mercy and a reminder for people who believe.

أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**29:52** A'ale: Ku p'iisik Allah testimonio ichil teen yeetel te'ex. Ku yojel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le Luum. Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' tuus yeetel ku p'ektiko'ob Allah, letio'ob le aj sa'atalo'ob.

Say, “God suffices as witness between you and me. He knows everything in the heavens and the Earth. Those who believe in vanity and reject God—it is they who are the losers.”

قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ

**29:53** Ku k'aatiko'ob tech a kaxantik u taal le yaayajil. Wa ma' tumen junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an, le yaayajil k'uchul ti' letio'ob ka'ach. Ba'ale' kun taal yook'ol letio'ob suulul, ma' tu yojelo'ob.

And they urge you to hasten the punishment. Were it not for a specified time, the punishment would have come to them. But it will come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware.

وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**29:54** Ku k'aatiko'ob tech a kaxantik u taal le yaayajil. Ba'ale' Mitnal kun u bak'pach le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

They urge you to hasten the punishment. But Hell will engulf the disbelievers.

يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**29:55** U k'iinil le yaayajil kun u bak'pach letio'ob, ti' ka'anal ti' letio'ob, yeetel ti' yanal u yooke'ob, kun u ya'al: Eejente'ex ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

On the Day when the punishment will envelop them, from above them, and from beneath their feet, He will say, “Taste what you used to do!”

يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**29:56** In palilo'ob ta oksaje'ex a woolo'ob: in luumil noj, kultene'ex Teen chen.

O My servants who have believed: My earth is vast, so worship Me alone.

يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

**29:57** Tulakal pixan kun u eejent u kiimil. Ka ti' To'on kun suuna'ake'ex.

Every soul will taste death. Then to Us you will be returned.

كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

**29:58** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob: To'on k jets'ik letio'ob ichil le Pak'alo', ichil kuchilo'ob ka'anal tu yanal ku bin ja'o'ob, ku p'atalo'ob teelo' mantats'. Uts u bo'olil le aj meyajo'ob.

Those who believe and work righteousness—We will settle them in Paradise, in mansions under which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. Excellent is the compensation for the workers.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ

**29:59** Le maaxo'ob ku muk'yajtiko'ob, yeetel ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u kub oolal.

Those who endure patiently, and in their Lord they trust.

ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

**29:60** Ya'ab ba'alche' yaan ma' tu kuchik u kuxtal. Allah ku ts'aik u kuxtal ti' letio'ob, yeetel ti' te'ex. Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Ojel.

How many a creature there is that does not carry its provision? God provides for them, and for you. He is the Hearer, the Knowledgeable.

وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**29:61** Wa ta k'aataj ti' letio'ob: Max tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, tu jets'aj le k'in yeetel le uj? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah. Ba'ax teen ku suutulo'ob paachil?

And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth and regulated the sun and the moon?” They would say, “God.” Why then do they deviate?

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

**29:62** Allah ku nojbesik u kuxtal ti' max ku k'aat ichil u palilo'ob, ku k'a'alik ti' leti'. Allah Aj Ojel Tulakal ti' tulakal ba'al.

God expands the provision for whomever He wills of His servants, and restricts it. God is Cognizant of all things.

ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**29:63** Wa ta k'aataj ti' letio'ob: Max ku ts'aik ja' ti' ka'an, yeetel ku kuxtalbesik le luum ka' kiimij? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah. A'ale: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah. Ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

And if you asked them, “Who sends water down from the sky, with which He revives the earth after it had died?” They would say, “God.” Say, “Praise be to God.” But most of them do not understand.

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

**29:64** Le kuxtal yook'ol kaaba' mixba'al chen báaxal yeetel saayab; u yotoch le u laak' kuxtalo' leti' le Kuxtal, wa tu yojelo'ob.

The life of this world is nothing but diversion and play, and the Home of the Hereafter is the Life, if they only knew.

وَمَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

**29:65** Ka' ku ooko'ob ichil junp'eel cheem, ku payalchi'tiko'ob Allah, ku ts'aiko'ob u kub oolal chen ti' Leti'; ba'ale' ka' tu to'okaj letio'ob ti' luumil, ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maak ti' Leti'.

When they embark on a vessel, they pray to God, devoting their faith to Him; but once He has delivered them safely to land, they attribute partners to Him.

فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

**29:66** Utia'al u p'ektiko'ob ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob, yeetel utia'al u ki' ooltiko'ob u baajo'ob. Jaaj kun u yojelo'ob.

To be ungrateful for what We have given them, and to enjoy themselves. They will surely come to know.

لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

**29:67** Ma' wa tu yilaje'ex To'on k beetaj junp'eel kuchil kananil, le maako'ob ku ch'a'abilo'ob tu bak'pach? Ku oksiko'ob wa u yoolo'ob ti' tuus, ku p'ektiko'ob u siibalo'ob Allah?

Do they not see that We established a Secure Sanctuary, while all around them the people are being carried away? Do they believe in falsehood, and reject the blessings of God?

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ

**29:68** Max ku beetik maas k'aas ti' le max ku beetik tuus yeetel ku ts'aik ti' Allah, wa ku ya'alik tuus ti' le jaaj ka' k'uch ti' leti'? Mina'an wa ichil Mitnal junp'eel kuchil ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob?

And who does greater wrong than he who fabricates lies and attributes them to God, or calls the truth a lie when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a dwelling for the blasphemers?

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**29:69** Le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u muuk' utia'al To'on: To'on k chiikbesik u beelo'ob ichil k beelo'ob. Allah yeetel le aj uts meyajo'ob.

As for those who strive for Us—We will guide them in Our ways. God is with the doers of good.

وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

## 30. The Romans

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**30:1** Alif, Lam, Meem.

Alif, Lam, Meem.

الٓمٓ

**30:2** Le Romano'ob p'atajo'ob paachil ichil ba'atel.

The Romans have been defeated.

غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ

**30:3** Ichil junp'eel luum naats'. Ba'ale' ka' p'atajo'ob paachil, kun u náajalo'ob.

In a nearby territory. But following their defeat, they will be victorious.

فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ

**30:4** Ichil ya'ab ja'abo'ob. Le ba'al u ti'al Allah, taanil yeetel paachil. Le k'iino', le aj oksaj oolo'ob kun ki' ooltiko'ob.

In a few years. The matter is up to God, in the past, and in the future. On that day, the believers will rejoice.

فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

**30:5** Yeetel u aantaj Allah. Ku yantik max ku k'aat. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

In God’s support. He supports whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, the Merciful.

بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**30:6** U promesa Allah: Allah ma' tu jelik u promesa, ba'ale' u ya'abil le maako'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

The promise of God—God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know.

وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**30:7** Ku yojelo'ob junp'eel ba'alil paachil ti' le kuxtal yook'ol kaaba', ba'ale' ma' tu yiliko'ob le u laak' kuxtalo'.

They know an outer aspect of the worldly life, but they are heedless of the Hereafter.

يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

**30:8** Ma' wa ku tukultiko'ob ichil u baajo'ob? Allah ma' tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil letio'ob, chen yeetel jaaj, yeetel utia'al junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Ba'ale' ya'ab maako'ob, yo'olal u nupik u baaj yeetel u Yuumtsilo'ob, ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

Do they not reflect within themselves? God did not create the heavens and the earth, and what is between them, except with reason, and for a specific duration. But most people, regarding meeting their Lord, are disbelievers.

أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ

**30:9** Ma' wa tu ximbaltajo'ob le luum yeetel tu yilajo'ob bix u ts'ook u maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob? Letio'ob maas chich u muuk'o'ob ti' letio'ob, tu pak'ajo'ob le luum yeetel tu nojbesajo'ob maas ti' letio'ob tu nojbesajo'ob, u tuuxtbilo'ob k'ucho'ob ti' letio'ob yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob. Allah mix bik'in kun u beet k'aas ti' letio'ob, ba'ale' letio'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas ti' u baajo'ob ka'ach.

Have they not travelled the earth and seen how those before them ended up? They were more powerful than them, and they cultivated the land and developed it more than they developed it, and their messengers came to them with clear signs. God would never wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

**30:10** Ka, k'aas u ts'ook le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob k'aas. Tumen tu p'ektajo'ob u chiikulo'ob Allah, ku beetiko'ob pooch' ti' letio'ob ka'ach.

Then, evil was the end of those who committed evil. That is because they rejected God’s revelations, and used to ridicule them.

ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**30:11** Allah ku beetik u chuunul le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob, ka tu suutik u beetik. Ka ti' Leti' kun suuna'ake'ex.

God originates creation, and then repeats it. Then to Him you will be returned.

ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**30:12** U k'iinil le K'intzilo' ku jets'kubaj, le aj kebano'ob kun u sa'ato'ob u pa'atik.

On the Day when the Hour takes place, the guilty will despair.

وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

**30:13** Mina'an ti' letio'ob maxo'ob ku t'aano'ob ti' Allah yo'olal letio'ob ichil u yet-maako'ob; kun u p'ekiko'ob u yet-maako'ob.

They will have no intercessors from among their idols, and they will disown their partners.

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ

**30:14** U k'iinil le K'intzilo' ku jets'kubaj, le k'iino' kun xoot'p'ata'alo'ob jejelaas muuch'o'ob.

On the Day when the Hour takes place—on that Day they will separate.

وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ

**30:15** Le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel tu beetajo'ob uts meyajo'ob, kun ki' oolta'alo'ob ichil pak'alo'ob.

As for those who believed and did good deeds—they will be delighted in meadows.

فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ

**30:16** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, tu p'ektajo'ob k chiikulo'on yeetel u nupik u baaj yeetel le u laak' kuxtalo', letio'ob kun taasa'alo'ob ichil le yaayajil.

But as for those who disbelieved, and rejected Our signs and the encounter of the Hereafter—those will be hauled into the torment.

وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ

**30:17** Ki'ichpamkune'ex Allah ka' ka ooko'ob ak'ab, yeetel ka' ka lik'ile'ex saas.

So glorify God when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.

فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ

**30:18** U ti'al le ki'iki' t'aan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol luum, yeetel ti' okook ak'ab, yeetel ka' ka k'uchule'ex chuun k'iin.

His is the praise in the heavens and on earth, and in the evening, and when you reach midday.

وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ

**30:19** Ku jok'sik le kuxtal ti' le kiimen, ku jok'sik le kiimen ti' le kuxtal, ku kuxtalbesik le luum ka' kiimij. Beey xan kun jok'sa'ake'ex.

He brings the living out of the dead, and He brings the dead out of the living, and He revives the land after it had died. Likewise you will be resurrected.

يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

**30:20** Ichil u chiikulo'ob: tu beetaje'ex ti' luum; ile'ex, ka wíiniktale'ex ka xiimbale'ex.

And of His signs is that He created you from dust; and behold, you become humans spreading out.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ

**30:21** Ichil u chiikulo'ob: tu beetaj te'ex a yet-maake'ex ti' te'ex laili', utia'al a kaxtike'ex jets' oolal yeetel letio'ob; tu ts'aaj yaakunaj yeetel ch'a' ootsilil ichil te'ex. Ichil lela' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku tukultiko'ob.

And of His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, so that you may find tranquility in them; and He planted love and compassion between you. In this are signs for people who reflect.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
