**30:22** Ichil u chiikulo'ob u beetajil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel u jejelaasil a t'aano'ob yeetel a boono'ob. Ichil lela' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ku yojelo'ob.

And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your languages and colors. In this are signs for those who know.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ

**30:23** Ichil u chiikulo'ob a wenel ak'ab yeetel k'iin, yeetel a kaxtik u siibal. Ichil lela' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku u'uyiko'ob.

And of His signs are your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His bounty. In this are signs for people who listen.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

**30:24** Ichil u chiikulo'ob ku e'esik te'ex le cháak xulub, ku beetik saajkil yeetel pa'atik; ku ts'aik ja' ti' ka'an, yeetel ku kuxtalbesik le luum ka' kiimij. Ichil lela' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku na'atiko'ob.

And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, causing fear and hope. And He brings down water from the sky, and with it He revives the earth after it was dead. In this are signs for people who understand.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

**30:25** Ichil u chiikulo'ob: le ka'an yeetel le luum ku jets'iko'ob tumen u a'almajt'aan. Ka, ka' ku t'anike'ex ti' le luum, chen kun jok'ke'ex.

And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand at His disposal. And then, when He calls you out of the earth, you will emerge at once.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ

**30:26** U ti'al tulakal max yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Tulakal ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob ti' Leti'.

To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. All are submissive to Him.

وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ

**30:27** Leti' max ku beetik u chuunul le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob, ka tu suutik u beetik, ba'al ma' talam ti' Leti'. U ti'al le maas ka'anal tuukul ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

It is He who initiates creation, and then repeats it, something easy for Him. His is the highest attribute, in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**30:28** Ku e'esik te'ex junp'eel keetil ti' a baaje'ex: Ka ts'aike'ex wa a palilo'ob je'ex yet-maako'ob tulakal ichil le taak'in To'on k ts'aaj te'ex? Ka saajkune'ex letio'ob je'ex a saajkune'ex a baaj? Beey To'on k t'ojik le chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku na'atiko'ob.

He illustrates an example for you, from your own selves: do you make your servants full partners in the wealth We have given you? Do you revere them as you revere one another? We thus explain the revelations for a people who understand.

ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

**30:29** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas ku bin u paach u k'aato'ob mina'an na'at. Max je'el u chiikbesik u beel max Allah tu p'ataj ma' yaan u beel? Mina'an ti' letio'ob aj aanto'ob.

Yet the wrongdoers follow their desires without knowledge. But who can guide whom God leaves astray? They will have no helpers.

بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

**30:30** Ts'a a baaj ti' le kuultajil chen Allah, le sukbenil Allah tu ts'aaj ichil wiinik. Mina'an jelbesajil ti' u beetajil Allah. Lela' le jaaj kuultajil, ba'ale' u ya'abil le maako'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

So devote yourself to the religion of monotheism—the natural instinct God has instilled in mankind. There is no altering God’s creation. This is the true religion, but most people do not know.

فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**30:31** Ka suunake'ex ti' Leti', saajkune'ex Leti', beete'ex le payalchi'o', ma' a wookole'ex ichil le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maak.

Turning towards Him—and be conscious of Him, and perform the prayer, and do not be of the idolaters.

۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**30:32** Ichil le maaxo'ob tu xoot'ajo'ob u kuultajil, anchajo'ob muuch' muuch'; tulakal muuch' ki' ool yeetel ba'ax yaan ti' letio'ob.

Of those who divided their religion, and became sects; each faction pleased with what they have.

مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

**30:33** Ka' junp'eel talamil ku k'uchul ti' le maako'ob, ku payalchi'tiko'ob u Yuumtsil, ku suutulo'ob ti' Leti'. Ba'ale' ka, ka' tu ts'aaj ti' letio'ob u eejentiko'ob u yatzil, yaan ichil letio'ob ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maak ti' u Yuumtsil.

When affliction touches the people, they call on their Lord, turning to Him in repentance. But then, when He gives them a taste of His mercy, some of them attribute partners to their Lord.

وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

**30:34** Utia'al u p'ektiko'ob ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob. Ki' oolte'ex a baaj, jaaj kun a waj u yojel.

To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Indulge yourselves—you will surely know.

لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**30:35** To'on k e'esaj wa ti' letio'ob mix junp'eel a'almajt'aan, ku t'aan utia'al u yet-maako'ob?

Have We sent down to them any authority, which speaks in support of their idols?

أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ

**30:36** Ka' To'on k ts'aik ti' le maako'ob u eejentiko'ob yatzil, ku ki' ooltiko'ob. Ba'ale' ka' junp'eel k'aas ku k'uchul ti' letio'ob, tumen ba'ax u k'abo'ob tu beetajo'ob, ku chuunul u sa'atal u pa'atik.

When We give people a taste of mercy, they rejoice in it. But when adversity befalls them, because of what their hands have perpetrated, they begin to despair.

وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ

**30:37** Ma' wa tu yiliko'ob Allah ku nojbesik u kuxtal ti' max ku k'aat, wa ku k'a'alik? Jaaj ichil lela' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Do they not see that God expands the provision for whomever He wills, or restricts it? Surely in this are signs for people who believe.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**30:38** Ts'a ti' a laak' u ti'al, yeetel ti' le ootsil maak, yeetel ti' le aj xiimbal beel. Lela' maas uts ti' le maaxo'ob ku kaxtiko'ob u wich Allah. Letio'ob le aj paakaalo'ob.

So give the relative his rights, and the destitute, and the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek God’s presence. Those are the prosperous.

فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

**30:39** Le taak'in a ts'aike'ex utia'al u ya'abtal ichil u taak'in maako'ob ma' kun ya'abtal yeetel Allah. Ba'ale' ba'ax a ts'aike'ex siibal, a kaxtike'ex u ya'ankuntal Allah, letio'ob le aj ya'abbesajo'ob.

The usury you practice, seeking thereby to multiply people’s wealth, will not multiply with God. But what you give in charity, desiring God’s approval—these are the multipliers.

وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ

**30:40** Allah Leti' tu beetaje'ex, ka tu ts'aaj te'ex a kuxtal, ka ku beetik a kiimile'ex, ka ku suutik a kuxtale'ex. Yaan wa ichil a yet-maako'ob max je'el u beetik mix junp'eel ti' lelo'? Ki'ichpam Leti', ka'anal tu yook'ol ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maak.

God is He who created you, then provides for you, then makes you die, then brings you back to life. Can any of your idols do any of that? Glorified is He, and Exalted above what they associate.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**30:41** K'aasbesaj e'esa'ab yook'ol luumil yeetel k'áak'náab, tumen ba'ax u k'abo'ob le maako'ob tu meyajtajo'ob, utia'al u ts'aik ti' letio'ob u eejentiko'ob junp'it ti' ba'ax tu beetajo'ob, utia'al u suutulo'ob.

Corruption has appeared on land and sea, because of what people’s hands have earned, in order to make them taste some of what they have done, so that they might return.

ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**30:42** A'ale: Xiimbale'ex yook'ol luum, ile'ex bix u ts'ook le maaxo'ob máano'ob taanil. U ya'abil letio'ob maako'ob ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maak.

Say, “Roam the earth, and observe the fate of those who came before. Most of them were idolaters.”

قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ

**30:43** Ts'a a baaj ti' le toh kuultajil, taanil ti' u taal ti' Allah junp'eel k'iin ma' je'el u suutulo'. Le k'iino', kun xoot'p'ata'alo'ob.

So devote yourself to the upright religion, before there comes from God a Day that cannot be averted. On that Day, they will be shocked.

فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

**30:44** Max ma' tu oksik u yool, u p'ekil yook'ol leti'. Max ku beetik uts, utia'al u baajo'ob ku jets'iko'ob.

Whoever disbelieves, upon him falls his disbelief. And whoever acts righteously—they are preparing for themselves.

مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ

**30:45** Utia'al u ts'aik u bo'olil ti' le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel tu beetajo'ob uts meyajo'ob ti' u siibal. Jaaj Leti' ma' tu yaakuntik le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob.

So that He may reward those who have believed and done the righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not love the ungrateful.

لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**30:46** Ichil u chiikulo'ob: ku tuuxtik le iik'o'ob ku taaso'ob uts tsikbal, utia'al u ts'aik te'ex a eejentike'ex u yatzil, utia'al u bin le cheemo'ob tumen u a'almajt'aan, utia'al a kaxtike'ex u siibal, utia'al a ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan.

And of His signs is that He sends the winds bearing good news, to give you a taste of His mercy, and so that the ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His bounty, and so that you may give thanks.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

**30:47** Taanil ti' teech, To'on k tuuxtaj tuuxtbilo'ob ti' u maako'ob. K'ucho'ob ti' letio'ob yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob. Ka To'on k ch'a'aj k pooch' yook'ol le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob keban. U ti'al To'on u yanta'al le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Before you, We sent messengers to their people. They came to them with clear proofs. Then We took revenge on those who sinned. It is incumbent on Us to help the believers.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**30:48** Allah Leti' ku tuuxtik le iik'o'ob. Ku lik'siko'ob muyalo'ob. Ka ku xit'ik letio'ob ichil ka'an je'ex ku k'aat. Ku beetik letio'ob xóot'o'ob. Ka ka wilik le ja' ku jok'ol ichil letio'ob. Ka, ka' ku beetik u k'axal yook'ol max ku k'aat ichil u palilo'ob, ile'ex, ku ki' ooltiko'ob.

God is He who sends the winds. They stir up clouds. Then He spreads them in the sky as He wills. And He breaks them apart. Then you see rain drops issuing from their midst. Then, when He makes it fall upon whom He wills of His servants, behold, they rejoice.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

**30:49** Kex letio'ob taanil ti' lela', taanil ti' u ts'a'abal yook'ol letio'ob, ichil u sa'atal u pa'atik.

Although they were before this—before it was sent down upon them—in despair.

وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ

**30:50** Il u meyajo'ob u yatzil Allah, bix ku kuxtalbesik le luum ka' kiimij. Jaaj Leti' le Aj Kuxtalbesaj le kiimeno'ob. Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

So observe the effects of God’s mercy—how He revives the earth after it was dead. Indeed, He is the Reviver of the dead. He is Capable of everything.

فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**30:51** Ba'ale' wa To'on k tuuxtik junp'eel iik', ka tu yilajo'ob ku k'ankuntal, kun u p'atalo'ob paachil ku p'ektiko'ob.

But if We send a wind, and they see it turning things yellow, they would continue thereafter to disbelieve.

وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ

**30:52** Ma' je'el a beetik u u'uyiko'ob le kiimeno'ob, mix je'el a beetik u u'uyiko'ob le koojo'ob le t'aan ka' ku suutulo'ob paachil.

You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away.

فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

**30:53** Mix je'el a chiikbesik u beel le ch'oopo'ob ti' u sa'atal u beel. Chen je'el a beetik u u'uyiko'ob le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' k chiikulo'on, beey tuuno' tu ts'aajo'ob u baajo'ob.

Nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who believe in Our signs, and so have submitted.

وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

**30:54** Allah Leti' tu beetaje'ex mina'an a muuk'e'ex, ka tu ts'aaj te'ex muuk' ka' mina'an a muuk'e'ex, ka tu ts'aaj te'ex mina'an muuk' yeetel sak pool. Ku beetik ba'ax ku k'aat. Leti' le Aj Ojel Tulakal, le Yaan Muuk' Tulakal.

God is He Who created you weak, then after weakness gave you strength, then after strength gave you weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.

۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ

**30:55** U k'iinil le K'intzilo' ku jets'kubaj, le aj kebano'ob kun u beetiko'ob hach t'aan ma' tu p'ata'alo'ob chen junp'eel k'intzil. Beey tuusbesa'abo'ob ka'ach.

On the Day when the Hour takes place, the sinners will swear they had stayed but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ

**30:56** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ts'aabilo'ob na'at yeetel oksaj ool kun u ya'alo'ob: Ta p'ataje'ex ichil u Aanalte' Allah tak u K'iinil Liksajil. Lela' u K'iinil Liksajil, ba'ale' te'ex ma' a waj u yojel.

But those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, “You remained in God’s Book until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**30:57** Le k'iino', u t'aano'ob le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob k'aas ma' kun u yant letio'ob, mix kun sa'atesa'alo'ob.

On that Day, the sinners’ excuses will not benefit them, nor will they be excused.

فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

**30:58** To'on k ts'aaj ichil le Quran ti' le maako'ob tulakal jejelaas keetil. Ba'ale' kex ka taasik ti' letio'ob junp'eel chiikul, le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob kun u ya'alo'ob: Te'ex chen aj tuuso'ob.

We have cited in this Quran for the people every sort of parable. But even if you bring them a miracle, those who disbelieve will say, “You are nothing but fakers.”

وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ

**30:59** Beey Allah ku kala'antik u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

God thus seals the hearts of those who do not know.

كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**30:60** Muk'yaj. U promesa Allah jaaj. Ma' u cha'ik le maaxo'ob mina'an u jaajil u beetiko'ob chich a wiche'ex.

So be patient. The promise of God is true. And do not let those who lack certainty belittle you.

فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ

## 31. Luqman

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**31:1** Alif, Lam, Meem.

Alif, Lam, Meem.

الٓمٓ

**31:2** Lela'ob le chiikulo'ob le Aanalte' Aj Na'at.

These are the Verses of the Wise Book.

تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**31:3** Junp'eel chiikbesajil beel yeetel yatzil utia'al le aj toh oolo'ob.

A guide and a mercy for the righteous.

هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**31:4** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob payalchi', ku ts'aiko'ob le siibal k'a'abet, yeetel jach u yojelo'ob le u laak' kuxtalo'.

Those who observe the prayer, and pay the obligatory charity, and are certain of the Hereafter.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

**31:5** Le'oba' yook'ol chiikbesajil beel taal ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob. Le'oba' le maaxo'ob ku naajalo'ob.

These are upon guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

**31:6** Ichil le maako'ob yaan maax ku maan tsikbalo'ob ku sa'atiko'ob ool, utia'al u sa'atik u beel maako'ob ti' u beel Allah mina'an na'at ti', yeetel utia'al u baaxtik le beelo'. Ti' le'oba' yaan junp'eel yaayajil ku p'ektik.

Among the people is he who trades in distracting tales; intending, without knowledge, to lead away from God’s way, and to make a mockery of it. These will have a humiliating punishment.

وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

**31:7** Ken k chiikulo'on tsikbalta'ako'ob ti' leti', ku suutik u paach ka'anal ool, bey ma' tu yu'ubajo'ob, bey yaan mina'an u'uyaj ichil u xikino'ob. A'al ti' leti' junp'eel yaayajil chich.

And when Our Verses are recited to him, he turns away in pride, as though he did not hear them, as though there is deafness in his ears. So inform him of a painful punishment.

وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِىٓ أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**31:8** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob, ti' letio'ob le Pak'alo'ob Ki'ichpam Kuxtal.

As for those who believe and do good deeds—for them are the Gardens of Bliss.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**31:9** Ku p'aatalo'ob ichilo'ob mantats'. U promesa Allah jaaj. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Dwelling therein forever. The promise of God is true. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**31:10** Tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob mina'an ba'al ku liik'ik a wiliko'ob, tu ts'aaj wiitso'ob yook'ol luum utia'al ma' u peek yeetel te'ex, tu t'ojaj ichil tulakal jejelaas ba'alche'ob. Ti' ka'an To'on k ts'aaj ja', ka ichil tu jook'saj tulakal ka'ap'eel ba'alo'ob ki'ichpam.

He created the heavens without pillars that you can see, and placed stabilizers on earth lest it shifts with you, and scattered throughout it all kinds of creatures. And from the sky We sent down water, and caused to grow therein of every noble pair.

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

**31:11** Lela' u beetajil Allah. Bejla'e' e'es teen ba'ax tu beetajo'ob le maaxo'ob tu ts'eel Leti'. Jaaj, le aj ma' toh oolo'ob tu sa'atiko'ob u beel, saasil.

Such is God’s creation. Now show me what those besides Him have created. In fact, the wicked are in obvious error.

هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**31:12** To'on k ts'aaj ti' Luqman na'at: Ts'a ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah. Maax ku ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan, chen utia'al uts ti' u pixan ku ts'aik. Maax ma' tu ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan, Allah Ayik'al, Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

We endowed Luqman with wisdom: “Give thanks to God.” Whoever is appreciative—is appreciative for the benefit of his own soul. And whoever is unappreciative—God is Sufficient and Praiseworthy.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

**31:13** Ka Luqman tu ya'alaj ti' u paal, ka tu ts'aaj tsikbal ti': In paal, ma' a ts'aik yet-maak ti' Allah, tumen le yet-maak ts'aikil junp'eel noj ma' toh.

When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him, “O my son, do not associate anything with God, for idolatry is a terrible wrong.”

وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَـٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَـٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ

**31:14** To'on k a'almajt'aan ti' wiinik u kananil u taata'ob. U na' tu kuchaj ichil talamil yook'ol talamil, tu ts'aaj chu'uch ti' ka'ap'eel ja'ab. Ts'a ki'iki' t'aan ti' Teen, yeetel ti' a taata'ob. Ti' Teen le suut.

We have entrusted the human being with the care of his parents. His mother carried him through hardship upon hardship, weaning him in two years. So give thanks to Me, and to your parents. To Me is the destination.

وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**31:15** Wa ku ts'aiko'ob u muuk' utia'al a ts'aik yet-maak ti' Teen ba'ax mina'an a na'at ti', ma' a tzic u t'aano'ob. P'aatal yeetel letio'ob ichil le kuxtala' yeetel uts, suutik u beel le maax ku suutik u baaj ti' Teen. Ka' ti' Teen a suutulo'ob, kun in a'al te'ex ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

But if they strive to have you associate with Me something of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. But keep them company in this life, in kindness, and follow the path of him who turns to Me. Then to Me is your return; and I will inform you of what you used to do.

وَإِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا ۖ وَٱتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَىَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**31:16** In paal, wa yaan bey u p'iis junp'eel u yich mostaza, ichil junp'eel tunich, wa ichil le ka'ano'ob, wa yook'ol luum, Allah kun u taasik ti' saasil. Allah Aj Uts Ool, Aj Ojel.

“O my son, even if it were the weight of a mustard-seed, in a rock, or in the heavens, or on earth, God will bring it to light. God is Kind and Expert.

يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَوْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ

**31:17** In paal, beet payalchi', a'ale u beeta'al toh, kala'antik u beeta'al k'aas, ch'a muk' yook'ol ba'ax k'uch tech. Lela'ob ichil le ba'alo'ob jach nojo'ob.

O my son, perform the prayer, advocate righteousness, forbid evil, and be patient over what has befallen you. These are of the most honorable traits.

يَـٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

**31:18** Ma' a p'ektik maako'ob yeetel ka'anal ool, ma' a ximbal ka'anal ool yook'ol luum. Allah ma' tu yaabiltik tulakal aj ka'anal ool aj nojbesaj u baaj.

And do not treat people with arrogance, nor walk proudly on earth. God does not love the arrogant showoffs.

وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ

**31:19** Beet a ximbal jets'a'an, eem a t'aan. Le maas p'ekbil ichil tulakal t'aano'ob leti' u t'aan le burro.

And moderate your stride, and lower your voice. The most repulsive of voices is the donkey’s voice.”

وَٱقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلْأَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ

**31:20** Ma' a wiliko'ob bix Allah tu ts'aaj utia'al a meyaje'ex tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel luum? Bix tu t'ojaj yook'ole'ex U siibalo'ob, ku yila'alo'ob yeetel ma' ku yila'alo'ob? Ichil le maako'ob yaan maax ku ba'atel yo'olal Allah mina'an na'at, mina'an chiikbesajil beel, mina'an aanalte' ku ts'aik saasil.

Do you not see how God placed at your service everything in the heavens and the earth? How He showered you with His blessings, both outward and inward? Yet among the people is he who argues about God without knowledge, without guidance, and without an enlightening Scripture.

أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَـٰهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَـٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ

**31:21** Ken a'ala'ak ti' letio'ob: Suutike'ex le ba'ax Allah tu e'esaj, ku ya'aliko'ob: Ma', k suutik ba'ax k kaxtaj k taatao'ob ku kultiko'ob. Wa Kisin ku payik letio'ob ti' u yaayajil le elel k'aak'o'?

And when it is said to them, “Follow what God has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we follow what we found our parents devoted to.” Even if Satan is calling them to the suffering of the Blaze?

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**31:22** Maax ku ts'aik u baaj tulakal ti' Allah, yeetel aj uts meyaj, tu machaj le maas chich mach. Yeetel Allah u ts'ookil tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Whoever submits himself wholly to God, and is a doer of good, has grasped the most trustworthy handle. With God rests the outcome of all events.

۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ

**31:23** Maax ma' tu oksik u yool, ma' a yaayajbesik u ma' oksaj oolal. Ti' To'on u suutulo'ob. Ka' To'on k a'al ti' letio'ob ba'ax tu beetajo'ob. Allah ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

Whoever disbelieves—let not his disbelief sadden you. To Us is their return. Then We will inform them of what they did. God knows what lies within the hearts.

وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُۥٓ ۚ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**31:24** To'on k ts'aik ti' letio'ob chan ki'imak oolal, ka' To'on k kala'antiko'ob ti' junp'eel yaayajil chich.

We give them a little comfort; then We compel them to a harsh torment.

نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ

**31:25** Wa a k'aatik ti' letio'ob: Maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel luum? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah. A'ale: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah. Ba'ale' u ya'abile'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

And if you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They will say, “God.” Say, “Praise be to God.” But most of them do not know.

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**31:26** Ti' Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel luum. Allah leti' le Ayik'alo', le Ki'iki' T'aanta'ano'.

To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. God is the Rich, the Praised.

لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

**31:27** Wa tulakal le che'o'ob yook'ol luum bey ba'alo'ob u ti'al ts'iib, le k'aak'naab ku chuukpajal, yeetel ukp'eel k'aak'naabo'ob tu paach, u t'aano'ob Allah ma' kun xu'uluko'ob. Allah Yaan Muuk', Aj Na'at.

If all the trees on earth were pens, filled by the ocean, with seven more oceans besides, the Words of God would not run out. God is Majestic and Wise.

وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَـٰمٌ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

**31:28** A beetajile'ex yeetel a lik'sajile'ex chen bey junp'eel pixan. Allah Aj U'uyaj, Aj Ilaj.

Your creation and your resurrection are only as a single soul. God is Hearing and Seeing.

مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

**31:29** Ma' a wilaj bix Allah ku ooksik aak'ab ichil k'iin, ku ooksik k'iin ichil aak'ab? Tu kala'antaj le k'in yeetel le uj, junjunp'iit ku ximbalo'ob tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Allah Aj Ojel ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Have you not seen how God merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night? That He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term? And that God is Cognizant of everything you do?

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**31:30** Lelo' tumen Allah leti' le Jaaj, ba'ax ku kultiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti' tuus, Allah leti' le Ka'anal, le Noj.

That is because God is the Reality, and what they worship besides Him is falsehood, and because God is the Exalted, the Supreme.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**31:31** Ma' a wilaj bix le cheemo'ob ku ximbalo'ob ichil le k'aak'naab tumen u siibal Allah, utia'al u e'esik te'ex U chiikulo'ob? Ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al tulakal aj ch'a' muk' aj ki'iki' t'aan.

Have you not seen how the ships sail through the sea, by the grace of God, to show you of His wonders? In that are signs for every persevering, thankful person.

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

**31:32** Ken le ja'o' ku bak'pachik letio'ob bey ka'ano'ob, ku payalchi'tiko'ob Allah, ku ts'aiko'ob u culto'ob chen ti' Leti'. Ka' tu taasaj letio'ob ti' tikin luum, ichilo'ob yaan maax ku p'aatal ichil. Mix maax ku p'ektik k chiikulo'on cheen tulakal aj tuus aj ma' oksaj ool.

When waves, like canopies, cover them, they call upon God, devoting their religion to Him. But when He has delivered them to dry land, some of them waver. No one renounces Our revelations except the treacherous blasphemer.

وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ

**31:33** Maako'ob, saajkune'ex a Yuumtsile'ex, sajakune'ex junp'eel K'iin ma' u paajtal taata u aant u paal, mix paal u aant u taata, ichil mixba'al. U promesa Allah jaaj. Ma' a p'atike'ex le kuxtala' u tuusike'ex, ma' a p'atike'ex le aj tuus u tuusike'ex yo'olal Allah.

O people! Be conscious of your Lord, and dread a Day when no parent can avail his child, nor can a child avail his parent, in anything. The promise of God is true. Therefore, do not let this life deceive you, nor let illusions deceive you regarding God.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱخْشَوْا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا يَجْزِى وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

**31:34** Yeetel Allah u na'at le K'intzilo'. Ku ts'aik le ja' ku k'aaxal, ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil u nak'o'ob le ko'olelo'ob. Mix junp'eel pixan ku yojel ba'ax kun u naajalt saamal, mix junp'eel pixan ku yojel tu'ux luumil kun kiimik. Allah Aj Ojel Tulakal, Aj Na'at.

With God rests the knowledge of the Hour. He sends down the rain, and He knows what the wombs contain. No soul knows what it will reap tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. God is All-Knowing, Well-Informed.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ

## 32. The Prostration

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**32:1** Alif, Lam, Meem.

Alif, Lam, Meem.

الٓمٓ

**32:2** Le e'esa'ab le Aanalte'o', mina'an ka'ap'eel ool ti', taal ti' Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

The revelation of the Book, without a doubt, is from the Lord of the Universe.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**32:3** Ku ya'aliko'ob wa: Tu beetaj tu baaj. Jaaj, leti' le Jaaj taal ti' a Yuumtsil, utia'al a ts'aik sajakil ti' junp'eel kaaj mina'an aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan taal ti' letio'ob taanil tech, utia'al u chiikbesa'alo'ob beel.

Yet they say, “He made it up.” In fact, it is the Truth from your Lord, to warn a people who received no warner before you, that they may be guided.

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

**32:4** Allah leti' maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel luum yeetel tulakal ichilo'ob ichil wakp'eel k'iin, ka' tu jets'aj u baaj yook'ol le Ts'amo'. Tu ts'eel Leti', mina'an te'ex aj kanan, mix maax ku t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal te'ex. Ma' a k'a'ajsike'ex wa?

God is He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and then established Himself on the Throne. Apart from Him, you have no master and no intercessor. Will you not reflect?

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**32:5** Ku jets'ik tulakal ba'alo'ob, ti' le ka'ano'ob tak luum. Ka' ku naakal ti' Leti' ichil junp'eel K'iin u chowakil mil ja'abo'ob bey a xookike'ex.

He regulates all affairs, from the heavens, to the earth. Then it ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your count.

يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

**32:6** Lelo' le Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ma' ku yila'al yeetel ba'ax ku yila'al, le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

That is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Powerful, the Merciful.

ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**32:7** Leti' maax tu jets'aj tulakal ba'ax tu beetaj, tu kaajsaj u beetajil wiinik ti' luk.

He who perfected everything He created, and originated the creation of man from clay.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍ

**32:8** Ka' tu beetaj u ch'i'ibal ti' junp'eel xoot' ja' mina'an u nojil.

Then made his reproduction from an extract of an insignificant fluid.

ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ

**32:9** Ka' tu jets'aj, tu ts'aaj iik' ichil leti' ti' U Pixan. Tu ts'aaj te'ex u u'uyaj, u yilaj, yeetel u tuukulo'ob, ba'ale' chan ba'ax ka ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan.

Then He proportioned him, and breathed into him of His Spirit. Then He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains—but rarely do you give thanks.

ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

**32:10** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Ka' k sa'atal ichil luum, yaan wa k beetajil tuumben? Jaaj, letio'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' u nupik u baaj yeetel u Yuumtsilo'ob.

And they say, “When we are lost into the earth, shall we be in a new creation?” In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord.

وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**32:11** A'ale: Le angel ti' kiimil, le aj kanan te'ex, kun u k'am a pixane'ex. Ka' ti' a Yuumtsile'ex kun suuna'ake'ex.

Say, “The angel of death put in charge of you will reclaim you. Then to your Lord you will be returned.”

۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

**32:12** Wa a wilik le aj kebano'ob, u polo'ob luuba'ano'ob taanil u Yuumtsilo'ob: K Yuumtsil, k ilaj yeetel k u'uyaj, suutse'en to'on, k beetik toh, bejla'e' jach k ojel.

If only you could see the guilty, bowing their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, we have seen and we have heard, so send us back, and we will act righteously; we are now convinced.”

وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ

**32:13** Wa k k'aat ka'ach, k ts'aaj ti' tulakal pixan u chiikbesajil beel, ba'ale' le t'aan taal ti' Teen kun jaajtal: Kun in chuukbesik Mitnal yeetel jinno'ob yeetel wiiniko'ob, tulakalo'ob.

Had We willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the declaration from Me will come true: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, altogether.”

وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ

**32:14** Eejente'ex, tumen a tu'ubike'ex u nupik u baaj yeetel le K'iina'. To'on k tu'ubike'ex. Eejente'ex le yaayajil mina'an u ts'ook tumen ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

So taste, because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours; We have forgotten you; so taste the eternal torment for what you used to do.

فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**32:15** Chen le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' k chiikulo'on, ken k'a'ajsa'ako'ob ti' letio'ob, ku xoolano'ob, ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob yeetel ki'iki' t'aan, ma' ka'anal oolo'ob.

They believe in Our communications, those who, when reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify their Lord with praise, and are not proud.

إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩

**32:16** U ts'eelo'ob ma' ku wenelo'ob ichil u kuuchil wenel, ku payalchi'tiko'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob yeetel sajakil yeetel pa'atik, ti' ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ku ts'aiko'ob.

Their sides shun their beds, as they pray to their Lord, out of reverence and hope; and from Our provisions to them, they give.

تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

**32:17** Mix junp'eel pixan ku yojel ba'ax ku ki'imakkunsik wicho'ob pa'atik letio'ob, junp'eel bo'olil tumen ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

No soul knows what eye’s delight awaits them—a reward for what they used to do.

فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**32:18** Maax aj oksaj ool bey maax aj keban wa? Ma' keeto'ob.

Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a sinner? They are not equal.

أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ

**32:19** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob, ti' letio'ob le Pak'alo'ob P'aatal, junp'eel k'amaj uts tumen ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Shelter—hospitality for what they used to do.

أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**32:20** Le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob k'aas, u kuuchil p'aatal leti' le K'aak'. Tulakal ka' ku k'aatiko'ob jook'ol ti', kun su'uta'alo'ob ichil, a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: Eejente'ex u yaayajil le K'aak' ka p'ektike'ex ka'ach.

But as for those who transgressed, their shelter is the Fire. Every time they try to get out of it, they will be brought back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the suffering of the Fire which you used to deny.”

وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**32:21** To'on k ts'aik ti' letio'ob u eejentiko'ob le chan yaayajil, taanil le noj yaayajil, utia'al u suunajo'ob.

We will make them taste the lesser torment, prior to the greater torment, so that they may return.

وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**32:22** Maax maas ku beetik k'aas ti' le maax, ken k'a'ajsa'ak ti' leti' u chiikulo'ob u Yuumtsil, ku suutik u paach ti' letio'ob? To'on jaaj k ts'aik u bo'olil ti' le aj kebano'ob.

Who is more wrong than he, who, when reminded of his Lord’s revelations, turns away from them? We will certainly wreak vengeance upon the criminals.

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ

**32:23** To'on k ts'aaj ti' Moses le Aanalte'o', ma' a yaan ka'ap'eel ool yo'olal u nupik u baaj yeetel Leti', To'on k beetaj bey chiikbesajil beel utia'al u Paalo'ob Israel.

We gave Moses the Book; so do not be in doubt regarding His encounter; and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**32:24** To'on k ts'aaj ichilo'ob aj jalbeso'ob, ku chiikbesiko'ob beel tumen K a'almajt'aan, ka' ch'a' muk'najo'ob yeetel jach u yojelo'ob k chiikulo'on.

And We appointed leaders from among them, guiding by Our command, as long as they persevered and were certain of Our communications.

وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ

**32:25** A Yuumtsil kun u xot t'aan ichil letio'ob ichil u k'iinil Liksajil yo'olal tulakal ba'ax ku keex t'aaniko'ob ka'ach.

Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they had disputed.

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

**32:26** Ma' wa bey junp'eel chiikbesajil beel ti' letio'ob, jayp'eel ch'i'ibalo'ob To'on k xuulsaj taanil letio'ob, ichil u otocho'ob ku ximbalo'ob? Jaaj ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob. Ma' tu yu'ubiko'ob wa?

Is it not a lesson for them, how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose habitations they walk? Surely in that are signs. Do they not hear?

أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ

**32:27** Ma' tu yilo'ob bix To'on k bisik ja' ti' junp'eel luum tikin, yeetel leti' k jook'sik ba'alo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob yook'ol luum, ti' ku jaantiko'ob u tamano'ob yeetel u baajo'ob? Ma' tu yilo'ob wa?

Do they not see how We conduct the water to a dry land, and with it We produce vegetation, from which their livestock eat, and themselves? Do they not see?

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ

**32:28** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax k'iin le naajal, wa te'ex aj jaajo'ob?

And they say, “When is this victory, if you are truthful?”

وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**32:29** A'ale: Ichil u k'iinil le naajal, u oksaj oolal le maaxo'ob ma' tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob ma' kun u yaantik letio'ob, mix kun ts'a'abal ti' letio'ob suut k'iin.

Say, “On the day of victory, the faith of those who disbelieved will be of no avail to them, and they will not be granted respite.”

قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

**32:30** Suut a paach ti' letio'ob, pa'atik. Letio'ob xan ku pa'atiko'ob.

So turn away from them, and wait. They too are waiting.

فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ

## 33. The Allies

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**33:1** Profeta! Sajaknen ti' Allah, ma' a yu'ubik le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob. Allah Aj Ojel, Aj Na'at.

O Prophet! Fear God, and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. God is Knowledgeable and Wise.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

**33:2** Ts'aik a paach ti' le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' teech ti' a Yuumtsil. Allah ku yojel tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

And follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. God is fully aware of what you do.

وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا

**33:3** Ts'a a yool ti' Allah. Allah ku chukik bey aj kanan ti' teech.

And put your trust in God. God is enough as a trustee.

وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا

**33:4** Allah ma' tu ts'aaj ka'ap'eel puksi'ik'al ichil u wiinkilal mix juntul wiinik. Ma' tu beetaj a watanilo'ob, le maaxo'ob ka a'alike'ex bey a na'obo'ob, a jaaj na'obo'ob. Ma' tu beetaj a paalo'ob ta ch'a'ajo'ob, a jaaj paalo'ob. Le'oba' a t'aane'ex ku jook'ol ti' a chi'obo'ob. Allah ku ya'alik le jaajo', ku chiikbesik beel.

God did not place two hearts inside any man's body. Nor did He make your wives whom you equate with your mothers, your actual mothers. Nor did He make your adopted sons, your actual sons. These are your words coming out of your mouths. God speaks the truth, and guides to the path.

مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى تُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ

**33:5** K'aaba'intiko'ob tumen u taata'obo'ob; lelo' maas toh yeetel Allah. Wa ma' a wojelo'ob u taata'obo'ob, u suku'uno'ob te'ex ichil le oksaj oolalo' yeetel a weeta'ilo'ob. Mina'an si'ipil yook'ol te'ex wa ka sa'atike'ex a beele'ex ichilo', chen ba'ax a puksi'ik'ale'ex tu tukultaj taanil. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Call them after their fathers; that is more equitable with God. But if you do not know their fathers, then your brethren in faith and your friends. There is no blame on you if you err therein, barring what your hearts premeditates. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

**33:6** Le Profeta maas ku kananik le aj oksaj oolo'ob ti' ba'ax ku kananiko'ob u baajo'ob, u watanilo'ob na'obo'ob ti' letio'ob. Le k'i'ik' laak'o'ob maas naats' u baajo'ob ichil U Aanalte' Allah ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob wa le maaxo'ob tu p'atajo'ob u luumo'ob, kex k'a'abet a beetike'ex uts ti' a weeta'ilo'ob. Lelo' ts'iibta'an ichil le Aanalte'o'.

The Prophet is more caring of the believers than they are of themselves, and his wives are mothers to them. And blood-relatives are closer to one another in God’s Book than the believers or the emigrants, though you should do good to your friends. That is inscribed in the Book.

ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ ۗ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفْعَلُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَسْطُورًا

**33:7** K'a'ajs a wool: To'on k k'amaj junp'eel promesa ti' le profeta'ob, yeetel ti' teech, yeetel ti' Noah, yeetel Abraham, yeetel Moses, yeetel Jesus u paal Mary. K k'amaj ti' letio'ob junp'eel promesa chich.

Recall that We received a pledge from the prophets, and from you, and from Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus son of Mary. We received from them a solemn pledge.

وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِيثَـٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَـٰقًا غَلِيظًا

**33:8** Utia'al u kaatik le aj jaajo'ob yo'olal u jaajilo'ob. Tu jets'aj utia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob junp'eel yaayajil chich.

That He may ask the sincere about their sincerity. He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.

لِّيَسْـَٔلَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

**33:9** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex! K'a'ajsike'ex u siibalo'ob Allah yook'ol te'ex, ka le muuk'o'ob tu taalo'ob yook'ol te'ex, ka To'on k tuuxtaj yook'ol letio'ob iik', yeetel muuk'o'ob ma' ta wilajo'ob. Allah Aj Ilaj ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

O you who believe! Remember God’s blessings upon you, when forces came against you, and We sent against them a wind, and forces you did not see. God is Observant of what you do.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

**33:10** Ka tu taalo'ob yook'ol te'ex ti' ka'anil yeetel ti' yaanalil; ka le wicho'ob sa'atnajo'ob, ka le puksi'ik'alo'ob naakajo'ob tak le kaalo'ob, ka te'ex tukultaje'ex ma' jaaj yo'olal Allah.

When they came upon you, from above you, and from beneath you; and the eyes became dazed, and the hearts reached the throats, and you harbored doubts about God.

إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠

**33:11** Te'elo' junp'eel prueba tu k'uchul yook'ol le aj oksaj oolo'ob, ka tu jeek'abo'ob jach chich.

There and then the believers were tested, and were shaken most severely.

هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا

**33:12** Ka le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan k'oja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil chen tuus tu promesa'ato'on.

When the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is sickness said, “God and His Messenger promised us nothing but illusion.”

وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا

**33:13** Ka jun muuch' ti' letio'ob tu ya'alaj: Te'ex maako'ob Yathrib, ma' je'el a wa'atalo'ob, suunene'ex paachil. Ka jun muuch' ti' letio'ob tu kaataj ti' le Profeta u p'ato'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: K otocho'ob cha'ano'ob. Ma' cha'ano'ob ka'ach. Chen tu kaato'ob puuts'ul.

And when a group of them said, “O people of Yathrib, you cannot make a stand, so retreat.” And a faction of them asked the Prophet to excuse them, saying, “Our homes are exposed,” although they were not exposed. They only wanted to flee.

وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۚ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا

**33:14** Wa o'okolo'ob ti' tulakal u tseelo'ob, ka kaatbil ti' letio'ob u p'ato'ob le oksaj oolalo', tu beeto'ob seeb, mina'an ya'ab peek ool ti' letio'ob.

Had it been invaded from its sides, and they were asked to dissent, they would have done so with little hesitation.

وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَـَٔاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًا

**33:15** Kex ka'ach tu promesa'ato'ob ti' Allah, ma' kun u suto'ob u paacho'ob. Junp'eel promesa ti' Allah junp'eel ba'al k'a'abet u beetiko'ob u muk'.

Although they had made a pledged to God, in the past, that they will not turn their backs. A pledge to God is a responsibility.

وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًا

**33:16** A'ale: Le puuts'ul ma' kun u yaantik te'ex, wa ka puuts'ule'ex ti' kiimil wa ti' kiinsa'al, kex beyo' chen chichin ki'imak oolal kun ts'a'ak te'ex.

Say, “Flight will not benefit you, if you flee from death or killing, even then you will be given only brief enjoyment.”

قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**33:17** A'ale: Maax kun u kanan te'ex ti' Allah, wa Leti' ku kaatik k'aas ti' te'ex, wa ku kaatik yatzil ti' te'ex? Tu ts'eel Allah, ma' kun u kaxto'ob u ti'al u baajo'ob mix weeta'il mix aj aantaj.

Say, “Who is it who will shield you from God, if He intends adversity for you, or intends mercy for you?” Besides God, they will find for themselves neither friend nor helper.

قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

**33:18** Allah ku yojel le maaxo'ob ku kala'antiko'ob ichile'ex, yeetel le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ti' u suku'uno'ob: Taala'ex yeetel to'on. Chen sajbe'en ku taalo'ob ti' le ba'atelilo'.

God already knows the hinderers among you, and those who say to their brethren, “Come and join us.” Rarely do they mobilize for battle.

۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**33:19** Ma' u kaat u ts'aiko'ob te'ex mixba'al. Ka ku k'uchul le sajkil, ka wilik letio'ob ku paktiko'ob teech, u wicho'ob ku suuto'ob, bey maax ku sa'atal u yool ti' kiimil. Ka le sajkil maanak, ku t'aaniko'ob te'ex yeetel chich t'aano'ob. Ku p'ektiko'ob te'ex tulakal uts. Le'oba' mix bik'in tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, ka Allah tu sa'ataj u meyajo'ob; junp'eel ba'al ma' talam ti' Allah.

Being stingy towards you. And when fear approaches, you see them staring at you—their eyes rolling—like someone fainting at death. Then, when panic is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They resent you any good. These have never believed, so God has nullified their works; a matter easy for God.

أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَٱلَّذِى يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَأَحْبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

**33:20** Tu tukultajo'ob le muuch'o'ob ma' suunajo'ob paachil. Wa le muuch'o'ob ku taalo'ob paach, u kaat p'aatalo'ob ichil le luum mina'an ja' yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob te'elo', ku kaatiko'ob yo'olal a k'aajo'ob. Wa yano'ob ichile'ex, chen chichin ba'atel tu beeto'ob ka'ach.

They assumed that the confederates had not withdrawn. But were the confederates to advance, they would wish they were in the desert with the Bedouins, inquiring about your news. And if they were among you, they would have done little fighting.

يَحْسَبُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى ٱلْأَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ أَنۢبَآئِكُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا قَـٰتَلُوٓا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**33:21** Yaan te'ex junp'eel uts e'esajil ichil U Tuuxtbil Allah; utia'al maax ku kaxtik Allah yeetel u ts'ook k'in, yeetel ku k'a'ajsik Allah ya'ab.

You have an excellent example in the Messenger of God; for anyone who seeks God and the Last Day, and remembers God frequently.

لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا

**33:22** Ka le aj oksaj oolo'ob tu yilajo'ob le muuch'o'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' ba'ax Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil tu promesa'ato'on; Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil tu ya'alajo'ob le jaajo'. Chen tu ya'besaj u oksaj oolalo'ob yeetel u ts'aik u baajo'ob.

And when the believers saw the confederates, they said, “This is what God and His messenger have promised us; and God and His messenger have told the truth.” And it only increased them in faith and submission.

وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّآ إِيمَـٰنًا وَتَسْلِيمًا

**33:23** Ichil le aj oksaj oolo'ob yaan wiiniko'ob jaajo'ob ti' ba'ax tu promesa'ato'ob ti' Allah. Yaan ti' letio'ob maax tu beetaj u promesa; yaan maax ku pa'atik, mix bik'in ku jeelik.

Of the believers are men who are true to what they pledged to God. Some of them have fulfilled their vows; and some are still waiting, and never wavering.

مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا۟ مَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُۥ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ ۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا۟ تَبْدِيلًا

**33:24** Utia'al Allah u bo'otik le aj jaajo'ob tumen u jaajilo'ob; yeetel u yaayajkunsik le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, wa ku kaatik, wa u sa'atesiko'ob. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

That God may reward the truthful for their truthfulness; and punish the hypocrites, if He wills, or pardon them. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

**33:25** Allah tu sutaj le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ichil u p'ekilo'ob; mixba'al uts tu naajalto'ob. Beyxan Allah tu kananaj le aj oksaj oolo'ob ti' le ba'atelilo'. Allah Chich, Yaan Muuk'.

God repelled the disbelievers in their rage; they gained no advantage. God thus spared the believers combat. God is Strong and Mighty.

وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا ۚ وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلْقِتَالَ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا

**33:26** Tu jook'saj luumil ti' u chich kaajilo'ob le maaxo'ob ichil u Maako'ob le Aanalte'o' tu yaantajo'ob letio'ob, ka tu ts'aaj sajkil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob. Yaan ti' letio'ob ta kiinsaje'ex, yaan ta ch'a'aje'ex bey preso'ob.

And He brought down from their strongholds those of the People of the Book who backed them, and He threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and others you took captive.

وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا

**33:27** Tu ts'aaj te'ex u ch'a'ike'ex u luumo'ob, u otocho'ob, u ayik'alilo'ob, yeetel junp'eel luum mix bik'in a xaak'abe'ex. Allah Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

And He made you inherit their land, and their homes, and their possessions, and a region you have never stepped on. God has power over all things.

وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَـٰرَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا

**33:28** Profeta! A'ale ti' a watanilo'ob: Wa ka kaatike'ex u kuxtal le yook'ol kaaba' yeetel u ki'ichpamile', taala'ex, kun in bo'otike'ex, kun in p'atike'ex yeetel uts oolal.

O Prophet! Say to your wives, “If you desire the life of this world and its finery, then let me compensate you, and release you kindly.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا

**33:29** Wa ka kaatike'ex Allah, U Tuuxtbil, yeetel U Otoch le u laak' kuxtalo', Allah tu jets'aj utia'al le aj toh oolo'ob ichile'ex junp'eel noj bo'olil.

But if you desire God, His Messenger, and the Home of the Hereafter, then God has prepared for the righteous among you a magnificent compensation.”

وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَـٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

**33:30** Te'ex watanilo'ob le Profeta! Maax ichile'ex ku beetik junp'eel ma' uts jaaj chiikpaj, le yaayajil utia'al leti' kun ka'aten ya'abtal. Lelo' ma' talam ti' Allah.

O wives of the Prophet! Whoever of you commits a proven indecency, the punishment for her will be doubled. And that would be easy for God.

يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهَا ٱلْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

**33:31** Maax ichile'ex ku p'aatal ku yu'ubik Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, yeetel ku beetik toh meyajo'ob, To'on kun k ts'aik ti' leti' ka'aten u bo'olil; k jets'maj utia'al leti' junp'eel ayik'al siibal.

But whoever of you remains obedient to God and His Messenger, and acts righteously, We will give her a double reward; and We have prepared for her a generous provision.

۞ وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا نُّؤْتِهَآ أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا

**33:32** Te'ex watanilo'ob le Profeta! Ma' te'ex bey u laak' ko'olelo'ob, wa ka yu'ubike'ex sajkil ti' Allah. Ma' a t'aanike'ex jach suuk, ma' u kaat u yool le maax yaan k'oja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'al tu paach te'ex, t'aane'ex yeetel t'aan toh.

O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other women, if you observe piety. So do not speak too softly, lest the sick at heart lusts after you, but speak in an appropriate manner.

يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ إِنِ ٱتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا

**33:33** P'aatale'ex ichil a wotocho'ob; ma' a e'esike'ex a baajo'ob bey le uuchben k'iino'ob mina'an na'at. Beetike'ex le payalchi'o', ts'aike'ex le siibal mantats', yu'ubike'ex Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil. Allah ku kaatik u jook'sik tulakal ma' uts ti' te'ex, Te'ex Maako'ob le Otocho', yeetel u cho'ik te'ex tulakal.

And settle in your homes; and do not display yourselves, as in the former days of ignorance. And perform the prayer, and give regular charity, and obey God and His Messenger. God desires to remove all impurity from you, O People of the Household, and to purify you thoroughly.

وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا

**33:34** K'a'ajsike'ex ba'ax ku tsikbalta'al ichil a wotocho'ob ti' u e'esa'abilo'ob Allah yeetel na'at. Allah Aj Uts Ool, Aj Ojel.

And remember what is recited in your homes of God's revelations and wisdom. God is Kind and Informed.

وَٱذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا

**33:35** Le musulman wiiniko'ob yeetel le musulman ko'olelo'ob, le aj oksaj ool wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj oksaj ool ko'olelo'ob, le aj yu'ub wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj yu'ub ko'olelo'ob, le aj jaaj wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj jaaj ko'olelo'ob, le aj ch'a' muk' wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj ch'a' muk' ko'olelo'ob, le aj suuk ool wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj suuk ool ko'olelo'ob, le aj siibal wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj siibal ko'olelo'ob, le aj suuk'in wiiniko'ob yeetel le aj suuk'in ko'olelo'ob, le wiiniko'ob ku kananiko'ob u suukilo'ob yeetel le ko'olelo'ob ku kananiko'ob, le wiiniko'ob ku k'a'ajsiko'ob Allah ya'ab yeetel le ko'olelo'ob ku k'a'ajsiko'ob, Allah tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob u sa'atesiko'ob yeetel junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Muslim men and Muslim women, believing men and believing women, obedient men and obedient women, truthful men and truthful women, patient men and patient women, humble men and humble women, charitable men and charitable women, fasting men and fasting women, men who guard their chastity and women who guard, men who remember God frequently and women who remember—God has prepared for them a pardon, and an immense reward.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَٱلْمُسْلِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظَـٰتِ وَٱلذَّٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱلذَّٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

**33:36** Ma' utia'al mix aj oksaj ool, wiinik wa ko'olel, ka Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil tu xotajo'ob t'aan yo'olal junp'eel ba'al, u yaan u ts'aik u yool ti' u xot t'aano'ob. Maax ma' tu yu'ubik Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, tu sa'ataj u beel naach.

It is not for any believer, man or woman, when God and His Messenger have decided a matter, to have liberty of choice in their decision. Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger has gone far astray.

وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَـٰلًا مُّبِينًا

**33:37** Ka ta wa'alaj ti' le maax Allah tu ts'aaj ya'ab uts ti', yeetel teech ta ts'aaj uts ti': Kan a watanil ti' a weet, sajaknen ti' Allah. Ka ta ta'akaj ichil a baaj ba'ax Allah kun u e'esik. Ka teech sajaknach a ti' le maako'ob, ba'ale' Allah le maax k'a'abet a sajaktal ti'. Ka Zaid tu ts'o'oksaj u nupik u baaj yeetel leti', To'on k ts'aaj leti' teech bey a watanil, utia'al mina'an kala'anil utia'al aj oksaj oolo'ob yo'olal u watanilo'ob u paalo'ob ch'a'abilo'ob, ka u nupik u baajo'ob ts'o'ok. U a'almajt'aan Allah beetbike'.

When you said to him whom God had blessed, and you had favored, “Keep your wife to yourself, and fear God.” But you hid within yourself what God was to reveal. And you feared the people, but it was God you were supposed to fear. Then, when Zaid ended his relationship with her, We gave her to you in marriage, that there may be no restriction for believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons, when their relationship has ended. The command of God was fulfilled.

وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا

**33:38** Mina'an si'ipil yook'ol le Profeta yo'olal ba'ax Allah tu jets'aj utia'al leti'. Bey u beelil Allah ichil le maaxo'ob maanajo'ob taanil. U a'almajt'aan Allah junp'eel jets' t'aan jaaj.

There is no blame on the Prophet regarding what God has ordained for him. Such is the pattern of God among those who passed before. The command of God is an absolute decree.

مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ ۖ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا

**33:39** Le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u t'aano'ob Allah, ku sajaktalo'ob ti' Leti', mix bik'in ku sajaktalo'ob ti' mix maax tu ts'eel Allah. Allah ku chukik utia'al u xot u bo'olil tulakal ba'al.

Those who deliver the messages of God, and fear Him, and never fear anyone except God. God is sufficient as a reckoner.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُۥ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا

**33:40** Muhammad ma' u taata mix juntul a wiinikilo'ob; leti' U Tuuxtbil Allah, yeetel u ts'ookil le profeta'ob. Allah Aj Ojel ti' tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Muhammad is not the father of any of your men; but he is the Messenger of God, and the seal of the prophets. God is Cognizant of everything.

مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا

**33:41** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex, k'a'ajsike'ex Allah yeetel ya'ab k'a'ajsajil.

O you who believe, remember God with frequent remembrance.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا

**33:42** Ki'iki' t'aane'ex Leti' tu ja'ats'kab k'iin yeetel tu o'ok'ot k'iin.

And glorify Him morning and evening.

وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

**33:43** Leti' le maax ku naats'ik u k'ab ti' te'ex, yeetel U angelo'ob, utia'al u jook'sik te'ex ti' eek'il tak saasil. Leti' mantats' ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

It is He who reaches out to you, and His angels, to bring you out of darkness into the light. And He is Ever-Merciful towards the believers.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَلِّى عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتُهُۥ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَكَانَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا

**33:44** U ki'iki' t'aano'ob tu K'iinil ken u nupo'ob u baajo'ob yeetel Leti': Jets' oolal. Tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob junp'eel ayik'al bo'olil.

Their greeting on the Day they meet Him is, “Peace,” and He has prepared for them a generous reward.

تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا

**33:45** Profeta! To'on k tuuxtajech bey aj testimonio, bey aj ts'aaj uts k'aaj, yeetel bey aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan.

O prophet! We have sent you as a witness, and a bearer of good news, and a warner.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

**33:46** Yeetel bey aj pay ku t'aaniko'ob tak Allah tumen u cha'aj, yeetel bey junp'eel noj saasil ku saaskunsik le beelo'.

And a caller towards God by His leave, and an illuminating beacon.

وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا

**33:47** Ts'a ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob le uts k'aajo' yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel noj bo'olil.

And give the believers the good news that for them is a great reward.

وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا

**33:48** Ma' a yu'ubik le aj p'ek t'aan ti' Allah yeetel le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, p'at u yaayaj t'aano'ob, ts'a a yool ti' Allah. Allah ku chukik bey aj kanan.

And do not obey the blasphemers and the hypocrites, and ignore their insults, and rely on God. God is a sufficient protector.

وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَىٰهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا

**33:49** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex! Ka ka nupike'ex a baajo'ob yeetel aj oksaj ool ko'olelo'ob, ka ka p'atike'ex letio'ob ka'ach ma' a machiko'obo'ob, mina'an u k'iinil pa'atal k'a'abet a kananike'ex yo'olal letio'ob; bo'otiko'ob, p'atiko'ob yeetel uts oolal.

O you who believe! When you marry believing women, but then divorce them before you have touched them, there is no waiting period for you to observe in respect to them; but compensate them, and release them in a graceful manner.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا ۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا

**33:50** Profeta! To'on k cha'aj ti' teech a watanilo'ob, le maaxo'ob ta ts'aaj u siibalo'ob nupik, yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan teech, bey ts'a'abil teech tumen Allah, yeetel u paalo'ob ko'olelo'ob a taata suku'un, yeetel u paalo'ob ko'olelo'ob a na' suku'un ko'olel, yeetel u paalo'ob ko'olelo'ob a taata kiik, yeetel u paalo'ob ko'olelo'ob a na' kiik, le maaxo'ob tu p'atajo'ob u luumo'ob yeetel teech, yeetel jun tul aj oksaj ool ko'olel tu ts'aaj u baaj ti' le Profeta, wa le Profeta ku kaatik u nupik u baaj yeetel leti', chen ti' teech, ma' ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob. To'on k ojel ba'ax k jets'maj utia'al letio'ob yo'olal u watanilo'ob yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan tu k'abo'ob. Lela' utia'al ma' a yaan mix talamil. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O Prophet! We have permitted to you your wives to whom you have given their dowries, and those you already have, as granted to you by God, and the daughters of your paternal uncle, and the daughters of your paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncle, and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you, and a believing woman who has offered herself to the Prophet, if the Prophet desires to marry her, exclusively for you, and not for the believers. We know what We have ordained for them regarding their wives and those their right-hands possess. This is to spare you any difficulty. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّـٰتِىٓ ءَاتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّـٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكَ ٱلَّـٰتِى هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمْرَأَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِىِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۗ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

**33:51** A p'atiko'ob maax ka kaatik ti' letio'ob, a k'amiko'ob maax ka kaatik. Wa ka kaatik maax ta p'ataj, mina'an si'ipil yook'ol teech. Lelo' maas toh, utia'al u jets' ooltalo'ob, ma' u yaajtal u yoolo'ob, ka u ch'a'iko'ob uts ti' ba'ax ta ts'aaj ti' juuntulo'ob. Allah ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil a puksi'ik'ale'ex. Allah Aj Ojel Tulakal, Aj Ch'a' Ool.

You may defer any of them you wish, and receive any of them you wish. Should you desire any of those you had deferred, there is no blame on you. This is more proper, so that they will be comforted, and not be grieved, and be content with what you have given each one of them. God knows what is within your hearts. God is Omniscient and Clement.

۞ تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا

**33:52** Naach ti' lelo', mix u laak' ko'olelo'ob cha'ano'ob ti' teech, mix je'el a jeeliko'ob yeetel u laak' watanilo'ob, kex ka ki' ooltik u ki'ichpamilo'ob, chen le maaxo'ob yaan teech. Allah Aj Ilaj yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Beyond that, no other women are permissible for you, nor can you exchange them for other wives, even if you admire their beauty, except those you already have. God is Watchful over all things.

لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رَّقِيبًا

**33:53** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex! Ma' a wo'okole'ex ti' u otocho'ob le Profeta, chen wa ts'a'ak te'ex cha'aj a taale'ex utia'al hanal; ma' a pa'ate'ex u jets'a'al. Ka payale'ex, o'okene'ex. Ka ta hanale'ex ts'o'ok, xiikene'ex, ma' a p'aatale'ex utia'al tsikbal. Lelo' ku yaayajkunsik le Profeta, ku su'uktal ti' te'ex, ba'ale' Allah ma' tu su'uktal ti' le jaajo'. Ka ka kaatike'ex ti' u watanilo'ob junp'eel ba'al, kaatike'ex ti' tu paacho'ob junp'eel ta'akbal. Lelo' maas cho'ok utia'al a puksi'ik'ale'ex yeetel u puksi'ikalo'ob. Mix bik'in k'a'abet a yaayajkunsike'ex U Tuuxtbil Allah, mix bik'in k'a'abet a nupike'ex a baajo'ob yeetel u watanilo'ob tu paach leti', tumen lelo' junp'eel noj si'ipil yeetel Allah.

O you who believe! Do not enter the homes of the Prophet, unless you are given permission to come for a meal; and do not wait for its preparation. And when you are invited, go in. And when you have eaten, disperse, without lingering for conversation. This irritates the Prophet, and he shies away from you, but God does not shy away from the truth. And when you ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a screen; that is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You must never offend the Messenger of God, nor must you ever marry his wives after him, for that would be an enormity with God.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَـٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوا۟ فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى ٱلنَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَـٰعًا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا۟ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓا۟ أَزْوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا

**33:54** Wa ka e'esike'ex junp'eel ba'al, wa ka ta'akike'ex, Allah Aj Ojel ti' tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Whether you declare a thing, or hide it, God is Aware of all things.

إِن تُبْدُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا

**33:55** Mina'an si'ipil yook'ol letio'ob yo'olal u taata'obo'ob, u paalo'ob, u suku'uno'ob, u paalo'ob u suku'uno'ob, u paalo'ob u kiiko'ob, u ko'olelo'ob, wa u palilo'ob ko'olelo'ob. K'a'abet u p'aatalo'ob ku yu'ubiko'ob sajkil ti' Allah. Allah Aj Testimonio yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

There is no blame on them concerning their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers’ sons, or their sisters’ sons, or their women, or their female servants. But they should remain conscious of God. God is Witness over all things.

لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِىٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ ۗ وَٱتَّقِينَ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدًا

**33:56** Allah yeetel U angelo'ob ku bendisiiontiko'ob le Profeta. Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex, bendisiiontike'ex leti', ki'iki' t'aane'ex leti' yeetel ki'iki' t'aan jets' oolal.

God and His angels give blessings to the Prophet. O you who believe, call for blessings on him, and greet him with a prayer of peace.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ ۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا

**33:57** Le maaxo'ob ku yaayajkunsiko'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, Allah tu p'ataj p'ekil yook'ol letio'ob ichil le kuxtala' yeetel ichil le u laak' kuxtalo', tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku p'ektik.

Those who insult God and His Messenger, God has cursed them in this life and in the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a demeaning punishment.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
