**33:58** Le maaxo'ob ku yaayajkunsiko'ob aj oksaj ool wiiniko'ob yeetel aj oksaj ool ko'olelo'ob, tumen ba'alo'ob ma' tu beeto'ob, ku kuuchiko'ob junp'eel tuus bo'olil yeetel junp'eel si'ipil chiikpaj.

Those who harm believing men and believing women, for acts they did not commit, bear the burden of perjury and a flagrant sin.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلُوا۟ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا

**33:59** Profeta! A'ale ti' a watanilo'ob, a paalo'ob ko'olelo'ob, yeetel u ko'olelo'ob le aj oksaj oolo'ob, u senko'ob u nook'o'ob. Lelo' maas toh, utia'al u k'ajoolta'alo'ob yeetel ma' u yaayajkunsa'alo'ob. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O Prophet! Tell your wives, and your daughters, and the women of the believers, to lengthen their garments. That is more proper, so they will be recognized and not harassed. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَـٰبِيبِهِنَّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

**33:60** Wa le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, le maaxo'ob yaan k'oja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob, yeetel le aj sen t'aano'ob ichil le Kaajo' ma' tu p'ato'ob, To'on kun k ts'aik te'ex yook'ol letio'ob; ka ma' kun u p'aatalo'ob a weet kaajilo'ob te'elo' chen chichin k'iin.

If the hypocrites, and those with sickness in their hearts, and the rumormongers in the City, do not desist, We will incite you against them; then they will not be your neighbors there except for a short while.

۞ لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْمُرْجِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**33:61** P'ekta'ano'ob; tu'ux ka kaxta'alo'ob, k'a'abet u ch'a'alo'ob yeetel u kiinsa'alo'ob tulakal.

They are cursed; wherever they are found, they should be captured and killed outright.

مَّلْعُونِينَ ۖ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ أُخِذُوا۟ وَقُتِّلُوا۟ تَقْتِيلًا

**33:62** Bey uuchik u beelil Allah yeetel le maaxo'ob maanajo'ob taanil. Ma' kun a kaxtik jeejel u beelil Allah.

Such has been God’s precedent with those who passed away before. You will find no change in God’s system.

سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا

**33:63** Le maako'ob ku kaatiko'ob teech yo'olal le K'intzilo'. A'ale: U na'atili' yaan yeetel Allah. Ba'ax a woojel? U laak' le K'intzilo' naats'aan.

The people ask you about the Hour. Say, “The knowledge thereof rests with God. But what do you know? Perhaps the hour is near.”

يَسْـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا

**33:64** Allah tu p'ataj p'ekil yook'ol le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob le elel k'aak'o'.

God has cursed the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a Blaze.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا

**33:65** Ku p'aatalo'ob ichilo' mantats', mina'an aj kanan mix aj aantaj u ti'alo'ob.

Dwelling therein forever, not finding a protector or a savior.

خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

**33:66** Le K'iin ken u jaalk'abta'al u ni'o'ob ichil le K'aak'o', kun u ya'alo'ob: Wa tu yu'ubajo'on Allah yeetel tu yu'ubajo'on le Tuuxtbilo'!

The Day when their faces are flipped into the Fire, they will say, “If only we had obeyed God and obeyed the Messenger.”

يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠

**33:67** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Yuumtsil, tu yu'ubajo'on k nojo'ob yeetel k aj jalbeso'ob, ba'ale' tu sa'ato'ob k beel.

And they will say, “Lord, we have obeyed our superiors and our dignitaries, but they led us away from the way.

وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠

**33:68** Yuumtsil, ts'a ti' letio'ob ka'aten le yaayajilo', p'at p'ekil yook'ol letio'ob yeetel junp'eel noj p'ekil.

Lord, give them double the punishment, and curse them with a great curse.”

رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا

**33:69** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex! Ma' a p'aatale'ex bey le maaxo'ob tu yaayajkunso'ob Moses; Allah tu cho'aj leti' ti' ba'ax tu ya'alajo'ob. Leti' chiikbesa'an yeetel Allah.

O you who believe! Do not be like those who abused Moses; but God cleared him of what they said. He was distinguished with God.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟ ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا

**33:70** Te'ex maaxo'ob ku oksike'ex a woole'ex! Yu'ubike'ex sajkil ti' Allah, t'aane'ex yeetel t'aan toh.

O you who believe! Be conscious of God, and speak in a straightforward manner.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا

**33:71** Kun u beetik toh a meyaje'ex, kun u sa'atesik a kebanilo'ob. Maax ku yu'ubik Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, tu naajaltaj junp'eel noj naajal.

He will rectify your conduct for you, and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger has won a great victory.

يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا

**33:72** To'on k e'esaj le kananil ts'a'abil ti' le ka'ano'ob, le luum, yeetel le wiitso'ob; ba'ale' ma' tu kaato'ob u kuchiko'ob, sajako'ob ti'; le wiinik tu k'amaj. Leti' ma' toh, mina'an na'at ti'.

We offered the Trust to the heavens, and the earth, and the mountains; but they refused to bear it, and were apprehensive of it; but the human being accepted it. He was unfair and ignorant.

إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا

**33:73** Allah kun u yaayajkunsik le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, wiiniko'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob, yeetel le aj ts'aaj yet-maako'ob, wiiniko'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob. Allah kun u sa'atesik le aj oksaj oolo'ob, wiiniko'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob. Allah mantats' Aj Sa'atesaj, le maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal.

God will punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the idolaters, men and women. And God will redeem the believers, men and women. God is Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا

## 34. Sheba

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**34:1** Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, Maax u ti'al tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luumo'; ki'iki' t'aan ti' Leti' ichil le u laak' kuxtalo'. Leti' le Aj Na'at, le Aj Ojel.

Praise be to God, to Whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Wise, the Expert.

ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ

**34:2** Ku yojel ba'ax ku o'okol ichil luum, ba'ax ku jook'ol ti', ba'ax ku luubul ti' ka'an, yeetel ba'ax ku naakal ti'. Leti' le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le Aj Sa'atesaj.

He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

**34:3** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Le K'intzilo' ma' kun u k'uchul yook'ol to'on. A'ale: Jaaj, tumen in Yuumtsil, kun u k'uchul yook'ol te'ex. Leti' Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ma' ku yila'al. Mix u p'iisil le maas chichin ba'alo' ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luumo', mix ba'al maas chichin wa maas noj, ku sa'atik U na'at. Tulakal yaan ichil junp'eel Aanalte' Saasil.

Those who disbelieve say, “The Hour will not come upon us.” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will come upon you. He is the Knower of the unseen.” Not an atom's weight in the heavens and the earth, or anything smaller or larger, escapes His knowledge. All are in a Clear Record.

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ

**34:4** Utia'al u bo'otik le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob. Le'oba' kun u yaan u sa'atesa'alo'ob, yeetel junp'eel ayik'al siibal hanal.

That He may recompense those who believe and do good works. Those will have forgiveness, and a generous provision.

لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

**34:5** Le maaxo'ob ku meyajo'ob ti' u paach k e'esa'abilo'ob, ku kaxtiko'ob u sa'ato'ob, ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ti' junp'eel yaayajil k'oja'anil.

As for those who strive against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—for them is a punishment of a painful plague.

وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ

**34:6** Le maaxo'ob ts'a'abil na'at ti' ku yojelo'ob le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' teech ti' a Yuumtsil le jaajo'; ku chiikbesik beel tak u beel le Yaan Muuk', le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

Those who received knowledge know that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth; and it guides to the path of the Majestic, the Praiseworthy.

وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

**34:7** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: K e'esik te'ex jun tul wiinik, kun u ya'alik te'ex, ka a xoot'olo'ex tulakal, kun a p'aatale'ex ichil junp'eel tuumben beetajil?

Those who disbelieved said, “Shall we point out to you a man, who will tell you that, once torn into shreds, you will be in a new creation?

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

**34:8** Wa tu beetaj tuus yo'olal Allah, wa mina'an u na'at ichil leti'? Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le u laak' kuxtalo' yano'ob ichil yaayajil, naach sa'ata'an u beelo'ob.

Did he invent a lie about God, or is there madness in him?” Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in torment, and far astray.

أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَـٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ

**34:9** Ma' wa ku tukultiko'ob ba'ax yaan tu taano'ob yeetel tu paacho'ob, ti' le ka'an yeetel le luumo'? Wa To'on k kaatik, je'el k beetik u luubul luum yaanal letio'ob, wa k ts'aik u luubul xoot'o'ob ka'an yook'ol letio'ob. Ichil lelo' yaan junp'eel chiikul utia'al tulakal palil ku suutik u baaj ti' Allah.

Do they not reflect upon what lies before them and behind them, of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth cave in beneath them, or make pieces of the sky fall down on them. In that is a sign for every devout servant.

أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

**34:10** To'on k ts'aaj ti' David uts ti' To'on: Te'ex wiitso'ob, yeetel ch'iich'o'ob: a'ale'ex ki'iki' t'aan yeetel leti'. To'on k beetaj suuk le maskabo' utia'al leti'.

We bestowed upon David favor from Us: “O mountains, and birds: echo with him.” And We softened iron for him.

۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَـٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ

**34:11** Beet a wookolo'ob ti' maskab, p'is uts u nupilo'ob; meyajne'ex toh. Teen Aj Ilaj ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

“Make coats of armor, and measure the links well; and work righteousness. I am Observant of everything you do.”

أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**34:12** Utia'al Solomon le iik'o', u xiimbal taanil junp'eel winal, u suut junp'eel winal. To'on k beetaj u jook'ol alquitran utia'al leti'. Yaan jinno'ob ku meyajo'ob yaanal leti', tumen u cha'aj u Yuumtsil. Maax ichil letio'ob ku p'atik K a'almajt'aan, To'on kun k beetik u yubik u yaayajil le K'aak' Mitnalo'.

And for Solomon the wind—its outward journey was one month, and its return journey was one month. And We made a spring of tar flow for him. And there were sprites that worked under him, by the leave of his Lord. But whoever of them swerved from Our command, We make him taste of the punishment of the Inferno.

وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**34:13** Tu beeto'ob utia'al leti' ba'ax ku kaatik: naj payalchi'o'ob, chiikulo'ob beetbil, noj p'uulo'ob bey ja' kuuchilo'ob, chich lecho'ob. Te'ex Otoch David, meyajne'ex yeetel ki'iki' t'aan; chen chichin ti' in palilo'ob aj ki'iki' t'aan.

They made for him whatever he wished: sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons. “O House of David, work with appreciation,” but a few of My servants are appreciative.

يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَـٰرِيبَ وَتَمَـٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَـٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ

**34:14** Ka To'on k xotaj t'aan kiimil utia'al leti', mixba'al tu e'esaj u kiimil ti' letio'ob chen junp'eel ba'alche' luum ku jaantik u che'il u muk'. Ka tu luubul, chiikpaj ti' le jinno'ob, wa tu yojelo'ob ka'ach ba'ax ma' ku yila'al, ma' tu p'aatalo'ob ka'ach ichil le yaayajil ku p'ektik.

Then, when We decreed death for him, nothing indicated his death to them except an earthworm eating at his staff. Then, when he fell down, it became clear to the sprites that, had they known the unseen, they would not have remained in the demeaning torment.

فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

**34:15** Ichil u luumil Sheba yaan ka'ach junp'eel chiikpaj uts: ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob, junp'eel tu no'oj, junp'eel tu ts'iik. Jane'ex ti' u siibal hanal a Yuumtsile'ex, ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan ti' Leti'. Junp'eel uts luum, yeetel jun tul Yuumtsil Aj Sa'atesaj.

In Sheba’s homeland there used to be a wonder: two gardens, on the right, and on the left. “Eat of your Lord’s provision, and give thanks to Him.” A good land, and a forgiving Lord.

لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ

**34:16** Tu suto'ob u paacho'ob, ka To'on k jook'saj yook'ol letio'ob le noj ja' le k'alo', k k'exaj u ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob yeetel ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob yaan k'aaj ba'alo'ob, che'o'ob yaan k'i'ix, chichin naajal.

But they turned away, so We unleashed against them the flood of the dam; and We substituted their two gardens with two gardens of bitter fruits, thorny shrubs, and meager harvest.

فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ

**34:17** Bey To'on k bo'otaj letio'ob tumen ma' tu ts'aajo'ob ki'iki' t'aan. K bo'otik mix maax chen le maax ma' tu ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan?

We thus penalized them for their ingratitude. Would We penalize any but the ungrateful?

ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَـٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ

**34:18** Ichil letio'ob yeetel le kaajo'ob To'on k ts'aaj uts ti'obo', To'on k ts'aaj kaajo'ob chiikpajo'ob, k jets'aj u xiimbal ichil letio'ob ma' talam. Xiimbale'ex ichil letio'ob ak'ab yeetel k'iin, yeetel jets' oolal.

Between them and the towns We had blessed, We placed prominent towns, and We made the travel between them easy. “Travel between them by night and day, in safety.”

وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَـٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ

**34:19** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K Yuumtsil, senk u naachil k xiimbalo'ob. Tu beeto'ob ma' toh ti' u baajo'ob; ka To'on k beetaj letio'ob bey uuchben tsikbalo'ob, k t'ojaj letio'ob tulakal tu'ux. Ichil lelo' yaan chiikbesajilo'ob utia'al tulakal aj ch'a' muk' aj ki'iki' t'aan.

But they said, “Our Lord, lengthen the distances of our journeys.” They wronged themselves; so We made them history, and We scattered them in every direction. In this are lessons for every steadfast and appreciative person.

فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَـٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَـٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

**34:20** Kisin jaaj tu tukultaj yo'olal letio'ob. Tu ts'aajo'ob u paach, chen jun muuch' aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Satan was correct in his assessment of them. They followed him, except for a group of believers.

وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**34:21** Mina'an a'almajt'aan ti' leti' yook'ol letio'ob; chen To'on k kaat k e'esik maax ku oksik u yool ti' le u laak' kuxtalo', ti' maax yaan ma' jaaj oolal yo'olal. A Yuumtsil Aj Kanan yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

He had no authority over them; except that We willed to distinguish him who believes in the Hereafter, from him who is doubtful about it. Your Lord is Guardian over all things.

وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ

**34:22** A'ale: Paye'ex le maaxo'ob ka a'alike'ex yano'ob tu ts'eel Allah. Mix u p'iisil le maas chichin ba'alo' u ti'alo'ob ichil le ka'ano'ob wa le luumo', mixba'al u jaajilo'ob ti' ka'ap'eel, Leti' mina'an aj aantajo'ob ichil letio'ob.

Say, “Call upon those whom you claim besides God. They possess not an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth, and they possess no share of either, and He has no backers from among them.”

قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ

**34:23** Le t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal u laak' mina'an u muk', chen utia'al maax Leti' tu cha'aj. Tak ka le sajkil jook'ok ti' u puksi'ik'alo'ob, kun u ya'alo'ob: Ba'ax tu ya'alaj a Yuumtsile'ex? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Le jaajo'; Leti' le Ka'anal, le Noj.

Intercession with Him is of no value, except for someone He has permitted. Until, when fear has subsided from their hearts, they will say, “What did your Lord say?” They will say, “The truth, and He is the High, the Great.”

وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**34:24** A'ale: Maax ku ts'aik te'ex hanal ti' le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luumo'? A'ale: Allah. Te'ex wa to'on, yook'ol chiikbesajil beel wa ichil sa'atal beel chiikpaj.

Say, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “God. And Either you, or we, are rightly guided, or in evident error.”

۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**34:25** A'ale: Ma' kun kaatbil te'ex yo'olal k si'ipilo'ob, mix to'on kun kaatbil yo'olal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Say, “You will not be asked about our misdeeds, nor will we be asked about what you do.”

قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

**34:26** A'ale: K Yuumtsil kun u muuch'kintiko'on; ka kun u xot t'aan ichil to'on yeetel toh. Leti' le Aj Ojel Tulakal, le Aj Xot T'aan.

Say, “Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us equitably. He is the All-Knowing Judge.”

قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**34:27** A'ale: E'es teen le maaxo'ob ta ts'aaje'ex ti' Leti' bey yet-maako'ob. Mix! Leti' Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Say, “Show me those you have attached to Him as associates. No indeed! But He is God, the Powerful, the Wise.”

قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**34:28** To'on k tuuxtajech chen utia'al tulakal maako'ob, bey aj ts'aaj uts k'aaj, yeetel bey aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan, ba'ale' le maas ya'ab maako'ob ma' u yojelo'ob.

We sent you only universally to all people, a herald and warner, but most people do not know.

وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**34:29** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax k'iin kun beetbil le promesa', wa te'ex aj jaajo'ob?

And they say, “When is this promise due, if you are truthful?”

وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**34:30** A'ale: Ts'a'abil te'ex junp'eel K'iin, ma' je'el a pa'ate'ex paachil junp'eel suutuk, mix a taaso'ob taanil.

Say, “You are promised a Day, which you cannot postpone by one hour, nor bring forward.”

قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

**34:31** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Mix bik'in kun k oksik k ool ti' le Aanalte'a', mix ti' ba'ax taal taanil ti'. Wa a wilaj le aj ma' toh oolo'ob, ch'a'ano'ob tu taan u Yuumtsilo'ob, ku suto'ob t'aan u baajo'ob. Le maaxo'ob p'ata'ano'ob yaanal kun u ya'alo'ob ti' le aj ka'anal oolo'ob: Wa ma' te'ex ka'ach, to'on aj oksaj oolo'on ka'ach.

Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Quran, nor in what came before it.” If you could only see the wrongdoers, captive before their Lord, throwing back allegations at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “Were it not for you, we would have been believers.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ

**34:32** Le aj ka'anal oolo'ob kun u ya'alo'ob ti' le maaxo'ob p'ata'ano'ob yaanal: To'on wa k kala'antaje'ex ti' le chiikbesajil beelo' ka taal te'ex? Mix, te'ex a baajo'ob aj kebano'ob.

Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, “Was it us who turned you away from guidance when it came to you? No indeed, you yourselves were sinful.”

قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ

**34:33** Le maaxo'ob p'ata'ano'ob yaanal kun u ya'alo'ob ti' le aj ka'anal oolo'ob: A meyaj tuuso'ob ak'ab yeetel k'iin; ka ta a'alo'on k p'atik Allah, k ts'aik yet-maako'ob ti' Leti'. Kun u ta'ako'ob u k'a'ajsajil k'aas oolal ka u yilo'ob le bo'olilo'. To'on kun k ts'aik kuuchilo'ob yook'ol u kaalo'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob. Kun bo'otbilo'ob tumen mixba'al tu ts'eel ba'ax tu beeto'ob ka'ach?

And those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “It was your scheming by night and day; as you instructed us to reject God, and to set up rivals to Him.” They will hide their remorse when they see the retribution. We will put yokes around the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be repaid for anything other than what they used to do?

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**34:34** To'on ma' k tuuxt mix aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' mix kaaj, chen u ayik'alo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: K p'atik le ba'ax tuuxta'ab te'ex.

We sent no warner to any town, without its affluent saying, “We reject what you are sent with.”

وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**34:35** Ku ya'aliko'ob: To'on ya'ab k ayik'alil yeetel ya'ab k paalilo'ob, ma' kun yaayajkunsa'alo'on.

And they say, “We have more wealth and more children, and we will not be punished.”

وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

**34:36** A'ale: In Yuumtsil ku senkik u siibal hanal ti' maax ku kaatik, wa ku p'iskuntik; ba'ale' le maas ya'ab maako'ob ma' u yojelo'ob.

Say, “My Lord spreads out His bounty to whomever He wills, or restricts it; but most people do not know.”

قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**34:37** Ma' a ayik'alile'ex mix a paalile'ex ku naats'ik te'ex ti' To'on, chen maax ku oksik u yool yeetel ku beetik uts meyajo'ob. Le'oba' kun u yaan ka'aten u bo'olo'ob tumen ba'ax tu beeto'ob; kun u p'aatalo'ob ichil le Kuuchilo'ob, yeetel jets' oolal yeetel kananil.

It is neither your wealth nor your children that bring you closer to Us, but it is he who believes and does good deeds. These will have a double reward for what they did; and they will reside in the Chambers, in peace and security.

وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ

**34:38** Le maaxo'ob ku meyajo'ob ti' u paach k e'esa'abilo'ob, ku kaxtiko'ob u sa'ato'ob, le'oba' kun paybilo'ob tak le yaayajilo'.

But those who work against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—those will be summoned to the punishment.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ

**34:39** A'ale: In Yuumtsil ku senkik le siibal hanalo' ti' maax ku kaatik ichil U palilo'ob, wa ku p'iskuntik. Ba'ax ka ts'aike'ex, Leti' kun u jeelik. Leti' le maas uts ichil le aj ts'aaj hanalo'ob.

Say, “My Lord extends the provision to whomever He wills of His servants, or withholds it. Anything you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of providers.”

قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

**34:40** Le K'iin ken u muuch'kintik tulakal letio'ob, ka kun u ya'alik ti' le angelo'ob: Te'ex wa tu kultajo'ob le'oba' ka'ach?

On the Day when He gathers them all together, then say to the angels, “Was it you these used to worship?”

وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

**34:41** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ki'ichpam teech; Teech k Yuumil, ma' letio'ob. Jaaj, tu kultajo'ob le jinno'ob ka'ach, le maas ya'ab ti' letio'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ti' letio'ob.

They will say, “Be You glorified; You are our Master, not them. In fact, they used to worship the jinn, and most of them had faith in them.”

قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ

**34:42** Bejla'e', mix juntul ichile'ex yaan u muk' u ts'aik uts wa k'aas ti' u laak'. To'on kun k a'alik ti' le maaxo'ob tu beeto'ob ma' toh: Yu'ube'ex u yaayajil le K'aak'o' ta p'atajo'ob ka'ach.

“Today, none of you has the power to profit or harm the other.” And We will say to those who did wrong, “Taste the agony of the Fire which you used to deny.”

فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

**34:43** Ka k chiikulo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob saasil ku tsikbalta'ako'ob ti' letio'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: Lela' chen jun tul wiinik ku kaatik u p'atike'ex ti' ba'ax a taata'obo'ob uuchik u kultiko'ob ka'ach. Ku ya'aliko'ob: Lela' chen junp'eel tuus beetbil. Ka le Jaajo' ku k'uchul ti' letio'ob, le aj ma' oksaj oolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob yo'olal le Jaajo': Lela' chen junp'eel tuus e'esajil chiikpaj.

And when Our enlightening Verses are recited to them, they say, “This is nothing but a man who wants to divert you from what your ancestors used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a fabricated lie.” And when the Truth comes to them, the blasphemers say of the Truth, “This is nothing but plain magic.”

وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**34:44** To'on ma' k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob mix aanalte' u xooko'ob, ma' k tuuxt mix aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob ka'ach ta taal.

But We gave them no book to study, and We did not send them any warner before you.

وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ

**34:45** Le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob tu p'atajo'ob le Jaajo' xan, ma' tu naajalto'ob junp'eel ti' lajup'eel ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ka'ach. Tu p'atajo'ob in tuuxtbilo'ob, bey u p'ekil teen?

Those before them also denied the Truth, yet they have not attained one-tenth of what We had given them. They rejected My messengers, so how was My disapproval?

وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

**34:46** A'ale: Teen kun in a'alik te'ex chen junp'eel a'ale: ts'aike'ex a baajo'ob ti' Allah, ka'atul wa juntuulil; tukultike'ex. Mina'an ka'ap'el oolal ichil a weeta'ile'ex. Leti' chen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' te'ex, taanil ti' junp'eel chich yaayajil.

Say, “I offer you a single advice: devote yourselves to God, in pairs, or individually; and reflect. There is no madness in your friend. He is just a warner to you, before the advent of a severe punishment.”

۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ

**34:47** A'ale: Ba'ax bo'olil in kaataj te'ex, a ti'ale'ex. In bo'olil chen ti' Allah, Leti' Aj Testimonio yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Say, “Whatever compensation I have asked of you, is yours. My compensation comes only from God, and He is Witness over all things.”

قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

**34:48** A'ale: In Yuumtsil ku tuuxtik le jaajo' taanil. Leti' Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ma' ku yila'al.

Say, “My Lord projects the truth. He is the Knower of the Unseen.”

قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ

**34:49** A'ale: Le Jaajo' taal; le ma' jaajo' ma' je'el u kaajik mixba'al, mix u beetik paachil.

Say, “The Truth has come; while falsehood can neither originate, nor regenerate.”

قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

**34:50** A'ale: Wa teen ku sa'atal in beel, chen yook'ol in pixan ku sa'atal; wa teen yook'ol chiikbesajil beel, tumen ba'ax in Yuumtsil ku e'esik teen. Leti' Aj U'uyaj, Naats'.

Say, “If I err, I err only to my own loss; but if I am guided, it is by what my Lord inspires me. He is Hearing and Near.”

قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ

**34:51** Wa a wilaj ka sajako'ob, mina'an puuts'ul, ch'a'ano'ob ti' junp'eel kuuchil naats'.

If you could only see when they are terrified, and there is no escape, and they are seized from a nearby place.

وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

**34:52** Ku ya'aliko'ob: K oksaj k ool ti'. Beyxan je'el u naajalto'ob ti' junp'eel kuuchil naach?

And they say, “We have believed in it.” But how can they attain it from a distant place?

وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**34:53** Tu p'atajo'ob taanil, tu beeto'ob t'aano'ob yo'olal ba'ax ma' ku yila'al ti' junp'eel kuuchil naach.

They have rejected it in the past, and made allegations from a far-off place.

وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**34:54** Junp'eel k'alaj kun ts'a'ak ichil letio'ob yeetel ba'ax ku kaatiko'ob, bey beetbil ti' u yet-maako'ob taanil. Letio'ob yano'ob ichil ma' jaaj oolal ku peeksik ool.

A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done formerly with their counterparts. They were in disturbing doubt.

وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ

## 35. The Originator

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**35:1** Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, le Aj Beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, le Aj Beetaj le angelo'ob tuuxtbilo'ob yaan u xiik'o'ob — ka'ap'eel, ooxp'eel, yeetel kamp'eel. Ku ya'besik le beetajil je'el ba'ax u k'aat. Allah Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'alo'ob.

Praise be to God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Maker of the angels messengers with wings—double, triple, and quadruple. He adds to creation as He wills. God is Able to do all things.

ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**35:2** Ba'ax yatzil Allah ku taasik ti' le maako'ob, mix maax je'el u p'atik. Wa Leti' ku p'atik, mix maax je'el u cha'ik tu paach Leti'. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Whatever mercy God unfolds for the people, none can withhold it. And if He withholds it, none can release it thereafter. He is the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**35:3** Maako'ob! K'a'ajsike'ex u siibalo'ob Allah yook'ol te'ex. Yaan wa u laak' aj beetaj tu ts'eel Allah, maax ku ts'aik te'ex a kuxtale'ex ti' le ka'an yeetel le luum? Mina'an u laak' k'uj, chen Leti'. Beyo', bix a sa'atike'ex a beele'ex?

O people! Remember God’s blessings upon you. Is there a creator other than God who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He. So how are you misled?

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَـٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

**35:4** Wa ku p'ektiko'ob a t'aan, tuuxtbilo'ob taanil ti' teech xan p'ekta'abo'ob u t'aano'ob. Ti' Allah ku suut tulakal ba'alo'ob.

If they reject you, messengers before you were also rejected. To God all matters are returned.

وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

**35:5** Maako'ob! U promesa Allah jaaj; ma' a cha'ike'ex u kuxtal le yook'ol kaaba' u tuusik te'ex, ma' a cha'ike'ex le Aj Tuus u tuusik te'ex naach ti' Allah.

O people! The promise of God is true; so let not the lowly life seduce you, and let not the Tempter tempt you away from God.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

**35:6** Kisin junp'eel aj p'ek ti' te'ex, ch'a'ike'ex bey aj p'ek. Chen ku payik u muuch' utia'al u p'aatalo'ob ichil le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak' Mitnal.

Satan is an enemy to you, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his gang to be among the inmates of the Inferno.

إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**35:7** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil chich, ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob yaan ti' letio'ob sa'atesaj yeetel junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Those who disbelieve will suffer a harsh punishment, but those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a great reward.

ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

**35:8** Ba'ax yo'olal maax u k'aas meyaj ki'ichpambesa'ab ti' leti', ka ku yilik bey uts? Allah ku sa'atik u beel maax u k'aat, ku chiikbesik beel ti' maax u k'aat. Beyo', ma' a sa'atik a baaj tumen yaaj oolal yook'ol letio'ob. Allah ku yojel jaaj ba'ax ku beetiko'ob.

What of him whose evil deed was made attractive to him, and so he regards it as good? God leads astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not waste yourself sorrowing over them. God knows exactly what they do.

أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

**35:9** Allah Leti' maax ku tuuxtik le iik'o'ob, ku peeksiko'ob le muyalo'ob, ka To'on k bisik ti' junp'eel luum kiimen, ka k ts'aik kuxtal ti' le luum tu paach u kiimil. Bey xan le Liksajilo'.

God is He who sends the winds, which agitate clouds, which We drive to a dead land, and thereby revive the ground after it had died. Likewise is the Resurrection.

وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ

**35:10** Maax ku k'aatik ki'ichpamil — tulakal ki'ichpamil u ti'al Allah. Ti' Leti' ku naakal t'aan cho'ok, Leti' ku ka'analkunsik toh meyaj. Le maaxo'ob ku tukultiko'ob k'aas, junp'eel yaayajil chich ku pa'atik letio'ob, u tukulilo'ob kun sa'atalo'ob.

Whoever desires honor—all honor belongs to God. To Him ascends speech that is pure, and He elevates righteous conduct. As for those who plot evil, a terrible punishment awaits them, and the planning of these will fail.

مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ

**35:11** Allah tu beetaje'ex ti' luum, ka ti' junp'eel chichin ja'el ja', ka tu beetaje'ex yet-kuxtalo'ob. Mix juntul ko'olel ku ch'a'ik paal ichil u nak', mix ku siijil, chen yeetel u na'at Allah. Mix ba'al kuxtal ku ya'abtal u ja'abilo'ob, mix ku p'iitta'al u kuxtal, chen yaan ichil junp'eel Ts'iib. Lelo' ma' talam ti' Allah.

God created you from dust, then from a small drop; then He made you pairs. No female conceives, or delivers, except with His knowledge. No living thing advances in years, or its life is shortened, except it be in a Record. That is surely easy for God.

وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

**35:12** Le ka'ap'eel k'aak'naabo'ob ma' junp'eelili'ob. Junp'eel ch'ujuk, uts u yuk'a'al, u laak' k'a'an yeetel k'aaj. Ti' tulakal ka'ap'eel ka jantike'ex bak' tuumben, ka ka jook'sike'ex ki'ichpam ba'alo'ob ka buukintike'ex. Ka ka wilike'ex le cheemo'ob ku maano'ob ichilo'ob, utia'al a kaxtike'ex ti' u siibal Allah, utia'al a ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan.

The two seas are not the same. One is fresh, sweet, good to drink, while the other is salty and bitter. Yet from each you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through them, so that you may seek of His bounty, so that you may give thanks.

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

**35:13** Ku yok'sik le ak'ab ichil le k'iin, ku yok'sik le k'iin ichil le ak'ab; ku jets'ik le k'iin yeetel le uj, tulakal ku maano'ob tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Bey Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex; u ti'al le jalbesil. Le maaxo'ob ka payalchi'tike'ex tu ts'eel Leti', mina'an u ti'alo'ob mix junp'eel chichin ba'al.

He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He regulates the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. Such is God, your Lord; His is the sovereignty. As for those you call upon besides Him, they do not possess a speck.

يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ

**35:14** Wa ka payalchi'tike'ex letio'ob, ma' je'el u yu'ubiko'ob a payalchi'. Kex u yu'ubo'ob, ma' kun u nuukike'ex. Tu K'iinil Liksajil, kun u p'ekto'ob a yet-maakile'ex. Mix maax ku ts'aik te'ex k'aaj bey junp'eel Aj Ojel.

If you pray to them, they cannot hear your prayer. And even if they heard, they would not answer you. And on the Day of Resurrection, they will reject your partnership. None informs you like an Expert.

إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ

**35:15** Maako'ob! Te'ex le ootsilo'ob, a k'a'abetex Allah; Allah leti' le Ayik'al, le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

O people! It is you who are the poor, in need of God; while God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.

۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

**35:16** Wa u k'aat, je'el u luk'sik te'ex, u taasik junp'eel tuumben beetajil.

If He wills, He can do away with you, and produce a new creation.

إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

**35:17** Lelo' ma' talam ti' Allah.

And that would not be difficult for God.

وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ

**35:18** Mix junp'eel pixan ku kuchik u kuuch u laak'. Kex junp'eel pixan kuuchben ku payik aantaj yo'olal u kuuch, mixba'al je'el u luk'sa'al ti', kex u laak'o'ob. Chen a k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' le maaxo'ob ku sajaktalo'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob, yeetel ku beetiko'ob le payalchi'o'. Maax ku cho'ik u baaj, chen utia'al u uts u baaj ku cho'ik. Ti' Allah le ts'ook suut.

No burdened soul can carry the burden of another. Even if one weighted down calls for help with its burden, nothing can be lifted from it, even if they were related. You are to warn those who fear their Lord inwardly, and perform the prayer. He who purifies himself purifies himself for his own good. To God is the ultimate return.

وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**35:19** Ma' junp'eelili'ob le ch'oop yeetel le ku yilik.

Not equal are the blind and the seeing.

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ

**35:20** Mix le ak'abo'ob yeetel le saasil.

Nor are the darkness and the light.

وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ

**35:21** Mix le bo'oy yeetel le chich chokwil.

Nor are the shade and the torrid heat.

وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ

**35:22** Mix junp'eelili'ob le kuxtalo'ob yeetel le kiimeno'ob. Allah ku beetik u yu'ub maax u k'aat, ba'ale' teech ma' je'el a beetik u yu'ubo'ob le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le muknalo'ob.

Nor are equal the living and the dead. God causes whomever He wills to hear, but you cannot make those in the graves hear.

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

**35:23** Teech chen junp'eel aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan.

You are only a warner.

إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ

**35:24** To'on k tuuxtajech yeetel le jaajo'; junp'eel aj taas uts k'aaj, yeetel junp'eel aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan. Mina'an kaaj mina'an aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan maan ichilo'.

We sent you with the truth; a bearer of good news, and a warner. There is no community but a warner has passed through it.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ

**35:25** Wa ku p'ektiko'ob a t'aan, le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob xan tu p'ektajo'ob. U tuuxtbilo'ob tu taalo'ob ti' letio'ob yeetel le chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, yeetel le Zaburo'ob, yeetel le Aanalte' ku ts'aik saasil.

If they disbelieve you, those before them also disbelieved. Their messengers came to them with the clear proofs, with the Psalms, and with the Enlightening Scripture.

وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ

**35:26** Ka Teen in ch'a'aj le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob — bey u p'ekil teen?

Then I seized those who disbelieved—so how was My rejection?

ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

**35:27** Ma' ta wilaj Allah ku ts'aik ja' ku taal ti' ka'an? Yeetel le ja'o' To'on k jook'sik wichilo'ob jejelaas u boonilo'ob. Ichil le wiitso'ob yaan bejo'ob sak yeetel chak — jejelaas u boonilo'ob — yeetel jach eek'.

Have you not seen that God sends down water from the sky? With it We produce fruits of various colors. And in the mountains are streaks of white and red—varying in their hue—and pitch-black.

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ

**35:28** Bey xan, wiiniko'ob, ba'alche'ob, yeetel tamano'ob ku taalo'ob jejelaas u boonilo'ob. Ichil u palilo'ob, le aj na'ato'ob ku sajaktalo'ob ti' Allah. Allah Yaan Muuk', Aj Sa'atesaj.

Likewise, human beings, animals, and livestock come in various colors. From among His servants, the learned fear God. God is Almighty, Oft-Forgiving.

وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ

**35:29** Le maaxo'ob ku xokiko'ob U Aanalte' Allah, ku beetiko'ob le payalchi'o', yeetel ku ts'aiko'ob ti' ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob, ichil ta'akbil yeetel ichil chiikpajil, ku pa'atiko'ob junp'eel koonol ma' kun sa'atal.

Those who recite the Book of God, and perform the prayer, and spend of what We have provided for them, secretly and publicly, expect a trade that will not fail.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ

**35:30** Kun u bo'otik ti' letio'ob u bo'olilo'ob tulakal, kun u ya'besik ti' letio'ob ti' u siibal. Leti' Aj Sa'atesaj, le Aj Ki'iki' T'aan.

He will pay them their dues in full, and will increase them from His bounty. He is Forgiving and Appreciative.

لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

**35:31** Ba'ax To'on k e'esaj ti' teech, ti' le Aanalte'o', leti' le jaajo', ku jets'ik ba'ax maan taanil ti'. Allah Aj Ojel ti' u palilo'ob, Aj Ilaj Tulakal.

What We inspired in you, of the Book, is the truth, confirming what preceded it. God is Well-Informed of His servants, All-Seeing.

وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

**35:32** Ka To'on k ts'aaj le Aanalte'o' ti' le maaxo'ob ichil k palilo'ob To'on k yeeyajo'ob. Yaan ichil letio'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas ti' u pixano'ob, yaan ku maano'ob ichil junp'eel beel ichil, yaan le maaxo'ob taanil ichil uts meyajo'ob tumen u cha'aj Allah; lelo' le maas noj siibal.

Then We passed the Book to those of Our servants whom We chose. Some of them wrong their souls, and some follow a middle course, and some are in the foremost in good deeds by God’s leave; that is the greatest blessing.

ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**35:33** Le Pak'alo'ob Eden, kun u yo'okolo'ob ichilo'ob. Kun u ki'ichpambesa'alo'ob te'elo' yeetel k'an taak'in ba'alo'ob yook'ol k'ab yeetel ki'ichpam tunicho'ob, u nook'o'ob te'elo' kun u p'aatalo'ob ti' suuk nook'.

The Gardens of Eden, which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with gold bracelets and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk.

جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ

**35:34** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, maax tu luk'saj tulakal yaaj oolal ti' to'on. K Yuumtsil, le maas Aj Sa'atesaj ichil tulakal, le maas Aj Ki'iki' T'aan ichil tulakal.

And they will say, “Praise God, who has lifted all sorrow from us. Our Lord is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.

وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

**35:35** Leti' maax tu jets'aj to'on ichil le Otoch Mantats', tumen u siibal, tu'ux chichin oolal ma' kun u machik to'on, mix yaj kuxtal ma' kun u yaayajkunsik to'on.

He Who settled us in the Home of Permanence, by His grace, where boredom will not touch us, and fatigue will not afflict us.”

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ

**35:36** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, u ti'alo'ob le K'aak' Mitnal, tu'ux mix bik'in kun u ts'o'oksa'alo'ob ka u kiimo'ob, mix kun u p'iitta'al u yaayajilo'ob ti' letio'ob. Bey To'on k bo'otik tulakal aj ma' ki'iki' t'aan.

As for those who disbelieve, for them is the Fire of Hell, wherein they will never be finished off and die, nor will its punishment be lightened for them. Thus We will repay every ingrate.

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ

**35:37** Ku awatiko'ob te'elo': K Yuumtsil, jook's to'on, kun k beetik toh, ma' bey ba'ax k beetik ka'ach. Ma' To'on k ts'aaj te'ex kuxtal chowak utia'al maax u k'aat u na'atik u na'ataj? Le aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan tu taal ti' te'ex. Beyo', u'uye'ex u yaayajil. Le aj k'aas meyajo'ob mina'an aj aantaj u ti'alo'ob.

And they will scream therein, “Our Lord, let us out, and we will act righteously, differently from the way we used to act.” Did We not give you a life long enough, in which anyone who wanted to understand would have understood? And the warner did come to you. So taste. The evildoers will have no helper.

وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

**35:38** Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax kun taal ti' le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Leti' ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

God is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He knows what the hearts contain.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَـٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**35:39** Leti' maax tu beetaje'ex aj suut kuxtalo'ob yook'ol luum. Maax ma' tu oksik u yool, u ma' oksaj oolalil kun suut yook'ol leti'. U ma' oksaj oolalil le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob chen ku ya'besik u p'ekil u Yuumtsilo'ob ti' letio'ob. U ma' oksaj oolalil le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob chen ku ya'besik u sa'atalo'ob.

It is He who made you successors on earth. Whoever disbelieves, his disbelief will recoil upon him. The disbelief of the disbelievers adds only to their Lord's disfavor of them. The disbelief of the disbelievers adds only to their perdition.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

**35:40** A'ale: Ta tukultaje'ex wa a yet-maako'ob ka kultike'ex tu ts'eel Allah? E'es teen ba'ax tu beetajo'ob yook'ol luum. Wa yaan u jaatsilo'ob ichil le ka'ano'ob? Wa To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob junp'eel aanalte' ku maano'ob yook'ol u chiikulo'ob saasil? Jaajil, le aj k'aas meyajo'ob chen ku promesa'atik u baajo'ob mixba'al chen tuuso'ob.

Say, “Have you considered those partners of yours that you worship instead of God? Show me what they have created on earth. Or do they have any share in the heavens?” Or have We given them a book whose clear teachings they follow? In fact, the wrongdoers promise one another nothing but delusions.

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا

**35:41** Allah ku kananik le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, ma' u luubulo'ob. Wa ku luubulo'ob, mina'an maax je'el u kananik letio'ob tu ts'eel Leti'. Leti' le maas Aj Ch'a' Ool ichil tulakal, le maas Aj Sa'atesaj ichil tulakal.

God holds the heavens and the earth, lest they fall apart. And were they to fall apart, there is none to hold them together except He. He is Most Clement, Most Forgiving.

۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

**35:42** Tu beetajo'ob hach t'aan tumen Allah yeetel u chich promesa'ob, wa junp'eel aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ku taal ti' letio'ob, kun u p'aatalo'ob maas chiikbesa'ano'ob ti' beel ti' mix junp'eel kaaj. Ka junp'eel aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan tu taal ti' letio'ob, chen tu ya'besaj u p'ekilo'ob.

And they swore by God with their solemn oaths, that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any other people. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion.

وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

**35:43** Ka'anal oolal yook'ol luum, yeetel tukultik k'aas. K'aas tukul chen ku k'uchul yook'ol u aj beetajo'ob. Ku pa'atiko'ob wa chen u beelil le uuchben maako'ob? Ma' kun a kaxtik mix jeelil ichil u beelil Allah, ma' kun a kaxtik mix u laak' ti' u beelil Allah.

Priding themselves on earth, and scheming evil. But evil scheming overwhelms none but its authors. Do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? You will not find any change in God’s practice, and you will not find any substitute to God’s practice.

ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا

**35:44** Ma' xiimbalnajo'ob yook'ol luum ka u yilajo'ob u ts'ook le maaxo'ob maanajo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob? Letio'ob chich'o'ob maas ti' letio'ob. Mixba'al je'el u sa'atik Allah ichil le ka'ano'ob mix yook'ol luum. Leti' Aj Ojel Tulakal, Yaan Muuk' Tulakal.

Have they not journeyed in the land and observed the fate of those who preceded them? They were superior to them in strength. But nothing can defeat God in the heavens or on Earth. He is indeed Omniscient and Omnipotent.

أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا

**35:45** Wa Allah ku yaayajkunsik le maako'ob tumen ba'ax tu naajalto'ob, ma' kun u p'atik mix junp'eel ba'al kuxtal yook'ol u paach le luum. Ba'ale' ku p'atik letio'ob tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Ka u k'iinilo'ob ku k'uchul — Allah Aj Ilaj ti' u palilo'ob.

If God were to punish the people for what they have earned, He would not leave a single living creature on its surface. But He defers them until a stated time. Then, when their time has arrived—God is Observant of His creatures.

وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا

## 36. Ya-Sin

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**36:1** Ya, Seen.

Ya, Seen.

يسٓ

**36:2** Tumen le Quran Aj Na'at.

By the Wise Quran.

وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**36:3** Teech juntul ichil le tuuxtbilo'ob.

You are one of the messengers.

إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**36:4** Yook'ol junp'eel toh beel.

On a straight path.

عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**36:5** Le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

The revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful.

تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

**36:6** Utia'al a k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' junp'eel kaaj u taata'ob ma' k'a'ay a'almajt'aanta'abo'ob, bey ma' u yojelo'ob.

To warn a people whose ancestors were not warned, and so they are unaware.

لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

**36:7** Le T'aan jaajchaj yook'ol u ya'abilo'ob, tumen ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

The Word was realized against most of them, for they do not believe.

لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**36:8** To'on k ts'aaj kuucho'ob yook'ol u kaalo'ob, tak u ka'abalo'ob, bey chich u kaalo'ob.

We placed shackles around their necks, up to their chins, so they are stiff-necked.

إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

**36:9** To'on k jets'aj junp'eel ba'al ichil taanil ti' letio'ob, yeetel junp'eel ba'al ichil tu paacho'ob, ka To'on k pixaj letio'ob, bey ma' je'el u yiliko'ob.

And We placed a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them, so they cannot see.

وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ

**36:10** Junp'eelili' ti' letio'ob, wa a k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob, wa ma' a k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob — ma' kun u oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

It is the same for them, whether you warn them, or do not warn them—they will not believe.

وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**36:11** Chen a k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' maax ku ts'aik u paach ti' le k'a'ajsajilo', ku sajaktal ti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil u puksi'ik'al. Beyo', ts'a ti' leti' uts k'aaj ti' sa'atesaj, yeetel junp'eel ayik'al bo'olil.

You warn only him who follows the Message, and fears the Beneficent inwardly. So give him good news of forgiveness, and a generous reward.

إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ

**36:12** To'on, To'onili', k ts'aik kuxtal ti' le kiimeno'ob; k ts'iibtik ba'ax tu tuuxtajo'ob taanil, yeetel u yooko'ob. To'on k xokaj tulakal ba'alo'ob ichil junp'eel Ts'iib Saasil.

It is We who revive the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded, and their traces. We have tallied all things in a Clear Record.

إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

**36:13** Ts'a ti' letio'ob bey junp'eel e'esajil le aj yuumilo'ob le kaajo' — ka le tuuxtbilo'ob tu taalo'ob ti'.

And cite for them the parable of the landlords of the town—when the messengers came to it.

وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

**36:14** To'on k tuuxtaj ti' letio'ob ka'ap'el tuuxtbilo'ob, ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob u t'aan ka'ap'elo'ob, bey To'on k chichkunsaj letio'ob yeetel junp'eel ooxp'eel. Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on tuuxtbilo'on ti' te'ex.

We sent them two messengers, but they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third. They said, “We are messengers to you.”

إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ

**36:15** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Te'ex chen wiiniko'ob bey to'on, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ma' tu ts'aaj mixba'al; te'ex chen ka tuusike'ex.

They said, “You are nothing but humans like us, and the Beneficent did not send down anything; you are only lying.”

قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

**36:16** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K Yuumtsil ku yojel To'on tuuxtbilo'on ti' te'ex.

They said, “Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you.

قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ

**36:17** Yook'ol to'on chen le t'aan saasil.

And our only duty is clear communication.”

وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**36:18** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K wilik junp'eel k'aas chiikul ichile'ex; wa ma' a p'atike'ex, kun k tunichkiinse'ex, junp'eel yaayajil chich ti' to'on kun u k'uchul yook'ol te'ex.

They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.”

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**36:19** Tu ya'alajo'ob: A k'aas chiikule'ex yaan yeetel te'ex. Tumen ta k'a'ajsa'ale'ex? Te'ex junp'eel kaaj ku maan naach ti' toh.

They said, “Your evil omen is upon you. Is it because you were reminded? But you are an extravagant people.”

قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ

**36:20** Ka juntul wiinik tu taal aalkabil ti' le maas naach jaats' le kaajo'. Tu ya'alaj: In kaaj, ts'aike'ex a paach ti' le tuuxtbilo'ob.

Then a man came running from the remotest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.

وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**36:21** Ts'aike'ex a paach ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu kaatiko'ob te'ex mix bo'olil, letio'ob chiikbesa'ano'ob ti' beel.

Follow those who ask you of no wage, and are themselves guided.

ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

**36:22** Bix ma' in kultik Leti' maax tu beetajen, ti' Leti' kun a suutike'ex?

“And why should I not worship Him Who created me, and to Whom you will be returned?

وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**36:23** Kun in ch'a'ik u laak' k'ujo'ob tu ts'eel Leti'? Wa le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ku k'aatik k'aas ti' teen, u t'aano'ob ti' Allah yo'olal teen ma' kun u yaantik teen mixba'al, mix kun u to'oko'ob teen.

Shall I take other gods instead of Him? If the Merciful desires harm for me, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor will they save me.

ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

**36:24** Beyo', teen yaanen ichil junp'eel sa'atal beel chiikpaj.

In that case, I would be completely lost.

إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**36:25** Teen tin oksaj in yool ti' a Yuumtsile'ex, bey u'uye'ex teen.

I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”

إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ

**36:26** A'ala'ab: O'oken ichil le Pak'alo'. Tu ya'alaj: Wa in kaaj u yojel!

It was said, “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew.

قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ

**36:27** Bix in Yuumtsil tu sa'atesaj teen, tu beetajen juntul ichil le ki'ichpambesa'ano'ob.

How my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honored.”

بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

**36:28** Tu paach leti', To'on ma' k ts'aaj mix muuk'o'ob ti' ka'an ti' u kaaj; mix bik'in To'on k ts'aik beyo'.

After him, We sent down no hosts from heaven to his people; nor would We ever send any down.

۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

**36:29** Chen junp'eel Awat; ka letio'ob jets'najo'ob.

It was just one Cry, and they were stilled.

إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ

**36:30** Yaaj oolal yook'ol le palilo'ob. Mix tuuxtbil ku taal ti' letio'ob, chen ku baaxtiko'ob leti'.

Alas for the servants. No messenger ever came to them, but they ridiculed him.

يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**36:31** Ma' tu tukultajo'ob jayp'eel kuxtalo'ob To'on k kiinsaj taanil ti' letio'ob; ti' letio'ob ma' kun suunajo'ob?

Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them; and that unto them they will not return?

أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

**36:32** Tulakal letio'ob, tulakal juuntulo'ob, kun u taalo'ob taanil ti' To'on.

All of them, every single one of them, will be arraigned before Us.

وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

**36:33** Yaan junp'eel chiikul ti' letio'ob ichil le luum kiimen: To'on k ts'aik kuxtal ti', k jook'sik ti' iinajo'ob ku jantiko'ob.

And there is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life, and produce from it grains from which they eat.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ

**36:34** To'on k jets'aj ichilo' pak'alo'ob ti' che'ob yaan u yich palmera yeetel uvo'ob, ka k beetik u jook'ol ja'o'ob ku buukulo'ob ichilo'.

And We place in it gardens of palm-trees and vines, and cause springs to gush out of it.

وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ

**36:35** Utia'al u jantiko'ob ti' u wich, kex u k'abo'ob ma' tu beeto'ob. Ma' wa kun u ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan?

That they may eat from its fruits, although their hands did not make it. Will they not be appreciative?

لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**36:36** Ki'ichpam Leti' maax tu beetaj tulakal le yet-baajo'ob; ti' ba'ax luum ku ts'aik, ti' u baajo'ob, yeetel ti' ba'ax ma' u yojelo'ob.

Glory be to Him who created all the pairs; of what the earth produces, and of their own selves, and of what they do not know.

سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**36:37** U laak' chiikul ti' letio'ob le ak'ab: To'on k luk'sik le k'iin ti', ka letio'ob yaan ichil eek'il.

Another sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are in darkness.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ

**36:38** Le k'iin ku maan tak u kuuchil jets'a'an. Bey u jets' t'aan le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ojel Tulakal.

And the sun runs towards its destination. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

**36:39** Le uj: To'on k jets'aj ichil jaats'o'ob, tak ku suut bey junp'eel uuchben che'el che'.

And the moon: We have disposed it in phases, until it returns like the old twig.

وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ

**36:40** Le k'iin ma' u k'aat u k'uchul yook'ol le uj, mix le ak'ab ma' u k'aat u maan taanil ti' le k'iin. Tulakal ku naachkuno'ob ichil u beelo'ob ka'an.

The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day. Each floats in an orbit.

لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

**36:41** U laak' chiikul ti' letio'ob To'on k bisaj u paalo'ob ichil le Cheem Chuuka'an.

Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

**36:42** To'on k beetaj ti' letio'ob u laak' bey lelo', ku buukintiko'ob.

And We created for them the like of it, in which they ride.

وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ

**36:43** Wa To'on k k'aat, je'el k buuk'besik letio'ob — mina'an awat ku yu'uba'al ti' letio'ob, mix kun u to'oka'alo'ob.

If We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be saved.

وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

**36:44** Chen tumen yatzil ti' To'on, yeetel ki'imak oolal junp'eel k'iin.

Except by a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.

إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

**36:45** Ka a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: Kanantike'ex ba'ax yaan taanil ti' te'ex, yeetel ba'ax yaan tu paach te'ex, wa ka k'ama'ake'ex yatzil.

Yet when it is said to them, “Beware of what lies before you, and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy.”

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

**36:46** Mix chiikul ti' u chiikulo'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob ku taal ti' letio'ob, chen ku suto'ob u paacho'ob ti'.

Yet never came to them a sign of their Lord’s signs, but they turned away from it.

وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

**36:47** Ka a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: Ts'aike'ex ti' ba'ax Allah tu ts'aaj te'ex bey a kuxtal, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: Kun k ts'aik janal ti' maax Allah je'el u ts'aik janal ti', wa u k'aat? Te'ex chen ichil junp'eel sa'atal beel noj.

And when it is said to them, “Spend of what God has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Shall we feed someone whom God could feed, if He so willed? You must be deeply misguided.”

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**36:48** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax k'iin le promesa, wa te'ex aj jaajo'ob?

And they say, “When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”

وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**36:49** Chen ku pa'atiko'ob junp'eel awat, kun u ch'a'ik letio'ob ka taan u ba'atel t'aano'ob.

All they can expect is a single blast, which will seize them while they feud.

مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

**36:50** Ma' je'el u beetiko'ob mix ts'ook t'aan, mix kun suunajo'ob ti' u laak'o'ob.

They will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families.

فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**36:51** Le trompeta kun juumkunsa'ak, ka, wilike'ex, ku aalkabtalo'ob ti' le muknalo'ob tak u Yuumtsilo'ob.

The Trumpet will be blown, then behold, they will rush from the tombs to their Lord.

وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

**36:52** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Yaaj to'on! Maax tu lik'saj to'on ti' k kuuchil wenel? Lela' ba'ax le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil tu promesa'aj, le tuuxtbilo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob le jaajo'.

They will say, “Woe to us! Who resurrected us from our resting-place?” This is what the Beneficent had promised, and the messengers have spoken the truth.”

قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

**36:53** Chen junp'eel awat; ka, wilike'ex, tulakal letio'ob taasa'ano'ob taanil ti' To'on.

It will be but a single scream; and behold, they will all be brought before Us.

إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

**36:54** Le k'iino', mix pixan kun u beeta'al k'aas ti' mix chichin, te'ex chen kun a bo'ota'ale'ex tumen ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

On that Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will be recompensed only for what you used to do.

فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**36:55** Le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le Pak'alo', le k'iino', yaan ichil meyaj ki'imak oolal.

The inhabitants of Paradise, on that Day, will be happily busy.

إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ

**36:56** Letio'ob yeetel u yet-kuxtalo'ob, ichil bo'oyo'ob, ku jets'iko'ob u baajo'ob yook'ol kuuchilo'ob jets' oolal.

They and their spouses, in shades, reclining on couches.

هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

**36:57** U ti'alo'ob te'elo' wichilo'ob. U ti'alo'ob ba'ax ku payiko'ob.

They will have therein fruits. They will have whatever they call for.

لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

**36:58** Jets' oolal — junp'eel t'aan ti' junp'eel Yuumtsil le maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal.

Peace—a saying from a Most Merciful Lord.

سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ

**36:59** Ba'ale' luk'ene'ex bejla'a, te'ex aj siipilo'ob.

But step aside today, you criminals.

وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

**36:60** Ma' Teen in promesa'aj yeetel te'ex, te'ex u paalalo'ob Adam, ma' a kultike'ex le Kisin? Leti' junp'eel aj p'ek chiikpaj ti' te'ex?

Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not serve the devil? That he is your sworn enemy?

۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

**36:61** Yeetel a kultene'ex Teen? Lela' junp'eel toh beel.

And that you shall serve Me? This is a straight path.

وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

**36:62** Tu sa'ataj u beel ya'ab muuch' maako'ob ichile'ex. Ma' wa ta na'atike'ex?

He has misled a great multitude of you. Did you not understand?

وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ

**36:63** Lela' le K'aak' Mitnal, le ta promesa'ata'ale'ex.

This is Hellfire, which you were promised.

هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

**36:64** Eele'ex ichilo' bejla'a, tumen mantats' ma' ta oksaje'ex a yoole'ex.

Roast in it today, because you persistently disbelieved.

ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

**36:65** Le k'iino', To'on k k'alik u chi'obo'ob, u k'abo'ob kun t'aaniko'ob To'on, u yooko'ob kun u jets'iko'ob le jaajo' yo'olal tulakal ba'ax tu naajalto'ob ka'ach.

On this Day, We will seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to everything they had done.

ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**36:66** Wa To'on k k'aat, je'el k ch'oopkunsik u wicho'ob ka ku aalkabtalo'ob tak le toh beelo' — ba'ale' bix kun u yiliko'ob?

If We will, We can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path—but how will they see?

وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

**36:67** Wa To'on k k'aat, je'el k beetik ma' u peeko'ob tu kuuchilo'ob; bey ma' je'el u maano'ob taanil, mix u suuto'ob paachil.

And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back.

وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

**36:68** Maax To'on k ts'aik chowak kuxtal, To'on k sutik u beetajil paachil. Ma' wa ku na'atiko'ob?

Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand?

وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

**36:69** To'on ma' k kanbesaj leti' u ts'iibil t'aano'ob ki'ichpam, mix toh utia'al leti'. Chen junp'eel k'a'ajsajil, yeetel junp'eel Quran Saasil.

We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran.

وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

**36:70** Utia'al u k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' maax kuxtal, yeetel u jets'ik le T'aan yook'ol le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless.

لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**36:71** Ma' tu yilajo'ob To'on k beetaj ti' letio'ob, ti' ba'ax k k'ab tu beetaj, tamano'ob u ti'alo'ob?

Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock that they own?

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ

**36:72** To'on k suukkunsaj letio'ob ti' letio'ob. Yaan yook'ol ku xiimbalo'ob, yaan ku jantiko'ob.

And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat.

وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

**36:73** U ti'alo'ob ichil letio'ob u laak' utsilo'ob, yeetel yuk'ajo'ob. Ma' wa kun u ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan?

And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks?

وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**36:74** Tu ch'a'ajo'ob u baajo'ob k'ujo'ob tu ts'eel Allah, wa ku aantalo'ob.

Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than God, that perhaps they may be helped.

وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

**36:75** Ma' je'el u yaantiko'ob letio'ob, kex letio'ob bey muuk'o'ob jets'a'ano'ob utia'al letio'ob.

They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them.

لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ

**36:76** Ma' a yaaj ooltal tumen u t'aano'ob. To'on k ojel ba'ax ku ta'akiko'ob, ba'ax ku e'esiko'ob.

So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal.

فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

**36:77** Le wiinik ma' ku tukultik To'on k beetaj leti' ti' junp'eel chichin ja'el ja'? Ka leti' ku p'aatal bey junp'eel aj ba'atel t'aan chiikpaj.

Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

**36:78** Ku ts'aik e'esajilo'ob yook'ol To'on, ku tu'ubsik u beetajil u baaj. Ku ya'alik: Maax kun u ts'aik kuxtal ti' le baako'ob ka k'aschajo'ob?

And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, “Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?”

وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ

**36:79** A'ale: Leti' maax tu beetaj letio'ob le chuunilil kun u ts'aik kuxtal ti' letio'ob. Leti' ku yojel tulakal beetajil.

Say, “He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation.”

قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

**36:80** Leti' maax tu beetaj ti' te'ex k'aak' u ti'al tooka'al ti' le che'o'ob ya'axo'ob, yeetel le k'aak'o' ka tookike'ex.

He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire.

ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

**36:81** Ma' wa Leti' maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum je'el u beetik u laak'o'ob bey letio'ob? Jaaj. Leti' le Aj Beetaj Tulakal, le Aj Ojel Tulakal, le Ka'anal.
