Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator.

أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**36:82** U a'almajt'aan, ka ku k'aatik junp'eel ba'al, chen u ya'alik ti': Ka anchahak, ka ku anchahal.

His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.

إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

**36:83** Bey ki'ichpam Leti', ichil u k'ab u jalbesil tulakal ba'alo'ob, ti' Leti' kun a suutike'ex.

So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned.

فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

## 37. Those Ranked in Columns

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**37:1** Hach t'aan le maaxo'ob ku tsoliko'ob u baajo'ob, ku tsoliko'ob.

By the aligners aligning.

وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا

**37:2** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku bisiko'ob, ku bisiko'ob.

And the drivers driving.

فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا

**37:3** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku xookiko'ob le K'a'ajsajilo'.

And the reciters of the Reminder.

فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا

**37:4** Jaaj, a k'uje'ex chen Juntul.

Your God is indeed One.

إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ

**37:5** U Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil ichilo'ob; yeetel U Yuumtsil le tu'ux ku jook'ol k'in.

Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; and Lord of the Easts.

رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ

**37:6** To'on k ki'ichpambesaj le ka'an maas yaanal yeetel u ki'ichpamil le eek'o'ob.

We have adorned the lower heaven with the beauty of the planets.

إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

**37:7** Yeetel kananta'ab ti' tulakal kisin aj ma' u'uyaj t'aan.

And guarded it against every defiant devil.

وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ

**37:8** Ma' tu beytalo'ob u yu'ubiko'ob mix bik'in le Noj Muuch' Ka'anal, tumen ku pulbilo'ob ti' tulakal tu'ux.

They cannot eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite, for they get bombarded from every side.

لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

**37:9** Pulbilo'ob paach — ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku p'aatal.

Repelled—they will have a lingering torment.

دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ

**37:10** Chen maax ku ch'a'ik junp'eel jaats tuusil — ku ts'a'ak paach ti' leti' junp'eel eek' ku taal bey k'aak', ku xotik u binil.

Except for him who snatches a fragment—he gets pursued by a piercing projectile.

إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

**37:11** Kaat ti' letio'ob: Letio'ob wa maas talam u beeta'alo'ob, wa le u laak'o'ob To'on k beetaj? To'on k beetaj letio'ob ti' luk ku ta'ak'al.

Inquire of them, “Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?” We created them from sticky clay.

فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ

**37:12** Ba'ale' teech ka jats'ik a wich, letio'ob ku baaxtiko'ob.

But you wonder, and they ridicule.

بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

**37:13** Yeetel ka' k'a'ajsa'ako'ob, ma' tu k'a'ajsiko'ob.

And when reminded, they pay no attention.

وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

**37:14** Yeetel ka' ku yilo'ob junp'eel chiikul, ku baaxtiko'ob.

And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

**37:15** Yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob: Lela' mix ba'al chen tuus na'at saasil.

And they say, “This is nothing but plain magic.

وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**37:16** Ka' ts'o'ok k kiimilo'on, k p'aatal bey luum yeetel baako'ob, lik'sa'ako'on wa?

When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

**37:17** Yeetel k uuchben taatao'ob xan?

And our ancestors of old?”

أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

**37:18** A'ale: Jaaj, yeetel kun a ts'aike'ex a baa'ex tulakal.

Say, “Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued.”

قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

**37:19** Chen kun p'aatal junp'eel chich awat — ka letio'ob ku paakatiko'ob.

It will be a single nudge, and they will be staring.

فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

**37:20** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Yaaj ti' to'on! Lela' u k'iinil Xot K'in.

They will say, “Woe to us. This is the Day of Judgment.”

وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

**37:21** Lela' u k'iinil Jaats, le ka p'ektike'ex ka'ach.

“This is the Day of Separation which you used to deny.

هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**37:22** Muuch'kine'ex le maaxo'ob tu beeto'ob ma' toh, yeetel u yet-kuxtalo'ob, yeetel ba'ax ku kultiko'ob ka'ach,

Gather those who did wrong, and their mates, and what they used to worship.

۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

**37:23** Tu ts'eel Allah, bisike'ex letio'ob ti' u beel Mitnal.

Besides God, and lead them to the way to Hell.

مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:24** Yeetel xaanbesike'ex letio'ob. Jaaj kun ka'ata'ak ti' letio'ob.

And stop them. They are to be questioned.”

وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ

**37:25** Ba'ax a ba'ale'ex? Ba'ax ten ma' a wantike'ex a baaj?

What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another?

مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

**37:26** Jaaj, le k'iina', letio'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob.

In fact, on that Day, they will be submissive.

بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

**37:27** Kun u taalo'ob u laak' ti' u laak', ku kaatiko'ob t'aan u baajo'ob.

They will come to one another, questioning one another.

وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**37:28** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Te'ex ka taale'ex ti' to'on ti' le noj k'ab.

They will say, “You used to come at us from the right.”

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**37:29** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ma', te'ex a baa'ex ma' aj oksaj oolo'ob ka'ach.

They will say, “You yourselves were not believers.

قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:30** Mina'an a'almajt'aan ti' to'on yook'ol te'ex. Te'ex a baa'ex maako'ob aj ma' u'uyaj t'aano'ob ka'ach.

We had no authority over you. You yourselves were rebellious people.

وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ

**37:31** U T'aan k Yuumtsil jaajchaj yook'ol to'on. To'on k eejentik leti'.

The Word of our Lord has been realized against us. We are tasting it.

فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

**37:32** To'on k sa'atbesaje'ex a beele'ex. To'on aj sa'atbesaj beelo'on ka'ach.

We seduced you. We were seducers.”

فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ

**37:33** Le k'iina', letio'ob kun u jaatsiko'ob le yaayajil.

On that Day, they will share in the punishment.

فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

**37:34** Beyxan To'on k beetik ti' le aj kebano'ob.

Thus We deal with the sinners.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**37:35** Ka' a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: Mina'an k'uj chen Allah, ku nojbe'etiko'ob u baajo'ob.

When it was said to them, “There is no god except God,” they grew arrogant.

إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

**37:36** Yeetel tu ya'alajo'ob: K p'aatik wa k k'ujo'ob utia'al jun tul aj ts'iib t'aan saatal u yool?

And said, “Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?”

وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

**37:37** Jaaj, leti' taal yeetel le jaajo', tu jets'aj le tuuxtbilo'ob.

In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the messengers.

بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:38** Jaaj, kun a eejente'ex le yaayajil chich.

Most assuredly, you will taste the painful punishment.

إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ

**37:39** Yeetel ma' kun bo'ota'ake'ex chen utia'al ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

And you will be repaid only for what you used to do.

وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**37:40** Chen u palilo'ob Allah maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' Leti'.

Except for God’s sincere servants.

إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:41** Ti' letio'ob junp'eel siibal ojela'an.

For them is a known provision.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

**37:42** Yich che'o'ob; yeetel kun ki'ichpambesa'alo'ob.

Fruits; and they will be honored.

فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

**37:43** Ichil le Pak'alo'ob Ki'imak Oolal.

In the Gardens of Bliss.

فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**37:44** Yook'ol kuuchilo'ob jets' oolal, ku paakatiko'ob u baajo'ob.

On furnishings, facing one another.

عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

**37:45** Kun bisa'ak u bak'pach letio'ob junp'eel uk'ul ti' ja' ku jook'ol saasil.

They will be offered a cup of pure drink.

يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ

**37:46** Sak; junp'eel ki'imak oolal ti' le maaxo'ob ku yuk'iko'ob.

White; a delight to those who drink.

بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ

**37:47** Mina'an k'aasil ichil, mix ku beetik u sa'atal u yool le maax ku yuk'ik.

Never polluted, and never intoxicating.

لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

**37:48** Yeetel letio'ob yaan ko'olelo'ob subtal u yoolo'ob, noj u yicho'ob, ki'ichpam u yicho'ob.

With them will be bashful women with lovely eyes.

وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ

**37:49** Bey wa sak tunicho'ob kananta'ano'ob ma'alob.

As if they were closely guarded pearls.

كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

**37:50** Ka kun u taalo'ob u laak' ti' u laak', ku kaatiko'ob t'aan.

Then they will approach one another, questioning.

فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**37:51** Jun tul ichilo'ob kun u ya'al: Yaan teen jun tul in yet-maak ka'ach.

One of them will say, “I used to have a friend.

قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ

**37:52** Maax ku ya'alik ka'ach: Teech wa jun tul ichil le aj oksaj oolo'ob?

Who used to say, “Are you of those who believe?

يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ

**37:53** Ka' ts'o'ok k kiimilo'on, k p'aatal bey luum yeetel baako'ob, taasa'ako'on wa taanil ti' xook?

That after we die and become dust and bones, we will be called to account?”

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

**37:54** Kun u ya'al: A paakatike'ex wa?

He will say, “Will you have a look?”

قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

**37:55** Kun u paakat, kun u yilik leti' ichil u chuun Mitnal.

He will look, and will see him in the pit of Hell.

فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:56** Kun u ya'al: Tumen Allah, naats' a k'aasbesiken.

He will say, “By God, you almost ruined me.

قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

**37:57** Wa ma' u siibal in Yuumtsil, je'el in p'aatal ichil le maaxo'ob taasa'ano'ob taanil.

Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among the arraigned.”

وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

**37:58** Ma' kun kiimilo'on.

“We will not die.

أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

**37:59** Chen k yaax kiimil, yeetel ma' kun yaayajkunsa'alo'on.

Except for our first death, and we will not be punished.”

إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

**37:60** Lela' le noj naajalil tulakal.

This is the supreme triumph.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**37:61** Utia'al bey lela', ka meyajnak le aj meyajo'ob.

For the like of this let the workers work.

لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ

**37:62** Lela' wa maas uts k'amaj, wa le Che' K'aaj?

Is this a better hospitality, or the Tree of Bitterness?

أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

**37:63** To'on k beetaj leti' junp'eel talamil ti' le aj ma' toh oolo'ob.

We made it an ordeal for the unjust.

إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**37:64** Leti' junp'eel che' ku jook'ol ti' u chuun Mitnal.

It is a tree that grows from the bottom of Hell.

إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:65** U yich bey u pool le kisino'ob.

Its fruits are like the devils’ heads.

طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ

**37:66** Jaaj, kun u jaanto'ob ti', kun u chuukbesiko'ob u nak'o'ob yeetel lelo'.

They will eat from it, and fill their bellies with it.

فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

**37:67** Ka, yook'ol lelo', ti' letio'ob junp'eel uk'ul ja' jach chokoj ku look.

Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of boiling liquid.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

**37:68** Ka u suutilo'ob kun p'aatal ti' le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

Then their return will be to the Blaze.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:69** Letio'ob tu kaxtajo'ob u taatao'obo'ob saatal u beelo'ob.

They had found their parents astray.

إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ

**37:70** Yeetel tu xaanajo'ob tu paach u yooke'ob.

And rushed along in their footsteps.

فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

**37:71** Yeetel u ya'abil le uuchben maako'ob taanil ti' letio'ob sa'at u beelo'ob.

And most of the ancients before them went astray.

وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**37:72** Kex To'on k tuuxtaj tuuxtbilo'ob utia'al u k'a'aybesiko'ob a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob.

Even though We sent messengers to warn them.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

**37:73** Paakat beyo' u ts'ook le maaxo'ob k'a'aybesa'ab a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob.

So observe the end of those who were warned.

فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

**37:74** Chen u palilo'ob Allah maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' Leti'.

Except for the sincere servants of God.

إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:75** Yeetel Noah tu t'aanaj To'on, To'on le maas uts ichil le maaxo'ob ku nukiko'ob.

And Noah called out to Us, and We are the Best of responders.

وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ

**37:76** Yeetel To'on k luk'saj leti' yeetel u laak'tsilo'ob ti' le noj talamil.

And We saved him and his family from the great calamity.

وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**37:77** Yeetel To'on k beetaj u ch'iibalo'ob le maaxo'ob p'aatalo'ob kuxtal.

And We made his descendants the survivors.

وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

**37:78** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj junp'eel uts tsikbal yo'olal leti' ichil le maaxo'ob taal tu paach.

And We left mention of him among those who succeeded.

وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**37:79** Jets' oolal yook'ol Noah ichil tulakal maako'ob.

Peace be upon Noah among all people.

سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**37:80** Beyxan To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

We thus reward the righteous.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**37:81** Leti' jun tul ichil k palilo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob.

He was one of Our believing servants.

إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:82** Ka To'on k bulbultaj ichil ja' le u laak'o'ob.

Then We drowned the others.

ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

**37:83** Ichil u maako'ob Noah, Abraham.

Of his kind was Abraham.

۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ

**37:84** Ka' taal ti' u Yuumtsil yeetel junp'eel puksi'ik'al toh.

When he came to his Lord with a sound heart.

إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

**37:85** Tu ya'alaj ti' u taata yeetel u maako'ob: Ba'ax a kultike'ex?

He said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?

إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**37:86** A k'aate'ex wa tuus k'ujo'ob, tu ts'eel Allah?

Is it falsified gods, instead of God, that you want?

أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

**37:87** Beyo', ba'ax a tuukule'ex yo'olal U Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob?

So what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?”

فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**37:88** Ka tu paakataj jun jaats ti' le eek'o'ob.

Then he took a glance at the stars.

فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ

**37:89** Yeetel tu ya'alaj: Teen k'oja'anen.

And said, “I am sick.”

فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ

**37:90** Ba'ale' tu suto'ob u paacho'ob ti' leti', binio'ob.

But they turned their backs on him, and went away.

فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

**37:91** Ka tu bin ti' u k'ujo'ob, tu ya'alaj: Ma' wa kun a jaante'ex?

Then he turned to their gods, and said, “will you not eat?

فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

**37:92** Ba'ax a ba'ale'ex, ma' a t'aane'ex?

What is it with you, that you do not speak?”

مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

**37:93** Ka tu bin yook'ol letio'ob, ku jaats'iko'ob yeetel u noj k'ab.

Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.

فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ

**37:94** Yeetel taalo'ob ku xaanalo'ob ti' leti'.

And they came running towards him.

فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

**37:95** Tu ya'alaj: A kultike'ex wa ba'ax a ch'a'ache'extike'ex?

He said, “Do you worship what you carve?

قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

**37:96** Ka' Allah tu beetaje'ex, yeetel ba'ax a beetike'ex?

When God created you, and what you manufacture?”

وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

**37:97** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Beetike'ex junp'eel naj k'aak' utia'al leti', pule'ex leti' ichil le k'aak' Mitnal.

They said, “Build a pyre for him, and throw him into the furnace.”

قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:98** Tu kaato'ob k'aas ti' leti', ba'ale' To'on k beetaj letio'ob le sa'atalo'ob.

They wished him ill, but We made them the losers.

فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

**37:99** Tu ya'alaj: Teen kin bin ti' in Yuumtsil, Leti' kun u chiikbesik in beel.

He said, “I am going towards my Lord, and He will guide me.”

وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

**37:100** In Yuumtsil, ts'a teen jun tul ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

“My Lord, give me one of the righteous.”

رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**37:101** Beey tuuno' To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' uts tsikbal yo'olal jun tul paal aj ch'a' ool.

So We gave him good news of a clement boy.

فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ

**37:102** Ka' k'uch u ja'abil utia'al u bin yeetel leti', tu ya'alaj: In paal, kin wilik ichil in wenel kin kinsik teech; paakat ba'ax a tuukul. Tu ya'alaj: In taata, beet ba'ax a'almajt'aanbil ti' teech; kun a kaxtiken, wa Allah ku k'aat, jun tul ichil le aj chich oolo'ob.

Then, when he was old enough to accompany him, he said, “O My son, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you; see what you think.” He said, “O my Father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, God willing, one of the steadfast.”

فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

**37:103** Ka', ka' tu ts'aajo'ob u baajo'ob, tu luubsaj u taan ti' luum.

Then, when they had submitted, and he put his forehead down.

فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ

**37:104** To'on k t'aanaj leti': Oo Abraham!

We called out to him, “O Abraham!

وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

**37:105** Ts'o'ok a jaajkuntik le ba'ax ta wilaj ichil wenel. Beyxan To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

You have fulfilled the vision.” Thus We reward the doers of good.

قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**37:106** Lela' jaaj junp'eel prueba saasil.

This was certainly an evident test.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**37:107** Yeetel To'on k luk'saj leti' yeetel junp'eel noj ba'alche' kinsa'ab bey siibal.

And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice.

وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ

**37:108** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj junp'eel uts tsikbal yo'olal leti' utia'al le ch'iibalo'ob taal tu paach.

And We left with him for later generations.

وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**37:109** Jets' oolal yook'ol Abraham.

Peace be upon Abraham.

سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

**37:110** Beyxan To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

Thus We reward the doers of good.

كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**37:111** Leti' jun tul ichil k palilo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob.

He was one of Our believing servants.

إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:112** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' uts tsikbal yo'olal Isaac, jun tul profeta, jun tul ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

And We gave him good news of Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.

وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**37:113** Yeetel To'on k bendisiiontaj leti', yeetel Isaac. Ba'ale' ichil u ch'iibalo'ob yaan maaxo'ob aj toh ool, yeetel maaxo'ob jaaj ku beetiko'ob ma' toh ti' u baajo'ob.

And We blessed him, and Isaac. But among their descendants are some who are righteous, and some who are clearly unjust to themselves.

وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ

**37:114** Yeetel To'on k bendisiiontaj Moses yeetel Aaron.

And We blessed Moses and Aaron.

وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

**37:115** Yeetel To'on k luk'saj letio'ob yeetel u maako'ob ti' le noj talamil.

And We delivered them and their people from the terrible disaster.

وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**37:116** Yeetel To'on k aantaj letio'ob, beey tuuno' letio'ob le aj naajalo'ob.

And We supported them, and so they were the victors.

وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

**37:117** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob le Kili'ich Ju'un ku Chiikbesik.

And We gave them the Clarifying Scripture.

وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ

**37:118** Yeetel To'on k chiikbesaj u beelo'ob yook'ol le toh beel.

And We guided them upon the straight path.

وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ

**37:119** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj junp'eel uts tsikbal yo'olal letio'ob utia'al le ch'iibalo'ob taal tu paach.

And We left with them for later generations.

وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**37:120** Jets' oolal yook'ol Moses yeetel Aaron.

Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

**37:121** Beyxan To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

Thus We reward the righteous.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**37:122** Letio'ob ichil k palilo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob.

They were of Our believing servants.

إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:123** Yeetel Elijah xan jun tul ichil le tuuxtbilo'ob.

Also Elijah was one of the messengers.

وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:124** Tu ya'alaj ti' u maako'ob: Ma' wa kun a saajkune'ex?

He said to his people, “Do you not fear?

إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

**37:125** A t'aanike'ex wa Baal, a p'aatike'ex le maas uts ichil le aj beetajo'ob?

Do you call on Baal, and forsake the Best of creators?

أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ

**37:126** Allah a Yuumtsile'ex, yeetel U Yuumtsil a uuchben taatao'ob.

God is your Lord, and the Lord of your ancestors.”

ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**37:127** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob u t'aan, beey tuuno' kun taasa'ako'ob taanil.

But they called him a liar, and thus they will be brought forward.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

**37:128** Chen u palilo'ob Allah maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' Leti'.

Except for God’s sincere servants.

إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:129** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj junp'eel uts tsikbal yo'olal leti' utia'al le ch'iibalo'ob taal tu paach.

And We left with him for later generations.

وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**37:130** Jets' oolal yook'ol U Otoch Elijah.

Peace be upon the House of Elijah.

سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ

**37:131** Beyxan To'on k bo'otik le aj uts meyajo'ob.

Thus We reward the virtuous.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**37:132** Leti' jun tul ichil k palilo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob.

He was one of Our believing servants.

إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:133** Yeetel Lot jun tul ichil le tuuxtbilo'ob.

And Lot was one of the messengers.

وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:134** To'on k luk'saj leti' yeetel u laak'tsilo'ob, tulakalo'ob.

We saved him and his family, all of them.

إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

**37:135** Chen jun tul xnuuk ko'olel p'aat paach.

Except for an old woman who lagged behind.

إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

**37:136** Ka To'on k k'aasbesaj tulakal le u laak'o'ob.

Then We annihilated the others.

ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

**37:137** Te'ex ka maane'ex tu ts'eel letio'ob ichil u saastal k'iin.

You pass by them in the morning.

وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ

**37:138** Yeetel ichil ak'ab. Ma' wa ka na'atike'ex?

And at night. Do you not understand?

وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

**37:139** Yeetel Jonah jun tul ichil le tuuxtbilo'ob.

And Jonah was one of the messengers.

وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:140** Ka' puuts' ti' le cheem chuuka'an u kuuch.

When he fled to the laden boat.

إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

**37:141** Tu pulaj suerte, ka sa'at ti' leti'.

He gambled and lost.

فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ

**37:142** Ka le noj kay tu luuk'aj leti', leti' yaan u si'ipil.

Then the fish swallowed him, and he was to blame.

فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

**37:143** Wa ma' leti' jun tul ichil le maaxo'ob ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob ka'ach,

Had he not been one of those who praised.

فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ

**37:144** Je'el u p'aatal ichil u nak' tak u k'iinil ken lik'sa'ako'ob.

He would have stayed in its belly until the Day they are raised.

لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

**37:145** Ka To'on k pulaj leti' ti' junp'eel luum mina'an che', leti' k'oja'an.

Then We threw him into the wilderness, and he was sick.

۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ

**37:146** Yeetel To'on k beetaj u jook'ol junp'eel che' k'uum yook'ol leti'.

And We made a gourd tree grow over him.

وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ

**37:147** Ka To'on k tuuxtaj leti' ti' jo'op'eel k'aal mil maako'ob, wa maas ya'ab.

Then We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.

وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

**37:148** Yeetel tu okso'ob u yoolo'ob, beey tuuno' To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ki'imak oolal junp'eel k'iin.

And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

**37:149** Kaat ti' letio'ob: A Yuumtsile'ex u ti'al wa le paalalo'ob ko'olel, ka letio'ob u ti'al le paalalo'ob xiib?

Ask them, “Are the daughters for your Lord, while for them the sons?”

فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

**37:150** Wa To'on k beetaj le angelo'ob ko'olelo'ob, ka letio'ob tu yilo'ob?

Or did We create the angels females, as they witnessed?”

أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ

**37:151** Ma'! Jaaj, ti' u tuuso'ob ku ya'aliko'ob:

No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say.

أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ

**37:152** Allah tu beetaj jun tul paal ti' u baaj. Jaaj letio'ob aj tuuso'ob.

“God has begotten.” They are indeed lying.

وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

**37:153** Tu yeyaj wa le paalalo'ob ko'olel yook'ol le paalalo'ob xiib?

So He preferred girls over boys?

أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ

**37:154** Ba'ax a ba'ale'ex? Bix a xotike'ex t'aan?

What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

**37:155** Ma' wa kun a k'a'ajsike'ex?

Will you not reflect?

أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

**37:156** Wa yaan te'ex junp'eel chiikul saasil?

Or do you have some clear proof?

أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ

**37:157** Taase'ex a Aanalte'e'ex, wa te'ex aj jaajo'ob.

Then bring your book, if you are telling the truth.

فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**37:158** Yeetel tu beeto'ob junp'eel laak'tsilil ichil Leti' yeetel le jinno'ob. Ba'ale' le jinno'ob ku yojelo'ob kun taasa'ako'ob taanil.

And they invented a relationship between Him and the jinn. But the jinn know that they will be arraigned.

وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

**37:159** Ki'ichpam Allah, jach ka'anal yook'ol ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob.

God be glorified, far above what they allege.

سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

**37:160** Chen u palilo'ob Allah maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' Leti'.

Except for God’s sincere servants.

إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:161** Jaaj, te'ex yeetel ba'ax a kultike'ex,

Surely, you and what you serve.

فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**37:162** Ma' tu beytal a sa'atbesike'ex u beel mix maax ti' Leti',

Cannot seduce away from Him.

مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ

**37:163** Chen maax kun eelel ichil Mitnal.

Except for he who will be roasting in Hell.

إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:164** Mina'an mix jun tul ichil to'on ma' yaan ti' junp'eel kuuchil ojela'an.

“There is not one of us but has an assigned position.

وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

**37:165** Yeetel to'on le maaxo'ob ku tsoliko'ob k baajo'ob.

And we are the arrangers.

وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ

**37:166** Yeetel to'on le maaxo'ob ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob.

And we are the glorifiers.”

وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ

**37:167** Kex tu ya'aliko'ob ka'ach:

Even though they used to say.

وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ

**37:168** Wa yaan to'on junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' le uuchben maako'ob ka'ach,

“Had we received advice from the ancients.

لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**37:169** Je'el k p'aatal u palilo'ob Allah maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' Leti'.

We would have been God's faithful servants.”

لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:170** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob leti', beey tuuno' kun u yojelo'ob.

But they rejected it, so they will find out.

فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

**37:171** K T'aan ts'o'ok u bin taanil ti' k palilo'ob tuuxtbilo'ob.

Our Word has already gone out to our servant messengers.

وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:172** Letio'ob le maaxo'ob kun aanta'alo'ob.

It is they who will be supported.

إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ

**37:173** Yeetel k aj ba'atelo'ob kun p'aatalo'ob aj naajalo'ob.

And Our troops will be the victors.

وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

**37:174** Beey tuuno', suut a paach ti' letio'ob junp'eel k'iin.

So disregard them for a while.

فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

**37:175** Yeetel paakatiko'ob — bejla'a ku yilo'ob.

And watch them—they will soon see.

وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

**37:176** Ku kaatiko'ob wa u seebbesiko'ob k yaayajil?

Are they seeking to hasten Our punishment?

أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

**37:177** Ka' ku luubul tu taan u najo'ob, k'aas kun p'aatal u saastal le maaxo'ob k'a'aybesa'ab a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob.

When it descends into their yard, miserable will be the morning of those forewarned.

فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

**37:178** Beey tuuno', suut a paach ti' letio'ob junp'eel k'iin.

So avoid them for a while.

وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

**37:179** Yeetel paakat — bejla'a ku yilo'ob.

And watch—they will soon see.

وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

**37:180** Ki'ichpam a Yuumtsil, U Yuumtsil Nojbe'enil, ka'anal yook'ol ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob.

Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, beyond their allegations.

سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

**37:181** Yeetel jets' oolal yook'ol le tuuxtbilo'ob.

And peace be upon the messengers.

وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:182** Yeetel ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, U Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

And praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.

وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

## 38. Sad

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**38:1** Saad. Hach t'aan le Quran nojbe'en.

Saad. By the renowned Quran.

صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

**38:2** Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob p'ataano'ob ichil u nojbe'etiko'ob u baajo'ob yeetel u ma' u'uyiko'ob t'aan.

Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance.

بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

**38:3** Jayp'eel ch'iibalo'ob To'on k k'aasbesaj taanil ti' letio'ob! Tu awatajo'ob ka' ts'o'ok u k'iinil u puuts'ulo'ob.

How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape.

كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

**38:4** Yeetel tu jats'ajo'ob u yicho'ob tumen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan taal ti' letio'ob ichil letio'ob. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' jun tul aj tuus na'at, aj tuus.

And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers said, “This is a lying magician.”

وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

**38:5** Tu beetaj wa tulakal le k'ujo'ob chen jun tul K'uj? Lela' junp'eel ba'al jats' wich.

“Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange.”

أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ

**38:6** Le noj maako'ob ichilo'ob binio'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: Bine'ex, chich p'aatane'ex yook'ol a k'uje'ex. Lela' junp'eel ba'al jets'a'an tu taanil.

The notables among them announced: “Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned.

وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ

**38:7** Ma' k yu'ubik yo'olal lela' ichil le uuchben oksaj oolal. Lela' mix ba'al chen junp'eel tuus beetbil.

We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.

مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ

**38:8** E'esa'ab wa ti' leti' le k'a'ajsaj, ichil tulakal to'on? Jaaj, letio'ob yaan ka'ap'el oolal yo'olal in k'a'ay a'almajt'aan. Jaaj, ma' tu eejentajo'ob in yaayajil.

Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?” In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

**38:9** Wa ti' letio'ob u kuuchilo'ob u yatzil a Yuumtsil — le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ts'aaj?

Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Majestic, the Giver?

أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

**38:10** Wa ti' letio'ob u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil ichilo'ob? Ka na'akako'ob beyo' ichil le suumo'ob.

Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes.

أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ

**38:11** Junp'eel muuch' aj ba'atelo'ob ti' le muuch'o'ob kun sa'atalo'ob te'elo'.

An army of confederates with be defeated there.

جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

**38:12** Taanil ti' letio'ob, u maako'ob Noah tu p'ektajo'ob le jaajo'; beyxan Aad, yeetel Pharaoh u ti'al le Ts'ipilo'ob.

Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes.

كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

**38:13** Yeetel Thamood, yeetel u maako'ob Lot, yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aaxo' — lelo'ob le muuch'o'ob.

And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods—these were the confederates.

وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

**38:14** Mix jun tul ichilo'ob ma' tu p'ektaj le tuuxtbilo'ob, beey tuuno' in xot t'aan yaayajil jaajchaj yook'ol letio'ob.

None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved.

إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

**38:15** Lelo'ob ma' tu pa'atiko'ob chen junp'eel awat, mina'an suut ti'.

These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery.

وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

**38:16** Yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil, seebbes to'on k ju'unil taanil u k'iinil Xook.

And they say, “Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account.”

وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**38:17** Chich p'aatan yook'ol ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob, k'a'ajs k palil David, le yaan u muuk'. Leti' ku suut ti' Allah mantats'.

Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient.

ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

**38:18** To'on k ts'aaj le wiitso'ob utia'al u ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob yeetel leti', ichil ookinel yeetel ichil u saastal.

We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak.

إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ

**38:19** Yeetel le ch'iich'o'ob, muuch'ulo'ob tulakal. Tulakal ku suuto'ob ti' leti'.

And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him.

وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

**38:20** Yeetel To'on k chichbesaj u jalbesil, k ts'aaj ti' leti' na'at yeetel t'aan ku xotik ts'ookbesaj.

And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

**38:21** K'uch wa ti' teech u tsikbalil le ka'ap'el aj xet' t'aano'ob? Ka' na'akajo'ob yook'ol le kili'ich kuuchil.

Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary?

۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

**38:22** Ka' oko'ob ti' David, tu saajbesajo'ob leti'. Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ma' a saajkil. Ka'ap'elon aj xet' t'aan; jun tul ichil to'on tu beetaj ma' toh ti' u laak'; beey tuuno', xot t'aan ichil to'on yeetel jaaj, ma' a beetik ma' toh, chiikbes k beel ti' le toh beel.

When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, “Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way.”

إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

**38:23** Lela' in sucu'un yaan ti' kamp'eel k'aal yeetel bolon lajun taman ko'olel, teen yaan teen chen junp'eel taman ko'olel; tu ya'alaj: Ts'a teen u kananil, tu chich t'aantajen.

“This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”

إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ

**38:24** Tu ya'alaj: Jaaj tu beetaj ma' toh ti' teech tumen tu kaataj a taman ko'olel utia'al u ts'aik yeetel u tamano'ob ko'olel. Ya'ab le aj yet-meyajo'ob ku beetiko'ob ma' toh u laak' ti' u laak', chen le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob, ba'ale' lelo'ob jach p'it. David tu na'ataj To'on k ts'aik prueba ti' leti', beey tuuno' tu kaataj sa'atesa'al ti' u Yuumtsil, tu luubsaj u baaj yook'ol u piixo'ob, tu sutaj u yool.

He said, “He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few.” David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented.

قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩

**38:25** Beey tuuno' To'on k sa'atesaj lelo' ti' leti'. Yeetel ti' leti' naats'il ti' To'on, yeetel junp'eel uts kuuchil suut.

So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return.

فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

**38:26** Oo David, To'on k beetajech aj jalbes ichil le luum; beey tuuno', xot t'aan ichil le maako'ob yeetel jaaj, ma' a ts'ayik a k'aat ool, ma' u sa'atbesik a beel ti' u beel Allah. Le maaxo'ob ku sa'atiko'ob u beel ti' u beel Allah ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil chich, tumen tu tu'ubsajo'ob u k'iinil Xook.

“O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from God’s path. Those who stray from God’s path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account.”

يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**38:27** To'on ma' k beetaj le ka'an yeetel le luum yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil ichilo'ob mina'an u jaajil. Lelo' u tuukul le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob — beey tuuno', yaaj ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob tumen le K'aak'!

We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve—so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire.

وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:28** Wa To'on k beetik le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob bey le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas yook'ol luum? Wa To'on k beetik le aj toh oolo'ob bey le maaxo'ob mina'an subtal?

Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the pious like the shameless?

أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ

**38:29** Junp'eel Aanalte' bendisiionta'an, To'on k e'esaj ti' teech, utia'al u tuukultiko'ob u chiikulo'ob, yeetel utia'al le maaxo'ob yaan na'at u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed.

كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**38:30** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ti' David, Solomon, junp'eel palil jach uts. Leti' ku suut ti' Allah mantats'.

And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent.

وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

**38:31** Ka' e'esa'ab ti' leti' ichil ookinel le ki'ichpam tsiminio'ob jets'a'ano'ob.

When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening.

إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

**38:32** Tu ya'alaj: Tin yaakuntaj u yaakunajil le uts ba'alo'ob maas ti' in k'a'ajsik in Yuumtsil — tak ka ta'ak u baaj tu paach junp'eel nook'.

He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil.

فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ

**38:33** Suutbesike'ex letio'ob ti' teen. Ka tu kaajsaj u taalik u yooke'ob yeetel u kaalo'ob.

Bring them back to me.” And he began caressing their legs and necks.

رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

**38:34** To'on k ts'aaj prueba ti' Solomon, k ts'aaj junp'eel winiikil yook'ol u kuuchil jalbesil; ka tu sutaj u yool.

We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented.

وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

**38:35** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, sa'ates in sipil, ts'a teen junp'eel jalbesil ma' kun k'uchul ti' mix maax tu paach teen. Teech le Aj Ts'aaj.

He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver.”

قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

**38:36** Beey tuuno' To'on k ts'aaj le iik' utia'al u meyaj ti' leti', ku bin oolal yeetel u a'almajt'aan, tu'ux ku bisik.

So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed.

فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

**38:37** Yeetel le kisino'ob — tulakal aj beetaj naj yeetel aj muukil ja'.

And the demons—every builder and diver.

وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

**38:38** Yeetel u laak'o'ob kaaxa'ano'ob ichil suumo'ob.

And others fettered in chains.

وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

**38:39** Lela' k siibal; beey tuuno', ts'a ya'ab, wa kanant, mina'an xook.

“This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account.”

هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

**38:40** Yeetel ti' leti' naats'il ti' To'on, yeetel junp'eel uts kuuchil suut.

For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort.

وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

**38:41** Yeetel k'a'ajs k palil Job, ka' tu t'aanaj u Yuumtsil: Kisin tu taasaaj teen talamil yeetel yaaj.

And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

**38:42** Jaats' yeetel a wook — lela' ja' sis utia'al a wich'ik a baaj, yeetel utia'al a wuk'ik.

“Stamp with your foot—here is cool water to wash with, and to drink.”

ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

**38:43** Yeetel To'on k suutbesaj ti' leti' u laak'tsilo'ob, yeetel u laak'o'ob bey letio'ob yeetel letio'ob; bey yatzil ti' To'on, yeetel junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' le maaxo'ob yaan na'at.

And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight.

وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**38:44** Ch'a' yeetel a k'ab junp'eel muuch' che'ob, jaats' yeetel, ma' a xet'ik a hach t'aan. To'on k kaxtaj leti' aj chich ool. Jay uts palil! Leti' ku suut ti' Allah mantats'.

“Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient.

وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

**38:45** Yeetel k'a'ajs k palilo'ob Abraham, Isaac, yeetel Jacob — maaxo'ob yaan muuk' yeetel wich.

And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—endowed with ability and vision.

وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ

**38:46** To'on k jaatsaj letio'ob yeetel junp'eel ba'al jaats: u k'a'ajsiko'ob le Otoch.

We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home.

إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

**38:47** Ti' To'on letio'ob ichil le yeeya'ano'ob, le maas utso'ob.

To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding.

وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

**38:48** Yeetel k'a'ajs Ishmael, Elisha, yeetel Ezekiel; tulakal ichil le maas utso'ob.

And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding.

وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

**38:49** Lela' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj. Le aj toh oolo'ob ti' letio'ob junp'eel uts kuuchil suut.

This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return.

هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

**38:50** Le Pak'alo'ob Eden, u joolo'ob jach je'ebilo'ob ti' letio'ob.

The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them.

جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

**38:51** Ku jets'iko'ob u baajo'ob te'elo', ku t'aaniko'ob ya'ab yich che' yeetel uk'ul.

Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.

مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

**38:52** Yeetel letio'ob yaan ko'olelo'ob ku kananiko'ob u wichilo'ob, junp'eel ja'abil bey letio'ob.

With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age.

۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

**38:53** Lela' ba'ax promesa'ab te'ex utia'al u k'iinil Xook.

This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**38:54** Lela' k siibal, mina'an u ts'ook.

Such is Our bounty, inexhaustible.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

**38:55** Tulakal lela'. Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob aj ma' u'uyaj t'aano'ob ti' letio'ob junp'eel k'aas kuuchil suut.

All This. But the transgressors will have a miserable return.

هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ

**38:56** Mitnal; ichil kun eelelo'ob; jay k'aas kuuchil p'aatal!

Hell; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode!

جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

**38:57** Tulakal lela'. Ka eejentiko'ob — ja' jach chokoj ku look, yeetel junp'eel ba'al jach sis.

All this. Let them taste it—boiling and bitter cold.

هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

**38:58** Yeetel u laak' yaayajilo'ob beyxan, jejelaas u beyilo'ob.

And similar torments of diverse kinds.

وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

**38:59** Lela' junp'eel muuch' ku yokol chich yeetel te'ex. Mina'an k'amaj uts ti' letio'ob. Jaaj kun eelelo'ob ichil le K'aak'.

“This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire.

هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:60** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ma', te'ex! Mina'an k'amaj uts ti' te'ex! Te'ex ta taase'ex lela' ti' to'on! Jay k'aas ts'ook!

They will say, “But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!”

قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

**38:61** Kun u ya'alo'ob: K Yuumtsil, maax tu taasaj lela' ti' to'on, ts'a ti' leti' ka'ap'eel yaayajil ichil le K'aak'.

They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire.”

قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

**38:62** Yeetel kun u ya'alo'ob: Ba'ax ti' to'on ma' k ilik wiiniko'ob k p'iisik ka'ach ichil le aj k'aaso'ob?

And they will say, “What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked?

وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

**38:63** K ch'a'aj wa letio'ob utia'al baaxtik, wa k wichilo'ob tu sa'ato'ob u beel ti' letio'ob?

Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them?

أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ

**38:64** Lela' jaaj — u xet' t'aan le maako'ob ichil le K'aak'.

This is certainly true—the feuding of the people of the Fire.

إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:65** A'ale: Teen chen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan, mina'an k'uj chen Allah — le Juntul, le maax ku naajal yook'ol tulakal.

Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god except God—the One, the Conqueror.

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

**38:66** U Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil ichilo'ob; le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Sa'atesaj.

The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver.”

رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ

**38:67** A'ale: Leti' junp'eel t'aan jach nojbe'en.

Say, “It is a message of great importance.

قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

**38:68** Te'ex ka sutike'ex a paache'ex ti'.

From which you are turning away.

أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

**38:69** Mina'an na'at teen yo'olal le Noj Muuch' Ka'anal ka' ku xet'iko'ob t'aan.

I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute.

مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

**38:70** Chen e'esa'ab teen teen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan saasil.

It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner.”

إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**38:71** A Yuumtsil tu ya'alaj ti' le angelo'ob: Teen kin beetik jun tul wiinik ti' luk.

Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay.

إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

**38:72** Ka' ts'o'ok in jets'ik leti', in ts'aik iik' ichil leti' ti' in pixan, xoolane'ex tu taan leti'.

When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.

فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

**38:73** Beey tuuno' le angelo'ob tu xoolano'ob, tulakalo'ob.

So the angels fell prostrate, all of them.

فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

**38:74** Chen Kisin. Tu nojbe'etaj u baaj, jun tul ichil le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Except for Satan. He was too proud, and one of the faithless.

إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**38:75** Tu ya'alaj: Oo Kisin, ba'ax tu kalaj teech a xoolan tu taan ba'ax tin beetaj yeetel in ka'ap'eel k'ab? Teech wa aj nojbe'etaj a baaj, wa jun tul ichil le ka'analo'ob?

He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?”

قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ

**38:76** Tu ya'alaj: Teen maas uts ti' leti'; Teech ta beetajen ti' k'aak', ta beetaj leti' ti' luk.

He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.”

قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ

**38:77** Tu ya'alaj: Beey tuuno', jook'en te'ela'! Teech jun tul pulbil paach!

He said, “Then get out of here! You are an outcast!

قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

**38:78** Yeetel in p'ekbesaj kun p'aatal yook'ol teech tak u k'iinil Xot K'in.

And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

**38:79** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, p'aat teen tak u k'iinil ken lik'sa'ako'ob.

He said, “Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected.”

قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

**38:80** Tu ya'alaj: Teech jun tul ichil le maaxo'ob p'aata'an u k'iin.

He said, “You are one of those deferred.

قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

**38:81** Tak u k'iinil le k'iin jets'a'an ojela'an.

Until the Day of the Time Appointed.”

إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

**38:82** Tu ya'alaj: Tumen a nojbe'enil, kun in sa'atbesik u beel tulakalo'ob.

He said, “By Your majesty, I will seduce them all.

قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**38:83** Chen a palilo'ob maaxo'ob jaaj u yoolo'ob ti' teech ichilo'ob.

Except for your loyal servants among them.”

إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**38:84** Tu ya'alaj: Le jaajo', yeetel le jaajo' kin ya'alik.

He said, “The truth is, and I say the truth.

قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

**38:85** Kun in chuukbesik Mitnal yeetel teech, yeetel tulakal maax ku ts'ayik teech ichilo'ob.

I will fill Hell with you, and with every one of them who follows you.”

لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**38:86** A'ale: Ma' kin kaatik te'ex mix bo'olil yo'olal lela', teen ma' jun tul aj tuus beetaj ba'al.

Say, “I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender.

قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

**38:87** Chen junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al wiiniko'ob.

It is but a reminder to mankind.

إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**38:88** Yeetel kun a wojelo'ob u t'aanil ka' maan junp'eel k'iin.

And you will know its message after a while.”

وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

## 39. The Throngs

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**39:1** Le e'esa'ab le Aanalte'o' taal ti' Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

The revelation of the Book is from God, the Mighty and Wise.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**39:2** To'on k e'esaj ti' teech le Aanalte'o' yeetel le jaajo'; beey tuuno', kulte Allah, jaaj a yool ti' Leti' ichil a culto.

We sent down to you the Book with the truth, so serve God, devoting your religion to Him.

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

**39:3** Ma' wa ti' Allah u ti'al le culto jaaj u yool? Le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob aj kanano'ob tu ts'eel Leti' ku ya'aliko'ob: Chen k kultik letio'ob utia'al u naats'besiko'ob to'on ti' Allah. Allah kun u xot t'aan ichil letio'ob yo'olal ba'ax ku p'ektik u baajo'ob yo'olal. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le aj tuus, le aj ma' oksaj ool.

Is not to God that sincere faith is due? As for those who take guardians besides Him, “We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God.” God will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide the lying blasphemer.

أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ

**39:4** Wa Allah tu k'aat u ch'a'ik jun tul paal, je'el u yeeyik ti' ba'ax Tu beetaj je'el ba'ax u k'aat. Nojbe'en Leti'. Leti' Allah, le Juntul, le maax ku naajal yook'ol tulakal.

If God wanted to have a son, He could have selected from His creation at will. Glory be to Him. He is God, the One, the Prevailing.

لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

**39:5** Tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel jaaj. Ku pitik le ak'ab yook'ol le k'iin, ku pitik le k'iin yook'ol le ak'ab. Ku jets'ik le k'iin yeetel le uj, junjunp'eel ku maano'ob tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Jaaj, Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Sa'atesaj.

He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He wraps the night around the day, and He wraps the day around the night. And He regulates the sun and the moon, each running along a specific course. He is indeed the Almighty, the Forgiver.

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ

**39:6** Tu beetaje'ex ti' jun tul maak, ka' tu beetaj ti' leti' u yet-kuxtal, ka' Tu ts'aaj te'ex ba'alche'o'ob, waxakp'eel jejelaas ku p'aatalo'ob ka'ka'ap'eel. Ku beetike'ex ichil u nak'o'ob a na'o'ob, beetajil tu paach beetajil, ichil ooxp'eel eek'il. Bey Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex. U ti'al le jalbesil. Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'. Ba'ax tu sa'atbesaj a beele'ex?

He created you from one person, then made from it its mate, and brought down livestock for you—eight kinds in pairs. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, in successive formations, in a triple darkness. Such is God, your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So what made you deviate?

خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

**39:7** Wa ma' a woksike'ex a yoole'ex, Allah mina'an u k'a'abeetil te'ex, ba'ale' ma' tu ch'a'ik uts le ma' ki'iki' t'aan ti' U palilo'ob. Wa ka ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan, Kun u ch'a'ik uts ichile'ex. Mix jun tul aj kuch kuuch je'el u kuchik u kuuch u laak'. Ka' a suuto'ob ti' a Yuumtsile'ex; Kun u ya'alik te'ex ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach. Leti' Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

If you disbelieve, God is Independent of you, yet He does not approve ingratitude on the part of His servants. And if you are thankful, He will approve that in you. No bearer of burden can bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return; and He will inform you of what you used to do. He is aware of what the hearts contain.

إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**39:8** Ka junp'eel yaaj ku machik le wiinik, ku payalchi'tik u Yuumtsil, ku suut u yool ti' Leti'. Ba'ale' ka' Tu ts'aaj ti' leti' junp'eel siibal ti' Leti', ku tu'ubsik ba'ax ku payalchi'tik ka'ach taanil, ku ts'aik yet-maako'ob ti' Allah, utia'al u sa'atbesik beel ti' U beel. A'ale: Ki'imakkun a wool yeetel a ma' oksaj oolal chichin k'iin; teech kun a p'atal ichil le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak'.

When some adversity touches the human being, he prays to his Lord, repenting to Him. But then, when He confers on him a grace of His, he forgets what he was praying for before, and he attributes rivals to God, in order to lead astray from His way. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while; you will be among the inmates of the Fire.”

۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ

**39:9** Le maax ku kultik yeetel jaaj ool ichil le k'iino'ob ak'ab, ku xoolan yeetel ku wa'atal, ku sajak ti' le u laak' kuxtalo', ku ts'aik u pa'atik ti' u yatzil u Yuumtsil, bey wa leti'? A'ale: Le maaxo'ob ku yojelo'ob yeetel le maaxo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob junp'eelili'ob wa? Chen le maaxo'ob yaan u na'ato'ob kun u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

Is he who worships devoutly during the watches of the night, prostrating himself and standing up, mindful of the Hereafter, and placing his hope in the mercy of his Lord? Say, “Are those who know and those who do not know equal?” Only those possessed of reason will remember.

أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**39:10** A'ale: Oo in palilo'ob ta woksaje'ex a yoole'ex, beete'ex a kuuch ti' a Yuumtsile'ex. Ti' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob uts ichil le yook'ol kaaba', yaan uts. U luum Allah noj. Le aj ch'a' muk'o'ob kun u bo'ota'alo'ob u bo'olil tulakal, mina'an xook.

Say, “O My devotees who have believed, keep your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world, is goodness. And God’s earth is vast. The steadfast will be paid their wages in full, without reckoning.”

قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

**39:11** A'ale: Teen a'ala'aben in kultik Allah, jaaj in yool ti' Leti' ichil in culto.

Say, “I was commanded to serve God, devoting my religion exclusively to Him.

قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

**39:12** Yeetel a'ala'aben in p'atal u yaaxil le musulmano'ob.

And I was commanded to be the first of those who submit.”

وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**39:13** A'ale: Kin sajak, wa ma' tin tzicaj in Yuumtsil, u yaayajil junp'eel k'iin nojbe'en.

Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the punishment of a horrendous Day.”

قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**39:14** A'ale: Allah chen kin kultik, jaaj in yool ti' Leti' ichil in culto.

Say, “It is God I worship, sincere in my faith in Him.”

قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى

**39:15** Kulte'ex je'el ba'ax a k'aate'ex tu ts'eel Leti'. A'ale: Le aj sa'atalo'ob letio'ob le maaxo'ob ku sa'atiko'ob u pixano'ob yeetel u maako'ob ichil u k'iinil Liksajil. Lela' le jaaj sa'atal saasil.

“But you can worship whatever you wish besides Him.” Say, “The losers are those who lose their souls and their people on the Day of Resurrection.” That is indeed the obvious loss.

فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**39:16** Ti' letio'ob yaan xoto'ob K'aak' yook'olo'ob, yeetel xoto'ob yaanalo'ob. Bey Allah ku saajsik U palilo'ob: Oo in palilo'ob! Sajakte'ex Teen!

They will have layers of Fire above them, and layers beneath them. That is how God strikes fear into His servants—“O My servants! Beware of Me!”

لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ

**39:17** Le maaxo'ob tu p'atajo'ob u kultiko'ob le ba'alo'ob ku kulta'alo'ob bey k'uj, ka' tu suuto'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah, ti' letio'ob le uts tsikbal. Beey tuuno', ts'a uts tsikbal ti' in palilo'ob.

As for those who avoid the worship of idols, and devote themselves to God—theirs is the good news. So give good news to My servants.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ

**39:18** Le maaxo'ob ku yu'ubiko'ob le T'aan, ku ts'ayiko'ob le maas uts ti'. Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob Allah tu chiikbesaj u beelo'ob. Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob yaan u na'ato'ob.

Those who listen to the Word, and follow the best of it. These are they whom God has guided. These are they who possess intellect.

ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**39:19** Ba'ax yo'olal le maax ts'o'ok u k'uchul u xot t'aan yaayajil yook'ol leti'? Teech wa je'el a tokik le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak'?

What about someone who has deserved the sentence of punishment? Is it you who can save those in the Fire?

أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ

**39:20** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku sajaktalo'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob, ti' letio'ob kuchilo'ob yook'ol kuchilo'ob, beetbil ka'anal, ja'o'ob ku bino'ob yaanalo'ob. U promesa Allah; Allah ma' tu tuskik promesa.

But those who fear their Lord will have mansions upon mansions, built high, with streams flowing beneath them. The promise of God; and God never breaks a promise.

لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ

**39:21** Ma' a wilaj bix Allah ku ts'aik ja' ti' le ka'an, ka ku ts'aik u bin ichil u jook'ol ja'o'ob yaanal luum, ka ku jook'sik yeetel le ja' ba'alo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob yook'ol luum jejelaas u boonilo'ob, ka ku tikintalo'ob ka ka wilik u k'anbesa'alo'ob, ka Tu beetik letio'ob bey xoot'o'ob tikin? Jaaj ichil lela' yaan junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' le maaxo'ob yaan u na'ato'ob.

Have you not considered how God sends down water from the sky, then He makes it flow into underground wells, then He produces with it plants of various colors, then they wither and you see them yellowing, then He turns them into debris? Surely in this is a reminder for those with understanding.

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَـٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَـٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**39:22** Ba'ax yo'olal le maax Allah tu je'aj u puksi'ik'al ti' Islam, beey tuuno' ku maan yook'ol junp'eel saasil ti' u Yuumtsil? Yaaj ti' le maaxo'ob u puksi'ik'alo'ob chichchajo'ob ti' u k'a'ajsa'al Allah. Lelo'ob ichil sa'atal beel saasil.

What about someone whose heart God has opened to Islam, so that he follows a light from His Lord? Woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the mention of God. Those are in manifest error.

أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَـٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَـٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**39:23** Allah tu e'esaj le maas uts tsikbalo'ob ichil tulakal: junp'eel ju'un junp'eelili' u baaj yeetel ku p'aatal ka'ka'ats. U yoot'elo'ob le maaxo'ob ku sajaktalo'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob ku yaan ooltalo'ob yo'olal, ka' u yoot'elo'ob yeetel u puksi'ik'alo'ob ku suuto'ob jets' ti' u k'a'ajsa'al Allah. Bey u chiikbesajil beel Allah; Ku chiikbesik beel yeetel ti' maax Ku k'aat. Ba'ale' maax Allah ku cha'ik u sa'at u beel, mina'an ti' aj chiikbesaj beel.

God has sent down the best of narrations: a Scripture consistent and paired. The skins of those who reverence their Lord shiver from it, then their skins and their hearts soften up to the remembrance of God. Such is God’s guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills. But whomever God leaves astray, for him there is no guide.

ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

**39:24** Ba'ax yo'olal le maax ku ta'akik u wich ti' le k'aas yaayajil ichil u k'iinil Liksajil? Ti' le aj k'aas meyajo'ob kun a'ala'ak: Eejente'ex ba'ax ka naajaltike'ex ka'ach.

What about someone who covers his face against the terrible misery of the Day of Resurrection? To the evildoers it will be said, “Taste what you used to earn.”

أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ

**39:25** Le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob tu p'ektajo'ob le jaajo' xan, beey tuuno' le yaayajil k'uch yook'olo'ob ti' tu'ux ma' tu yojelo'ob ka'ach.

Those before them also denied the truth, so the penalty came upon them from where they did not perceive.

كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**39:26** Allah tu ts'aaj letio'ob u eejentiko'ob p'ekbil ichil le kuxtal bejla'o', ba'ale' u yaayajil le u laak' kuxtalo' maas k'aas, wa tu yojelo'ob ka'ach.

God made them taste disgrace in the present life, but the punishment of the Hereafter is worse, if they only knew.

فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

**39:27** To'on k ts'aaj ti' wiiniko'ob ichil le Qurana' tulakal jejelaas beyil, utia'al u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

We have cited in this Quran for mankind every ideal, that they may take heed.

وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**39:28** Junp'eel Quran ichil u t'aan Arabia, mina'an mix p'eel ma' toh ti', utia'al u p'atalo'ob aj toh oolo'ob.

An Arabic Quran, without any defect, so they may become righteous.

قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

**39:29** Allah ku ts'aik u beyil jun tul wiinik jaatsa'an ichil yet-meyajo'ob ma' ku nupiko'ob u baajo'ob, yeetel jun tul wiinik u ti'al chen jun tul wiinik. Junp'eelili'ob wa ichil u p'atal? Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, ba'ale' u ya'abilo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

God cites the example of a man shared by partners at odds, and a man belonging exclusively to one man. Are they equal in status? Praise be to God, but most of them do not know.

ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَـٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**39:30** Teech kun a kiimik, yeetel letio'ob kun kiimiko'ob.

You will die, and they will die.

إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

**39:31** Ka', ichil u k'iinil Liksajil, kun a ba'ateltike'ex a baaj tu taan a Yuumtsile'ex.

Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be quarrelling before your Lord.

ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ

**39:32** Maax maas k'aas ti' le maax ku tuusik yo'olal Allah, ku p'ektik le jaajo' ka' k'uch ti' leti'? Mina'an wa kuuchil ichil Mitnal ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan?

Who is more evil than he who lies about God, and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell room for the ungrateful?

۞ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**39:33** Ba'ale' le maax ku taasa'al yeetel le jaajo', ku ts'aik testimonio ti', lelo'ob le aj toh oolo'ob.

But he who promotes the truth, and testifies to it—these are the righteous.

وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ

**39:34** Ti' letio'ob yaan je'el ba'ax u k'aato'ob tu taan u Yuumtsilo'ob. Bey u bo'olil le aj uts meyajo'ob.

They will have whatever they please with their Lord. Such is the reward for the virtuous.

لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**39:35** Allah kun u sa'atesik ti' letio'ob le maas k'aas ti' ba'ax tu beeto'ob, kun u bo'otik letio'ob bin u bo'olil yeetel le maas uts ti' ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

God will acquit them of the worst of their deeds, and will reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**39:36** Ma' wa ts'aab ti' Allah ti' U palil? Ku saajsike'ex yeetel le maaxo'ob tu ts'eel Leti'. Maax Allah ku cha'ik u sa'at u beel, mina'an ti' aj chiikbesaj beel.

Is God not enough for His servant? And they frighten you with those besides Him. Whomever God sends astray, for him there is no guide.

أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

**39:37** Yeetel maax Allah ku chiikbesik u beel, mina'an ti' aj sa'atbesaj beel. Ma' wa Allah Yaan Muuk', yaan u muuk' u bo'otik paach?

And whomever God guides, for him there is no misleader. Is God not Powerful and Vengeful?

وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ

**39:38** Wa ta k'aataj ti' letio'ob: Maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah. A'ale: Ta wile'ex wa le maaxo'ob ka payalchi'tike'ex tu ts'eel Allah? Wa Allah tu k'aat junp'eel yaaj ti' teen, je'el u luk'siko'ob U yaaj wa? Wa Tu k'aat junp'eel siibal ti' teen, je'el u kananiko'ob U yatzil wa? A'ale: Allah ts'aab teen. Yook'ol Leti' ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob yook'ol Leti'.

And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they would say, “God.” Say, “Have you seen those you pray to instead of God? If God willed any harm for me, can they lift His harm? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they hold back His mercy?” Say, “God suffices for me. On Him the reliant rely.”

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَـٰشِفَـٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَـٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

**39:39** A'ale: Oo in kaaj, meyajne'ex bin a beyilile'ex; teen xan kun meyajnaken. Ka' kun a woyele'ex,

Say: “O my people, work according to your ability; and so will I. Then you will know.

قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**39:40** Maax kun u k'am junp'eel yaayajil ku p'ektik, yeetel maax kun luubul yook'ol junp'eel yaayajil ku p'aatal.

Who will receive a humiliating punishment, and on whom will fall a lasting torment.”

مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ

**39:41** To'on k e'esaj yook'ol teech le Aanalte'o' ti' wiiniko'ob yeetel jaaj. Maax ku ts'ayik chiikbesajil beel, ku beetik ti' uts ti' u pixan. Maax ku sa'at u beel, ku sa'at chen yook'ol leti'. Teech ma' aj kanan yook'olo'ob.

We sent down upon you the Book for mankind in truth. He who follows guidance does so for the good of his soul. And he who strays in error does so to its detriment. You are not their overseer.

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

**39:42** Allah ku ch'a'ik le pixano'ob ichil u k'iinil u kiimilo'ob, yeetel le maaxo'ob ma' kiimeno'ob ichil u wenelo'ob. Ku kananik le maaxo'ob Tu jets'aj kiimil ti', ku cha'ik u laak'o'ob tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. Ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku tukultiko'ob.

God takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that have not died during their sleep. He retains those for which He has decreed death, and He releases the others until a predetermined time. In that are signs for people who reflect.

ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

**39:43** Wa tu ch'a'ajo'ob maaxo'ob ku t'aano'ob ti' Allah yo'olal letio'ob tu ts'eel Allah? A'ale: Kex mina'an u muuk'o'ob yook'ol mixba'al, mina'an u na'ato'ob?

Or have they chosen intercessors other than God? Say, “Even though they have no power over anything, and are devoid of reason?”

أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

**39:44** A'ale: Tulakal t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal u laak' yaan ti' Allah. U ti'al u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ka' kun a suuta'ale'ex ti' Leti'.

Say, “All intercession is up to God. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned.”

قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**39:45** Ka Allah chen u baaj ku k'a'ajsa'al, u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le u laak' kuxtalo' ku p'ektiko'ob ku chich u puksi'ik'alo'ob. Ba'ale' ka ku k'a'ajsa'alo'ob le maaxo'ob tu ts'eel Leti', ku chuupulo'ob yeetel ki'imak oolal.

When God alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with resentment. But when those other than Him are mentioned, they become filled with joy.

وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

**39:46** A'ale: K Allah, Aj Beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ma' ku yila'al yeetel ba'ax ku ya'ala'al. Teech kun a xot t'aan ichil a palilo'ob yo'olal ba'ax ku p'ektik u baajo'ob yo'olal ka'ach.

Say, “Our God, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations. You will judge between your servants regarding what they had differed about.”

قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

**39:47** Wa le maaxo'ob tu beeto'ob ma' toh yaan tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol luum ti', yeetel u beyil yeetel, tu bo'oto'ob u baajo'ob yeetel ti' le k'aas yaayajil ichil u k'iinil Liksajil. Ba'ale' kun chiikpajak ti' letio'ob ti' Allah ba'ax mix bik'in tu pa'ato'ob ka'ach.

If those who did wrong owned everything on earth, and the like of it with it, they would redeem themselves with it from the terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection. But there will appear to them from God what they never anticipated.
