وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ

**39:48** Kun chiikpajak ti' letio'ob u k'aasilo'ob u meyajo'ob, kun u bak'iko'ob letio'ob ba'ax ku baaxtiko'ob ka'ach.

There will appear to them the evils of their deeds, and they will be surrounded by what they used to ridicule.

وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**39:49** Ka junp'eel yaaj ku machik le wiinik, ku t'anik to'on. Ba'ale' ka' To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' junp'eel siibal ti' To'on, ku ya'alik: Tin k'amaj lela' tumen in na'at. Ba'ale' leti' junp'eel prueba, ba'ale' u ya'abilo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

When adversity touches the human being, he calls on Us. But then, when We favor him with a blessing from Us, he says, “I have attained this by virtue of my knowledge.” However, it is a test, but most of them do not know.

فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَـٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**39:50** Le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob tu ya'alajo'ob, ba'ale' ba'ax tu naajalto'ob ma' tu yaantaj letio'ob.

Those before them said it, but what they had earned did not avail them.

قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**39:51** U k'aasilo'ob u meyajo'ob tu machajo'ob letio'ob. Le aj k'aas meyajo'ob ichil lelo'oba' xan kun u machiko'ob u k'aasilo'ob ba'ax tu naajalto'ob, mix je'el u kaliko'ob.

The evils of their deeds caught up with them. And the wrongdoers among these will also be afflicted by the evils of what they earned, and they cannot prevent it.

فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

**39:52** Ma' wa tu yojelo'ob Allah ku senkik le siibal hanal ti' maax Ku k'aat, ku p'iskuntik xan? Ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob ti' maako'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Do they not know that God extends the provision to whomever He wills, and constricts it? In that are signs for people who believe.

أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**39:53** A'ale: Oo in palilo'ob ta maano'ob naach ti' toh yook'ol a baa'ex, ma' a sa'atike'ex a pa'atik ti' u yatzil Allah, tumen Allah ku sa'atesik tulakal kebano'ob. Jaaj, Leti' le Aj Sa'atesaj, le Aj Ch'a' Ool.

Say, “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves: do not despair of God’s mercy, for God forgives all sins. He is indeed the Forgiver, the Clement.”

۞ قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**39:54** Suune'ex a woole'ex ti' a Yuumtsile'ex, ts'a'e'ex a baa'ex ti' Leti', taanil ti' u taal le yaayajil yook'ole'ex. Ka' ma' kun aanta'ake'ex.

And turn to your Lord, and submit to Him, before the retribution comes upon you. Then you will not be helped.

وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

**39:55** Ts'aye'ex le maas uts ti' ba'ax e'esa'ab te'ex ti' a Yuumtsile'ex, taanil ti' u taal le yaayajil yook'ole'ex suulul, ka' te'ex ma' a woyele'ex.

And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord, before the punishment comes upon you suddenly, while you are unaware.

وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

**39:56** Utia'al ma' junp'eel pixan u ya'alik: Yaaj in wool, tumen tin p'ataj in kuuch ti' Allah, tumen teen ichil le aj baaxtajo'ob ka'ach.

So that a soul may not say, “How sorry I am, for having neglected my duty to God, and for having been of the scoffers.”

أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَـٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ

**39:57** Wa u ya'alik: Wa Allah tu chiikbesaj in beel ka'ach, teen ichil le aj toh oolo'ob ka'ach.

Or say, “Had God guided me; I would have been of the pious.”

أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**39:58** Wa u ya'alik, ka ku yilik le yaayajil: Wa chen je'el in ka' suut ka'ach, teen ichil le aj uts meyajo'ob ka'ach.

Or say, when it sees the penalty, “If only I had another chance, I would be of the virtuous.”

أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**39:59** Jaaj tuun! In chiikulo'ob k'ucho'ob ti' teech, ba'ale' ta p'ektaj letio'ob bey tuus, ta nojbe'etaj a baaj, teech ichil le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ka'ach.

Yes indeed! My Verses did come to you, but you called them lies, turned arrogant, and were of the faithless.

بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**39:60** Ichil u k'iinil Liksajil, kun a wilik le maaxo'ob tu tuuso'ob yo'olal Allah yeetel u wicho'ob eek'besa'ano'ob. Mina'an wa kuuchil ichil Mitnal ti' le aj nojbe'etaj baajo'ob?

On the Day of Resurrection, you will see those who told lies about God with their faces blackened. Is there not a place in Hell for the arrogant?

وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**39:61** Allah kun u tokik le maaxo'ob tu kananajo'ob toh ti' u kuuchil to'okol. Mix yaaj kun u machik letio'ob, mix kun ok'omtal u yoolo'ob.

And God will save those who maintained righteousness to their place of salvation. No harm will touch them, nor will they grieve.

وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**39:62** Allah Aj Beetaj tulakal ba'al, Leti' Aj Kanan yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

God is the Creator of all things, and He is in Charge of all things.

ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ

**39:63** U ti'al u mach'ilo'ob le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' u chiikulo'ob Allah, lelo'ob le aj sa'atalo'ob.

To Him belong the reins of the heavens and the earth. But those who blaspheme against the revelations of God—it is they who are the losers.

لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ

**39:64** A'ale: Ma' wa tu ts'eel Allah ka a'alike'ex teen in kultik, te'ex mina'an na'at te'ex?

Say, “Is it other than God you instruct me to worship, you ignorant ones?”

قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ

**39:65** E'esa'ab ti' teech, yeetel ti' le maaxo'ob taanil ti' teech, wa ka ts'aik yet-maako'ob ti' Allah, a meyajo'ob kun sa'atalo'ob, teech kun a p'atal ichil le aj sa'atalo'ob.

It was revealed to you, and to those before you, that if you idolize, your works will be in vain, and you will be of the losers.

وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ

**39:66** Chen kulte Allah, p'atal ichil le aj ki'iki' t'aano'ob.

Rather, worship God, and be of the appreciative.

بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ

**39:67** Ma' tu ts'aajo'ob ti' Allah u p'iisil bey u k'a'abeet u ts'a'abal. Tulakal le luum kun p'atal ichil U mach' ichil u k'iinil Liksajil, le ka'ano'ob kun ko'ots'olo'ob ichil U noj k'ab. Mina'an u k'aasil, ka'anal Leti' naach ti' ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob yet-maako'ob ti' Leti'.

They have not esteemed God as He ought to be esteemed. The entire earth will be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His righ. Immaculate is He, and Transcendent He is beyond the associations they make.

وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**39:68** Le trompeta kun juumkunsa'ak, ka tulakal maax ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum kun luubulo'ob mina'an u na'ato'ob, chen maax Allah ku k'aat. Ka' kun ka' juumkunsa'ak, ka letio'ob kun lik'iko'ob, ku paakatiko'ob.

And the Trumpet will be sounded, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth will be stunned, except whomever God wills. Then it will be sounded another time, whereupon they will rise up, looking on.

وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ

**39:69** Le luum kun saasiltal yeetel u Saasil u Yuumtsil; le Aanalte'o' kun ts'a'abal tu kuuchil; le profetao'ob yeetel le aj testimonio'ob kun taasa'alo'ob; u xot t'aan kun beeta'ak ichil letio'ob yeetel jaaj, ma' kun beeta'ak k'aas ti' letio'ob.

And the earth will shine with the Light of its Lord; and the Book will be put in place; and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought in; and Judgment will be passed among them equitably, and they will not be wronged.

وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**39:70** Tulakal pixan kun u bo'ota'al tulakal tumen ba'ax tu beetaj. Leti' jach Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ku beetiko'ob.

And every soul will be fully compensated for what it had done. He is well aware of what they do.

وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

**39:71** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob kun bisa'alo'ob ti' Mitnal ichil muuch'o'ob. Tak ka' k'ucho'ob ti', u joolo'ob kun je'ebelo'ob, u aj kanano'ob kun u ya'alo'ob ti' letio'ob: Ma' wa k'ucho'ob ti' te'ex tuuxtbilo'ob ichile'ex, ku xookiko'ob te'ex u chiikulo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex, ku k'a'ayiko'ob te'ex u k'iinil Nupik Baaj te'exa'? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Jaaj, ba'ale' u xot t'aan yaayajil jaajchaj yook'ol le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in throngs. Until, when they have reached it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, “Did not messengers from among you come to you, reciting to you the revelations of your Lord, and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?” They will say, “Yes, but the verdict of punishment is justified against the disbelievers.”

وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**39:72** Kun a'ala'ak: Ooke'ex tu joolo'ob Mitnal, a p'aatale'ex te'elo' mantats'. K'aas u kuuchil p'aatal le aj nojbe'etaj baajo'ob.

It will be said, “Enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein eternally.” How wretched is the destination of the arrogant.

قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**39:73** Le maaxo'ob ku sajaktalo'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob kun bisa'alo'ob ti' le Pak'alo' ichil muuch'o'ob. Tak ka' k'ucho'ob ti', u joolo'ob kun je'ebelo'ob, u aj kanano'ob kun u ya'alo'ob ti' letio'ob: Jets' oolal yook'ole'ex, te'ex utse'ex ka'ach, ooke'ex ti', a p'aatale'ex te'elo' mantats'.

And those who feared their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. Until, when they have reached it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, “Peace be upon you, you have been good, so enter it, to abide therein eternally.”

وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَـٰلِدِينَ

**39:74** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, Maax tu ts'ookbesaj U promesa ti' to'on, tu ts'aaj to'on k ch'a'ik le luum bey paachil, k ki'imaktal ichil le Pak'alo' tu'ux k k'aat. Uts u bo'olil le aj meyajo'ob.

And they will say, “Praise be to God, who has fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the land, enjoying Paradise as we please.” How excellent is the reward of the workers.

وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ

**39:75** Kun a wilik le angelo'ob ku bak'iko'ob yook'ol le Ts'amo', ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob yeetel ki'iki' t'aan. U xot t'aan kun beeta'ak ichil letio'ob yeetel jaaj, kun a'ala'ak: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

And you will see the angels hovering around the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise. And it will be judged between them equitably, and it will be said, “Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.”

وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

## 40. The Forgiver

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**40:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**40:2** Le e'esa'ab le kili'ich ju'uno' taal ti' Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ojel Tulakal.

The sending down of the Scripture is from God the Almighty, the Omniscient.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

**40:3** Aj Sa'atesaj kebano'ob, Aj K'amaj le maaxo'ob ku suuto'ob u yoolo'ob, Chich ichil yaayajil, Yaan u Siibal ma' xu'ulul. Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'. Ti' Leti' le ts'ook suut.

Forgiver of sins, Accepter of repentance, Severe in punishment, Bountiful in bounty. There is no god but He. To Him is the ultimate return.

غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**40:4** Mix maax ku ba'ateltik u t'aan yo'olal u chiikulo'ob Allah chen le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. Ma' u jats'ik a wich u meyajo'ob ichil le luum.

None argues against God’s revelations except those who disbelieve. So do not be impressed by their activities in the land.

مَا يُجَـٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ

**40:5** Taanil ti' letio'ob, u kaajil Noah tu p'ektaj le jaajo', bey le muuch'o'ob tu paach letio'ob xan. Tulakal muuch' kaaj tu tukultaj yo'olal u tuuxtbil, utia'al u machik. Tu ba'ateltajo'ob u t'aan yeetel ma' jaaj, utia'al u naajaltiko'ob yeetel le jaajo'. Ba'ale' Teen tin machaj letio'ob. Bix le yaayajil ka'ach!

Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth, as did the confederates after them. Every community plotted against their messenger, to capture him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat with it the truth. But I seized them. What a punishment it was!

كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَـٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

**40:6** Bey u t'aan a Yuumtsil jaajchaj yook'ol le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, tumen letio'ob le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak'.

Thus the sentence of your Lord became realized against those who disbelieve, that they are to be inmates of the Fire.

وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:7** Le maaxo'ob ku kuchiko'ob le Ts'amo', yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan yook'ol, ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob yeetel ki'iki' t'aan, ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Leti', ku k'aatiko'ob u sa'atesa'al u kebano'ob le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: K Yuumtsil, Teech ta bak'aj tulakal ba'al yeetel yatzil yeetel na'at; beey tuuno', sa'ates u kebano'ob le maaxo'ob ku suuto'ob u yoolo'ob ku ts'ayiko'ob a beel, kanante letio'ob ti' u yaayajil Mitnal.

Those who carry the Throne, and those around it, glorify their Lord with praise, and believe in Him, and ask for forgiveness for those who believe: “Our Lord, You have encompassed everything in mercy and knowledge; so forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and protect them from the agony of the Blaze.

ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**40:8** Okse letio'ob, K Yuumtsil, ichil le Pak'alo'ob Mantats', le ta promesa'aj ti' letio'ob, yeetel le aj toh oolo'ob ichil u taatao'ob, u yet-kuxtalo'ob, yeetel u paalalo'ob. Teech jaaj le Yaan Muuk', le maas Aj Na'at ichil tulakal.

And admit them, Our Lord, into the Gardens of Eternity, which You have promised them, and the righteous among their parents, and their spouses, and their offspring. You are indeed the Almighty, the Most Wise.

رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**40:9** Kanante letio'ob ti' le k'aas meyajo'ob. Maax ka kanantik ti' le k'aas meyajo'ob, le k'iina', Teech ta ch'a'aj ootsilil ti'. Lela' le maas noj naajal ichil tulakal.

And shield them from the evil deeds. Whomever You shield from the evil deeds, on that Day, You have had mercy on him. That is the supreme achievement.”

وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**40:10** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob kun t'aana'alo'ob: U p'ek Allah maas noj ti' a p'eke'ex a baa'ex, tumen ta t'aana'ale'ex ti' le oksaj oolal, ba'ale' ta p'ektaje'ex.

Those who disbelieved will be addressed, “The loathing of God is greater than your loathing of yourselves—for you were invited to the faith, but you refused.”

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ

**40:11** Kun u ya'alo'ob: K Yuumtsil, ta beetaj k kiimilo'on ka'ats, ka'ats ta ts'aaj to'on kuxtal. Bejla'e' k eejentik k kebano'on. Yaan wa beel jook'ol?

They will say, “Our Lord, you made us die twice, and twice you gave us life. Now we acknowledge our sins. Is there any way out?”

قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

**40:12** Lela' tumen ka Allah chen u baaj t'aana'ak ka'ach, ta p'ektaje'ex a woksike'ex a yoole'ex; ba'ale' ka u laak'o'ob ts'a'ako'ob yet-maako'ob ti' Leti', ta woksaje'ex a yoole'ex. Le xot t'aan yaan ti' Allah, le Ka'anal, le Yaan Muuk'.

That is because when God alone was called upon, you disbelieved; but when others were associated with Him, you believed. Judgment rests with God the Sublime, the Majestic.

ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ

**40:13** Leti' Maax ku e'esik te'ex U chiikulo'ob, ku ts'aik te'ex siibal hanal ti' le ka'an. Ba'ale' mix maax ku k'a'ajsik chen le maax ku suut u yool.

It is He who shows you His wonders, and sends down sustenance from the sky for you. But none pays heed except the repentant.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ

**40:14** Beey tuuno', payalchi'te'ex Allah, jaaj a yoole'ex ti' Leti' ichil a culto, kex le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

So call upon God, with sincere devotion to Him, even though the disbelievers resent it.

فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

**40:15** Ka'anal ichil u p'atal, U Yuumil le Ts'amo'. Ku ts'aik le Pixan, tumen U a'almajt'aan, yook'ol maax Ku k'aat ichil U palilo'ob, utia'al u k'a'ayik a'almajt'aan yo'olal u k'iinil Nupik Baaj.

Exalted in rank, Owner of the Throne. He conveys the Spirit, by His command, upon whomever He wills of His servants, to warn of the Day of Encounter.

رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ

**40:16** Le k'iin kun jook'oko'ob, mixba'al yo'olal letio'ob kun ta'aka'ak ti' Allah. Maax u ti'al le jalbesil bejla'e'? Ti' Allah, le Juntul, le maax ku naajal yook'ol tulakal.

The Day when they will emerge, nothing about them will be concealed from God. “To whom does the sovereignty belong today?” “To God, the One, the Irresistible.”

يَوْمَ هُم بَـٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ

**40:17** Le k'iina', tulakal pixan kun u bo'ota'al tumen ba'ax tu naajaltaj. Mina'an ma' toh le k'iina'. Allah seeb u beetik Xook.

On that Day, every soul will be recompensed for what it had earned. There will be no injustice on that Day. God is quick to settle accounts.

ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**40:18** K'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob yo'olal u k'iinil le ba'ax naats'o', ka le puksi'ik'alo'ob yaan ti' le kaalo'ob, ku kaliko'ob letio'ob. Le aj k'aas meyajo'ob mina'an ti' letio'ob yet-maak jach yaabil, mina'an maax ku t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal letio'ob utia'al u yu'uba'al u t'aan.

And warn them of the Day of Imminence, when the hearts are at the throats, choking them. The evildoers will have no intimate friend, and no intercessor to be obeyed.

وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَـٰظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ

**40:19** Ku yojel u tuusilo'ob le wicho'ob, yeetel ba'ax ku ta'akiko'ob le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

He knows the deceptions of the eyes, and what the hearts conceal.

يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ

**40:20** Allah ku xot t'aan yeetel jaaj, le maaxo'ob ku payalchi'tiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti' ma' tu beytalo'ob u xotiko'ob t'aan yeetel mixba'al. Allah Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Ilaj.

God judges with justice, while those whom they invoke besides Him cannot judge with anything. It is God who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

**40:21** Ma' wa xiimbalnajo'ob yook'ol le luum, tu yilajo'ob bix u ts'ook le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob? Letio'ob chich u muuk'o'ob maas ti' letio'ob, tu p'atajo'ob maas chiikul yook'ol luum. Ba'ale' Allah tu machaj letio'ob tumen u kebano'ob, mina'an ti' letio'ob aj kanan tu ts'eel Allah.

Have they not travelled through the earth, and seen the consequences for those before them? They were stronger than them, and they left more impact on earth. But God seized them for their sins, and they had no defender against God.

۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ

**40:22** Lela' tumen u tuuxtbilo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' letio'ob ka'ach yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, ba'ale' ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, beey tuuno' Allah tu machaj letio'ob. Leti' Chich, Chich ichil bo'olil paach.

That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so God seized them. He is Strong, Severe in retribution.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

**40:23** To'on k tuuxtaj Moses yeetel K chiikulo'ob, yeetel junp'eel a'almajt'aan saasil.

We sent Moses with Our signs, and a clear authority.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

**40:24** Ti' Pharaoh, Hamaan, yeetel Quaroon. Ba'ale' tu ya'alajo'ob: Jun tul aj tuus aj tuus na'at.

To Pharaoh, Hamaan, and Quaroon. But they said, “A lying sorcerer.”

إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَقَـٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

**40:25** Ka', ka k'uch ti' letio'ob yeetel le jaajo' ti' To'on, tu ya'alajo'ob: K'iinse'ex u paalalo'ob le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel leti', cha'e'ex u ko'olelo'ob kuxtal. Ba'ale' u tukul k'aas le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob chen ku sa'at u beel.

Then, when he came to them with the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have believed with him, and spare their daughters.” But the scheming of the unbelievers can only go astray.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ

**40:26** Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Cha'e'ex teen in k'iinsik Moses, ka u payalchi'tik u Yuumtsil. Kin sajak u jeelik a culto, wa u ts'aik ma' toh ichil le luum.

Pharaoh said, “Leave me to kill Moses, and let him appeal to his Lord. I fear he may change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.”

وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ

**40:27** Moses tu ya'alaj: Tin kaxtaj in kanan ti' in Yuumtsil yeetel a Yuumtsile'ex, ti' tulakal aj nojbe'etaj baaj ma' tu oksik u yool ti' u k'iinil Xook.

Moses said, “I have sought the protection of my Lord and your Lord, from every tyrant who does not believe in the Day of Account.”

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**40:28** Jun tul wiinik aj oksaj ool ti' u laako'ob Pharaoh, ku ta'akik u oksaj oolal ka'ach, tu ya'alaj: Kun a k'iinse'ex wa jun tul wiinik tumen ku ya'alik: In Yuumtsil Allah, ts'o'ok u taasik te'ex chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob ti' a Yuumtsile'ex? Wa aj tuus, u tuus kun suut yook'ol leti'; wa ku ya'alik jaaj, junp'eel ti' ba'ax ku promesa'ik te'ex kun k'uchul yook'ole'ex. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le maax ku maan naach ti' toh, le aj tuus.

A believing man from Pharaoh's family, who had concealed his faith, said, “Are you going to kill a man for saying, `My Lord is God,’ and he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lying will rebound upon him; but if he is truthful, then some of what he promises you will befall you. God does not guide the extravagant imposter.

وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَـٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَـٰذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ

**40:29** Oo in kaaj! Te'ex a ti'ale'ex le jalbesil bejla'e', ka'analo'ob ichil le luum; ba'ale' maax kun u yaantik to'on ti' u muuk' Allah, wa ku taal yook'ol to'on? Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Ma' kin e'esik te'ex chen ba'ax kin wilik, ma' kin chiikbesik a beele'ex chen ti' u beel toh tukul.

O my people! Yours is the dominion today, supreme in the land; but who will help us against God’s might, should it fall upon us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the path of prudence.”

يَـٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَـٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

**40:30** Le maax tu oksaj u yool tu ya'alaj: Oo in kaaj, kin sajak te'ex u beyil u k'iinil le muuch'o'ob.

The one who had believed said, “O my people, I fear for you the like of the day of the confederates.

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

**40:31** Bey u ts'ook u kaajil Noah, Aad, yeetel Thamood, yeetel le maaxo'ob tu paach letio'ob. Allah ma' tu k'aatik ma' toh ti' le palilo'ob.

Like the fate of the people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood, and those after them. God wants no injustice for the servants.

مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ

**40:32** Oo in kaaj, kin sajak te'ex u k'iinil Aawat.

O my people, I fear for you the Day of Calling Out.

وَيَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ

**40:33** Le k'iin kun a suute'ex a paache'ex a puuts'ule'ex, mina'an te'ex aj kanan tu ts'eel Allah. Maax Allah ku cha'ik u sa'at u beel, mina'an ti' aj chiikbesaj beel.

The Day when you will turn and flee, having no defender against God. Whomever God misguides has no guide.”

يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

**40:34** Joseph k'uch ti' te'ex ka'ach yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, ba'ale' ta p'aataje'ex ichil ka'ap'eel oolal yo'olal ba'ax tu taasaj te'ex. Tak ka', ka kiimij, ta ya'alaje'ex: Allah mix bik'in kun u tuuxt jun tul tuuxtbil tu paach leti'. Bey Allah ku sa'atbesik beel ti' le maax ku maan naach ti' toh, le maax yaan ka'ap'eel oolal ti'.

Joseph had come to you with clear revelations, but you continued to doubt what he came to you with. Until, when he perished, you said, “God will never send a messenger after him.” Thus God leads astray the outrageous skeptic.

وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ

**40:35** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob u t'aan yo'olal u chiikulo'ob Allah, mina'an a'almajt'aan k'uch ti' letio'ob, junp'eel noj p'ek ichil u wich Allah, yeetel ichil u wich le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. Bey Allah ku kalik u puksi'ik'al tulakal aj nojbe'etaj baaj aj sen muuk'.

Those who argue against God’s revelations, without any proof having come to them—a heinous sin in the sight of God, and of those who believe. Thus God seals the heart of every proud bully.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ

**40:36** Pharaoh tu ya'alaj: Oo Hamaan, beet teen junp'eel noj naj ka'anal, utia'al in k'uchul ti' le beelo'ob.

And Pharaoh said, “O Hamaan, build me a tower, that I may reach the pathways.

وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبَ

**40:37** Le beelo'ob le ka'ano'ob, utia'al in paakat ti' Allah, u ti'al Moses; kex kin tukultik leti' aj tuus. Bey u k'aas meyajo'ob Pharaoh beeta'abo'ob uts ti' leti', ka kala'an ti' le beel. U tukul k'aas Pharaoh chen ichil sa'atal.

The pathways of the heavens, so that I may glance at the God of Moses; though I think he is lying.” Thus Pharaoh’s evil deeds were made to appear good to him, and he was averted from the path. Pharaoh's guile was only in defeat.

أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍ

**40:38** Le maax tu oksaj u yool tu ya'alaj: Oo in kaaj, ts'ayene'ex teen, kun in chiikbesik a beele'ex ti' u beel toh tukul.

The one who had believed said, “O my people, follow me, and I will guide you to the path of rectitude.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

**40:39** Oo in kaaj, u kuxtal le yook'ol kaaba' mixba'al chen junp'eel ki'imak oolal ku maan seeb; ba'ale' le u laak' kuxtalo' leti' le Otoch Mantats'.

“O my people, the life of this world is nothing but fleeting enjoyment, but the Hereafter is the Home of Permanence.

يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَـٰعٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ

**40:40** Maax ku beetik junp'eel k'aas, chen kun u bo'ota'al yeetel u beyil. Ba'ale' maax ku beetik toh, xiib wa ko'olel, aj oksaj ool xan, lelo'ob kun oojoko'ob ichil le Pak'alo', tu'ux kun ts'a'abal ti' letio'ob mina'an xook.

Whoever commits a sin will be repaid only with its like. But whoever works righteousness, whether male or female, and is a believer—these will enter Paradise, where they will be provided for without account.

مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

**40:41** Oo in kaaj, bix teen kin t'anike'ex ti' le to'okol, te'ex ka t'anike'ex teen ti' le K'aak'?

O my people, how is it that I call you to salvation, and you call me to the Fire?

۞ وَيَـٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

**40:42** Ka t'anike'ex teen utia'al in p'ektik Allah, in ts'aik yet-maako'ob ti' Leti' yeetel ba'ax mina'an in na'at yo'olal, teen kin t'anike'ex ti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Sa'atesaj.

You call me to reject God, and to associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I call you to the Mighty Forgiver.

تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرِ

**40:43** Mina'an ka'ap'eel oolal, ba'ax ka t'anike'ex teen ti' mina'an u t'aan ichil le yook'ol kaaba', mix ichil le u laak' kuxtalo'; k ts'ook suut yaan ti' Allah; le maaxo'ob ku maano'ob naach ti' toh letio'ob le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak'.

Without a doubt, what you call me to has no say in this world, or in the Hereafter; and our turning back is to God; and the transgressors are the inmates of the Fire.

لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:44** Kun a k'a'ajsike'ex ba'ax kin wa'alik te'ex, kin ts'aik in meyaj ti' Allah. Allah Aj Ilaj ti' le palilo'ob.

You will remember what I am telling you, so I commit my case to God. God is Observant of the servants.”

فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**40:45** Beey tuuno' Allah tu kanantaj leti' ti' u k'aasilo'ob u tukul k'aaso'ob, junp'eel k'aas yaayajil tu bak'aj u laako'ob Pharaoh.

So God protected him from the evils of their scheming, while a terrible torment besieged Pharaoh’s clan.

فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:46** Le K'aak'. Kun e'esa'ako'ob ti' saamal yeetel ka' ku oka'an k'iin. Ichil le k'iin ku jets'kubaj le K'intzilo': Okse'ex u laako'ob Pharaoh ti' le maas chich yaayajil ichil tulakal.

The Fire. They will be exposed to it morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour takes place: “Admit the clan of Pharaoh to the most intense agony.”

ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:47** Ka ku ba'ateltiko'ob u t'aan ichil le K'aak', le maaxo'ob mina'an u muuk'o'ob kun u ya'alo'ob ti' le maaxo'ob tu nojbe'etajo'ob u baajo'ob: To'on a ts'ayajo'on ka'ach; kun a luk'sike'ex wa ti' to'on junp'eel xoot' ti' le K'aak'?

As they quarrel in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “We were followers of yours; will you then spare us a portion of the Fire?”

وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:48** Le maaxo'ob tu nojbe'etajo'ob u baajo'ob kun u ya'alo'ob: To'on tulakal yaan ichil; Allah ts'o'ok u xot t'aan ichil le palilo'ob.

Those who were arrogant will say, “We are all in it; God has judged between the servants.”

قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ

**40:49** Le maaxo'ob yaan ichil le K'aak' kun u ya'alo'ob ti' u aj kanano'ob Mitnal: Payalchi'te'ex a Yuumtsile'ex utia'al u p'iskuntik k yaayajil junp'eel k'iin.

And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, “Call to your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:50** Kun u ya'alo'ob: Ma' wa a tuuxtbilo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' te'ex ka'ach yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Jaaj. Kun u ya'alo'ob: Beey tuuno' payalchi'ne'ex, ba'ale' u payalchi'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob chen ichil sa'atal beel mantats'.

They will say, “Did not your messengers come to you with clear signs?” They will say, “Yes.” They will say, “Then pray, but the prayers of the disbelievers will always be in vain.”

قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا دُعَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ

**40:51** Jaaj To'on kun k aantik K tuuxtbilo'ob yeetel le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ichil le kuxtala' bejla'o', yeetel ichil le k'iin ku lik'iko'ob le aj testimonio'ob.

Most surely We will support Our messengers and those who believe, in this life, and on the Day the witnesses arise.

إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَـٰدُ

**40:52** Le k'iin u ya'aliko'ob ma' k'aas ma' kun u yaantik le aj k'aas meyajo'ob, ti' letio'ob le p'ekbesaj, ti' letio'ob le Otoch Yaajil.

The Day when their excuses will not profit the wrongdoers, and the curse will be upon them, and they will have the Home of Misery.

يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

**40:53** To'on k ts'aaj ti' Moses chiikbesajil beel, k ts'aaj le kili'ich ju'uno' bey paachil ti' u paalalo'ob Israel.

We gave Moses guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the Scripture.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ

**40:54** Junp'eel chiikbesajil beel yeetel junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' le maaxo'ob yaan u na'ato'ob.

A guide and a reminder for those endowed with reason.

هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

**40:55** Beey tuuno', ch'a' muk'. U promesa Allah jaaj. K'aate u sa'atesa'al a keban, ki'iki' t'aante a Yuumtsil yeetel ki'iki' t'aan ka' ku oka'an k'iin yeetel saamal.

So be patient. The promise of God is true. And ask forgiveness for your sin, and proclaim the praise of your Lord evening and morning.

فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ

**40:56** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob u t'aan yo'olal u chiikulo'ob Allah mina'an a'almajt'aan k'uch ti' letio'ob, mina'an ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob chen u yu'ubik u baajo'ob nojo'ob, ma' bik'in kun u k'ucho'ob ti'. Beey tuuno', kaaxte a p'aatal tu yanal Allah; Leti' le Aj U'uyaj Tulakal, le Aj Ilaj Tulakal.

Those who dispute regarding God’s revelations without any authority having come to them—there is nothing in their hearts but the feeling of greatness, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in God; for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَـٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

**40:57** Jaaj u beetajil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum maas noj ti' u beetajil wiiniko'ob, ba'ale' u ya'abil wiiniko'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Certainly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of humanity, but most people do not know.

لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**40:58** Ma' junp'eelili'ob le ch'oop yeetel le ku yilik. Mix le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob junp'eelili'ob yeetel le aj kebano'ob. Chichin ka tukultike'ex.

Not equal are the blind and the seeing. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. How little you reflect.

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**40:59** Jaaj, le K'intzilo' ku taal; mina'an ka'ap'eel oolal yo'olal; ba'ale' u ya'abil wiiniko'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Indeed, the Hour is coming; there is no doubt about it; but most people do not believe.

إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**40:60** A Yuumtsile'ex tu ya'alaj: Payalchi'te'ex Teen, kun in nukik te'ex. Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku nojbe'etiko'ob u baajo'ob ti' in kulta'alo'ob kun oojoko'ob ichil Mitnal ch'a'abilo'ob tumen muuk'.

Your Lord has said, “Pray to Me, and I will respond to you. But those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell forcibly.”

وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

**40:61** Allah Leti' Maax tu beetaj te'ex le ak'ab utia'al a je'elele'ex ichil, yeetel le k'iin ku ts'aik wich. Allah Aj Siibal ti' wiiniko'ob, ba'ale' u ya'abil wiiniko'ob ma' tu ts'aiko'ob ki'iki' t'aan.

It is God Who made the night for you, that you may rest therein; and the day allowing sight. God is gracious towards the people, but most people do not give thanks.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**40:62** Bey Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex, Aj Beetaj tulakal ba'al. Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'; bix je'el a suuta'ale'ex paachil?

Such is God, your Lord, Creator of all things. There is no god except Him; so how could you turn away?

ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

**40:63** Bey ku suuta'alo'ob paachil le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob u chiikulo'ob Allah.

Thus are turned away those who dispute the signs of God.

كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

**40:64** Allah Leti' Maax tu beetaj te'ex le luum bey kuuchil p'aatal, le ka'an bey junp'eel beetajil. Tu beetaj a wiche'ex, tu beetaj uts a wiche'ex; Tu ts'aaj te'ex ti' le uts ba'alo'ob. Bey Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex; beey tuuno', bendisiionta'an Allah, Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

It is God who made the earth a habitat for you, and the sky a structure. And He designed you, and designed you well; and He provided you with the good things. Such is God, your Lord; so Blessed is God, Lord of the Worlds.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**40:65** Leti' le Kuxtal. Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'. Beey tuuno', payalchi'te'ex Leti', jaaj a yoole'ex ti' Leti' ichil a culto. Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah, Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

He is the Living One. There is no god except He. So pray to Him, devoting your religion to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.

هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۗ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**40:66** A'ale: Ma' cha'bil teen in kultik le maaxo'ob ka payalchi'tike'ex tu ts'eel Allah, ka k'uch teen chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob ti' in Yuumtsil; a'ala'aben in ts'aik in baaj ti' Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Say, “I was prohibited from worshiping those you invoke besides God, now that clear revelations have come to me from my Lord; and I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.”

۞ قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**40:67** Leti' Maax tu beetaje'ex ti' luum, ka' ti' junp'eel ja' paal, ka' ti' junp'eel xoot' k'iik' chich, ka ku jook'sike'ex bey mejen paal, ka' utia'al a k'uchule'ex ti' a ch'iijile'ex, ka' utia'al a p'aatale'ex bey nojo'ob; ichile'ex yaan maax ku kiimik taanil; utia'al a k'uchule'ex ti' junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an, utia'al a na'atike'ex.

It is He who created you from dust, then from a seed, then from an embryo, then He brings you out as an infant, then He lets you reach your maturity, then you become elderly—although some of you die sooner—so that you may reach a predetermined age, so that you may understand.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**40:68** Leti' Maax ku ts'aik kuxtal ku ts'aik kiimil; ka Ku jets'ik junp'eel ba'al, chen Ku ya'alik ti': Ka anchahak, ku anchahal.

It is He who gives life and death; and when He decides on a thing, He just says to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

**40:69** Ma' a wilaj le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob u t'aan yo'olal u chiikulo'ob Allah, bix ts'o'ok u sa'atal u beelo'ob?

Have you not observed those who dispute regarding God's revelations, how they have deviated?

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ

**40:70** Le maaxo'ob tu p'ektajo'ob le Aanalte'o' bey tuus, yeetel ba'ax To'on k tuuxtaj K tuuxtbilo'ob yeetel, kun u yojeelo'ob.

Those who call the Book a lie, and what We sent Our messengers with—they will surely know.

ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

**40:71** Ka le kuuchilo'ob yaan yook'ol u kaalo'ob, kun bisa'ako'ob tumen le suumo'ob.

When the yokes are around their necks, and they will be dragged by the chains.

إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَـٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ

**40:72** Ichil le ja' ku kelemtal, ka' ichil le K'aak' kun elelo'ob.

Into the boiling water, then in the Fire they will be consumed.

فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ

**40:73** Ka' kun a'ala'ak ti' letio'ob: Tu'ux le maaxo'ob ka ts'aike'ex yet-maako'ob ka'ach?

Then it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to deify?

ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ

**40:74** Tu ts'eel Allah? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Tu p'atajo'ob to'on. Jaaj, to'on ma' k payalchi'tik mixba'al taanil ka'ach. Bey Allah ku sa'atbesik beel ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Instead of God?” They will say, “They have abandoned us. In fact, we were praying to nothing before.” Thus God sends the disbelievers astray.

مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**40:75** Lela' tumen ka ki'imaktalo'ob ka'ach yook'ol luum mina'an jaaj, tumen ka beetike'ex a baa'ex bey mina'an a subtalile'ex.

That is because you used to rejoice on earth in other than the truth, and because you used to behave with vanity.

ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ

**40:76** Ooke'ex tu joolo'ob Mitnal, a p'aatale'ex te'elo' mantats'. K'aas u kuuchil p'aatal le aj nojbe'etaj baajo'ob.

Enter the gates of Hell, to remain therein forever. What a terrible dwelling for the arrogant.

ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**40:77** Beey tuuno', ch'a' muk'. U promesa Allah jaaj. Kex To'on k e'esik teech junp'eel ti' ba'ax To'on k promesa'aj ti' letio'ob, wa k ch'a'ik teech ti' To'on, ti' To'on kun suuta'ako'ob.

So be patient. The promise of God is true. Whether We show you some of what We have promised them, or take you to Us, to Us they will be returned.

فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

**40:78** To'on k tuuxtaj tuuxtbilo'ob taanil ti' teech. Ichilo'ob yaan maaxo'ob To'on k tsikbaltaj teech yo'olal, yaan maaxo'ob ma' k tsikbaltaj teech yo'olal. Mix jun tul tuuxtbil je'el u taasik junp'eel chiikul chen yeetel u cha'abalil Allah. Ka', ka ku taal u a'almajt'aan Allah, u xot t'aan kun beeta'ak yeetel jaaj, te'elo' le aj kaax tuuso'ob kun sa'atalo'ob.

We sent messengers before you. Some of them We told you about, and some We did not tell you about. No messenger can bring a miracle except by leave of God. Then, when the command of God is issued, fair judgment will be passed, and there and then the seekers of vanity will lose.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

**40:79** Allah Leti' Maax tu beetaj te'ex le ba'alche'o'ob, yaan ti' letio'ob a tsiiminte'ex, yaan a jaante'ex.

God is He who created the domestic animals for you—some for you to ride, and some you eat.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

**40:80** Te'ex yaan te'ex ichil letio'ob u laak' utsilo'ob, utia'al a k'uchule'ex yeetel letio'ob ti' junp'eel k'a'abeetil ichil a puksi'ik'ale'ex. Yook'ol letio'ob, yook'ol le cheemo'ob, ka bisa'ale'ex.

And in them you have other benefits as well, and through them you satisfy your needs. And on them, and on the ships, you are transported.

وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

**40:81** Ku e'esik te'ex U chiikulo'ob. Beey tuuno', maax ti' u chiikulo'ob Allah kun a p'ektike'ex?

And He shows you His signs. So which of God’s signs will you deny?

وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

**40:82** Ma' wa xiimbalnajo'ob yook'ol le luum, tu yilajo'ob bix u ts'ook le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob? Letio'ob maas ya'ab ti' letio'ob, yaan maas muuk' yeetel maas chiikul yook'ol le luum. Ba'ale' ba'ax tu k'ucho'ob ti' ma' tu yaantaj letio'ob mixba'al.

Have they not journeyed through the land, and seen the outcome for those before them? They were more numerous than they, and had greater power and influence in the land. But what they had achieved availed them nothing.

أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**40:83** Ka', ka u tuuxtbilo'ob k'ucho'ob ti' letio'ob yeetel chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, tu ki'imakkunsajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel le na'at yaan ti' letio'ob, ba'ax ku baaxtiko'ob ka'ach tu bak'aj letio'ob.

When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they had, and the very things they used to ridicule besieged them.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**40:84** Ka', ka tu yilajo'ob K muuk', tu ya'alajo'ob: K oksaj k yool ti' Allah chen u baaj, k p'ektik ba'ax k ts'aik yet-maako'ob ti' Leti' ka'ach.

Then, when they witnessed Our might, they said, “We believe in God alone, and we reject what we used to associate with Him.”

فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ

**40:85** Ba'ale' u oksaj oolalo'ob ma' tu yaantaj letio'ob ka tu yilajo'ob K muuk'. Lela' u beelil Allah, ts'o'ok u maan ichil U palilo'ob. Te'elo' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob sa'atalo'ob.

But their faith could not help them once they witnessed Our might. This has been God’s way of dealing with His servants. And there and then the disbelievers lost.

فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

## 41. Detailed

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**41:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**41:2** Junp'eel e'esa'ab taal ti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful.

تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

**41:3** Junp'eel Aanalte' u chiikulo'ob tsoltsola'ano'ob, junp'eel Quran ichil arab t'aan utia'al maako'ob ku na'atiko'ob.

A Scripture whose Verses are detailed, a Quran in Arabic for people who know.

كِتَـٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ

**41:4** Ku taasik uts tsikbal, ku k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan. Ba'ale' u ya'abilo'ob ku suuto'ob paach, beey tuuno' ma' tu yu'ubiko'ob.

Bringing good news, and giving warnings. But most of them turn away, so they do not listen.

بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

**41:5** Ku ya'aliko'ob: K puksi'ik'alo'ob taaka'ano'ob ti' ba'ax ka payik to'on ti', ichil k xikino'ob yaan ko'ojil, ichil to'on yeetel teech yaan junp'eel ba'al ku xu'ulsik to'on. Beey tuuno', beete ba'ax a k'aat, to'on xan k beetik.

And they say, “Our hearts are screened from what you call us to, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a barrier. So do what you want, and so will we.”

وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَـٰمِلُونَ

**41:6** A'ale: Teen chen jun tul wiinik je'el te'ex; e'esa'ab teen u yool ti' teen a K'uje'ex chen Jun tul K'uj. Beey tuuno', p'aate'ex toh ti' Leti', kaxtike'ex sa'atesa'al ti' Leti'. Yaayaj ti' le maaxo'ob ku kultiko'ob u laak' k'ujo'ob.

Say, “I am only a human like you; it is inspired in me that your God is One God. So be upright towards Him, and seek forgiveness from Him.” And woe to the idolaters.

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**41:7** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu bo'otiko'ob le siibal k'a'abeeta'an; yo'olal le u laak' kuxtalo', letio'ob maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

Those who do not pay the alms; and regarding the Hereafter, they are disbelievers.

ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**41:8** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob, ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel bo'olil ma' xu'ulul.

As for those who believe and do righteous deeds—for them is a reward uninterrupted.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

**41:9** A'ale: Ka p'ektike'ex wa le maax tu beetaj le luum ichil ka'ap'eel k'iin? Ka ts'aike'ex wa yet-maako'ob ti' Leti'? Leti' Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Say, “Do you reject the One who created the earth in two days? And you attribute equals to Him? That is the Lord of the Universe.”

۞ قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**41:10** Tu ts'aaj wiitso'ob yook'ol le luum utia'al u jets'ik; tu ts'aaj uts ti'; tu jets'aj u kuxtal ichil kamp'eel k'iin, keet ti' le maaxo'ob ku kaxtiko'ob.

He placed stabilizers over it; and blessed it; and planned its provisions in four days, equally to the seekers.

وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَـٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

**41:11** Ka' tu suut u wiche ti' le ka'an, leti' buuts' ka'ach, tu ya'alaj ti' leti' yeetel ti' le luum: Taale'ex, a k'aate'ex wa ma' a k'aate'ex. Tu ya'alajo'ob: K taal k k'aat k ool.

Then He turned to the sky, and it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come, willingly or unwillingly.” They said, “We come willingly.”

ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ

**41:12** Tu ts'o'oksaj letio'ob bey ukp'eel ka'ano'ob ichil ka'ap'eel k'iin, tu ts'aaj ti' tulakal ka'an u a'almajt'aano'ob. To'on k beetaj uts u yilbal le ka'an naats' yaan yeetel saas k'ujo'ob, utia'al kanan. Bey u jets' t'aan le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ojel Tulakal.

So He completed them as seven universes in two days, and He assigned to each universe its laws. And We decorated the lower universe with lamps, and for protection. That is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

**41:13** Wa ku suuto'ob paach, a'ale: Ts'o'ok in k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan te'ex yo'olal junp'eel chajak k'aak', je'el u chajak k'aak' Aad yeetel Thamood.

But if they turn away, say, “I have warned you of a thunderbolt, like the thunderbolt of Aad and Thamood.”

فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَـٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَـٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ

**41:14** U tuuxtbilo'ob tu taalo'ob ti' letio'ob, ti' u taano'ob yeetel ti' u paacho'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: Ma' a kulte'ex mix maax chen Allah. Tu ya'alajo'ob: Wa k Yuumtsil tu k'aat, tu tuuxtaj angelo'ob; beey tuuno', k p'ektik ba'ax a'ala'ab te'ex ti' a tuuxtbilo'ob.

Their messengers came to them, from before them and from behind them, saying, “Do not worship anyone but God.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He would have sent down angels; Therefore, we reject what you are sent with.”

إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**41:15** Aad, tu beetajo'ob noj oolal yook'ol luum, ma' yeetel jaaj, tu ya'alajo'ob: Maax maas chich ti' to'on? Ma' tu yilajo'ob wa Allah, maax tu beetaj letio'ob, maas chich ti' letio'ob? Ku p'ektiko'ob k chiikulo'ob.

As for Aad, they turned arrogant on earth, and opposed justice, and said, “Who is more powerful than us?” Have they not considered that God, who created them, is more powerful than they? And they went on denying Our revelations.

فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

**41:16** To'on k tuuxtaj yook'ol letio'ob junp'eel iik' ku juum, ichil ya'ab k'iino'ob k'aaso'ob, utia'al k beetik u yuk'iko'ob u yaayajilil subtal ichil le kuxtala'; u yaayajilil le u laak' kuxtalo' maas subtal; ma' kun aanta'ako'ob.

So We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, for a few miserable days, to make them taste the punishment of shame in this life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more shameful; and they will not be saved.

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

**41:17** Thamood, To'on k chiikbesaj u beelo'ob, ba'ale' tu yeeyajo'ob ch'opo'ol yook'ol chiikbesajil beel. Le chajak k'aak' u yaayajilil subtal tu machaj letio'ob, tumen ba'ax ku naajaltiko'ob ka'ach.

And as for Thamood, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance. So the thunderbolt of the humiliating punishment seized them, because of what they used to earn.

وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَـٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**41:18** To'on k aantasaj le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, aj toh oolo'ob ka'ach.

And We saved those who believed and were righteous.

وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ

**41:19** Le k'iin le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob Allah ku muuch'inta'alo'ob tak le K'aak', yeetel muuk'.

The Day when God’s enemies are herded into the Fire, forcibly.

وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

**41:20** Tak ka' k'ucho'ob ti', u u'uyajo'ob, u yilajo'ob, u ooto'ob kun t'aano'ob yook'ol letio'ob yo'olal ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

Until, when they have reached it, their hearing, and their sight, and their skins will testify against them regarding what they used to do.

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**41:21** Kun u ya'alo'ob ti' u ooto'ob: Ba'ax tumen ta t'aanaje'ex yook'ol to'on? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah, maax ku beetik tulakal ba'al ku t'aan, tu beetaj to'on k t'aan. Leti' tu beetaje'ex u yaax ka'aj; ti' Leti' ka suuta'ale'ex.

And they will say to their skins, “Why did you testify against us?” They will say, “God, Who made all things speak, made us speak. It is He who created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.”

وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**41:22** Ma' beeytal a taake'ex a baaj ti' a wu'uyaje'ex, a wilaje'ex, a woote'ex, utia'al ma' u t'aano'ob yook'ole'ex; ta tuukultaje'ex Allah ma' tu yojel ya'ab ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

You were unable to hide yourselves from your hearing, and your sight, and your skins, to prevent them from testifying against you, and you imagined that God was unaware of much of what you do.

وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَـٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

**41:23** Lelo' a tuukulo'ob yo'olal a Yuumtsil tu taasaj a sa'atalo'ob te'ex, beey tuuno' ta p'aataje'ex ichil le aj sa'atalo'ob.

It is that thought of yours about your Lord that led you to ruin—so you became of the losers.

وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ

**41:24** Wa ku ch'a'iko'ob muk'ool, le K'aak' kun p'aatal u yotocho'ob; wa ku kaxtiko'ob bo'olsa'al, ma' kun bo'olsa'ako'ob.

If they endure patiently, the Fire will be their residence; and if they make up excuses, they will not be pardoned.

فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ

**41:25** To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob yet-maako'ob, tu beetajo'ob uts u yilbal ti' letio'ob ba'ax yaan u taano'ob, ba'ax yaan u paacho'ob. Le T'aan jaajchaj yook'ol letio'ob ichil kaajo'ob jinno'ob yeetel wiiniko'ob ts'o'ok u maano'ob u taanilo'ob. Letio'ob aj sa'atalo'ob ka'ach.

We had assigned companions for them, who glamorized to them what was in front of them, and what was behind them. And the Word proved true against them in communities of jinn and humans that have passed away before them. They were losers.

۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ

**41:26** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Ma' a wu'uyike'ex le Quran la', t'aane'ex yook'ol, utia'al ka naajale'ex.

Those who disbelieve say, “Do not listen to this Quran, and talk over it, so that you may prevail.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

**41:27** To'on k beetik le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob u yuk'iko'ob junp'eel chich yaayajil, To'on k bo'otik ti' letio'ob je'el u maas k'aasil ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

We will make those who disbelieve taste an intense agony, and We will recompense them according to the worst of what they used to do.

فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**41:28** Bey u bo'olil le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob Allah, le K'aak', ti' yaan u yotocho'ob ku p'aatalo'ob; bo'olil tumen tu p'ektajo'ob k chiikulo'ob.

Such is the recompense of God’s enemies—the Fire—where they will have their permanent home, in recompense for having disregarded Our revelations.

ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

**41:29** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob kun u ya'alo'ob: K Yuumtsil, e'ese to'on le maaxo'ob tu sa'atbesajo'ob k beel, ichil jinno'ob yeetel wiiniko'ob; k ts'aik letio'ob tu yanal k ooke'ex, utia'al u p'aatalo'ob ichil le maas kaabalo'ob.

Those who disbelieved will say, “Our Lord, show us those who led us astray—among jinn and humans—and we will trample them under our feet, so they become among of the lowest.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

**41:30** Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil Allah, ka' ku maano'ob toh, le angelo'ob kun luubulo'ob yook'ol letio'ob: Ma' a saajkile'ex, ma' a subtalo'ex, ki' ooltke'ex yeetel le uts tsikbal yo'olal le Pak'alo' ts'a'ab a'almajt'aan te'ex ka'ach.

Surely, those who say: “Our Lord is God,” and then go straight, the angels will descend upon them: “Do not fear, and do not grieve, but rejoice in the news of the Garden which you were promised.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

**41:31** To'on a yet-aanto'on ichil le kuxtala' yeetel ichil le u laak' kuxtalo'; ti' yaan te'ex tulakal ba'ax u k'aat a pixano'ob, ti' yaan te'ex tulakal ba'ax ka payike'ex.

We are your allies in this life and in the Hereafter, wherein you will have whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you call for.

نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

**41:32** Bey junp'eel ts'aabil ti' le Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

As Hospitality from an All-Forgiving, Merciful One.”

نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ

**41:33** Maax maas uts ichil t'aan ti' jun tul maax ku payik ti' Allah, ku beetik toh meyaj, ku ya'alik: Teen ichil le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob?

And who is better in speech than someone who calls to God, and acts with integrity, and says, “I am of those who submit”?

وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**41:34** Uts yeetel k'aas ma' keeto'ob. P'eke k'aas yeetel uts; le maax ka'ach a p'ek, ku p'aatal bey jun tul yet-maak jach yaabil.

Good and evil are not equal. Repel evil with good, and the person who was your enemy becomes like an intimate friend.

وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ

**41:35** Mix maax kun u k'am, chen le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob muk'ool; mix maax kun u k'am, chen le maax jach yaan u uts ba'altal.

But none will attain it except those who persevere, and none will attain it except the very fortunate.

وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ

**41:36** Ka' junp'eel tuus ti' Kisin ku k'aasbesikech, kaxt a kananil ti' Allah; Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Ojel.

When a temptation from the Devil provokes you, seek refuge in God; He is the Hearer, the Knower.

وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**41:37** Ichil u chiikulo'ob yaan le ak'ab yeetel le k'iin, le k'iin yeetel le uj. Ma' a xootchitkune'ex ti' le k'iin, ma' ti' le uj; xootchitkune'ex ti' Allah, maax tu beetaj letio'ob, wa Leti' ka kultike'ex.

And of His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not bow down to the sun, nor to the moon, but bow down to God, Who created them both, if it is Him that you serve.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

**41:38** Wa jach noj u yoolo'ob, le maaxo'ob yaan tu taan a Yuumtsil ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob Leti' ak'ab yeetel k'iin, mix bik'in ku naak'al u yoolo'ob.

But if they are too proud—those in the presence of your Lord praise Him night and day, and without ever tiring.

فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩

**41:39** Ichil u chiikulo'ob yaan a wilik le luum jok'a'an. Ka' To'on k ts'aik ja' ku luubul yook'ol, ku peek, ku ch'iijil. Jaaj, maax tu kuxtalbesaj leti' kun u kuxtalbes le kiimeno'ob. Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

And of His signs is that you see the land still. But when We send down water upon it, it stirs and grows. Surely, He Who revived it will revive the dead. He is Able to do all things.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَـٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**41:40** Le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob k chiikulo'ob ma' taaka'ano'ob ti' To'on. Maax ku chu'uksa'al ichil le K'aak' maas uts wa? Wa maax ku taal kananta'an ichil u k'iinil Liksajil? Beete'ex ba'ax a k'aate'ex; Leti' Aj Ilaj ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Those who despise Our revelations are not hidden from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better? Or he who arrives safely on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you please; He is Seeing of everything you do.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**41:41** Le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le K'a'ajsajil ka' k'uch ti' letio'ob, leti' junp'eel Aanalte' ma' naajalta'al.

Those who reject the Reminder when it has come to them—it is an invincible Book.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَـٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ

**41:42** Tuus ma' beeytal u naats'al ti', ti' u taan wa ti' u paach. Junp'eel e'esa'ab ti' jun tul Aj Na'at, Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

Falsehood cannot approach it, from before it or behind it. It is a revelation from One Wise and Praiseworthy.

لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ

**41:43** Mixba'al ku ya'ala'al ti' teech chen ba'ax a'ala'ab ti' le Tuuxtbilo'ob a taanil. A Yuumtsil yaan u sa'atesaj, yaan u yaayaj bo'olil paach.

Nothing is said to you but was said to the Messengers before you: your Lord is Possessor of Forgiveness, and Possessor of Painful Repayment.

مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**41:44** Wa To'on k beetaj bey junp'eel Quran ichil ma' arab t'aan, tu ya'alajo'ob: Ba'ax tumen ma' tsola'ano'ob u chiikulo'ob? Ma' arab t'aan yeetel jun tul arab? A'ale: Ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, leti' chiikbesajil beel yeetel ts'aak; le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ichil u xikino'ob yaan ko'ojil, leti' ch'opo'ol ti' letio'ob. Le maaxo'oba' p'aya'ano'ob ti' junp'eel kuuchil naach.

Had We made it a Quran in a foreign language, they would have said, “If only its verses were made clear.” Non-Arabic and an Arab? Say, “For those who believe, it is guidance and healing. But as for those who do not believe: there is heaviness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. These are being called from a distant place.”

وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**41:45** To'on k ts'aaj ti' Moses le Aanalte'o', ba'ale' ba'atel t'aano'ob jook' yo'olal. Wa ma' junp'eel t'aan ts'o'ok u maan a taanil ti' a Yuumtsil, xot t'aan ku beetbil ichil letio'ob. Letio'ob ichil ka'ap'eel ool ku sa'atbesik ool yo'olal.

We gave Moses the Book, but disputes arose concerning it. Were it not for a prior decree from your Lord, judgment would have been pronounced between them. But they are in perplexing doubt concerning it.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

**41:46** Maax ku beetik toh meyaj, utia'al u baaj ku beetik; maax ku beetik k'aas, yook'ol u baaj. A Yuumtsil ma' aj ma' toh ti' le palilo'ob.

Whoever acts righteously does so for himself; and whoever works evil does so against himself. Your Lord is not unjust to the servants.

مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

**41:47** Ti' Leti' ku suut u na'at le K'intzilo'. Mix ich ku jook'ol ti' u yoot'el, mix ko'olel ku yo'omtal wa ku siijil u paal, chen yeetel u na'at. Le k'iin ku payik letio'ob: Tu'ux in yet-maako'ob? Kun u ya'alo'ob: K a'alik ti' teech, mina'an ichil to'on aj testimonio.

To Him is referred the knowledge of the Hour. No fruit emerges from its sheath, and no female conceives or delivers, except with His knowledge. And on the Day when He calls out to them, “Where are My associates?” They will say, “We admit to you, none of us is a witness.”

۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ

**41:48** Ba'ax ku payalchi'tiko'ob ka'ach kun u p'atiko'ob; kun u na'atiko'ob mina'an jook'ol beel ti' letio'ob.

What they used to pray to before will forsake them, and they will realize that they have no escape.

وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ

**41:49** Le wiinik mix bik'in ku naak'al u yool u payalchi' utia'al uts ba'alo'ob; ka' k'aas ku k'uchul ti', ku sa'atal u yool, ku sa'atal u pa'at.

The human being never tires of praying for good things; but when adversity afflicts him, he despairs and loses hope.

لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ

**41:50** Ka' To'on k beetik u yuk'ik yatzil ti' To'on, paachil ti' le k'aas k'uch ti' leti' ka'ach, kun u ya'al: Lela' in ti'al, ma' kin tuukultik le K'intzilo' ku taal; wa kin suuta'al ti' in Yuumtsil, teen yaan le maas uts yeetel Leti'. To'on k tsikbesik ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ba'ax tu beetajo'ob, To'on k beetik u yuk'iko'ob junp'eel k'aas yaayajil.

And when We let him taste a mercy from Us, after the adversity that had afflicted him, he will say, “This is mine, and I do not think that the Hour is coming; and even if I am returned to my Lord, I will have the very best with Him.” We will inform those who disbelieve of what they did, and We will make them taste an awful punishment.

وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ

**41:51** Ka' To'on k ts'aik uts ti' le wiinik, ku suut paach, ku naats'besik u baaj; ka' k'aas ku k'uchul ti', ku kaajsik payalchi'o'ob chowak.

When We provide comfort for the human being, he withdraws and distances himself; but when adversity befalls him, he starts lengthy prayers.

وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ

**41:52** A'ale: Ta tuukultaje'ex wa? Wa leti' taal ti' Allah, ka p'ektike'ex, maax maas sa'ata'an u beel ti' maax jach naach u baaj, xa'ax u baaj?

Say, “Have you considered? If it is from God and you reject it—who is further astray than he who is cutoff and alienated?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**41:53** To'on k e'esik ti' letio'ob k chiikulo'ob yook'ol le ka'ano'ob naach, yeetel ichil u pixano'ob, tak u saasital ti' letio'ob leti' le jaajo'. Ma' chuka'an wa a Yuumtsil testimonio yook'ol tulakal ba'al?

We will show them Our proofs on the horizons, and in their very souls, until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. Is it not sufficient that your Lord is witness over everything?

سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

**41:54** Jaaj letio'ob ichil ka'ap'eel ool yo'olal u nupiko'ob u baajo'ob yeetel u Yuumtsil. Jaaj Leti' ku bak'ik tulakal ba'al.

Surely they are in doubt about the encounter with their Lord. Surely He comprehends everything.

أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ

## 42. The Consultation

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**42:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**42:2** Ayn, Seen, Qaf.

Ayn, Seen, Qaf.

عٓسٓقٓ

**42:3** Bey ku e'esik u yool ti' teech, yeetel ti' le maaxo'ob a taanil: Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Thus He inspires you, and those before you—God the Almighty, the Wise.

كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**42:4** Ti' Leti' tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob, tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol luum. Leti' le Ka'anal, le Nojbe'en.

To him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. He is the Sublime, the Magnificent.

لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**42:5** Le ka'ano'ob yook'ol letio'ob ooli' ku ja'ats'alo'ob; le angelo'ob ku ki'iki' t'aantiko'ob u ki'iki' t'aano'ob u Yuumtsil, ku kaxtiko'ob sa'atesa'al utia'al le maaxo'ob yook'ol luum. Allah jaaj le Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

The heavens above them almost burst apart, while the angels glorify the praises of their Lord, and ask forgiveness for those on earth. God is indeed the Forgiver, the Merciful.

تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**42:6** Le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob aj kanano'ob tu ts'eel Leti', Allah ku kanantik letio'ob, teech ma' aj kanan yook'ol letio'ob.

As for those who take masters other than Him: God is in charge of them, and you are not responsible for them.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

**42:7** Bey To'on k e'esaj ti' teech u yool junp'eel Quran ichil arab t'aan, utia'al a k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan ti' le noj kaaj ichilo', le maaxo'ob yaan u yook'ol, a k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan yo'olal u K'iinil Muuch'ul, mina'an ka'ap'eel ool ti'; junp'eel muuch' ichil le Pak'alo', junp'eel muuch' ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

Thus We inspired you with an Arabic Quran, that you may warn the Central City and whoever is around it, and to warn of the Day of Assembly, of which there is no doubt; a group in the Garden, and a group in the Furnace.

وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**42:8** Wa Allah tu k'aat, je'el u beetik letio'ob junp'eel kaaj; ba'ale' ku ookbesik ichil u yatzil maax u k'aat. Le aj ma' toh meyajo'ob, mina'an aj kanan ti', mina'an aj aanto' ti'.

Had God willed, He could have made them one community, but He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the wrongdoers, they will have no protector and no savior.

وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
