**42:9** Tu ch'a'ajo'ob wa aj kanano'ob tu ts'eel Leti'? Allah leti' le Aj Kanan; ku ts'aik kuxtal ti' le kiimeno'ob; yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Or have they adopted protectors besides him? But God is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He has power over all things.

أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**42:10** Je'el ba'ax ba'al ka ba'atel t'aantike'ex yo'olal, u xot t'aan yaan ti' Allah. Bey Allah, in Yuumtsil, ti' Leti' kin ch'a'ik in ool, ti' Leti' kin suut in ool.

Whatever matter you differ about, its judgment rests with God. “Such is God, my Lord, in Whom I trust, and unto Him I repent.”

وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ

**42:11** Aj Beetaj u kaajil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Tu beetaj te'ex yet-kuxtalo'ob ti' a pixano'ob, ka'ap'eelilo'ob ba'alche'o'ob, yeetel letio'ob ku ya'besike'ex. Mina'an ba'al je'el Leti'. Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Ilaj.

Originator of the heavens and the earth. He made for you mates from among yourselves, and pairs of animals, by means of which He multiplies you. There is nothing like Him. He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

**42:12** Ti' Leti' u muuk' u jalbesil tulakal le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ku ya'besik u kuxtal ti' maax u k'aat, wa ku p'iisik. Ku yojel tulakal ba'al.

To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He spreads the bounties to whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is aware of all things.

لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**42:13** Tu jets'aj te'ex le culto tu jets'aj ti' Noah, ba'ax To'on k e'esaj ti' teech u yool, ba'ax To'on k jets'aj ti' Abraham, Moses, yeetel Jesus: Ka ts'aike'ex u p'aatal le culto, ma' a xa'axte'ex a baa'ex ichil. Ti' le maaxo'ob ku kultiko'ob u laak' k'ujo'ob, ba'ax ka payiko'ob ti' jach noj. Allah ku yeeyik ti' u baaj maax u k'aat, ku chiikbesik u beel ti' u baaj maax ku suut u yool.

He prescribed for you the same religion He enjoined upon Noah, and what We inspired to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus: “You shall uphold the religion, and be not divided therein.” As for the idolaters, what you call them to is outrageous to them. God chooses to Himself whom He wills, and He guides to Himself whoever repents.

۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ

**42:14** Tu xa'axajo'ob u baajo'ob chen paachil ti' taal na'at ti' letio'ob, tumen p'ek ichil u baajo'ob. Wa ma' junp'eel t'aan jets'a'an u taanil ti' a Yuumtsil tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an, xot t'aan ku beetbil ichil letio'ob. Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ts'a'abo'ob u k'amiko'ob le Aanalte'o' paachil ti' letio'ob ichil noj ka'ap'eel ool yo'olal.

They became divided only after knowledge came to them, out of resentment among themselves. Were it not for a predetermined decision from your Lord, judgment would have been pronounced between them. Indeed, those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in grave doubt about it.

وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

**42:15** Uti'al lela', maane payik, p'aate toh je'el a'ala'ab ti' teech, ma' a maan paachil u k'aato'ob, a'ale: Kin oksik in ool ti' je'el ba'ax Aanalte' tu e'esaj Allah; a'ala'aben in xotik t'aan ichile'ex yeetel keetil. Allah k Yuumtsil yeetel a Yuumtsile'ex. To'on k meyajo'on, te'ex a meyaje'ex. Mina'an ba'atel t'aan ichil to'on yeetel te'ex. Allah kun u muuch'kintiko'on; ti' Leti' u ts'ook suutulo'.

To this go on inviting, and be upright as you were commanded, and do not follow their inclinations, and say, “I believe in whatever Book God has sent down, and I was commanded to judge between you equitably. God is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds, and you have your deeds. Let there be no quarrel between us and you. God will bring us together, and to Him is the ultimate return.”

فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ ۖ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**42:16** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob t'aan yo'olal Allah paachil ti' u k'ama'al u payik, u ba'atel t'aano'ob ma' jaajo'ob yeetel u Yuumtsil; yook'ol letio'ob ku luubul p'ek; junp'eel chich yaayajil ku pa'atik letio'ob.

As for those who dispute about God after having answered His call, their argument is invalid with their Lord; and upon them falls wrath; and a grievous torment awaits them.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ

**42:17** Allah maax tu e'esaj le Aanalte'o' yeetel jaaj, yeetel le P'iis. Ba'ax kun u beet a na'atik ooli' le K'intzilo' naats'?

It is God who revealed the Book with the truth, and the Balance. And what will make you realize that perhaps the Hour is near?

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ

**42:18** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' ku kaxtiko'ob u seebkunsiko'ob; le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob sajako'ob ti', ku yojelo'ob leti' le jaajo'. Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob t'aan yo'olal le K'intzilo' ichil sa'atal beel naach.

Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it; but those who believe are apprehensive of it, and they know it to be the truth. Absolutely, those who question the Hour are in distant error.

يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**42:19** Allah uts u yool ti' u palilo'ob. Ku ts'aik kuxtal ti' maax u k'aat. Leti' le Chich, le Yaan Muuk'.

God is kind towards His worshipers. He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Honorable.

ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ

**42:20** Maax ku k'aat u naajalt le u laak' kuxtalo', To'on k ya'besik ti' leti' u naajal; maax ku k'aat u naajalt le kuxtala', To'on k ts'aik ti' leti' ti'; mina'an u jaats ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' ti'.

Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him thereof, and he has no share of the Hereafter.

مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ

**42:21** Yaan wa ti' letio'ob yet-maako'ob ku jets'iko'ob ti' letio'ob a'almajt'aano'ob culto mix bik'in a'ala'ab ti' Allah? Wa ma' le t'aan xot t'aan, ts'o'ok u xota'al ichil letio'ob. Le aj k'aas meyajo'ob kun u k'amo'ob junp'eel yaayaj yaayajil.

Or is it that they have partners who litigate for them religious laws never authorized by God? Were it not for the conclusive decision, it would have been settled between them. The wicked will have a painful punishment.

أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**42:22** Kun a wil le aj ma' toh sajako'ob tumen ba'ax tu naajaltajo'ob, kun u luubul yook'ol letio'ob. Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob, kun p'aatalo'ob ichil u ki'ik' luumil le Pak'alo'ob; ti' letio'ob yaan tulakal ba'ax u k'aato'ob tu taan u Yuumtsil; lelo' le noj siibal.

You will see the unjust terrified of what they have earned, and it will befall them. As for those who believe and do good deeds, they will be in the Meadows of the Gardens; they will have whatever they please in the presence of their Lord; that is the supreme blessing.

تَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**42:23** Lelo' le uts tsikbal Allah ku ts'aik ti' u palilo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob. A'ale: Ma' kin kaxtik te'ex mix bo'olil yo'olal, chen yaabil ichil le naats' ch'iibalo'ob. Maax ku beetik junp'eel uts meyaj, To'on k ya'besik u uts ti' leti'. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, Aj Ki'iki' T'aan.

That is the good news God gives to His servants who believe and do good deeds. Say, “I ask of you no wage for it, except affection among the near of kin.” Whoever does a good deed, We will increase its goodness for him. God is Forgiving and Appreciative.

ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

**42:24** Ku ya'aliko'ob wa: Tu beetaj tuus yo'olal Allah? Wa Allah u k'aat, je'el u jets'ik a puksi'ik'al. Allah ku tupsik le tuus, ku jaajkunsik le jaaj yeetel u T'aano'ob. Ku yojel ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

Or do they say, “He forged a lie about God.” If God so willed, He could have sealed your heart. But God obliterates the false, and confirm the true by His Words. He knows what is in the hearts.

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**42:25** Leti' maax ku k'amik u suut ool u palilo'ob, ku sa'atesik u kebano'ob, ku yojel ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

It is He who accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and remits the sins, and knows what you do.

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

**42:26** Ku k'amik le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob, ku ya'besik ti' letio'ob ti' u siibal. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob kun u k'amo'ob junp'eel k'aas yaayajil.

And He answers those who believe and do good deeds, and He increases them of His grace. But the disbelievers will suffer a terrible punishment.

وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ

**42:27** Wa Allah tu ya'besaj u kuxtal ti' u palilo'ob, tu beetajo'ob ba'atel yook'ol luum; ku ts'aik ichil jets' p'iis je'el ba'ax u k'aat. Jaaj, yo'olal u palilo'ob, Leti' Aj Ojel, Aj Ilaj.

If God were to increase the provision to His servants, they would transgress on earth; but He sends down in precise measure whatever He wills. Surely, regarding His servants, He is Expert and Observant.

۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

**42:28** Leti' maax ku luubsik le k'aaxal ja' paachil ti' u sa'atal u yoolo'ob, ku t'it'besik u yatzil. Leti' le Aj Kanan, le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

It is He who brings down the rain after they have despaired, and unfolds His mercy. He is the Guardian, the Praised.

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

**42:29** Ichil u chiikulo'ob yaan u beetajil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, le ba'alche'o'ob tu t'it'besaj ichil letio'ob; yaan u Muuk' u muuch'kintik letio'ob ka' u k'aat.

And of His signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the creatures He has spread throughout them; and He is Able to gather them at will.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ

**42:30** Je'el ba'ax k'aas ku k'uchul te'ex, tumen ba'ax a k'abo'ob tu naajaltajo'ob; ku sa'atesik ya'ab.

Whatever misfortune befalls you, it is because of what your hands have earned; and yet He pardons much.

وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ

**42:31** Te'ex ma' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob ba'atel yook'ol luum; tu ts'eel Allah, mina'an aj kanan te'ex, mina'an aj aanto' te'ex.

You are not the ones to interfere on earth; and besides God, you have no ally, and no helper.

وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

**42:32** Ichil u chiikulo'ob yaan le cheemo'ob ku maano'ob ichil le k'aak'naab bey noj chiikulo'ob.

And of His signs are the ships sailing the sea like flags.

وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ

**42:33** Wa u k'aat, je'el u jets'besik le iik'o'ob, u p'aatalo'ob mina'an peek yook'ol u paach. Jaaj ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al tulakal maax ku ch'a'ik muk'ool, ku ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan.

If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on its surface. Surely in that are signs for every disciplined, grateful person.

إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

**42:34** Wa je'el u sa'atbesik letio'ob, tumen ba'ax tu naajaltajo'ob. Ku sa'atesik ya'ab.

Or He could wreck them, because of what they have earned. And yet He pardons much.

أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ

**42:35** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob t'aan yo'olal k chiikulo'ob ku yojelo'ob mina'an kuuchil kanan ti' letio'ob.

Those who dispute Our signs know that there is no asylum for them.

وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ

**42:36** Je'el ba'ax ba'al ts'a'aba'ex chen u kuxtal le kuxtala'. Ba'ax yaan ti' Allah maas uts, maas ku p'aatal, utia'al le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku ch'a'iko'ob u ool ti' u Yuumtsil.

Whatever thing you are given is only the provision of this life. But what God possesses is better and more lasting for those who believe and rely on their Lord.

فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

**42:37** Le maaxo'ob ku p'atiko'ob naach noj kebano'ob yeetel ma' uts meyajo'ob; ka' ku p'ekta'alo'ob, ku sa'atesiko'ob.

And those who avoid major sins and indecencies; and if they become angry, they forgive.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ

**42:38** Le maaxo'ob ku k'amiko'ob u Yuumtsil, ku beetiko'ob payalchi' jets'a'an, ku tsoliko'ob u ba'alo'ob ichil u baajo'ob, ku ts'aiko'ob ti' ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob u kuxtal.

And those who respond to their Lord, and pray regularly, and conduct their affairs by mutual consultation, and give of what We have provided them.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

**42:39** Le maaxo'ob, ka' ku beetbil ma' toh ti' letio'ob, ku kananiko'ob u baajo'ob.

And those who, when wronged, defend themselves.

وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

**42:40** U bo'olil junp'eel k'aas meyaj junp'eel je'el leti'. Maax ku sa'atesik, ku beetik toh ichil, u bo'olil yaan ti' Allah. Ma' tu yaabiltik le aj ma' toh.

The repayment of a bad action is one equivalent to it. But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation, his reward lies with God. He does not love the unjust.

وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**42:41** Le maaxo'ob ku bo'otiko'ob paach paachil ti' u beeta'al ma' toh ti' letio'ob, mina'an p'ek yook'ol letio'ob.

As for those who retaliate after being wronged, there is no blame on them.

وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ

**42:42** P'ek chen yook'ol le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob ma' toh ti' maako'ob, ku beetiko'ob ba'atel yook'ol luum mina'an jaaj ti'. Le maaxo'oba' kun u k'amo'ob junp'eel yaayaj yaayajil.

Blame lies on those who wrong people, and commit aggression in the land without right. These will have a painful punishment.

إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**42:43** Maax ku ch'a'ik muk'ool, ku sa'atesik, lelo' chiikul jaaj chich oolal.

But whoever endures patiently and forgives—that is a sign of real resolve.

وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

**42:44** Maax Allah ku p'atik sa'ata'an u beel, mina'an aj kanan ti' tu ts'eel Leti'. Kun a wil le aj ma' toh, ka' ku yiliko'ob le yaayajil, ku ya'aliko'ob: Yaan wa beel suut?

Whoever God leaves astray has no protector apart from Him. And you will see the transgressors, when they see the torment, saying, “Is there a way of going back?”

وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

**42:45** Kun a wil letio'ob ts'a'abo'ob tu taan, ku xootchitkuno'ob tumen subtal, ku paakatiko'ob yeetel wich taaka'an. Le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob kun u ya'alo'ob: Le aj sa'atalo'ob le maaxo'ob tu sa'atbesajo'ob u baajo'ob yeetel u ch'iibalo'ob ichil u k'iinil Liksajil. Jaaj, le aj k'aas meyajo'ob ichil junp'eel yaayajil ku p'aatal.

And you will see them exposed to it, cowering from disgrace, looking with concealed eyes. Those who believed will say, “The losers are those who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.” Indeed, the evildoers are in a lasting torment.

وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ

**42:46** Mina'an ti' letio'ob yet-aanto'ob kun u aanto'ob tu ts'eel Allah. Maax Allah ku p'atik sa'ata'an u beel, mina'an beel jook'ol ti'.

They will have no allies to support them against God. Whomever God leaves astray has no way out.

وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ

**42:47** K'ame'ex a Yuumtsile'ex taanil ti' u taal ti' Allah junp'eel K'iin ma' beeytal u suuta'al. Mina'an kuuchil kanan te'ex le k'iino', mina'an beeytal a p'ektike'ex jaaj te'ex.

Respond to your Lord before there comes from God a Day that cannot be turned back. You will have no refuge on that Day, and no possibility of denial.

ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ

**42:48** Wa ku suuto'ob paach, To'on ma' k tuuxtaje'ex bey aj kanan yook'ol letio'ob. A meyaj chen tsikbal. Ka' To'on k beetik le wiinik u yuk'ik yatzil ti' To'on, ku ki' ooltal yeetel; ka' k'aas ku k'uchul ti' letio'ob, tumen ba'ax u k'abo'ob tu beetajo'ob u taanil, le wiinik ku p'ektik Allah.

But if they turn away—We did not send you as a guardian over them. Your only duty is communication. Whenever We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but when misfortune befalls them, as a consequence of what their hands have perpetrated, man turns blasphemous.

فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌ

**42:49** Ti' Allah u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ku beetik je'el ba'ax u k'aat. Ku ts'aik paal ko'olelo'ob ti' maax u k'aat, ku ts'aik paal wiiniko'ob ti' maax u k'aat.

To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He grants daughters to whomever He wills, and He grants sons to whomever He wills.

لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَـٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ

**42:50** Wa ku much'besik letio'ob, wiiniko'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob; ku beetik maax u k'aat mina'an u paal. Leti' Aj Ojel, le Yaan Muuk'.

Or He combines them together, males and females; and He renders whomever He wills sterile. He is Knowledgeable and Capable.

أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَـٰثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

**42:51** Mina'an utia'al mix wiinik u t'aan Allah ti' leti', chen yeetel e'esajil ool, wa ti' paachil junp'eel taaka'anil, wa ku tuuxtik jun tul tuuxtbil ku e'esik u yool yeetel u cha'ab je'el ba'ax u k'aat. Leti' Ka'anal Tulakal, Aj Na'at Tulakal.

It is not for any human that God should speak to him, except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His permission whatever He wills. He is All-High, All-Wise.

۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

**42:52** Bey To'on k e'esaj ti' teech u yool junp'eel pixan ti' k a'almajt'aan. Ma' a wojel ka'ach ba'ax le Aanalte'o', ba'ax oksaj oolal; To'on k beetaj bey saas, yeetel k chiikbesik beel ti' maax To'on k k'aat ichil k palilo'ob. Teech jaaj ka chiikbesik beel tak junp'eel toh beel.

We thus inspired you spiritually, by Our command. You did not know what the Scripture is, nor what faith is, but We made it a light, with which We guide whomever We will of Our servants. You surely guide to a straight path.

وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**42:53** U beel Allah, ti' Leti' tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob, tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol luum. Jaaj, ti' Allah ku suutulo'ob tulakal ba'alo'ob.

The path of God, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Indeed, to God all matters revert.

صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

## 43. The Ornaments of Gold

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**43:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**43:2** Hach t'aan le Aanalte' ku beetik saasil tulakal ba'al.

By the Book that makes things clear.

وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

**43:3** To'on k beetaj bey junp'eel Quran ichil arab t'aan, utia'al a na'atike'ex.

We made it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand.

إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**43:4** Leti' yaan ti' To'on ichil le Yaax Aanalte'o', ka'anal yeetel aj na'at.

And it is with Us, in the Source Book, sublime and wise.

وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

**43:5** K p'atik wa paachil le K'a'ajsajil ti' te'ex, tumen te'ex junp'eel kaaj ku beetik ma' toh?

Shall We hold back the Reminder from you, since you are a transgressing people?

أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ

**43:6** Ya'ab profetao'ob To'on k tuuxtaj ti' le maaxo'ob u taanil.

How many a prophet did We send to the ancients?

وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**43:7** Mix jun tuuxtbil tu taal ti' letio'ob, chen ku poch'iko'ob leti'.

No messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him.

وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**43:8** To'on k xu'ulsaj maako'ob maas yaan u muuk' ti' letio'ob; bey tu maan u tsikbal le maaxo'ob u taanil.

We destroyed people more powerful than they, and so the example of the ancients has passed away.

فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**43:9** Wa ka kaat ti' letio'ob: Maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Ojel tu beetaj letio'ob.

And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They would say, “The Mighty, the Knower created them.”

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**43:10** Leti' tu beetaj le luum bey junp'eel kuuchil kuxtal te'ex, tu beetaj beelo'ob te'ex yook'ol, utia'al u chiikbesa'al a beele'ex.

He who made the earth a habitat for you, and traced pathways for you on it, that you may be guided.

ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

**43:11** Leti' ku ts'aik ja' ti' ka'an ichil p'iis jets'a'an; bey To'on k kuxtalbesik junp'eel luum kiimen. Beyxan kun a jook'sa'ale'ex.

He who sends down water from the sky in due proportion; and so We revive thereby a dead land. Thus you will be brought out.

وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

**43:12** Leti' tu beetaj tulakal le ka'ap'eelilo'ob; tu ts'aaj te'ex cheemo'ob yeetel ba'alche'o'ob ka naakale'ex yook'ol u paacho'ob.

He Who created all the pairs; and provided you with ships, and animals on which you ride.

وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

**43:13** U tia'al a naakale'ex yook'ol u paacho'ob, a k'a'ajsike'ex u siibal a Yuumtsil ka' a jets'kubae'ex yook'ol, a'ale'ex: Nojbe'enil ti' Leti' tu ts'aaj le ba'alo'oba' utia'al k meyajo'ob; jaaj, to'on ma' beeytal k beetik tu juunal.

That you may mount their backs, and remember the favor of your Lord as you sit firmly upon them, and say, “Glory be to Him Who placed these at our service; surely we could not have done it by ourselves.

لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ

**43:14** Yeetel jaaj, ti' k Yuumtsil kun k suuto'ob.

And surely, to our Lord we will return.”

وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

**43:15** Ba'ale' ku beetiko'ob jun tul u palilo'ob bey junp'eel u jaats ti' Leti'. Le wiinik, jaaj, ma' u yojel ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan.

Yet they turn one of His servants into a part of Him. Man is clearly ungrateful.

وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ

**43:16** Tu yeeyaj wa utia'al u baaj paal ko'olelo'ob ti' ba'ax ku beetik, tu ts'aaj te'ex paal wiiniko'ob utia'al a baaje'ex?

Or has He chosen for Himself daughters from what He creates, and favored you with sons?

أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ

**43:17** Ka' jun tul ti' letio'ob ku k'amik tsikbal yo'olal ba'ax ku ts'aik ti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil bey ejenplo, u wich ku eek'tal, ku muk'ik u yaayajil ichil u yool.

Yet when one of them is given news of what he attributes to the Beneficent, his face darkens, and he suppresses grief.

وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

**43:18** Jun tul maax ku ch'iijbesa'al utia'al ki'ichpam, ma' beeytal u yaantik ichil ba'atel?

“Someone brought up to be beautiful, and unable to help in a fight?”

أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ

**43:19** Ku beetiko'ob le angelo'ob, u palilo'ob le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, bey ko'olelo'ob. Tu yilajo'ob wa u beetajilo'ob? U tsikbalo'ob kun ts'iibta'al, kun ka'ata'al ti' letio'ob.

And they appoint the angels, who are servants to the Beneficent, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their claim will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ

**43:20** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Wa le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil tu k'aat, to'on ma' k kultik letio'ob ka'ach. Mina'an u na'ato'ob yo'olal lelo'; chen ku tuukultiko'ob.

And they say, “Had the Beneficent willed, we would not have worshiped them.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are merely guessing.

وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

**43:21** To'on k ts'aaj wa ti' letio'ob junp'eel aanalte' a taanil ti' lela', ku machiko'ob?

Or have We given them a book prior to this one, to which they adhere?

أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

**43:22** Ku ya'aliko'ob: K ch'iibalo'ob k kaxtaj yook'ol junp'eel beel, to'on chiikbesa'ano'on ichil u yooke'ob.

But they say, “We found our parents on a course, and we are guided in their footsteps.”

بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

**43:23** Beyxan, To'on ma' k tuuxtaj mix jun aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan a taanil ti' teech ti' mix jun kaaj, chen le maaxo'ob yaan u ayikalil ichilo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: K ch'iibalo'ob k kaxtaj yook'ol junp'eel beel, to'on k ximbaltik u yooke'ob.

Likewise, We sent no warner before you to any town, but the wealthy among them said, “We found our parents on a course, and we are following in their footsteps.”

وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

**43:24** Tu ya'alaj: Kex kin taasik te'ex chiikbesajil beel maas uts ti' ba'ax ta kaxtaje'ex a ch'iibalo'ob ku ximbaltiko'ob? Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on k p'ektik tulakal ba'ax ta taasaje'ex.

He would say, “Even if I bring you better guidance than what you found your parents following?” They would say, “We reject what you are sent with.”

۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**43:25** Bey tuuno' To'on k bo'otaj paach ti' letio'ob. Paakat ba'ax u ts'ook le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob jaaj.

So We wreaked vengeance upon them. Behold, then, what was the fate of those who deny.

فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**43:26** Ka' Abraham tu ya'alaj ti' u yuum yeetel u kaaj: Teen mina'an in keban ti' ba'ax ka kultike'ex.

When Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship.

وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

**43:27** Chen ti' Leti' tu beetajen, Leti' kun u chiikbes in beel.

Except for He who created me, for He will guide me.”

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ

**43:28** Tu beetaj bey junp'eel t'aan ku p'aatal ichil u ch'iibalo'ob, utia'al u suuto'ob.

And he made it an enduring word in his progeny, so that they may return.

وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**43:29** Teen tu ts'aajen ki' oolal ti' le maaxo'oba' yeetel u ch'iibalo'ob, tak ka' taal ti' letio'ob le jaaj yeetel jun tul tuuxtbil ku beetik saasil.

I gave these and their forefathers some enjoyment, until the truth and a manifest messenger came to them.

بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

**43:30** Ka' taal le jaaj ti' letio'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' meyaj tuus, to'on ma' k oksik k ool ti'.

But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and we refuse to believe in it.”

وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

**43:31** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ba'ax tumen ma' e'esa'ab le Quran ti' jun tul wiinik nojbe'en ti' le ka'ap'eel noj kaajo'ob?

They also said, “If only this Quran was sent down to a man of importance from the two cities.”

وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

**43:32** Letio'ob wa ku jaatsiko'ob u yatzil a Yuumtsil? To'on k jaatsaj ichil letio'ob u kuxtalo'ob ichil le kuxtala'; To'on k ka'anbesaj wa jujun tul ti' letio'ob ichil u p'atal yook'ol u laak'o'ob, utia'al wa jujun tul u ch'a'iko'ob u laak'o'ob bey palilo'ob. U yatzil a Yuumtsil maas uts ti' ba'ax ku muuch'kintiko'ob.

Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in this life, and We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they amass.

أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

**43:33** Wa ma' tulakal wiiniko'ob ku p'aatalo'ob bey junp'eel kaaj, To'on k ts'aaj ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil u ka'anil u najo'ob beetbil yeetel plata, yeetel eebilo'ob ku naakalo'ob yook'ol.

Were it not that humanity would become a single community, We would have provided those who disbelieve in the Beneficent with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways by which they ascend.

وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

**43:34** Yeetel joolo'ob ti' u najo'ob, yeetel ba'alo'ob ku he'elelo'ob yook'ol.

And doors to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline.

وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

**43:35** Yeetel ki'ichpam ba'alo'ob. Tulakal lelo' chen u ba'alil le kuxtala'. Le u laak' kuxtalo', ti' a Yuumtsil, utia'al le aj toh oolo'ob.

And decorations. Yet all that is nothing but the stuff of this life. Yet the Hereafter, with your Lord, is for the righteous.

وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

**43:36** Maax ku p'atik ma' u k'a'ajsik le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, To'on k ts'aik ti' leti' jun tul Kisin bey u yet-maak.

Whoever shuns the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign for him a devil, to be his companion.

وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ

**43:37** Letio'ob ku kaliko'ob letio'ob ti' le beel, kex ku tuukultiko'ob chiikbesa'ano'ob.

They hinder them from the path, though they think they are guided.

وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

**43:38** Tak ka' taal ti' To'on, kun u ya'al: Uts ka'ach wa ichil teen yeetel teech yaan u naachil le ka'ap'eel Lak'iino'ob. Ba'ax k'aas yet-maak!

Until, when He comes to Us, he will say, “If only there were between me and you the distance of the two Easts.” What an evil companion!

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ

**43:39** Ma' kun u yaantik te'ex le k'iino', tumen ta beetaje'ex ma' toh. Te'ex yet-maako'ob ichil le yaayajil.

It will not benefit you on that Day, since you did wrong. You are partners in the suffering.

وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

**43:40** Beeytal wa a beetik le ko'oj xikino'ob u yu'ubiko'ob, wa a chiikbesik u beel le ch'opo'ob, yeetel maax ichil sa'atal beel ku beetik saasil?

Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind, and him who is in evident error?

أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**43:41** Kex To'on k ch'a'ik teech naach, To'on k bo'otik paach ti' letio'ob.

Even if We take you away, We will wreak vengeance upon them.

فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

**43:42** Wa k e'esik ti' teech ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob; To'on yaan k muuk' tulakal yook'ol letio'ob.

Or show you what We have promised them; for We have absolute power over them.

أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

**43:43** Mach a baaj ti' ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' teech. Teech yook'ol junp'eel toh beel.

So adhere to what is revealed to you. You are upon a straight path.

فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**43:44** Leti' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al teech yeetel utia'al a kaaj; kun ka'ata'al te'ex.

It is a message for you, and for your people; and you will be questioned.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

**43:45** Kaat ti' le tuuxtbilo'ob To'on k tuuxtaj a taanil ti' teech: To'on k ts'aaj wa k'ujo'ob tu ts'eel le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil utia'al u kulta'alo'ob?

Ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods besides the Beneficent to be worshiped?”

وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

**43:46** To'on k tuuxtaj Moses yeetel k chiikulo'ob ti' Pharaoh yeetel u noj maako'ob. Tu ya'alaj: Teen u Tuuxtbil Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

We sent Moses with Our revelations to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. He said, “I am the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.”

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**43:47** Ka' tu taasaj ti' letio'ob k chiikulo'ob, tu kaajsajo'ob che'ej yo'olal letio'ob.

But when he showed them Our signs, they started laughing at them.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

**43:48** Tulakal chiikul To'on k e'esaj ti' letio'ob maas nojbe'en ti' u yet-chiikul. To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob le yaayajilo'ob, utia'al u suuto'ob u yoolo'ob.

Each sign We showed them was more marvelous than its counterpart. And We afflicted them with the plagues, so that they may repent.

وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**43:49** Tu ya'alajo'ob: A aj tuus, payalchi' ti' a Yuumtsil utia'al to'on, je'el u t'aan jets'a'an ti' teech, bey tuuno' to'on chiikbesa'ano'on.

They said, “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us, according to His pledge to you, and then we will be guided.”

وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

**43:50** Ka' To'on k luk'saj le yaayajil ti' letio'ob, tu seeb p'atijo'ob u t'aan jets'a'an.

But when We lifted the torment from them, they immediately broke their promise.

فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

**43:51** Pharaoh tu k'a'aybesaj ichil u kaaj, ku ya'alik: A kaaje'ex, teen wa in ti'al u jalbesil Egypt, le ja'ilo'ob ku maano'ob tu yanal teen? Ma' ka wilike'ex wa?

Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying, “O my people, do I not own the Kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flow beneath me? Do you not see?

وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**43:52** Teen wa maas uts ti' le ootsil maaxa', ma' beeytal u ya'alik u baaj maas saasil?

Am I not better than this miserable wretch, who can barely express himself?

أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

**43:53** Ba'ax tumen ma' luubsa'ab yook'ol leti' ba'alo'ob ku ts'a'abal ti' u k'ab beetbil yeetel oro, wa ma' taal angelo'ob yeetel leti' ichil muuch'?

Why are bracelets of gold not dropped on him, or they angels came with him in procession?”

فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

**43:54** Bey tu tuusaj u kaaj, tu yu'ubajo'ob leti'. Letio'ob kaaj aj k'aas meyajo'ob ka'ach.

Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were wicked people.

فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

**43:55** Ka' tu beetajo'ob k p'ek u luubul, To'on k bo'otaj paach ti' letio'ob, To'on k bulkuntaj letio'ob tulakal.

And when they provoked Our wrath, We took retribution from them, and We drowned them all.

فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**43:56** Bey To'on k beetaj letio'ob bey junp'eel ejenplo utia'al le maaxo'ob ku taalo'ob paachil.

Thus We made them a precedent and an example for the others.

فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**43:57** Ka' u paal Mary a'ala'ab bey ejenplo, a kaaj tu kaajsaj p'ek.

And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people opposed.

۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

**43:58** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K k'ujo'ob wa maas uts, wa leti'? Chen utia'al ba'atel t'aan tu a'alajo'ob leti' ti' teech. Jaaj, letio'ob junp'eel kaaj ku ba'atel t'aan.

They said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument. In fact, they are a quarrelsome people.

وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

**43:59** Leti' chen jun tul palil To'on k ts'aaj uts ti'; To'on k beetaj leti' bey ejenplo utia'al u Paalo'ob Israel.

He was just a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

**43:60** Wa To'on k k'aat, To'on k beetaj ti' te'ex angelo'ob ku p'aatalo'ob bey u laak'o'ob yook'ol luum.

Had We willed, We would have made of you angels to be successors on earth.

وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

**43:61** Leti' junp'eel chiikul ti' le K'intzilo'; ma' a ka'ap'eel ooltike'ex yo'olal, maane'ex paachil teen. Lela' junp'eel toh beel.

He is a portent of the Hour, so have no doubt about it, and follow Me. This is a straight way.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

**43:62** Ma' a p'atike'ex Kisin u kalik te'ex ti' le beel. Leti' jun tul p'ek ku beetik saasil te'ex.

And let not Satan divert you. He is an open enemy to you.

وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

**43:63** Ka' Jesus taal yeetel le saasil tsololo'ob, tu ya'alaj: Ts'o'ok in taal te'ex yeetel na'at, utia'al in beetik saasil te'ex wa jujun jaats ti' ba'ax ka ba'atel t'aantike'ex yo'olal. Beey tuuno', p'aate'ex toh ti' Allah, yu'ube'ex teen.

When Jesus came with the clarifications, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ about. So fear God, and obey me.

وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**43:64** Allah in Yuumtsil yeetel a Yuumtsile'ex, kulte'ex Leti'; lela' junp'eel toh beel.

God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him—this is a straight path.”

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

**43:65** Le muuch'o'ob tu xa'axajo'ob u baajo'ob ichil u baajo'ob. Yaayaj ti' le aj ma' toh meyajo'ob ti' u yaayajilil junp'eel k'iin yaayaj.

But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers from the suffering of a painful Day.

فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

**43:66** Chen wa ku pa'atiko'ob le K'intzilo' u taal yook'ol letio'ob seeb, ma' tu na'atiko'ob?

Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?

هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**43:67** Le k'iino', le yet-maako'ob kun p'aatalo'ob p'eko'ob ichil u baajo'ob, chen ma' le aj toh oolo'ob.

On that Day, friends will be enemies of one another, except for the righteous.

ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**43:68** A palilo'obe'ex teen: mina'an saajkil te'ex le k'iino', ma' kun a subtalo'ex.

O My servants, you have nothing to fear on that Day, nor will you grieve.

يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

**43:69** Le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ti' k chiikulo'ob, tu ts'a'ajo'ob u baajo'ob ti' Allah.

Those who believed in Our revelations, and were submissive.

ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

**43:70** Ooke'ex ichil le Pak'alo', te'ex yeetel a yet-kuxtale'ex, yeetel ki' oolal.

Enter the Garden, you and your spouses, Joyfully.

ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

**43:71** Kun bisa'ab ti' letio'ob ba'alo'ob beetbil yeetel oro utia'al u jaanto'ob, yeetel uk'ulo'ob. Ichil yaan tulakal ba'ax u k'aat u pixano'ob, ku beetik ki' u wicho'ob. Te'ex kun a p'aatale'ex te' mantats'.

They will be served around with trays of gold, and cups. Therein is whatever the souls desire and delights the eyes. Therein you will stay forever.

يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

**43:72** Bey le Pak'alo' a ch'a'ike'ex bey a ti'al, tumen ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

Such is the Garden you are made to inherit, because of what you used to do.

وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**43:73** Te' yaan te'ex ya'ab u yich che', ka jaantike'ex ti'.

Therein you will have abundant fruit, from which you eat.

لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

**43:74** Le aj kebano'ob, kun p'aatalo'ob ichil u yaayajilil Mitnal mantats'.

As for the sinners, they will be in the torment of Hell forever.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

**43:75** Ma' kun u piitbesa'al ti' letio'ob. Ichil letio'ob kun sa'atal u yoolo'ob.

It will never be eased for them. In it, they will be devastated.

لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

**43:76** To'on ma' k beetaj ma' toh ti' letio'ob, letio'ob aj ma' toh ka'ach.

We did them no injustice, but it was they who were the unjust.

وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**43:77** Kun awato'ob: A Malek, a Yuumtsil u ts'o'oks to'on. Kun u ya'al: Te'ex ka p'aatale'ex way.

And they will cry, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He will say, “You are staying.”

وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ

**43:78** To'on k taasaj te'ex le jaaj, ya'ab ti' te'ex ku p'ektiko'ob le jaaj.

We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth.

لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

**43:79** Tu jets'ajo'ob wa junp'eel tuus? To'on xan k jets'ik.

Have they contrived some scheme? We too are contriving.

أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

**43:80** Ku tuukultiko'ob wa To'on ma' k u'uyik u taaka'an t'aano'ob yeetel u muuch' t'aano'ob? Jaaj, k tuuxtbilo'ob yaan tu ts'eel letio'ob, ku ts'iibiko'ob.

Or do they think that We cannot hear their secrets and their conspiracies? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down.

أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

**43:81** A'ale: Wa le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil yaan u paal, teen u yaax maax ku kultik.

Say, “If the Beneficent had a son, I would be the first to worship.”

قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

**43:82** Nojbe'enil ti' Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, Yuumtsil le Ts'amo', naach ti' ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob.

Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe.

سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

**43:83** P'at letio'ob u beetiko'ob sa'atal beel yeetel baaxal, tak u nupiko'ob u K'iino'ob ts'a'ab a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob.

So leave them to blunder and play, until they encounter their Day which they are promised.

فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

**43:84** Leti' le maax ku p'aatal Allah ichil ka'an yeetel yook'ol luum. Leti' le Aj Na'at, le Aj Ojel.

It is He who is God in heaven, and God on earth. He is the Wise, the Knower.

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**43:85** Bendisiionta'an le maax ti' leti' u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil letio'ob. Chen ti' Leti' u na'at le K'intzilo'; ti' Leti' kun a suuta'ale'ex.

And blessed is He Who has sovereignty over the heavens and the earth and what is between them. He alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.

وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**43:86** Le maaxo'ob ku payiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti' mina'an u muuk'o'ob u t'aano'ob ti' Allah yo'olal u laak'o'ob; chen le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob le jaaj yeetel yaan u na'ato'ob.

Those they invoke besides Him are incapable of intercession; only those who testify to the truth and have knowledge.

وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

**43:87** Wa ka kaat ti' letio'ob: Maax tu beetaj letio'ob? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Allah. Ba'ax tumen ku suuto'ob naach?

And if you asked them, “Who created them?”, they would say, “God.” Why then do they deviate?

وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

**43:88** Yo'olal u t'aan: In Yuumtsil, le maaxo'oba' junp'eel kaaj ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

As for his statement: “My Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”

وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**43:89** Sa'ates letio'ob, a'ale: Jets' oolal. Kun u yojelo'ob.

Pardon them, and say, “Peace.” They will come to know.

فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

## 44. The Smoke

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**44:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**44:2** Hach t'aan le Aanalte' ku beetik saasil.

By the Enlightening Scripture.

وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

**44:3** To'on k e'esaj ichil junp'eel aak'ab yaan uts ti'; To'on aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aano'on.

We have revealed it on a Blessed Night—We have warned.

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

**44:4** Ichil leti' ku ja'ats'a'al tulakal a'almajt'aan yaan na'at.

In it is distinguished every wise command.

فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

**44:5** Junp'eel jets' t'aan ti' To'on; To'on aj tuuxto'ob t'aan ka'ach.

A decree from Us. We have been sending messages.

أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

**44:6** Bey yatzil ti' a Yuumtsil. Leti' le Aj U'uyaj, le Aj Ojel.

As mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**44:7** Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil letio'ob, wa a yojel jaaj.

Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you know for sure.

رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

**44:8** Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'. Ku ts'aik kuxtal, ku beetik kiimil; a Yuumtsil yeetel Yuumtsil a ch'iibalo'ob u taanil.

There is no god but He. He gives life and causes death—your Lord and Lord of your ancestors of old.

لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**44:9** Letio'ob ku baaxalo'ob ichil ka'ap'eel ool.

Yet they play around in doubt.

بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

**44:10** Paakat utia'al le K'iin le ka'an ku taasik junp'eel buuts' ku yila'al.

So watch out for the Day when the sky produces a visible smoke.

فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

**44:11** Ku bak'ik wiiniko'ob; lela' junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

Enveloping mankind; this is a painful punishment.

يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**44:12** K Yuumtsil, luk's le yaayajil ti' to'on, to'on aj oksaj oolo'on.

“Our Lord, lift the torment from us, we are believers.”

رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

**44:13** Ba'ax beeytal u k'a'ajsa'alo'ob? Jun tul tuuxtbil ku beetik saasil ts'o'ok u taal ti' letio'ob.

But how can they be reminded? An enlightening messenger has already come to them.

أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

**44:14** Tu suutajo'ob paach ti' leti', tu ya'alajo'ob: Xooka'an, ba'ale' aj tuus.

But they turned away from him, and said, “Educated, but crazy!”

ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

**44:15** To'on k luk'sik le yaayajil junp'iit, te'ex kun a suute'ex.

We will ease the punishment a little, but you will revert.

إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

**44:16** Le K'iin To'on k ch'a'ik le Noj Ba'atel, To'on aj bo'ot paach.

The Day when We launch the Great Assault—We will avenge.

يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

**44:17** A taanil ti' letio'ob To'on k ts'aaj prueba ti' u kaajil Pharaoh; jun tul tuuxtbil tsikbe'en taal ti' letio'ob.

Before them We tested the people of Pharaoh; a noble messenger came to them.

۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

**44:18** Ku ya'alik: Ts'a teen u palilo'ob Allah. Teen jun tul tuuxtbil jaaj te'ex.

Saying, “Hand over God’s servants to me. I am an honest messenger to you.”

أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

**44:19** Yeetel: Ma' a ka'anbesike'ex a baaj yook'ol Allah. Teen kin taal te'ex yeetel a'almajt'aan ku beetik saasil.

And, “Do not exalt yourselves above God. I come to you with clear authority.

وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

**44:20** Ts'o'ok in kaxtik kananil ti' in Yuumtsil yeetel a Yuumtsile'ex, utia'al ma' a tunichkintike'ex teen.

I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

**44:21** Wa ma' ka oksike'ex a woole'ex teen, p'atene'ex tu juun teen.

But if you do not believe in me, keep away from me.”

وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

**44:22** Tu payalchi'taj ti' u Yuumtsil: Le maaxo'oba' junp'eel kaaj aj keban.

He appealed to his Lord: “These are a sinful people.”

فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

**44:23** Maane'ex ichil aak'ab yeetel in palilo'ob; kun a pa'ata'ale'ex.

“Set out with My servants by night—you will be followed.

فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

**44:24** Xiimbal a maan yook'ol le k'aak'naab seeb; letio'ob junp'eel muuch' aj ba'atel kun bulkunta'ako'ob.

And cross the sea quickly; they are an army to be drowned.”

وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

**44:25** Ya'ab pak'alo'ob yeetel jool ja'o'ob tu p'atijo'ob paachil!

How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind?

كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**44:26** Yeetel paak'alo'ob, yeetel najo'ob tsikbe'en.

And plantations, and splendid buildings.

وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

**44:27** Yeetel ba'alo'ob uts ku yuk'iko'ob ka'ach.

And comforts they used to enjoy.

وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

**44:28** Bey uchik; To'on k ts'aaj bey u ti'al junp'eel u laak' kaaj.

So it was; and We passed it on to another people.

كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

**44:29** Mix ka'an mix luum tu yok'olajo'ob yook'ol letio'ob, ma' ts'a'ab u pa'atalo'ob.

Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved.

فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

**44:30** To'on k tokaj u Paalo'ob Israel ti' le yaayajil ku beetik subtal.

And We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating persecution.

وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

**44:31** Ti' Pharaoh. Leti' jun tul aj ka'anbesaj baaj ichil le maaxo'ob ku maano'ob ma' toh.

From Pharaoh. He was a transgressing tyrant.

مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

**44:32** To'on k yeeyaj letio'ob yeetel na'at yook'ol tulakal maako'ob.

And We chose them knowingly over all other people.

وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**44:33** To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ya'ab chiikulo'ob, ichil yaan junp'eel prueba ku beetik saasil.

And We gave them many signs, in which was an obvious test.

وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

**44:34** Le maaxo'oba' ku ya'aliko'ob.

These people say.

إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

**44:35** Mina'an ba'al chen k yaax kiimil, ma' kun kuxtalbesa'ako'on.

“There is nothing but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

**44:36** Taasike'ex k ch'iibalo'ob, wa te'ex aj jaaj.

Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”

فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**44:37** Letio'ob wa maas uts, wa u kaajil Tubba yeetel le maaxo'ob u taanil ti' letio'ob? To'on k xu'ulsaj letio'ob. Letio'ob aj k'aas meyajo'ob ka'ach.

Are they better, or the people of Tubba and those before them? We annihilated them. They were evildoers.

أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

**44:38** To'on ma' k beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil letio'ob utia'al baaxal.

We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play.

وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

**44:39** To'on k beetaj letio'ob chen utia'al junp'eel jets' meyaj; ya'ab ti' letio'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

We created them only for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.

مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**44:40** Jaaj, le k'iin ku ja'ats'alo'ob u k'iin jets'a'an utia'al letio'ob tulakal.

The Day of Sorting Out is the appointed time for them all.

إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**44:41** Le k'iin mix jun yet-maak kun u yaantik u yet-maak ichil mixba'al, ma' kun aanta'ako'ob.

The Day when no friend will avail a friend in any way, and they will not be helped.

يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

**44:42** Chen maax Allah tu ch'a'aj ootsilil ti'. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Except for him upon whom God has mercy. He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**44:43** Le Che' u yich k'aas.

The Tree of Bitterness.

إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

**44:44** U jaanal le aj keban.

The food of the sinner.

طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

**44:45** Bey plomo ts'o'ok u yiibil, ku wok'ol ichil u nak'o'ob.

Like molten lead; boiling inside the bellies.

كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

**44:46** Bey u wok'ol le ja' jach chich ku wok'ol.

Like the boiling of seething water.

كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

**44:47** Mach leti', bis leti' tak ichil Mitnal!

Seize him and drag him into the midst of Hell!

خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**44:48** Ka' ts'a a luubsik yook'ol u pool u yaayajilil le ja' jach wok'ol.

Then pour over his head the suffering of the Inferno!

ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

**44:49** Yuk'! Teech ka'ach a yaan a muuk' yeetel tsikbe'en.

Taste! You who were powerful and noble.

ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

**44:50** Lela' ba'ax ka ka'ap'eel ooltike'ex ka'ach.

This is what you used to doubt.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

**44:51** Le aj toh oolo'ob, kun p'aatalo'ob ichil junp'eel kuuchil kanan.

As for the righteous, they will be in a secure place.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

**44:52** Ichil pak'alo'ob yeetel jool ja'o'ob.

Amidst gardens and springs.

فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**44:53** Ku buukintiko'ob nook' seda yeetel nook' jach ki'ichpam, ku paakatiko'ob u baajo'ob.

Dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another.

يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

**44:54** Bey uchik; To'on k ts'aik ti' letio'ob yet-kuxtalo'ob ki'ichpam.

So it is, and We will wed them to lovely companions.

كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

**44:55** Kun u payiko'ob te' tulakal u yich che', yeetel jets' oolal yeetel kanan.

They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security.

يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

**44:56** Te' ma' kun u yuk'iko'ob kiimil, chen le yaax kiimil; Leti' kun u kanantik letio'ob ti' u yaayajilil Mitnal.

Therein they will not taste death, beyond the first death; and He will protect them from the torment of Hell.

لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**44:57** Junp'eel siibal ti' a Yuumtsil. Lelo' le maas noj to'okol ichil tulakal.

A favor from your Lord. That is the supreme salvation.

فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**44:58** To'on k beetaj ma' talam ichil a t'aan, utia'al u k'a'ajsiko'ob.

We made it easy in your language, so that they may remember.

فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**44:59** Paakat yeetel p'aat. Letio'ob xan ku pa'atiko'ob yeetel ku paakatiko'ob.

So wait and watch. They too are waiting and watching.

فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

## 45. The Kneeling

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**45:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**45:2** Le e'esa'ab le Aanalte'o' taal ti' Allah, le maax Ka'anal u Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**45:3** Ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

In the heavens and the earth are proofs for the believers.

إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**45:4** Ichil a beetajile'ex, yeetel ichil le beetbilo'ob tu xit'aj, yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al maako'ob yaan jaaj oksaj oolal u yoolo'ob.

And in your own creation, and in the creatures He scattered, are signs for people of firm faith.

وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

**45:5** Ichil u jeelbesajil le aak'ab yeetel le k'iin, yeetel le kuxtal ba'al Allah ku ts'aik ti' ka'an, yeetel leti' ku kuxtalbesik le luum paachil ti' u kiimil, yeetel ichil u suut le iik'o'ob, yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al maako'ob ku na'atiko'ob.

And in the alternation of night and day, and in the sustenance God sends down from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death, and in the circulation of the winds, are marvels for people who reason.

وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَـٰحِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

**45:6** Lelo'ob u Chiikulo'ob Allah, To'on k xokik letio'ob ti' teech yeetel jaaj. Ichil ba'ax t'aan, paachil ti' Allah yeetel u chiikulo'ob, kun u oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob?

These are God’s Verses which We recite to you in truth. In which message, after God and His revelations, will they believe?

تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**45:7** Yaayaj ti' tulakal aj tuus aj keban.

Woe to every sinful liar.

وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

**45:8** Ku yu'ubik u chiikulo'ob Allah ku xoka'alo'ob ti' leti', ba'ale' ku p'aatal bey aj ka'anbesaj baaj, bey ma' tu yu'ubaj letio'ob ka'ach. Ts'a ti' leti' tsikbal yo'olal junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

Who hears God's revelations being recited to him, yet he persists arrogantly, as though he did not hear them. Announce to him a painful punishment.

يَسْمَعُ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**45:9** Ka' ku yojel wa junp'eel ba'al ti' k chiikulo'ob, ku ch'a'ik letio'ob utia'al poch'. Ti' le maaxo'oba' yaan junp'eel yaayajil ku beetik subtal.

And when he learns something of Our revelations, he takes them in mockery. For such there is a shameful punishment.

وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

**45:10** Paachil ti' letio'ob yaan Mitnal. Ba'ax tu meyajtajo'ob ma' kun u yaantik letio'ob mixba'al, mix le maaxo'ob tu ch'a'ajo'ob bey yuumtsilo'ob tu ts'eel Allah. Ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel yaayajil jach noj.

Beyond them lies Hell. What they have earned will not benefit them at all, nor will those they adopted as lords instead of God. They will have a terrible punishment.

مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

**45:11** Lela' chiikbesajil beel. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' u chiikulo'ob u Yuumtsil kun u k'amo'ob junp'eel yaayajil jach yaayaj.

This is guidance. Those who blaspheme their Lord’s revelations will have a punishment of agonizing pain.

هَـٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ

**45:12** Allah leti' tu ts'aaj le k'aak'naab utia'al a meyajo'ob, utia'al cheemo'ob u maano'ob ichil leti' yeetel u a'almajt'aan, utia'al a kaxtike'ex ti' u siibal, utia'al a ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan.

It is God who placed the sea at your service, so that ships may run through it by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may give thanks.

۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

**45:13** Tu ts'aaj utia'al a meyajo'ob tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol luum, tulakal taal ti' Leti'. Ichil lelo' yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al maako'ob ku tuukultiko'ob.

And He placed at your service whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth—all is from Him. In that are signs for a people who think.

وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

**45:14** A'ale ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: sa'atesike'ex le maaxo'ob ma' tu pa'atiko'ob u K'iino'ob Allah. Leti' kun u bo'otik tulakal ti' maako'ob tumen ba'ax tu meyajtajo'ob.

Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not hope for the Days of God. He will fully recompense people for whatever they have earned.

قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**45:15** Maax ku beetik junp'eel uts meyaj, utia'al u pixan; maax ku beetik k'aas, yook'ol u pixan; ka' a suuta'ale'ex ti' a Yuumtsile'ex.

Whoever does a good deed, it is for his soul; and whoever commits evil, it is against it; then to your Lord you will be returned.

مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

**45:16** To'on k ts'aaj ti' u Paalo'ob Israel le Aanalte'o', yeetel na'at, yeetel u t'aan le profetao'ob; To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob ti' le uts ba'alo'ob; To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob u yutsil yook'ol tulakal u laak' maako'ob.

We gave the Children of Israel the Book, and wisdom, and prophecy; and We provided them with the good things; and We gave them advantage over all other people.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**45:17** To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob jets' t'aano'ob saasilo'ob. Ma' tu xa'axajo'ob u baajo'ob chen paachil ti' taal na'at ti' letio'ob, tumen u p'ek u baajo'ob ichil u baajo'ob. A Yuumtsil kun u xot t'aan ichil letio'ob ichil u k'iinil Liksajil yo'olal ba'ax ma' junp'eelili' u tukulo'ob yo'olal.

And We gave them precise rulings. They fell into dispute only after knowledge came to them, out of mutual rivalry. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding the things they differed about.

وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

**45:18** Ka' To'on k ts'aaj teech yook'ol junp'eel beel oksaj oolal, maane paachil ti', ma' a maan paachil ti' u k'aato'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Then We set you upon a pathway of faith, so follow it, and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**45:19** Letio'ob ma' kun u yaantike'ex teech tu ts'eel Allah ichil mixba'al. Le aj ma' toh meyajo'ob yet-maako'ob ichil u baajo'ob, Allah Aj Kanan ti' le aj toh oolo'ob.

They will not help you against God in any way. The wrongdoers are allies of one another, while God is the Protector of the righteous.

إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**45:20** Lela' junp'eel saasil utia'al wiiniko'ob, yeetel chiikbesajil beel, yeetel yatzil utia'al maako'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel jaaj oolal.

This is an illumination for mankind, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe with certainty.

هَـٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

**45:21** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob le k'aas meyajo'ob ku tuukultiko'ob wa To'on k beetik letio'ob bey keet ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob, ichil u kuxtalo'ob wa ichil u kiimilo'ob? K'aas u xot t'aano'ob!

Do those who perpetrate the evil deeds assume that We will regard them as equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, whether in their life or their death? Evil is their judgment!

أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

**45:22** Allah tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel toh, utia'al tulakal pixan u bo'ota'al tumen ba'ax tu meyajtaj. Letio'ob ma' kun beetbil ma' toh ti' letio'ob.

God created the heavens and the earth with justice, so that every soul will be repaid for what it has earned. And they will not be wronged.

وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**45:23** Ta wilaj wa le maax tu ch'a'aj u k'aat bey u k'uj? Allah tu sa'atbesaj u beel yeetel u na'at, tu jets'aj u yu'ubik yeetel u puksi'ik'al, tu ts'aaj junp'eel taaka'an yook'ol u wich. Maax kun u chiikbes u beel paachil ti' Allah? Ma' a k'a'ajsike'ex wa?

Have you considered him who has taken his desire for his god? God has knowingly led him astray, and has sealed his hearing and his heart, and has placed a veil over his vision. Who will guide him after God? Will you not reflect?

أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَـٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

**45:24** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Mina'an ba'al chen le kuxtal k yaan waye'; k kiimil yeetel k kuxtal, mixba'al ku xu'ulsik to'on chen k'iin. Mina'an u na'ato'ob yo'olal lelo'; chen ku tuukultiko'ob.

And they say, “There is nothing but this our present life; we die and we live, and nothing destroys us except time.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are only guessing.

وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

**45:25** Ka' k chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob ku xoka'alo'ob ti' letio'ob, chen ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob utia'al u ba'ateltiko'ob t'aan: Suutbesike'ex k ch'iibalo'ob, wa te'ex aj jaaj.

When Our clarifying Verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”

وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**45:26** A'ale: Allah ku ts'aik te'ex kuxtal, ka' ku beetik a kiimile'ex; ka' ku muuch'kintike'ex utia'al u k'iinil Liksajil, mina'an ka'ap'eel oolal yo'olal. Ya'ab maako'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

Say, “God gives you life, then He makes you die; then He gathers you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”

قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**45:27** Ti' Allah u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Le k'iin ku lik'ik le K'intzilo', le k'iino' le aj tuuso'ob kun u sa'atiko'ob.

To God belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. On the Day when the Hour takes place, on that Day the falsifiers will lose.

وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

**45:28** Kun a wilik tulakal kaaj ku xoolan yook'ol u piixo'ob; tulakal kaaj kun paya'ak ti' u Aanalte': Bejla'e' ka bo'ota'ale'ex tumen ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

You will see every community on its knees; every community will be called to its Book: “Today you are being repaid for what you used to do.

وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**45:29** Le Aanalte'a' To'on ku t'aan yo'olal te'ex yeetel jaaj. To'on k ts'iibik ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

This Book of Ours speaks about you in truth. We have been transcribing what you have been doing.”

هَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**45:30** Le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel tu beetajo'ob toh meyajo'ob, u Yuumtsil kun u yokbes letio'ob ichil u yatzil. Lelo' le to'okol saasil.

As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the clear triumph.

فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**45:31** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob: Ma' xoka'ab wa te'ex in chiikulo'ob ka'ach? Ta ka'anbesaje'ex a baaj, te'ex kaaj aj keban ka'ache'ex.

But as for those who disbelieved: “Were My revelations not recited to you? But you turned arrogant, and were guilty people.”

وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ

**45:32** Ka' a'ala'ab: U promesa Allah jaaj, yo'olal le K'intzilo' mina'an ka'ap'eel oolal, ta ya'alaje'ex: Ma' k ojel ba'ax le K'intzilo'; chen k tuukultik leti' junp'eel tukul, ma' jach jaaj k ool ti'.

And when it was said, “The promise of God is true, and of the Hour there is no doubt,” you said, “We do not know what the Hour is; we think it is only speculation; we are not convinced.”

وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ

**45:33** Le k'aaso'ob ti' ba'ax tu beetajo'ob kun chiikpajako'ob ti' letio'ob, ba'ax tu poch'iko'ob ka'ach kun u bak' letio'ob.

The evils of what they did will become evident to them, and the very thing they ridiculed will haunt them.

وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**45:34** Kun a'ala'ak: Bejla'e' To'on k tu'ubsike'ex, bey a tu'ubsaje'ex u nupik le K'iina' te'ex. A kuuchil kuxtale'ex le K'aak', mina'an aj aantajo'ob te'ex.

And it will be said, “Today We forget you, as you forgot the encounter of this Day of yours. Your abode is the Fire, and there are no saviors for you.

وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

**45:35** Lelo' tumen ta ch'a'aje'ex u chiikulo'ob Allah utia'al poch', le kuxtala' tu tuusaje'ex. Bejla'e' ma' kun jook'sa'ako'ob ti', ma' kun cha'abalo'ob u suut u yoolo'ob.

That is because you took God’s revelations for a joke, and the worldly life lured you.” So today they will not be brought out of it, and they will not be allowed to repent.

ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

**45:36** Ki'iki' t'aan ti' Allah; Yuumtsil le ka'ano'ob, Yuumtsil le luum, Yuumtsil wiiniko'ob.

Praise belongs to God; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of humanity.

فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**45:37** Ti' Leti' tulakal nojbe'enil ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Majestic, the Wise.

وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

## 46. The Sand Dunes

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**46:1** Ha, Meem.

Ha, Meem.

حمٓ

**46:2** Le e'esa'ab le kili'ich ju'uno' taal ti' Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

The sending down of the Scripture is from God, the Honorable, the Wise.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**46:3** To'on ma' k beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil letio'ob chen yeetel jaaj, yeetel utia'al junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an u ts'ook. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku p'atik ma' u yu'ubiko'ob le tsololo'ob ku k'a'aybesa'alo'ob ti' letio'ob.

We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them except with reason, and for a finite period. But the blasphemers continue to ignore the warnings they receive.

مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ

**46:4** A'ale: Ta wilaje'ex wa le maaxo'ob ka kultike'ex tu ts'eel Allah? E'ese'ex teen ba'ax jaats ti' le luum tu beetajo'ob. Yaan wa u jaats ti' le ka'ano'ob? Taasike'ex teen junp'eel aanalte' a taanil ti' lela', wa junp'eel xet' na'at, wa te'ex aj jaaj.

Say, “Have you considered those you worship instead of God? Show me which portion of the earth they have created. Or do they own a share of the heavens? Bring me a scripture prior to this one, or some trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَـٰرَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**46:5** Maax maas ma' toh ti' le maax ku payik, tu ts'eel Allah, le maaxo'ob ma' kun u nuuko'ob leti' tak u k'iinil Liksajil, ma' tu yu'ubiko'ob u payalchi'o'ob?

Who is more wrong than him who invokes, besides God, those who will not answer him until the Day of Resurrection, and are heedless of their prayers?

وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

**46:6** Ka' wiiniko'ob ku muuch'besa'alo'ob, kun p'aatalo'ob p'eko'ob ti' letio'ob, kun u p'ektiko'ob u kultiko'ob letio'ob ka'ach.

And when humanity is gathered, they will be enemies to them, and will renounce their worship of them.
