وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ

**46:7** Ka' k chiikulo'ob ku xoka'alo'ob ti' letio'ob, saasilo'ob yeetel jets'a'ano'ob, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob yo'olal le jaaj ka' taal ti' letio'ob: Lela' meyaj tuus ku beetik saasil.

When Our revelations are recited to them, plain and clear, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is obviously magic.”

وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**46:8** Wa ku ya'aliko'ob: Leti' tu beetaj tu juunal? A'ale: Wa teen tu beetaj tin juunal, mina'an ba'ax beeytal a beetike'ex utia'al a kananikene'ex ti' Allah. Leti' ku yojel uts ba'ax ka beetike'ex. Leti' jets' utia'al aj testimonio ichil teen yeetel te'ex. Leti' Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Or do they say, “He invented it himself”? Say, “If I invented it myself, there is nothing you can do to protect me from God. He knows well what you are engaged in. He is sufficient witness between me and you. He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.”

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**46:9** A'ale: Teen ma' jejelaas ti' le u laak' tuuxtbilo'ob; ma' in wojel ba'ax kun beeta'ak yeetel teen, wa yeetel te'ex. Chen kin maan paachil ti' ba'ax e'esa'ab u yool ti' teen, teen chen jun tul aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan ku beetik saasil.

Say, “I am not different from the other messengers; and I do not know what will be done with me, or with you. I only follow what is inspired in me, and I am only a clear warner.”

قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**46:10** A'ale: Ta wilaje'ex wa? Wa leti' taal ti' Allah yeetel ma' ta oksaje'ex a woole'ex ti'? Jun tul aj testimonio ti' u Paalo'ob Israel tu ts'aaj testimonio yo'olal u yet-beyil, tu oksaj u yool, te'ex ta ka'anbesaje'ex a baaj. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le kaaj aj ma' toh.

Say, “Have you considered? What if it is from God and you disbelieve in it? A witness from the Children of Israel testified to its like, and has believed, while you turned arrogant. God does not guide the unjust people.”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**46:11** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: Wa uts ka'ach, ma' u taanbesajo'ob to'on ti'. Tumen ma' chiikbesa'ab u beelo'ob yeetel leti', kun u ya'alo'ob: Lela' junp'eel tuus uuchben.

Those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “If it were anything good, they would not have preceded us to it.” And since they were not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient lie.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَآ إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ

**46:12** A taanil ti' leti' yaan u Aanalte' Moses, junp'eel beyil yeetel yatzil. Lela' junp'eel Aanalte' ku jets'ik jaaj, ichil arab t'aan, utia'al u k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan ti' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob ma' toh, yeetel uts tsikbal utia'al le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob uts.

And before it was the Book of Moses, a model and a mercy. And this is a confirming Book, in the Arabic language, to warn those who do wrong—and good news for the doers of good.

وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**46:13** Le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil Allah, ka' ku beetiko'ob toh kuxtal, mina'an saajkil ti' letio'ob, ma' kun subtalo'ob.

Those who say, “Our Lord is God,” then lead a righteous life—they have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**46:14** Lelo'ob u maako'ob le Pak'alo', te' kun p'aatalo'ob mantats', junp'eel bo'olil tumen ba'ax tu beetiko'ob ka'ach.

These are the inhabitants of Paradise, where they will dwell forever—a reward for what they used to do.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**46:15** To'on k ts'aaj a'almajt'aan yook'ol wiinik u beetik uts ti' u na' yeetel u yuum. U na' tu kuchaj leti' yeetel talamil, tu siijbesaj leti' yeetel talamil. U kuchik yeetel u ts'u'utsbesa'al 30 winaal. Tak, ka' k'uch u nojochil, k'uch 40 ja'ab, ku ya'alik: In Yuumtsil, beet in beeytal in ch'a'ik uts u siibalo'ob ta ts'aaj teen yeetel in na' yeetel in yuum, in beetik toh meyaj, ku ch'a'ik uts a yool ti'. Beet uts in paalo'ob utia'al teen. Ts'o'ok in suut in yool ti' Teech yeetel jaaj, teen ti' le maaxo'ob tu ts'a'ajo'ob u baajo'ob.

We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty, and delivered him with difficulty. His bearing and weaning takes thirty months. Until, when he has attained his maturity, and has reached forty years, he says, “Lord, enable me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to act with righteousness, pleasing You. And improve my children for me. I have sincerely repented to You, and I am of those who have surrendered.”

وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ ثَلَـٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**46:16** Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob To'on k k'amik u maas uts u meyajo'ob ichil tulakal ba'ax tu beetajo'ob, To'on k p'atik ma' k ilik u k'aas meyajo'ob, ichil u maako'ob le Pak'alo', le promesa jaaj, le promesa a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob.

Those are they from whom We accept the best of their deeds, and We overlook their misdeeds, among the dwellers of Paradise—the promise of truth which they are promised.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

**46:17** Le maax ku ya'alik ti' u na' yeetel u yuum: Ts'o'ok te'ex! Ka promesa'atiken wa kin jook'sa'al, ts'o'ok u maano'ob ya'ab ch'iibalo'ob a taanil ti' teen ka'ach? Le ka' tul tu payiko'ob aantaj ti' Allah: Yaayaj ti' teech! Okse a yool! U promesa Allah jaaj! Ku ya'alik: Lelo'ob chen u tsikbalo'ob le uuchbeno'ob.

As for him who says to his parents, “Enough of you! Are you promising me that I will be raised up, when generations have passed away before me?” While they cry for God’s help, “Woe to you! Believe! The promise of God is true!” But he says, “These are nothing but tales of the ancients.”

وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**46:18** Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob le xot t'aan jaajchaj yook'ol letio'ob, ichil kaajo'ob ts'o'ok u maano'ob a taanil ti' letio'ob, ti' jinno'ob yeetel wiiniko'ob. Letio'ob jaaj aj sa'atalo'ob.

Those are they upon whom the sentence is justified, among the communities that have passed away before them, of jinn and humans. They are truly losers.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ

**46:19** Ti' tulakal yaan p'atalilo'ob, bey ba'ax tu beetajo'ob, Leti' kun u bo'otik ti' letio'ob u meyajo'ob tulakal, ma' kun beetbil ma' toh ti' letio'ob.

There are degrees for everyone, according to what they have done, and He will repay them for their works in full, and they will not be wronged.

وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَـٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**46:20** Le k'iin le maaxo'ob ma' oksaj oolo'ob kun e'esa'ako'ob taanil ti' le K'aak': Ta xu'ulsaje'ex a uts ba'alo'ob ichil a kuxtal yook'ol luum, ta ch'a'aje'ex ki' oolal yeetel letio'ob. Bejla'e' ka bo'ota'ale'ex yeetel u yaayajilil subtal, tumen a ka'anbesaj a baaje'ex yook'ol luum mina'an jaaj ti', tumen ka beetike'ex keban ka'ach.

On the Day when the faithless will be paraded before the Fire: “You have squandered your good in your worldly life, and you took pleasure in them. So today you are being repaid with the torment of shame, because of your unjust arrogance on earth, and because you used to sin.”

وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَـٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

**46:21** Yeetel k'a'ajse u suku'un Aad, ka' tu k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan ti' u kaaj ichil le pu'uko'ob. Le k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aano'ob ts'o'ok u maano'ob a taanil ti' leti', yeetel paachil ti' leti': Ma' a kultike'ex mixba'al chen Allah; kin sajak utia'al te'ex u yaayajilil junp'eel k'iin jach noj.

And mention the brother of Aad, as he warned his people at the dunes. Warnings have passed away before him, and after him: “Worship none but God; I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day.”

۞ وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**46:22** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ta taal wa ti' to'on utia'al a pu'ubsik k beel ti' k k'ujo'ob? Taase to'on ba'ax ka a'alik kun taal yook'ol to'on, wa teech aj jaaj.

They said, “Did you come to us to divert us from our gods? Then bring us what you threaten us with, if you are being truthful.”

قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

**46:23** Tu ya'alaj: Le na'at chen ti' Allah, kin ts'aik tsikbal te'ex yo'olal ba'ax tuuxta'aben yeetel; ba'ale' kin wilik te'ex junp'eel kaaj mina'an na'at te'ex.

He said, “The knowledge is only with God, and I inform you of what I was sent with; but I see you are an ignorant people.”

قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ

**46:24** Ka' tu yilajo'ob junp'eel muyal ku taal u nupik u ja' k'axo'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' junp'eel muyal kun u ts'a to'on k'aax ja'. Jaaj, leti' ba'ax ka kaxtike'ex u seebtal: junp'eel iik' ichil yaan junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

Then, when they saw a cloud approaching their valley, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” “In fact, it is what you were impatient for: a wind in which is grievous suffering.”

فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**46:25** Kun u xu'uls tulakal ba'al yeetel u a'almajt'aan u Yuumtsil. Ka' taal le saamal, mixba'al ku yila'al chen u najo'ob. Bey To'on k bo'otik le kaaj aj keban.

It will destroy everything by the command of its Lord. And when the morning came upon them, there was nothing to be seen except their dwellings. Thus We requite the guilty people.

تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**46:26** To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob muuk' bey bix To'on k ts'aaj muuk' te'ex; To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob u yu'ubiko'ob, u yilo'ob, u na'ato'ob. Mix u yu'ubiko'ob, mix u yilo'ob, mix u na'ato'ob tu yaantajo'ob letio'ob ichil mixba'al. Lelo' tumen tu p'ektajo'ob u chiikulo'ob Allah; bey tu bak'aj letio'ob ba'ax tu poch'iko'ob ka'ach.

We had empowered them in the same way as We empowered you; and We gave them the hearing, and the sight, and the minds. But neither their hearing, nor their sight, nor their minds availed them in any way. That is because they disregarded the revelations of God; and so they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.

وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَـٰرًا وَأَفْـِٔدَةً فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**46:27** To'on k xu'ulsaj ya'ab kaajo'ob ta wetel, To'on k jeelbesaj le chiikulo'ob, utia'al u suuto'ob.

We have destroyed many townships around you, and diversified the signs, so that they may return.

وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**46:28** Ba'ax tumen le k'ujo'ob tu kultajo'ob utia'al u naats'talo'ob ti' Allah, tu ch'a'ajo'ob tu ts'eel Allah, ma' tu yaantajo'ob letio'ob? Jaaj, tu p'atajo'ob letio'ob. Lelo' u tuuso'ob, junp'eel beetajil tu beetajo'ob tu juunalo'ob.

Why then did the idols, whom they worshiped as means of nearness to God, not help them? In fact, they abandoned them. It was their lie, a fabrication of their own making.

فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

**46:29** Yeetel k'a'ajse ka' To'on k tuuxtaj ti' teech junp'eel muuch' jinno'ob, utia'al u yu'ubiko'ob le Quran. Ka' k'ucho'ob tu taan, tu ya'alajo'ob: Yu'ube'ex! Ka' ts'o'ok, tu seeb suuto'ob ti' u kaajo'ob, ku k'a'aybesiko'ob ti' letio'ob.

Recall when We dispatched towards you a number of jinn, to listen to the Quran. When they came in its presence, they said, “Pay attention!” Then, when it was concluded, they rushed to their people, warning them.

وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

**46:30** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Oo k kaaj, To'on k yu'ubaj junp'eel Aanalte', e'esa'ab paachil ti' Moses, ku jets'ik jaaj ba'ax taal a taanil ti'. Ku chiikbesik beel ti' le jaaj, ti' junp'eel toh beel.

They said, “O our people, we have heard a Scripture, sent down after Moses, confirming what came before it. It guides to the truth, and to a straight path.

قَالُوا۟ يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَـٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**46:31** Oo k kaaj! Nuuke'ex le maax ku payik ti' Allah, okse'ex a woole'ex ti' Leti'; Leti' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob te'ex, kun u tokike'ex ti' junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

O our people! Answer the caller to God, and believe in Him; and He will forgive you your sins, and will save you from a painful punishment.”

يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**46:32** Maax ma' tu nuukik le maax ku payik ti' Allah, ma' kun u sa'atbes u baaj yook'ol luum, mina'an u aj kanano'ob tu ts'eel Leti'. Lelo'ob ichil sa'atal beel ku beetik saasil.

He who does not answer the caller to God will not escape on earth, and has no protectors besides Him. Those are in obvious error.

وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**46:33** Ma' tu yiliko'ob wa Allah, tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, mix bik'in tu ka'ap'eeltal u yool tumen u beetik letio'ob, Yaan u Muuk' u kuxtalbesik le kiimeno'ob? Jaaj, Leti' Yaan Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Do they not realize that God, who created the heavens and the earth, and was never tired by creating them, is Able to revive the dead? Yes indeed; He is Capable of everything.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**46:34** Le k'iin le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob kun e'esa'ako'ob taanil ti' le K'aak': Lela' ma' jaaj wa? Kun u ya'alo'ob: Jaaj, tumen k Yuumtsil. Kun u ya'al: Yuk'e'ex le yaayajil tumen ma' ta oksaje'ex a woole'ex ka'ach.

On the Day when those who disbelieved are presented to the Fire: “Is this not real?” They will say, “Yes, indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the suffering for having disbelieved.”

وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

**46:35** Ch'a'e muk', bey le tuuxtbilo'ob yaan u jets' oolo'ob tu ch'a'ajo'ob muk', ma' a seebkunsik yo'olal letio'ob. Le k'iin kun u yilo'ob ba'ax promesa'ata'alo'ob, bey wa chen junp'eel jaats k'iin tu p'aatalo'ob ka'ach. Junp'eel k'a'aybesaj! Kun xu'ulsa'ako'ob wa chen le kaaj aj k'aas meyaj?

So be patient, as the messengers with resolve were patient, and do not be hasty regarding them. On the Day when they witness what they are promised, it will seem as if they had lasted only for an hour of a day. A proclamation: Will any be destroyed except the sinful people?

فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَـٰغٌ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ

## 47. Muhammad

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**47:1** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku p'atik maako'ob ti' u beel Allah, Leti' ku beetik u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of God—He nullifies their works.

ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:2** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob, yeetel ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' Muhammad, leti' le jaaj taal ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob, Leti' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob, kun u beetik uts u yolo'ob.

While those who believe, and work righteousness, and believe in what was sent down to Muhammad—and it is the truth from their Lord—He remits their sins, and relieves their concerns.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ

**47:3** Lelo' tumen le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku maano'ob paachil ti' tuus ba'alo'ob, le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku maano'ob paachil ti' le jaaj taal ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob. Bey Allah ku ts'aik ti' maako'ob u beyilo'ob.

That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehoods, while those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. God thus cites for the people their examples.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:4** Ka' ka nupike'ex le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, jaatse'ex u kaalo'ob. Ka' ts'o'ok a jach aantik letio'ob, k'axe'ex letio'ob chich. Ka' paachil, wa a cha'ike'ex letio'ob tumen siibal, wa tumen bo'olil, tak le ba'atel ku p'atik u kuucho'ob. Wa Allah u k'aat ka'ach, Leti' tu juunal je'el u aantik letio'ob ka'ach, ba'ale' Bey ku ts'aik prueba ti' wa baax ti' te'ex tumen u laak'o'ob. Le maaxo'ob kiimo'ob yook'ol u beel Allah, Leti' ma' kun u beet u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

When you encounter those who disbelieve, strike at their necks. Then, when you have routed them, bind them firmly. Then, either release them by grace, or by ransom, until war lays down its burdens. Had God willed, He could have defeated them Himself, but He thus tests some of you by means of others. As for those who are killed in the way of God, He will not let their deeds go to waste.

فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَضَرْبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا۟ ٱلْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَا۟ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:5** Leti' kun u chiikbes u beelo'ob, kun u beetik uts u yolo'ob.

He will guide them, and will improve their state of mind.

سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ

**47:6** Kun u yokbes letio'ob ichil le Pak'alo', ts'o'ok u e'esik ti' letio'ob.

And will admit them into Paradise, which He has identified for them.

وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ

**47:7** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Wa ka aantike'ex Allah, Leti' kun u aantike'ex, kun u chichkint a wooko'ob.

O you who believe! If you support God, He will support you, and will strengthen your foothold.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ

**47:8** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ti' letio'ob le sa'atalo', Leti' kun u beet u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

But as for those who disbelieve, for them is perdition, and He will waste their deeds.

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:9** Lelo' tumen tu p'ektajo'ob le ba'ax Allah tu e'esaj, bey tu beetaj u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

That is because they hated what God revealed, so He nullified their deeds.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:10** Ma' ximaano'ob wa yook'ol le luum, ma' tu yilajo'ob ba'ax u ts'ook ti' le maaxo'ob maanajo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob? Allah tu taasaj xu'ulsajil yook'ol letio'ob, ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yaan u yet-beyil.

Have they not journeyed through the earth and seen the consequences for those before them? God poured destruction upon them, and for the unbelievers is something comparable.

۞ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْثَـٰلُهَا

**47:11** Lelo' tumen Allah u Yuumil le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob mina'an u yuumilo'ob.

That is because God is the Master of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no master.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

**47:12** Allah kun u yokbes le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob ichil pak'alo'ob yaan beel ja'o'ob ku maano'ob yanal ti' letio'ob. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob ki' oolal, ku jaantiko'ob bey ku jaantik le ba'alche'o'ob, le K'aak' kun u yotoche'ob.

God will admit those who believe and do good deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves, and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire will be their dwelling.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ

**47:13** Jayp'eel kaaj maas yaan u muuk' ti' a kaaj, le kaaj tu jok'sajech? To'on k xu'ulsaj letio'ob, mina'an aj aantaj ti' letio'ob.

How many a town was more powerful than your town which evicted you? We destroyed them, and there was no helper for them.

وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ

**47:14** Le maax wa'ala'an yook'ol chiikul saasil ti' u Yuumtsil, bey wa le maax u k'aas meyaj ts'o'ok u beeta'al bey uts ti' leti'? Ku maano'ob paachil ti' u k'aato'ob.

Is he who stands upon evidence from his Lord, like someone whose evil deed is made to appear good to him? And they follow their own desires?

أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم

**47:15** U beyil le Pak'alo' promesa'ata'an ti' le aj toh oolo'ob: ichil yaan beel ja'o'ob ti' ja' mina'an u k'aasil, beel ja'o'ob ti' le uk'ul ti' ba'alche'o'ob mina'an u jeelbesajil u ts'ikil, beel ja'o'ob ti' vino ku beetik ki' oolal ti' le maaxo'ob ku yu'uk'iko'ob, beel ja'o'ob ti' kaab ts'o'ok u luk'sa'al u k'aasil. Ichil leti' kun u yaantal ti' letio'ob tulakal ich che', yeetel sa'atesa'al keban ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob. Bey wa jun tul ku p'aatal ichil le K'aak' mantats', ku ts'a'abal u yu'uk' ja' jach wok'ol, ku xotik u chocho'ob?

The likeness of the Garden promised to the righteous: in it are rivers of pure water, and rivers of milk forever fresh, and rivers of wine delightful to the drinkers, and rivers of strained honey. And therein they will have of every fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord. Like one abiding in the Fire forever, and are given to drink boiling water, that cuts-up their bowels?

مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ أَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَـٰلِدٌ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ

**47:16** Ichil letio'ob yaan maaxo'ob ku yu'ubike'ex teech, ba'ale' ka' ku jook'olo'ob ti' a taanil, ku ya'aliko'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ts'a'aba'an na'at ti' letio'ob: Ba'ax tu ya'alaj bejla'ili'e'? Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob Allah tu nup'aj u puksi'ik'alo'ob, ku maano'ob paachil ti' u k'aato'ob.

Among them are those who listen to you, but when they leave your presence, they say to those given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are they whose hearts God has sealed, and they follow their own desires.

وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ

**47:17** Le maaxo'ob chiikbesa'ab u beelo'ob, Leti' ku ya'abbesik u chiikbesajil beelo'ob, ts'o'ok u ts'aik ti' letio'ob u toh oolalo'ob.

As for those who are guided, He increases them in guidance, and He has granted them their righteousness.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ

**47:18** Chen ku pa'atiko'ob wa le K'intzilo' ku taal ti' letio'ob saamale'? U chiikulo'ob ts'o'ok u taalo'ob. Bix kun u k'a'ajsa'alo'ob ka' ts'o'ok u taal ti' letio'ob?

Are they just waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? Its tokens have already come. But how will they be reminded when it has come to them?

فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ

**47:19** Ojel: mina'an u laak' k'uj chen Allah. K'aate u sa'atesa'al a keban, yeetel u kebano'ob le xiibo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel le ko'olelo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. Allah ku yojel a xiimbal yeetel a kuuchil p'atal.

Know that there is no god but God, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and for the believing men and believing women. God knows your movements, and your resting-place.

فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ

**47:20** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax tumen ma' e'esa'ab junp'eel sura? Ka' junp'eel sura jets'a'an ku e'esa'ab, ku tsikbalta'al ba'atel ichil, ka wilik le maaxo'ob yaan k'oja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob ku paakatiko'ob teech yeetel u paakat le maax ku tuuk'ul tumen kiimil. Bey yaayaj ti' letio'ob!

Those who believe say, “If only a chapter is sent down.” Yet when a decisive chapter is sent down, and fighting is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you with the look of someone fainting at death. So woe to them!

وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ ۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

**47:21** Yu'ubik yeetel toh t'aan. Ka' le ba'alo' ku jets'el, wa jaajchajo'ob ti' Allah, uts ti' letio'ob ka'ach.

Obedience and upright speech. Then, when the matter is settled, being true to God would have been better for them.

طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ

**47:22** Wa ka suutike'ex a wicho'ob, je'el wa ka beetike'ex k'aas yook'ol luum, ka xotike'ex u nuup a laak'o'ob?

If you turn away, you are likely to make mischief on earth, and sever your family ties.

فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓا۟ أَرْحَامَكُمْ

**47:23** Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob Allah tu ts'aaj k'aas p'ek yook'ol letio'ob. Tu beetaj letio'ob koojo'ob, tu ch'optaj u yicho'ob.

Those are they whom God has cursed. He made them deaf, and blinded their sight.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ

**47:24** Ma' kun u tuukultiko'ob le Quran wa? Wa yaan ba'al ku nup'ik u puksi'ik'alo'ob?

Will they not ponder the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts?

أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ

**47:25** Le maaxo'ob tu suutajo'ob paachil, paachil ti' ts'o'ok u saasiltal u chiikbesajil beel ti' letio'ob, Kisin tu ch'a'aj u yolo'ob, tu ts'aaj ti' letio'ob u p'atal u beelo'ob.

Those who reverted after the guidance became clear to them—Satan has enticed them, and has given them latitude.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَـٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَى ۙ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

**47:26** Lelo' tumen tu ya'alajo'ob ti' le maaxo'ob tu p'ektajo'ob le ba'ax Allah tu e'esaj: To'on k yu'ubike'ex te'ex ichil wa baax ba'alo'ob. Allah ku yojel u taaka'an tukulo'ob.

That is because they said to those who hated what God has revealed, “We will obey you in certain matters.” But God knows their secret thoughts.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا۟ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ

**47:27** Bix ka' le angelo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob letio'ob ichil kiimil, ku jaats'iko'ob u taano'ob yeetel u paacho'ob?

How about when the angels take them at death, beating their faces and their backs?

فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ

**47:28** Lelo' tumen tu maano'ob paachil ti' ba'ax ku p'ektik Allah, tu p'ektajo'ob u ch'a'ik uts u yool ti' letio'ob, bey tu beetaj u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

That is because they pursued what displeases God, and they disliked His approval, so He nullified their works.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَآ أَسْخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:29** Le maaxo'ob yaan k'oja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob ku tuukultiko'ob wa Allah ma' kun u jook's u p'ekilo'ob wa?

Do those in whose hearts is sickness think that God will not expose their malice?

أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضْغَـٰنَهُمْ

**47:30** Wa To'on k k'aat ka'ach, To'on je'el k e'esik letio'ob ti' teech ka'ach, ta wojeltajo'ob tumen u chiikulo'ob. Ka wojeltik letio'ob tumen u t'aan u chi'o'ob. Allah ku yojel a meyajo'ob.

Had We willed, We could have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them by their marks. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech. And God knows your actions.

وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيْنَـٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

**47:31** To'on jaaj k ts'aik prueba ti' te'ex, tak To'on k ojel le maaxo'ob ichil te'ex ku ba'ateliko'ob utia'al jaaj yeetel le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob muk', To'on k ts'aik prueba ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

We will certainly test you, until We know those among you who strive, and those who are steadfast, and We will test your reactions.

وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَـٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ

**47:32** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku p'atik maako'ob ti' u beel Allah, ku p'atik u Tuuxtbil paachil ti' ts'o'ok u saasiltal u chiikbesajil beel ti' letio'ob, ma' kun u yaayajbesiko'ob Allah mixba'al, Leti' kun u beet u meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

Those who disbelieve, and hinder from the path of God, and oppose the Messenger after guidance has become clear to them—they will not hurt God in the least, but He will nullify their deeds.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**47:33** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Yu'ube'ex Allah, yu'ube'ex le Tuuxtbil, ma' a beetike'ex a meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

O you who believe! obey God, and obey the Messenger, and do not let your deeds go to waste.

۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

**47:34** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku p'atik maako'ob ti' u beel Allah, ka' ku kiimilo'ob bey ma' oksaj oolo'ob, Allah ma' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob.

Those who disbelieve, and hinder from God’s path, and then die as disbelievers—God will not forgive them.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ

**47:35** Ma' a luku'ex a muuk', ma' a payike'ex ti' jets' oolal ka' te'ex le maas ka'analo'ob. Allah yaan yeetel te'ex, ma' kun u beet a meyajo'ob u bin u sa'atalo'ob.

So do not waver and call for peace while you have the upper hand. God is with you, and He will not waste your efforts.

فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

**47:36** U kuxtal le yook'ol kaaba' chen ba'atel poch' yeetel ki' oolal. Ba'ale' wa ka oksike'ex a woole'ex yeetel ka beetike'ex toh kuxtal, Leti' kun u ts'a te'ex a bo'olile'ex, ma' kun u k'aat te'ex a ayik'alile'ex.

The life of this word is nothing but play and pastime. But if you have faith and lead a righteous life, He will grant you your rewards, and He will not ask you for your possessions.

إِنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۚ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ أَمْوَٰلَكُمْ

**47:37** Wa Leti' u k'aat letio'ob ti' te'ex, ku sen k'aatik, ka p'aatalo'ob a ts'u'ut oole'ex, Leti' kun u jook's u p'ekile'ex.

Were He to ask you for it, and press you, you would become tightfisted, and He would expose your unwillingness.

إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَـٰنَكُمْ

**47:38** Te'ex waye', ka paya'ale'ex a ts'aike'ex ichil u beel Allah. Ichil te'ex yaan maaxo'ob ku p'atik u ts'aiko'ob; maax ku p'atik u ts'aik, chen ku p'atik ti' u pixan. Allah leti' le Ayik'al, te'ex le ootsilo'ob. Wa ka suutike'ex a wicho'ob, Leti' kun u jeelbes te'ex yeetel ulaak' kaaj, letio'ob ma' kun bey te'ex.

Here you are, being called to spend in the cause of God. Among you are those who withhold; but whoever withholds is withholding against his own soul. God is the Rich, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you.

هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓا۟ أَمْثَـٰلَكُم

## 48. The Victory

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**48:1** To'on k ts'aaj ti' teech junp'eel to'okol ku beetik saasil.

We have granted you a conspicuous victory.

إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا

**48:2** U tia'al Allah u sa'ates a keban, le maanajo' yeetel le kun taalo', u ts'ookbes u siibalo'ob yook'ol teech, u chiikbes a beel ichil junp'eel toh beel.

That God may forgive you your sin, past and to come, and complete His favors upon you, and guide you in a straight path.

لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا

**48:3** U aantikech yeetel junp'eel aantaj mina'an u suut.

And help you with an unwavering support.

وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا

**48:4** Leti' le maax tu e'esaj u jets' oolal ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le aj oksaj oolo'ob, utia'al u ya'abtal u oksaj oolalo'ob yook'ol u oksaj oolalo'ob. Ti' Allah u muuch' ba'atel le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Allah Aj Ojel, Aj Na'at.

It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers, to add faith to their faith. To God belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. God is Knowing and Wise.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

**48:5** Leti' kun u yokbes le aj oksaj oolo'ob, xiibo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob, ichil pak'alo'ob yaan beel ja'o'ob ku maano'ob yanal ti' letio'ob, utia'al u p'aatalo'ob te' mantats', kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob. Lelo', ti' Allah, junp'eel noj to'okol.

He will admit the believers, male and female, into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to abide therein forever, and He will remit their sins. That, with God, is a great triumph.

لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا

**48:6** Kun u yaayajbes le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, xiibo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob, le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob ulaak' bey Allaho', xiibo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob, le maaxo'ob ku tuukultiko'ob k'aas yo'olal Allah. Le k'aaso' ku bak'ik letio'ob; Allah ts'o'ok u p'ektal ti' letio'ob, tu ts'aaj k'aas p'ek yook'ol letio'ob, tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob Mitnal, junp'eel k'aas kuuchil k'uchul.

And He will punish the hypocrites, male and female, and the idolaters, male and female, those who harbor evil thoughts about God. They are surrounded by evil; and God is angry with them, and has cursed them, and has prepared for them Hell—a miserable destination.

وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا

**48:7** Ti' Allah u muuch' ba'atel le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Allah Yaan Muuk', Aj Na'at.

To God belong the troops of the heavens and the earth. God is Mighty and Wise.

وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

**48:8** To'on k tuuxtaj teech bey aj testimonio, aj taas uts tsikbal, aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan.

We sent you as a witness, and a bearer of good news, and a warner.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

**48:9** U tia'al a oksike'ex a woole'ex ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, a aantike'ex Leti', a tsikbesike'ex Leti', a ki'iki' t'aantike'ex Leti' ja'atskaab yeetel o'ok'in.

That you may believe in God and His Messenger, and support Him, and honor Him, and praise Him morning and evening.

لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

**48:10** Le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u promesa ti' teech, chen ku ts'aiko'ob u promesa ti' Allah. U k'ab Allah yook'ol u k'abo'ob. Maax ku p'atik u promesa, chen ku p'atik ti' u pixan. Maax ku ts'ookbesik u promesa yeetel Allah, Leti' kun u ts'a ti' leti' junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Those who pledge allegiance to you are pledging allegiance to God. The hand of God is over their hands. Whoever breaks his pledge breaks it to his own loss. And whoever fulfills his covenant with God, He will grant him a great reward.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَـٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

**48:11** Le maako'ob ti' le k'aax luum p'ata'ano'ob paachil kun u ya'alo'ob ti' teech: K ayik'alil yeetel k laak'o'ob tu ch'a'aj k k'iin tulakal, k'aate u sa'atesa'al to'on. Ku ya'aliko'ob yeetel u chi'o'ob ba'ax mina'an ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob. A'ale: Maax je'el u yaantik te'ex mixba'al tu ts'eel Allah, wa Leti' u k'aat junp'eel k'aas ti' te'ex, wa u k'aat junp'eel uts ti' te'ex? Jaaj, Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

The Desert-Arabs who remained behind will say to you, “Our belongings and our families have preoccupied us, so ask forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who can avail you anything against God, if He desires loss for you, or desires gain for you?” In fact, God is Informed of what you do.

سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا

**48:12** Ta tuukultaje'ex le Tuuxtbil yeetel le aj oksaj oolo'ob ma' kun u suuto'ob ti' u laak'o'ob bik'in, lelo' tu chiikpaj uts ti' a puksi'ik'ale'ex; ta tuukultaje'ex k'aas tukul, te'ex junp'eel kaaj sa'ata'an.

But you thought that the Messenger and the believers will never return to their families, and this seemed fine to your hearts; and you harbored evil thoughts, and were uncivilized people.

بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا

**48:13** Maax ma' tu oksik u yool ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, To'on ts'o'ok k jets'aj utia'al le ma' oksaj oolo'ob le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

He who does not believe in God and His Messenger—We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blazing Fire.

وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا

**48:14** Ti' Allah u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ku sa'atesik maax u k'aat, ku yaayajbesik maax u k'aat. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and He punishes whomever He wills. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

**48:15** Le p'ata'ano'ob paachil kun u ya'alo'ob, ka' ka bino'ob a ch'a'e'ex le ba'axo'ob ch'a'aba'ano'ob: Cha'e'ex k maan paachil ti' te'ex. Ku k'aatiko'ob u jeelbesiko'ob u T'aan Allah. A'ale: Ma' kun a maane'ex paachil ti' to'on; Allah tu ya'alaj bey taanil. Ka' kun u ya'alo'ob: Te'ex chen a p'ek to'on. Jaaj, chen junp'eel jaats ku na'atiko'ob.

Those who lagged behind will say when you depart to collect the gains, “Let us follow you.” They want to change the Word of God. Say, “You will not follow us; God has said so before.” Then they will say, “But you are jealous of us.” In fact, they understand only a little.

سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**48:16** A'ale: ti' le maako'ob ti' le k'aax luum p'ata'ano'ob paachil: Ka paya'ale'ex tu ts'eel junp'eel kaaj jach yaan u muuk'; ka ba'atelike'ex letio'ob, wa ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob. Wa ka yu'ubike'ex, Allah kun u ts'a te'ex junp'eel uts bo'olil. Wa ka suutike'ex a wicho'ob, bey ta suutaje'ex a wiche'ex taanil, Leti' kun u yaayajbese'ex yeetel junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

Say to the Desert-Arabs who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of great might; you will fight them, unless they submit. If you obey, God will give you a fine reward. But if you turn away, as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.”

قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَـٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

**48:17** Mina'an keban yook'ol le ch'oo'p, mix yook'ol le ko'ox ook, mix yook'ol le k'oja'an. Maax ku yu'ubik Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, Leti' kun u yokbes leti' ichil pak'alo'ob yaan beel ja'o'ob ku maano'ob yanal ti' letio'ob; maax ku suutik u wich, Leti' kun u yaayajbes yeetel junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj.

There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger—He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away—He will punish him with a painful punishment.

لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

**48:18** Allah tu ch'a'aj uts u yool ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob, ka' tu ts'aajo'ob u promesa ti' teech yanal le che'. Tu yojel ba'ax yaan ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob, tu e'esaj u jets' oolal yook'ol letio'ob, tu ts'aaj ti' letio'ob bo'olil junp'eel naats' to'okol.

God was pleased with the believers, when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, and sent down serenity upon them, and rewarded them with an imminent conquest.

۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَـٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

**48:19** Yeetel ya'ab ba'axo'ob ch'a'aba'ano'ob kun u ch'a'ako'ob. Allah Yaan Muuk', Aj Na'at.

And abundant gains for them to capture. God is Mighty and Wise.

وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

**48:20** Allah ts'o'ok u promesa'atik te'ex ya'ab ba'axo'ob ch'a'aba'ano'ob, kun a ch'a'ako'ob. Tu seebkunsaj lela' utia'al te'ex, tu p'atik u k'abo'ob maako'ob ma' u k'ucho'ob ti' te'ex; utia'al u p'atal bey junp'eel chiikul utia'al le aj oksaj oolo'ob, utia'al u chiikbes a beele'ex ichil junp'eel toh beel.

God has promised you abundant gains, which you will capture. He has expedited this for you, and has restrained people’s hands from you; that it may be a sign to the believers, and that He may guide you on a straight path.

وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا

**48:21** Yeetel ulaak' ba'alo'ob, ma' beeytal te'ex ka'ach, Allah ts'o'ok u bak'ik letio'ob. Allah Yaan Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

And other things, of which you were incapable, but God has encompassed them. God is Capable of everything.

وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا

**48:22** Wa le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob tu ba'atelajo'ob te'ex ka'ach, tu suutajo'ob u paacho'ob ka'ach, tu pu'utajo'ob ka'ach, ka' mina'an u Aj Kanan, mina'an u aj aantaj.

If those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned back and fled, then found neither protector nor helper.

وَلَوْ قَـٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

**48:23** U beelil Allah, ku maan ti' le uuchbeno'. Ma' kun a kaxtik mix junp'eel jeelbesajil ichil u beelil Allah.

It is God’s pattern, ongoing since the past. You will never find any change in God’s pattern.

سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا

**48:24** Leti' le maax tu p'atik u k'abo'ob letio'ob ma' u k'ucho'ob ti' te'ex, yeetel a k'abe'ex ma' u k'ucho'ob ti' letio'ob, ichil u ja' k'axil Mecca, paachil ti' ts'o'ok u ts'aik ti' te'ex aantik yook'ol letio'ob. Allah Aj Ilaj ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after giving you advantage over them. God is Observer of what you do.

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

**48:25** Letio'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, tu p'atajo'ob te'ex ma' a wookolo'ob ti' le Kili'ich Naj Payalchi'o', tu p'atajo'ob le ts'aabil ma' u k'uchul ti' u kuuchil. Wa ma' tumen xiibo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob, ma' a wojelo'ob ka'ach, a yaayajbesike'ex letio'ob ka'ach, ku taal te'ex junp'eel keban mina'an a k'aat ti'. Bey Allah ku yokbesik ichil u yatzil maax u k'aat. Wa tu xit'ajo'ob u baajo'ob ka'ach, To'on je'el k yaayajbesik le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ichil letio'ob yeetel junp'eel yaayajil yaayaj ka'ach.

It is they who disbelieved, and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and prevented the offering from reaching its destination. Were it not for faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know, you were about to hurt them, and became guilty of an unintentional crime. Thus God admits into His mercy whomever He wills. Had they dispersed, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with a painful penalty.

هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

**48:26** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob tu chuupbesajo'ob u puksi'ik'alo'ob yeetel p'ek, u p'ekil u k'iino'ob mina'an na'at. Allah tu e'esaj U jets' oolal yook'ol U Tuuxtbil yeetel yook'ol le aj oksaj oolo'ob, tu jets'aj yook'ol letio'ob le t'aano'ob toh oolal; letio'ob le maas u ti'alo'ob ichil tulakal, jaaj u ti'alo'ob. Allah Aj Ojel tulakal ba'al.

Those who disbelieved filled their hearts with rage—the rage of the days of ignorance. But God sent His serenity down upon His Messenger, and upon the believers, and imposed on them the words of righteousness—of which they were most worthy and deserving. God is aware of everything.

إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا

**48:27** Allah ts'o'ok u jaajbes u naay U Tuuxtbil yeetel jaaj: Te'ex kun a wookole'ex ti' le Kili'ich Naj Payalchi'o', wa Allah u k'aat, yeetel jets' oolal, a poolo'ob k'osa'ano'ob, wa a tso'otsile'ex xeta'ano'ob k'uut, ma' a sajaktale'ex. Tu yojel ba'ax ma' a wojelo'ob ka'ach, tu ts'aaj, ulaak' ti' lelo', junp'eel naats' to'okol.

God has fulfilled His Messenger’s vision in truth: “You will enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in security, heads shaven, or hair cut short, not fearing. He knew what you did not know, and has granted besides that an imminent victory.”

لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

**48:28** Leti' le maax tu tuuxtaj U Tuuxtbil yeetel chiikbesajil beel yeetel le oksaj oolal jaaj, utia'al u ka'anchajal yook'ol tulakal oksaj oolalo'ob. Ku p'iisik Allah aj testimonio.

It is He who sent His Messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions. God suffices as Witness.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا

**48:29** Muhammad U Tuuxtbil Allah. Le maaxo'ob yaan yeetel leti' chicho'ob tu ts'eel le ma' oksaj oolo'ob, ku ch'a'iko'ob ootsilil ichil u baajo'ob. Ka wilik letio'ob ku xoolano'ob, ku noktalo'ob, ku kaxtiko'ob siibal ti' Allah yeetel u ch'a'ik uts u yool ti' letio'ob. U chiikulo'ob yaan yook'ol u taano'ob tumen u noktalo'ob. Bey u beyil letio'ob ichil le Torah, u beyil letio'ob ichil le Gospel: bey junp'eel paak'al ku jook'ol, ku chichtal, ku poloktal, ku wa'atal yook'ol u che'il, ku beetik uts u yool le aj paak'alo'ob. Yeetel letio'ob ku p'ekbesik le ma' oksaj oolo'ob. Allah ts'o'ok u promesa'atik le maaxo'ob ichil letio'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts meyajo'ob sa'atesa'al keban yeetel junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Those with him are stern against the disbelievers, yet compassionate amongst themselves. You see them kneeling, prostrating, seeking blessings from God and approval. Their marks are on their faces from the effects of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah, and their description in the Gospel: like a plant that sprouts, becomes strong, grows thick, and rests on its stem, impressing the farmers. Through them He enrages the disbelievers. God has promised those among them who believe and do good deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

## 49. The Chambers

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**49:1** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' a ts'aike'ex a tukule'ex yook'ol u tukul Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, sajaknene'ex ti' Allah. Allah Aj U'uyaj, Aj Ojel.

O you who believe! Do not place your opinions above that of God and His Messenger, and fear God. God is Hearing and Knowing.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

**49:2** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' a ka'anbesike'ex a t'aane'ex yook'ol u t'aan le Profeta, ma' a t'aane'ex chich ti' leti', bey ka t'aane'ex chich ti' a baa'ex, ma' a meyaje'ex u bin u sa'atal mina'an a wojel.

O you who believe! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak loudly to him, as you speak loudly to one another, lest your works be in vain without you realizing.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

**49:3** Le maaxo'ob ku p'iskuntiko'ob u t'aano'ob tu taan U Tuuxtbil Allah, lelo'ob le maaxo'ob Allah tu ts'aaj prueba ti' u puksi'ik'alo'ob utia'al toh oolal. Ti' letio'ob yaan sa'atesa'al keban yeetel junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Those who lower their voices before God’s Messenger—those are they whose hearts God has tested for piety. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

**49:4** Le maaxo'ob ku payike'ex paachil ti' le najo'ob, u ya'abil letio'ob ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

Those who call you from behind the chambers—most of them do not understand.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

**49:5** Wa tu ch'a'ajo'ob muk' tak ka jook'ole'ex ti' letio'ob ka'ach, uts ti' letio'ob ka'ach. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Had they remained patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. But God is Forgiving and Merciful.

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**49:6** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Wa jun tul aj k'aas meyaj ku taasik te'ex junp'eel tsikbal, kaxtike'ex wa jaaj le tsikbalo', ma' a beetike'ex k'aas ti' maako'ob tumen mina'an a na'ate'ex, ka a suutike'ex a woole'ex yo'olal ba'ax ta beetaje'ex.

O you who believe! If a troublemaker brings you any news, investigate, lest you harm people out of ignorance, and you become regretful for what you have done.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ

**49:7** Ojele'ex: ichil te'ex yaan U Tuuxtbil Allah. Wa tu yu'ubaj te'ex ichil ya'ab ba'alo'ob ka'ach, ta ch'a'aje'ex talamil ka'ach. Ba'ale' Allah tu ts'aaj te'ex a yaabiltike'ex le oksaj oolal, tu beetaj ki'ichpam ichil a puksi'ik'ale'ex, tu beetaj p'ekbil ti' te'ex le ma' oksaj oolal, le k'aas meyaj, yeetel le ma' yu'ubik t'aan. Lelo'ob le maaxo'ob chiikbesa'ab u beelo'ob.

And know that among you is the Messenger of God. Had he obeyed you in many things, you would have suffered hardship. But God has given you the love of faith, and adorned it in your hearts, and made disbelief, mischief, and rebellion hateful to you. These are the rightly guided.

وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ

**49:8** Junp'eel siibal yeetel junp'eel uts taal ti' Allah. Allah Aj Ojel, Aj Na'at.

A Grace and Favor from God. God is Knowing and Wise.

فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

**49:9** Wa ka'ap'eel muuch' aj oksaj oolo'ob ku ba'ateliko'ob u baajo'ob, ts'aike'ex jets' oolal ichil letio'ob. Wa junp'eel muuch' ku beetik k'aas yook'ol le u laak'o', ba'atelike'ex le muuch' ku beetik k'aaso' tak ku yu'ubik u a'almajt'aan Allah. Ka' ts'o'ok u yu'ubik, ts'aike'ex jets' oolal ichil letio'ob yeetel toh, beete'ex toh. Allah ku yaabiltik le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob toh.

If two groups of believers fight each other, reconcile between them. But if one group aggresses against the other, fight the aggressing group until it complies with God’s command. Once it has complied, reconcile between them with justice, and be equitable. God loves the equitable.

وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ

**49:10** Le aj oksaj oolo'ob suku'uno'ob, bey ts'aike'ex jets' oolal ichil a suku'une'ex, p'aatale'ex yeetel a wojel Allah, utia'al a k'amike'ex ch'a' ootsilil.

The believers are brothers, so reconcile between your brothers, and remain conscious of God, so that you may receive mercy.

إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

**49:11** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' cha'abik junp'eel kaaj u poch'ik ulaak' kaaj, tumen je'el u p'atalo'ob maas uts ti' letio'ob. Ma' cha'abik ko'olelo'ob u poch'iko'ob ulaak' ko'olelo'ob, tumen je'el u p'atalo'ob maas uts ti' letio'ob. Ma' a t'aane'ex k'aas yo'olal a baa'ex, ma' a payike'ex a baa'ex yeetel k'aas k'aaba'o'ob. K'aas le suut ti' k'aas meyaj paachil ti' ts'o'ok u k'uchul oksaj oolal. Maax ma' tu suutik u yool, lelo'ob le aj ma' toh meyajo'ob.

O you who believe! No people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you slander one another, nor shall you insult one another with names. Evil is the return to wickedness after having attained faith. Whoever does not repent—these are the wrongdoers.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَـٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

**49:12** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! P'atike'ex u ya'abil le tukul k'aas yo'olal a laak'o'ob; wa baax tukul k'aas keban. Ma' a kaxtike'ex u taaka'an ba'alo'ob a laak'o'ob, ma' a t'aane'ex k'aas paachil ti' a laak'o'ob. Ku yaabiltik wa jun tul ti' te'ex u jaantik u bak'el u suku'un kiimeen? Ka p'ektike'ex lelo'. Bey p'aatale'ex yeetel a wojel Allah. Allah le maas ku k'amik suut ool ichil tulakal, le maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal.

O you who believe! Avoid most suspicion—some suspicion is sinful. And do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it. So remain mindful of God. God is Most Relenting, Most Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**49:13** Oo maako'ob! To'on k beetaje'ex ti' jun tul xiib yeetel jun tul ko'olel, To'on k beetaje'ex jejelaas kaajo'ob yeetel muuch'o'ob, utia'al a wojeltik a baa'ex. Le maas uts ichil te'ex tu taan Allah leti' le maas toh ool ichil te'ex. Allah Aj Ojel Tulakal, Aj Ojel ti' tulakal ba'al.

O people! We created you from a male and a female, and made you races and tribes, that you may know one another. The best among you in the sight of God is the most righteous. God is All-Knowing, Well-Experienced.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

**49:14** Le maako'ob ti' le k'aax luum ku ya'aliko'ob: To'on k oksaj k ool. A'ale: Ma' a oksaje'ex a woole'ex; a'ale'ex: To'on k ts'aaj k baaj, tumen le oksaj oolal ma' oksa'an ichil a puksi'ik'ale'ex tojol. Wa ka yu'ubike'ex Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, Leti' ma' kun u p'iskunt mixba'al ti' a meyaje'ex. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

The Desert-Arabs say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed; but say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. But if you obey God and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”

۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَـٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**49:15** Le aj oksaj oolo'ob le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, ka' ma' tu ka'ap'eeltal u yoolo'ob, ku ba'ateliko'ob yeetel u taak'ino'ob yeetel u pixano'ob ichil u beel Allah. Lelo'ob le aj jaajo'ob.

The believers are those who believe in God and His Messenger, and then have not doubted, and strive for God’s cause with their wealth and their persons. These are the sincere.

إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ

**49:16** A'ale: Ka kaansike'ex wa Allah yo'olal a culto'e'ex, ka' Allah ku yojel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum, Allah Aj Ojel tulakal ba'al?

Say, “Are you going to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is aware of all things?”

قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**49:17** Ku tuukultiko'ob junp'eel uts ku beetiko'ob ti' teech tumen tu ts'a'ajo'ob u baajo'ob. A'ale: Ma' a tuukultike'ex a ts'aik a baa'ex junp'eel uts ti' teen; Allah leti' tu beetaj uts ti' te'ex tumen tu chiikbesaj a beele'ex ti' le oksaj oolal, wa te'ex aj jaaj.

They regarded it a favor to you that they have submitted. Say, “Do not consider your submission a favor to me; it is God who has done you a favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere.”

يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَـٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**49:18** Allah ku yojel ba'ax taaka'an ti' le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, Allah Aj Ilaj ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

God knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and God is seeing of everything you do.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

## 50. Qaf

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**50:1** Qaf. Hach t'aan, le Quran nojbe'en.

Qaf. By the Glorious Quran.

قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

**50:2** Tu jak'aj u yoolo'ob tumen jun tul aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan taal ti' letio'ob ti' ichil letio'ob. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Lela' junp'eel ba'al jak' oolal.

They marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers say, “This is something strange.

بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

**50:3** Ka' ts'o'ok k kiimil yeetel k p'aatal bey poox luum? Lelo' junp'eel suut jach naach.

When we have died and become dust? This is a farfetched return.”

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

**50:4** To'on k ojel ba'ax le luum ku jaantik ti' letio'ob, yeetel To'on yaan junp'eel Aanalte' ku kuchik tulakal.

We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a comprehensive book.

قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

**50:5** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob le jaaj ka' taal ti' letio'ob, bey letio'ob ichil junp'eel p'aatal mina'an u jets' oolal.

But they denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.

بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

**50:6** Ma' tu yilajo'ob wa le ka'an yook'ol letio'ob, bix To'on k beetaj, To'on k beetaj ki'ichpam, mina'an xet' ti'?

Have they not observed the sky above them, how We constructed it, and decorated it, and it has no cracks?

أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

**50:7** Yeetel le luum, bix To'on k xit'aj, To'on k ts'aaj yook'ol wiitso'ob, To'on k ts'aaj u yichankil ichil tulakal jejelaas ka'ka'ap'eel ki' oolal?

And the earth, how We spread it out, and set on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of delightful pairs?

وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

**50:8** Junp'eel saasil yeetel junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al tulakal palil ku suutik u yool.

A lesson and a reminder for every penitent worshiper.

تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

**50:9** To'on k taasaj ti' le ka'an ja' ku taasik uts, To'on k ts'aaj yeetel pak'alo'ob yeetel ixi'im kun k'amo'ak.

And We brought down from the sky blessed water, and produced with it gardens and grain to harvest.

وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

**50:10** Yeetel le palmera che'o'ob ka'analo'ob, yaan u muuch' datilo'ob.

And the soaring palm trees, with clustered dates.

وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

**50:11** Bey kuxtal ba'al utia'al le palilo'ob. To'on k ts'aik kuxtal yeetel ti' junp'eel kaaj kiimeen. Bey xan le Liksajilo'.

As sustenance for the servants. And We revive thereby a dead town. Likewise is the resurrection.

رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

**50:12** Taanil ti' letio'ob u maako'ob Noah tu p'ektajo'ob le jaaj, bey xan le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob ti' Russ, yeetel Thamood.

Before them the people of Noah denied the truth, and so did the dwellers of Russ, and Thamood.

كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

**50:13** Yeetel Aad, yeetel Pharaoh, yeetel u suku'uno'ob Lot.

And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.

وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ

**50:14** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aaxo', yeetel u maako'ob Tubba. Tulakal tu p'ektajo'ob le tuuxtbilo'ob, bey in k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan yo'olal yaayajil jaajchaj.

And the Dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba. They all rejected the messengers, so My threat came true.

وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

**50:15** Tu ka'ap'eeltal wa k ool tumen le uuchben beetajil? Ba'ale' letio'ob ichil ka'ap'eel oolal yo'olal junp'eel tumben beetajil.

Were We fatigued by the first creation? But they are in doubt of a new creation.

أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

**50:16** To'on k beetaj le wiinik, To'on k ojel ba'ax u pixan ku ya'alik chichin ti' leti'. To'on maas naats' ti' leti' ti' u kaal.

We created the human being, and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

**50:17** Ka' le ka'atulo'ob ku k'amiko'ob, ku kuluko'ob tu no'oj yeetel tu ts'iik.

As the two receivers receive, seated to the right and to the left.

إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

**50:18** Mix junp'eel t'aan ku ya'alik, ba'ale' yaan jun tul aj kanan naats' ti' leti', jets'a'an.

Not a word does he utter, but there is a watcher by him, ready.

مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

**50:19** Le sa'atal na'at tumen kiimil taal yeetel jaaj: Lela' ba'ax ta kaxtik a puuts'ul ti' ka'ach.

The daze of death has come in truth: “This is what you tried to evade.”

وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

**50:20** Le trompeta ku juumbesa'al: Lela' u K'iinil le promesa'ata'ano'.

And the Trumpet is blown: “This is the Promised Day.”

وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

**50:21** Tulakal pixan kun taal, yaan yeetel jun tul aj bisaj yeetel jun tul aj testimonio.

And every soul will come forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.

وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

**50:22** Ta p'aatal ka'ach mina'an a na'at yo'olal lela', bey To'on k luk'saj a taaka'an ti' teech, a yilik bejla'e' jach saasil.

“You were in neglect of this, so We lifted your screen from you, and your vision today is keen.”

لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

**50:23** U yet-maak kun u ya'al: Lela' ba'ax yaan teen jets'a'an.

And His escort will say, “This is what I have ready with me.”

وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

**50:24** Pule'ex ichil Mitnal tulakal ma' oksaj ool aj chich ool.

“Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever.

أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

**50:25** Aj p'atik uts, aj beetik k'aas yook'ol u laak', aj ka'ap'eel ool.

Preventer of good, aggressor, doubter.

مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

**50:26** Maax tu beetaj ulaak' k'uj yeetel Allah, pule'ex leti' ichil le yaayajil jach chich.

Who fabricated another god with God; toss him into the intense agony.”

ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

**50:27** U yet-maak kun u ya'al: K Yuumtsil, teen ma' tin beetaj u ka'anbesik u baaj, ba'ale' leti' ka'ach ichil sa'atal beel jach naach.

His escort will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him rebel, but he was far astray.”

۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

**50:28** Leti' kun u ya'al: Ma' a ba'atelike'ex t'aan tu taan teen; ts'o'ok in k'a'aybesik a'almajt'aan ti' te'ex taanil.

He will say, “Do not feud in My presence—I had warned you in advance.

قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

**50:29** Le xot t'aan taal ti' teen ma' kun jeelbesa'ak, teen ma' aj ma' toh ti' le palilo'ob.

The decree from Me will not be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.”

مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

**50:30** Le k'iin To'on k ya'alik ti' Mitnal: Ts'o'ok wa a chuuptal? Kun u ya'al: Yaan wa u laak'?

On the Day when We will say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it will say, “Are there any more?”

يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

**50:31** Le Pak'alo' kun naats'besa'al ti' le aj toh oolo'ob, ma' naach.

And Paradise will be brought closer to the pious, not far away.

وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

**50:32** Lela' ba'ax promesa'ata'abe'ex, utia'al tulakal maax ku kananik u baaj yeetel ku suutik u yool.

“This is what you were promised—for every careful penitent.

هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

**50:33** Maax tu sajaktaj le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil ba'ax ma' ku yila'al, taal yeetel junp'eel puksi'ik'al ku suutik u yool.

Who inwardly feared the Beneficent, and came with a repentant heart.

مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

**50:34** Ooke'ex ichil yeetel jets' oolal. Lela' u K'iinil le kuxtal mina'an u ts'ook.

Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”

ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

**50:35** Ti' letio'ob ichil yaan tulakal ba'ax ku k'aatiko'ob, yeetel To'on yaan u laak' maas ya'ab.

Therein they will have whatever they desire—and We have even more.

لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

**50:36** Jayp'eel ch'iibalo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob, chicho'ob maas ti' letio'ob, To'on k xu'ulsaj? Tu xiimbaltajo'ob le luumo'ob; yaan wa tu'ux u puuts'ulo'ob?

How many generations before them, who were more powerful than they, did We destroy? They explored the lands—was there any escape?

وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

**50:37** Ichil lelo' yaan junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al maax yaan u puksi'ik'al, wa ku yu'ubik yeetel ku yilik.

In that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart, or cares to listen and witness.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

**50:38** To'on k beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil ichilo'ob ichil wakp'eel k'iino'ob, mixba'al lubul muuk' tu ta'alaj To'on.

We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us.

وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

**50:39** Ch'a'e muk' yo'olal ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob, a'ale ki'iki' t'aan yo'olal a Yuumtsil taanil ti' u jook'ol le k'iin, yeetel taanil ti' u bin le k'iin.

So endure what they say, and proclaim the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before sunset.

فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

**50:40** Ki'iki' t'aante ichil le aak'ab, yeetel tu ts'ook le payalchi'o'ob.

And glorify Him during the night, and at the end of devotions.

وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

**50:41** Yu'ubik le k'iin le aj pay ku payik ti' junp'eel kuuchil naats'.

And listen for the Day when the caller calls from a nearby place.

وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

**50:42** Le k'iin kun u yu'ubiko'ob le Aawat yeetel jaaj. Lelo' u K'iinil le Jook'olo'.

The Day when they will hear the Shout in all truth. That is the Day of Emergence.

يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

**50:43** To'on, To'on k ts'aik kuxtal yeetel k beetik kiimil, ti' To'on le ts'ook suut.

It is We who control life and death, and to Us is the destination.

إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**50:44** Le k'iin le luum kun xet' utia'al letio'ob seeb. Lelo' junp'eel muuch'besajil chichin utia'al To'on.

The Day when the earth will crack for them at once. That is an easy gathering for Us.

يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

**50:45** To'on k ojel tulakal ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob, teech ma' jun tul aj ka'anbesaj baaj yook'ol letio'ob. Bey k'a'ajbes tumen le Quran maax ku sajak in k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan.

We are fully aware of what they say, and you are not a dictator over them. So remind by the Quran whoever fears My warning.

نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

## 51. The Scattering Winds

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**51:1** Hach t'aan le maaxo'ob ku xit'iko'ob, ku xit'iko'ob.

By the spreaders spreading.

وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا

**51:2** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kuchiko'ob kuch.

And those carrying loads.

فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

**51:3** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku xiimbalo'ob yeetel jets' oolal.

And those moving gently.

فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

**51:4** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku t'o'oxiko'ob bey a'almajta'an ti' letio'ob.

And those distributing as commanded.

فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا

**51:5** Ba'ax promesa'ata'abe'ex jaaj.

What you are promised is true.

إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

**51:6** Le Xot K'in kun u yuchul.

Judgment will take place.

وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

**51:7** Hach t'aan le ka'an jilbil.

By the sky that is woven.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

**51:8** Te'ex jejelaas ba'ax ka ya'alike'ex.

You differ in what you say.

إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

**51:9** Le maax suutbesa'ab ti', suutbesa'ab.

Averted from it is he who is averted.

يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

**51:10** Ka kiimko'ob le aj tus t'aano'ob.

Perish the imposters.

قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

**51:11** Le maaxo'ob mina'an u na'ato'ob ichil ma' wojelal.

Those who are dazed in ignorance.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

**51:12** Ku k'aatiko'ob: Ba'ax k'iin u K'iinil le Xot K'in?

They ask, “When is the Day of Judgment?”

يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

**51:13** Le k'iin kun bisa'ako'ob tu taan le K'aak'o'.

The Day they are presented to the Fire.

يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

**51:14** Tuune'ex a yaayajil. Lela' ba'ax ta k'aataje'ex u taal seeb ka'ach.

“Taste your ordeal. This is what you used to challenge.”

ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

**51:15** Ba'ale' le aj toh oolo'ob ichil pak'alo'ob yeetel tu'ux ku jook'ol ja'.

But the pious are amidst gardens and springs.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**51:16** Ku k'amiko'ob ba'ax u Yuumtsil tu ts'aaj ti' letio'ob. Taanil ti' lelo', letio'ob aj beetaj utso'ob ka'ach.

Receiving what their Lord has given them. They were virtuous before that.
