ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

**51:17** Ku weenlo'ob chan chichin ichil le aak'ab ka'ach.

They used to sleep a little at night.

كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

**51:18** Yeetel ka' tu saastal, ku k'aatiko'ob sa'atesa'al.

And at dawn, they would pray for pardon.

وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

**51:19** Yeetel ichil u taak'ino'ob yaan junp'eel p'iit utia'al le aj k'aat ba'al yeetel le maax mina'an ti'.

And in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the deprived.

وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

**51:20** Yeetel yook'ol le luum yaan chiikulo'ob utia'al le maaxo'ob jach u yojelo'ob jaaj.

And on earth are signs for the convinced.

وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

**51:21** Yeetel ichil a baa'ex. A wile'ex wa ma'?

And within yourselves. Do you not see?

وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**51:22** Yeetel ichil le ka'an yaan ba'ax k'a'abeet utia'al a kuxtale'ex, yeetel ba'ax promesa'ata'abe'ex.

And in the heaven is your livelihood, and what you are promised.

وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

**51:23** Hach t'aan u Yuumtsil le ka'an yeetel le luum: lela' jaaj, bey jaaj ba'ax ka t'aane'ex.

By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is as true as the fact that you speak.

فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

**51:24** Ts'o'ok wa u k'uchul tech u tsikbalil u ulaako'ob Abraham tsikbe'eno'ob?

Has the story of Abraham’s honorable guests reached you?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

**51:25** Ka' tu yokolo'ob tu taan, tu ya'alajo'ob: Jets' oolal. Tu ya'alaj: Jets' oolal, maako'ob ma' in kajol.

When they entered upon him, they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”

إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

**51:26** Ka' tu bin tu taanil ti' u lak'tsilo'ob, tu taasaj junp'eel u paalil wakax polok.

Then he slipped away to his family, and brought a fatted calf.

فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

**51:27** Tu ts'aaj tu taan letio'ob. Tu ya'alaj: Ma' a jaante'ex?

He set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”

فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

**51:28** Tu taa'aj sajakil ti' letio'ob ichil u yool. Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ma' sajaktech, tu ts'aajo'ob ti' leti' le uts tsikbalil yo'olal jun tul paal yaan u na'at.

And he harbored fear of them. They said, “Do not fear,” and they announced to him the good news of a knowledgeable boy.

فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

**51:29** U yatan taal taanil ku aawat. Tu laaj u taan u yich, tu ya'alaj: Jun tul nojoch ko'olel mina'an u paal?

His wife came forward crying. She clasped her face, and said, “A barren old woman?”

فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

**51:30** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Bey tu ya'alaj a Yuumtsil. Leti' le Aj Na'at, le Aj Ojel.

They said, “Thus spoke your Lord. He is the Wise, the Knowing.”

قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**51:31** Tu ya'alaj: Ba'ax a meyaje'ex, oo te'ex tuuxtbilo'ob?

He said, “What is your business, O envoys?”

۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

**51:32** Tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on tuuxta'ano'on ti' junp'eel kaaj aj kebano'ob.

They said, “We are sent to a people guilty of sin.”

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

**51:33** Utia'al k pulik yook'ol letio'ob tuunicho'ob ti' k'at.

“To unleash upon them rocks of clay.”

لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

**51:34** Ts'o'ok u chiikbesa'al tu taan a Yuumtsil utia'al le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob ya'abach.

“Marked by your Lord for the excessive.”

مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

**51:35** To'on k jook'saj tulakal le aj oksaj oolo'ob yaan ichilo'ob ka'ach.

We evacuated all the believers who were in it.

فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**51:36** Ba'ale' To'on k kaxtaj ichil chen junp'eel otoch ti' le maaxo'ob tu ts'aajo'ob u baajo'ob ti' Allah.

But found in it only one household of Muslims.

فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**51:37** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj ichil junp'eel chiikul utia'al le maaxo'ob ku sajako'ob le yaayajil ku beetik yaj.

And We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

**51:38** Yeetel ichil Moses. To'on k tuuxtaj leti' ti' Pharaoh yeetel junp'eel a'almajt'aan saasil.

And in Moses. We sent him to Pharaoh with a clear authority.

وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

**51:39** Ba'ale' leti' tu suutaj u paach yeetel u aj ba'atelilo'ob, tu ya'alaj: Jun tul aj tuus wa jun tul ma' na'at ool.

But he turned away with his warlords, and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”

فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

**51:40** Bey To'on k ch'a'aj leti' yeetel u aj ba'atelo'ob, To'on k pulaj letio'ob ichil le k'aak'naab, leti' yaan u sipil.

So We seized him and his troops, and threw them into the sea, and He was to blame.

فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

**51:41** Yeetel ichil Aad. To'on k taasaj yook'ol letio'ob le iik' ku xu'ulsik tulakal.

And in Aad. We unleashed against them the devastating wind.

وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

**51:42** Ma' tu p'aataj mixba'al tu k'uchul yook'ol, ba'ale' tu beetaj bey ba'al ts'o'ok u k'astal yeetel u sa'atal.

It spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like decayed ruins.

مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

**51:43** Yeetel ichil Thamood. A'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: K'iimak a woole'ex ichil chichin k'iin.

And in Thamood. They were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

**51:44** Ba'ale' ma' tu yu'ubajo'ob u a'almajt'aan u Yuumtsil, bey le chaak tu ch'a'aj letio'ob ka' tu yiliko'ob ka'ach.

But they defied the command of their Lord, so the lightning struck them as they looked on.

فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

**51:45** Ma' paajchaj u lik'ilo'ob, mina'an aj aantaj ti' letio'ob.

They could not rise up, nor could they find help.

فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

**51:46** Yeetel taanil ti' lelo', u maako'ob Noah. Letio'ob maako'ob aj k'aas meyaj ka'ach.

And before that, the people of Noah. They were immoral people.

وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

**51:47** To'on k beetaj le ka'an yeetel muuk', To'on k chowakbesik.

We constructed the universe with power, and We are expanding it.

وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

**51:48** Yeetel le luum, To'on k xit'aj, bey uts To'on k jets'aj!

And the earth—We spread it out—How well We prepared it!

وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ

**51:49** To'on k beetaj tulakal ba'al ka'ka'ap'eel, utia'al a tuukultike'ex yeetel a na'atike'ex.

We created all things in pairs, so that you may reflect and ponder.

وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

**51:50** Bey puuts'ule'ex ti' Allah. Teen jun tul aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan saasil ti' te'ex ti' Leti'.

“So flee towards God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”

فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**51:51** Ma' a ts'aike'ex ulaak' k'uj yeetel Allah. Teen jun tul aj k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan saasil ti' te'ex ti' Leti'.

“And do not set up any other god with God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”

وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**51:52** Bey xan, mix jun tul tuuxtbil taal ti' le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob, ba'ale' tu ya'alajo'ob: Jun tul aj tuus wa jun tul ma' na'at ool.

Likewise, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”

كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

**51:53** Tu k'a'aybesajo'ob wa lelo' ti' u baajo'ob? Jaajile', letio'ob aj ma' yu'ubik t'aano'ob.

Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are rebellious people.

أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

**51:54** Bey suut a paach ti' letio'ob; teech mina'an a sipil.

So turn away from them; you are not to blame.

فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

**51:55** Yeetel k'a'ajbes, tumen le k'a'ajsaj ku beetik uts ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.

وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**51:56** Teen ma' tin beetaj le jinno'ob yeetel le wiiniko'ob, chen utia'al u kulteno'ob.

I did not create the jinn and the humans except to worship Me.

وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

**51:57** Ma' in k'aat mixba'al utia'al kuxtal ti' letio'ob, ma' in k'aat u jaanteso'ob Teen.

I need no livelihood from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.

مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

**51:58** Allah leti' le Aj Ts'aik Kuxtal, le Yaan Muuk', le Chich.

God is the Provider, the One with Power, the Strong.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

**51:59** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas kun yaan u k'iino'ob, bey u k'iino'ob u yet-maako'ob, bey ma' u k'aatiko'ob Teen u taal seeb.

Those who do wrong will have their turn, like the turn of their counterparts, so let them not rush Me.

فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

**51:60** Bey yaayajil ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool tumen le K'iin ti' letio'ob promesa'ata'an ti' letio'ob.

So woe to those who disbelieve because of that Day of theirs which they are promised.

فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

## 52. The Mount

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**52:1** Hach t'aan le Wiits.

By the Mount.

وَٱلطُّورِ

**52:2** Yeetel junp'eel Aanalte' ts'iibta'an.

And a Book inscribed.

وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ

**52:3** Ichil junp'eel ju'un cha'aba'an ti' tulakal.

In a published scroll.

فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

**52:4** Yeetel le Otoch ku ximbata'al ya'ab.

And the frequented House.

وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

**52:5** Yeetel le ba'al yook'ol le naj ka'analbesa'an.

And the elevated roof.

وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

**52:6** Yeetel le k'aak'naab ku wok'ol.

And the seething sea.

وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

**52:7** U yaayajil a Yuumtsil jaaj kun taal.

The punishment of your Lord is coming.

إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

**52:8** Mina'an ba'ax kun u xu'ulsik u taal.

There is nothing to avert it.

مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ

**52:9** Le k'iin le ka'an kun jeebek yeetel ku bin.

On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation.

يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا

**52:10** Yeetel le wiitso'ob kun u bino'ob.

And the mountains go into motion.

وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

**52:11** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ma' jaaj.

Woe on that Day to the deniers.

فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**52:12** Le maaxo'ob ku baaxalo'ob yeetel tukulo'ob mina'an u jaajil.

Those who play with speculation.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

**52:13** Le k'iin kun puliko'ob ichil le K'aak' ti' Mitnal yeetel muuk'.

The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully.

يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

**52:14** Lela' le K'aak' ta ya'alike'ex ma' jaaj ka'ach.

“This is the Fire which you used to deny.

هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

**52:15** Lela' tuus wa, wa te'ex ma' a wile'ex?

Is this magic, or do you not see?

أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**52:16** Tooka'e'ex ichil. Wa ka ch'a'ike'ex muk' wa ma', junp'eelili' ti' te'ex. Chen ka bo'ota'ale'ex yo'olal ba'ax ta beetaje'ex ka'ach.

Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”

ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**52:17** Ba'ale' le aj toh oolo'ob kun yano'ob ichil pak'alo'ob yeetel ki' oolal.

But the righteous will be amid gardens and bliss.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

**52:18** Ku ki'imaktal u yoolo'ob tumen ba'ax u Yuumtsil tu ts'aaj ti' letio'ob, u Yuumtsil tu kananbesaj letio'ob ti' u yaayajil Mitnal.

Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of Hell.

فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**52:19** Jaane'ex yeetel uk'e'ex yeetel ki' oolal, yo'olal ba'ax ta beetaje'ex ka'ach.

Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do.

كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**52:20** Ku jets'iko'ob u baajo'ob yook'ol ki'ichpam kuuchilo'ob jets'a'ano'ob tu xol; To'on k ts'aik ti' letio'ob yet-atanilo'ob jach ki'ichpamo'ob.

Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses.

مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

**52:21** Le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yool yeetel u paalo'ob tu ts'aajo'ob u paach ichil oksaj oolal, To'on k muuch'besik letio'ob yeetel u paalo'ob, To'on ma' k p'iskuntik mixba'al ti' u meyajo'ob. Tulakal wiinik kun bo'otik yo'olal ba'ax tu beetaj.

Those who believed and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

**52:22** To'on k ts'aik ti' letio'ob u yich che' yeetel bak', ba'ax ku k'aatiko'ob.

And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire.

وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

**52:23** Kun u k'exiko'ob ichilo'ob junp'eel luuch; mina'an ichil k'aas, mina'an keban.

They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin.

يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

**52:24** Jun muuch' paalalo'ob kun xiimbalo'ob tu yook'ol letio'ob utia'al u meyajo'ob, bey sak tuunicho'ob taaka'ano'ob.

Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls.

۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

**52:25** Junp'eelilo'ob kun taal ti' u laak'o'ob, ku k'aat chi'iko'ob u baajo'ob.

And they will approach one another, inquiring.

وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**52:26** Kun u ya'aliko'ob: Taanil ti' lela', to'on sajako'on ka'ach yo'olal k lak'tsilo'ob.

They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families.

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

**52:27** Ba'ale' Allah tu beetaj uts ti' to'on, tu kananbesaj to'on ti' u yaayajil le iik'o'ob yeetel k'aak'.

But God blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds.

فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

**52:28** Taanil ti' lela', to'on k payalchi'tik Leti' ka'ach. Leti' le Aj Uts, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”

إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**52:29** Bey k'a'ajbes. Tumen u siibal a Yuumtsil, teech ma' jun tul aj ojel ba'ax kun uchul, ma' jun tul ma' na'at ool.

So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

**52:30** Wa ku ya'aliko'ob: Jun tul aj ts'iib, k pa'atiko'ob ti' leti' junp'eel k'aas kun taal ti' k'iin?

Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”?

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

**52:31** A'ale: Pa'ate'ex; teen kun in pa'at yeetel te'ex.

Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”

قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

**52:32** Wa ba'ax ku weneiko'ob ku ya'alik letio'ob ti' lela'? Wa letio'ob maako'ob ku ka'anbesiko'ob u baajo'ob?

Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people?

أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

**52:33** Wa ku ya'aliko'ob: Leti' tu beetaj? Ma'; letio'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool.

Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe.

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**52:34** Bey ka taasiko'ob junp'eel tsikbal bey lela', wa letio'ob aj jaajo'ob.

So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful.

فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**52:35** Wa beetabo'ob ti' mixba'al? Wa letio'ob le aj beetajo'ob?

Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ

**52:36** Wa letio'ob tu beetajo'ob le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum? Jaajile', letio'ob ma' jach u yojelo'ob.

Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.

أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

**52:37** Wa ti' letio'ob yaan u taaka'an taak'in a Yuumtsil? Wa letio'ob le maaxo'ob yaan u jalbesil?

Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?

أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

**52:38** Wa ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel eeb utia'al u yu'ubiko'ob? Bey ka taasik le maax ku yu'ubik junp'eel chiikul saasil.

Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof.

أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

**52:39** Wa ti' Leti' le xch'upul paalo'ob, ti' te'ex le xiib paalo'ob?

Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons?

أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

**52:40** Wa ka k'aatik junp'eel bo'olil ti' letio'ob, letio'ob kuuchbesa'ano'ob tumen p'aax?

Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt?

أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

**52:41** Wa ti' letio'ob yaan ba'ax ma' ila'an, letio'ob ku ts'iibtiko'ob?

Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down?

أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

**52:42** Wa ku k'aatiko'ob junp'eel tuus meyaj? Le tuus meyaj kun luubul yook'ol le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool.

Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers.

أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

**52:43** Wa ti' letio'ob yaan ulaak' k'uj tu ts'eel Allah? Allah ka'anal ti' ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti'.

Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate.

أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**52:44** Kex ka yiliko'ob xeto'ob ti' le ka'an ku luubulo'ob, kun u ya'aliko'ob: Junp'eel muuch' muyalo'ob.

Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”

وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

**52:45** Bey p'at letio'ob tak ka u k'uchko'ob u K'iino'ob ichil le kun sa'atak u na'ato'ob.

So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned.

فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

**52:46** Le k'iin u tuus meyajo'ob ma' kun u beet uts mixba'al ti' letio'ob; letio'ob ma' kun aantako'ob.

The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped.

يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

**52:47** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas yaan u yaayajilo'ob tu ts'eel lelo'; ba'ale' u ya'abil letio'ob ma' tu yojelo'ob.

For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know.

وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**52:48** Bey ch'a'e muk' utia'al u xot t'aan a Yuumtsil, tumen teech yaneech tu taan K Icho'ob; a'ale ki'iki' t'aan yo'olal a Yuumtsil ka' ka lik'ile'.

So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise.

وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

**52:49** Yeetel ki'iki' t'aante ichil le aak'ab, yeetel ka' ku bin u paach le eek'o'ob.

And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars.

وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

## 53. The Star

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**53:1** Hach t'aan le eek' ka' ku luubul.

By the star as it goes down.

وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

**53:2** A yet-maak ma' tu sa'ataj u beel, ma' tu beetaj ma' toh.

Your friend has not gone astray, nor has he erred.

مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

**53:3** Ma' ku t'aan tumen u k'aat u yool.

Nor does he speak out of desire.

وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ

**53:4** Chen junp'eel e'esa'ab, e'esa'ab ti' leti'.

It is but a revelation revealed.

إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ

**53:5** Tu ka'ansaj leti' le jach yaan u muuk'.

Taught to him by the Extremely Powerful.

عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ

**53:6** Le maax yaan muuk' chich. Tu jets'aj u baaj.

The one of vigor. He settled.

ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ

**53:7** Ka' yaan tu maas ka'anal ts'ook le ka'ano'.

While he was at the highest horizon.

وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

**53:8** Ka' tu naats'taj, ka' tu p'aataj naats' yaanal.

Then he came near, and hovered around.

ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

**53:9** Yaan ka'ap'eel p'iis u naats'il, wa maas naats'.

He was within two bows’ length, or closer.

فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ

**53:10** Ka' Leti' tu ye'esaj ti' u palil ba'ax tu ye'esaj.

Then He revealed to His servant what He revealed.

فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ

**53:11** Le puksi'ik'al ma' tu tusaj yo'olal ba'ax tu yilaj.

The heart did not lie about what it saw.

مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ

**53:12** A kaxtike'ex wa a t'aane'ex k'aas yo'olal leti' yo'olal ba'ax ku yilik?

Will you dispute with him concerning what he saw?

أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

**53:13** Tu yilaj leti' tu ulaak' taal.

He saw him on another descent.

وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ

**53:14** Tu ts'eel le Che' tu Ts'ook.

At the Lotus Tree of the Extremity.

عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

**53:15** Tu ts'eel leti' yaan le Pak'al Jets' Oolal.

Near which is the Garden of Repose.

عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ

**53:16** Ka' tu pixaj le Che' ba'ax tu pixaj.

As there covered the Lotus Tree what covered it.

إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

**53:17** U yilik ma' tu suutaj, ma' tu maan u p'iis.

The sight did not waver, nor did it exceed.

مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

**53:18** Tu yilaj ti' le noj chiikulo'ob u Yuumtsil.

He saw some of the Great Signs of his Lord.

لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ

**53:19** Ta tuukulte'ex wa al-Lat yeetel al-Uzza?

Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?

أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ

**53:20** Yeetel Manat, le ooxp'eel, le ulaak'?

And Manat, the third one, the other?

وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ

**53:21** Ti' te'ex wa le xiibo'ob, ti' Leti' le ko'olelo'ob?

Are you to have the males, and He the females?

أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

**53:22** Lela' junp'eel xotol ba'al ma' toh.

What a bizarre distribution.

تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ

**53:23** Lelo'ob chen k'aaba'o'ob ta beetaje'ex ti' a baa'ex, te'ex yeetel a taatao'ob, mina'an a'almajt'aan tu ts'aaj Allah yo'olal letio'ob. Cheen ku ts'ayiko'ob tukulo'ob, yeetel ba'ax u pixano'ob ku k'aatiko'ob, kex ts'o'ok u taal ti' letio'ob chiikbesajil beel ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob.

These are nothing but names, which you have devised, you and your ancestors, for which God sent down no authority. They follow nothing but assumptions, and what the ego desires, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.

إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

**53:24** Wa le wiinik u ti'al tulakal ba'ax ku k'aatik?

Or is the human being to have whatever he desires?

أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

**53:25** Ti' Allah u ti'al le Ts'ook yeetel le Yaax.

To God belong the Last and the First.

فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

**53:26** Ya'ab angelo'ob yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob, u t'aano'ob yo'olal u laak'o'ob ma' ku beetik uts mixba'al, chen paachil ti' Allah ku ts'aik cha'abal ti' maax ku k'aat, yeetel ku k'amik leti'.

How many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing, except after God gives permission to whomever He wills, and approves?

۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ

**53:27** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool ti' le u laak' kuxtalo' ku ts'aiko'ob ti' le angelo'ob u k'aaba'o'ob ko'olelo'ob.

Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

**53:28** Mina'an u na'ato'ob yo'olal lelo'. Cheen ku ts'ayiko'ob tukulo'ob, yeetel tukulo'ob ma' ku beetiko'ob uts mixba'al tu ts'eel le jaajo'.

They have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, and assumptions are no substitute for the truth.

وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا

**53:29** Bey p'at le maax tu suutaj u paach ti' K k'a'ajsaj, ku k'aatik chen le kuxtal bejla'e'.

So avoid him who has turned away from Our remembrance, and desires nothing but the present life.

فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

**53:30** Lelo' u ts'ook u na'ato'ob. A Yuumtsil maas u yojel ichil tulakal maax tu sa'ataj u beel ti' u beel, yeetel Leti' maas u yojel ichil tulakal maax tu k'amaj chiikbesajil beel.

That is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who has accepted guidance.

ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

**53:31** Ti' Allah u ti'al tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol luum. Leti' kun u bo'otik le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas bey u meyajo'ob, yeetel kun u bo'otik le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob uts yeetel le maas uts.

To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and recompense those who do good with the best.

وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

**53:32** Le maaxo'ob ku p'atiko'ob le noj kebano'ob yeetel le ba'alo'ob ma' tsikbe'en — chen yo'olal chan p'iit sa'atalo'ob — a Yuumtsil yaan u noj sa'atesa'al. Leti' u yojel te'ex uts, cheen ka' tu beetaje'ex ti' luum, yeetel cheen ka' te'ex chan paalalo'ob ma'ili' a siijile'ex ichil u nak' a na'o'ob ka'ach. Bey ma' a ki'iki' t'aantike'ex a toh oole'ex; Leti' jach u yojel le aj toh oolo'ob.

Those who avoid gross sins and indecencies—except for minor lapses—your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well, ever since He created you from the earth, and ever since you were embryos in your mothers’ wombs. So do not acclaim your own virtue; He is fully aware of the righteous.

ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

**53:33** Ta paakate'ex wa le maax tu suutaj u paach?

Have you considered him who turned away?

أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ

**53:34** Tu ts'aaj chan chichin, ka' tu p'aataj ma' u ts'aik u laak'.

And gave a little, and held back?

وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ

**53:35** Ti' leti' wa na'at yo'olal ba'ax ma' ila'an, bey je'el u paakate'?

Does he possess knowledge of the unseen, and can therefore foresee?

أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ

**53:36** Wa ma' tsikbalta'ab ti' leti' yo'olal ba'ax yaan ichil u Ju'uno'ob Moses?

Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses?

أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

**53:37** Yeetel yo'olal Abraham, le maax tu ts'ookbesaj?

And of Abraham, who fulfilled?

وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ

**53:38** Mix jun tul pixan ku kuchik u kuuch u laak' pixan.

That no soul bears the burdens of another soul.

أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ

**53:39** Le wiinik chen u ti'al ba'ax ku meyajtik yeetel chich oolal.

And that the human being attains only what he strives for.

وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

**53:40** Yeetel u meyaj kun ila'ak.

And that his efforts will be witnessed.

وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

**53:41** Ka' kun bo'ota'ak ti' leti' u maas chuka'an bo'olil.

Then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward.

ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ

**53:42** Yeetel ti' a Yuumtsil le ts'ook.

And that to your Lord is the finality.

وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

**53:43** Yeetel Leti' le maax ku beetik che'ej yeetel okol.

And that it is He who causes laughter and weeping.

وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ

**53:44** Yeetel Leti' le maax ku ts'aik kiimil yeetel kuxtal.

And that it is He who gives death and life.

وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا

**53:45** Yeetel Leti' le maax tu beetaj le ka'ka'ap'eel — le xiib yeetel le ko'olel.

And that it is He who created the two kinds—the male and the female.

وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ

**53:46** Ti' junp'eel puts' ja', ka' ku jook'sa'al.

From a sperm drop, when emitted.

مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

**53:47** Yeetel yook'ol Leti' u ts'aik le ulaak' kuxtal.

And that upon Him is the next existence.

وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ

**53:48** Yeetel Leti' le maax ku beetik ayik'al yeetel ku beetik ootsil.

And that it is He who enriches and impoverishes.

وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ

**53:49** Yeetel Leti' U Yuumtsil Sirius.

And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ

**53:50** Yeetel Leti' le maax tu xu'ulsaj le yaax Aad.

And that it is He who destroyed the first Aad.

وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ

**53:51** Yeetel Thamood, ma' tu p'aataj mix maax.

And Thamood, sparing no one.

وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ

**53:52** Yeetel u maako'ob Noah taanil ti' lelo'; letio'ob le maas ma' toh, le maas ku beetiko'ob k'aas yook'ol u laak'o'ob ka'ach.

And the people of Noah before that; for they were most unjust and most oppressive.

وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

**53:53** Yeetel tu luubsaj le kaajo'ob ts'o'ok u k'aasalo'ob.

And He toppled the ruined cities.

وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ

**53:54** Tu pixaj letio'ob yeetel ba'ax tu pixaj letio'ob.

And covered them with whatever covered them.

فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

**53:55** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsil je'el a p'ektik?

So which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

**53:56** Lela' junp'eel k'a'ay a'almajt'aan, bey le yaax k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

This is a warning, just like the first warnings.

هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

**53:57** Le ba'ax ma' u paajtal u puuts'ul ts'o'ok u naats'tal.

The inevitable is imminent.

أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ

**53:58** Mix maax tu ts'eel Allah je'el u e'esik leti'.

None besides God can unveil it.

لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

**53:59** Ka jats'ik wa a wich yo'olal le tsikbal la'?

Do you marvel at this discourse?

أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

**53:60** Yeetel ka che'ejtike'ex, ma' ka okole'ex?

And laugh, and do not weep?

وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

**53:61** Te'ex ichil baaxal mina'an u jaajil?

Lost in your frivolity?

وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ

**53:62** Bey xolane'ex ti' Allah, yeetel kulte'ex Leti'!

So bow down to God, and worship!

فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩

## 54. The Moon

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**54:1** Le K'intzilo' ts'o'ok u naats'tal, yeetel le uj tu xet'aj u baaj.

The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.

ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

**54:2** Wa ku yilo'ob junp'eel chiikul, ku suutiko'ob u paacho'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: Tuus mina'an u ts'ook.

Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”

وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

**54:3** Tu tusajo'ob, tu ts'ayajo'ob u tukulo'ob, ba'ale' tulakal ba'al yaan u k'iinil.

They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time.

وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

**54:4** Ts'o'ok u taal ti' letio'ob tsikbal yaan ichil ba'ax ku p'atik letio'ob ti' k'aas.

And there came to them news containing a deterrent.

وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

**54:5** Na'at taam — ba'ale' le k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob ma' ku beetiko'ob uts mixba'al.

Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail.

حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

**54:6** Bey suut a paach ti' letio'ob. Ichil le k'iin le Aj Pay kun t'aan ti' junp'eel ba'al jach k'aas.

So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible.

فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

**54:7** U yicho'ob p'iska'ano'ob tumen subtal, kun jook'oko'ob ti' le muknalo'ob, bey jun muuch' chan ba'alche'o'ob ku xik'nalo'ob ku xit'iko'ob u baajo'ob.

Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts.

خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

**54:8** Ku aalkabtalo'ob ti' le Aj Pay, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool kun u ya'aliko'ob: Lela' junp'eel k'iin talam.

Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”

مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

**54:9** Taanil ti' letio'ob, u maako'ob Noah ma' tu okso'ob u yool. Tu p'ektajo'ob K palil, tu ya'aliko'ob: Jun tul ma' na'at ool, yeetel t'aan k'aas a'ala'ab ti' leti'.

Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked.

۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

**54:10** Bey tu payalchi'taj u Yuumtsil: Teen ts'o'ok in luubul, bey ts'a teen aantaj.

So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”

فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

**54:11** Bey To'on k je'aj u joolilo'ob le ka'an yeetel ja' ku luubul chich.

So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down.

فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

**54:12** Yeetel To'on k beetaj u jook'ol ja'o'ob ti' luum bey tu'ux ku jook'ol ja', yeetel le ja'o'ob tu nupajo'ob u baajo'ob yo'olal junp'eel ba'al ts'o'ok u xot t'aan.

And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined.

وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

**54:13** Yeetel To'on k bisaj leti' yook'ol junp'eel ba'al beetbil yeetel che'o'ob yeetel chan ba'alo'ob ku nupik letio'ob.

And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails.

وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

**54:14** Ku bin tu taan K Icho'ob; junp'eel bo'olil utia'al le maax p'ekta'ab ka'ach.

Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected.

تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

**54:15** Yeetel To'on k p'aataj leti' bey junp'eel chiikul. Yaan wa maax ku k'a'ajsik?

And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed?

وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:16** Bey, bix u yuchul in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob?

So how were My punishment and My warnings?

فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:17** To'on k beetaj le Quran seebil u ka'ansa'al. Yaan wa maax ku ka'ansik u baaj?

We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn?

وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:18** Aad tu p'ektaj le jaajo'. Bey, bix u yuchul in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob?

Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings?

كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:19** To'on k taasaj yook'ol letio'ob junp'eel iik' ku aawat chich, ichil junp'eel k'iin talamil mina'an u ts'ook.

We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

**54:20** Ku luk'sik le maako'ob, bey u chuun le palmera che'o'ob luk'sa'ano'ob ti' luum.

Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

**54:21** Bey, bix u yuchul in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob?

So how were My punishment and My warnings?

فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:22** To'on k beetaj le Quran seebil u k'a'asa'al. Yaan wa maax ku k'a'ajsik?

We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember?

وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:23** Thamood tu p'ektajo'ob le k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

Thamood rejected the warnings.

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

**54:24** Tu ya'aliko'ob: K ts'ayik wa jun tul ichil to'on, jun tul wiinik? Bey To'on k bin ichil sa'atal beel, yeetel k ts'ook ichil Mitnal.

They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell.

فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

**54:25** Ts'aaba'an wa le e'esa'ab ti' leti', ichil tulakal to'on? Jaajile', leti' jun tul aj tus jach k'aas ool.

Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”

أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

**54:26** Kun u yojelo'ob saamal maax le aj tus jach k'aas ool.

They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is.

سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

**54:27** To'on k tuuxtik le camello ko'olel bey junp'eel prueba utia'al letio'ob; bey paakat letio'ob, yeetel ch'a' muk'.

We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient.

إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

**54:28** Yeetel tsikbalt ti' letio'ob: le ja' kun t'o'oxa'ak ichil letio'ob; tulakal u xoot' uk'bil kun ts'aaba'ak.

And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available.

وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

**54:29** Ba'ale' tu payajo'ob u yet-maak, tu beetaj u k'aat, tu kinsaj leti'.

But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered.

فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

**54:30** Bey, bix u yuchul in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob?

So how were My punishment and My warnings?

فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:31** To'on k taasaj yook'ol letio'ob chen junp'eel Aawat, ka' p'aatajo'ob bey su'uk tikin ts'o'ok u yaach'a'al.

We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

**54:32** To'on k beetaj le Quran seebil u na'ata'al. Yaan wa maax ku na'atik?

We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand?

وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:33** U maako'ob Lot tu p'ektajo'ob le k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

**54:34** To'on k taasaj yook'ol letio'ob tunicho'ob ku luubulo'ob, chen u lak'tsilo'ob Lot ma'; To'on k luk'saj letio'ob ka' tu saastal.

We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

**54:35** Junp'eel siibal taal ti' To'on. Bey To'on k bo'otik le maax ku ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan.

A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful.

نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

**54:36** Tu k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan ti' letio'ob yo'olal K chich muuk', ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob le k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings.

وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

**54:37** Tu kaxtajo'ob xan u beetiko'ob k'aas yeetel u ulaak', bey To'on k xu'ulsaj u yicho'ob. Bey tuune'ex in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”

وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:38** Le saastal taal yook'ol letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku p'aatal.

Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment.

وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

**54:39** Bey tuune'ex in yaayajil yeetel in k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob.

So taste My punishment and My warnings.

فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

**54:40** To'on k beetaj le Quran seebil u ts'aik ichil u puksi'ik'al. Yaan wa maax ku ts'aik ichil u puksi'ik'al?

We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize?

وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:41** Le k'a'ay a'almajt'aano'ob taal xan ti' u lak'tsilo'ob Pharaoh.

The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.

وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

**54:42** Tu p'ektajo'ob K chiikulo'ob, tulakalo'ob, bey To'on k ch'a'aj letio'ob — u ch'a'ajil le Yaan Muuk', le Yaan Muuk' Tulakal.

They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent.

كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

**54:43** A maako'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool maas uts wa ti' tulakal lelo'ob? Wa yaan te'ex junp'eel t'aan ichil le ju'uno'ob ku ya'alik ma' kun a k'amo'ob yaayajil?

Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures?

أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

**54:44** Wa ku ya'aliko'ob: To'on jun muuch', kun naajalo'on?

Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”?

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

**54:45** Le muuch' kun luubul ichil ba'atel, yeetel kun suutiko'ob u paacho'ob.

The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.

سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

**54:46** Le K'intzilo' u k'iinil u pa'atalo'ob; le K'intzilo' maas k'aas, maas yaaj.

The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter.

بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

**54:47** Le aj kebano'ob ichil sa'atal beel yeetel sa'atal na'at.

The wicked are in confusion and madness.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

**54:48** Le k'iin kun bisa'ako'ob yook'ol u wicho'ob ichil le K'aak': Tuune'ex u taalil Saqar.

The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”

يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

**54:49** Tulakal ba'al, To'on k beetaj tu p'iis.

Everything We created is precisely measured.

إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

**54:50** K a'almajt'aan chen junp'eel, bey junp'eel je'ebal wich.

And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.

وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

**54:51** To'on ts'o'ok k xu'ulsik le maako'ob bey te'ex. Yaan wa maax ku tuukultik?

We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder?

وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

**54:52** Tulakal ba'al tu beetajo'ob yaan ichil le Ju'uno'ob.

Everything they have done is in the Books.

وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

**54:53** Tulakal ba'al, chan wa noj, ts'iibta'an.

Everything, small or large, is written down.

وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

**54:54** Le aj toh oolo'ob kun yano'ob ichil pak'alo'ob yeetel tu'ux ku maan ja'.

The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

**54:55** Ichil junp'eel muuch' aj toh oolo'ob, tu taan jun tul Ajaw Yaan Muuk' Tulakal.

In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King.

فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

## 55. The Beneficent

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**55:1** Le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

The Compassionate.

ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ

**55:2** Tu ka'ansaj le Quran.

Has taught the Quran.

عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ

**55:3** Tu beetaj le wiinik.

He created man.

خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ

**55:4** Yeetel tu ka'ansaj leti' u t'aan saasil.

And taught him clear expression.

عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ

**55:5** Le k'in yeetel le uj ku xiimbalo'ob bey u p'iis.

The sun and the moon move according to plan.

ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ

**55:6** Yeetel le eek'o'ob yeetel le che'o'ob ku xolantalo'ob.

And the stars and the trees prostrate themselves.

وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

**55:7** Yeetel le ka'an, Leti' tu lik'saj leti'; yeetel tu jets'aj le p'iis.

And the sky, He raised; and He set up the balance.

وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

**55:8** Bey ma' a maan a p'iise'ex ichil le p'iis.

So do not transgress in the balance.

أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ

**55:9** Ba'ale' jets'ike'ex le p'iisilo'ob yeetel toh, yeetel ma' a k'aasbesike'ex le p'iis.

But maintain the weights with justice, and do not violate the balance.

وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

**55:10** Yeetel le luum; Leti' tu jets'aj utia'al le kuxtalo'ob.

And the earth; He set up for the creatures.

وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ

**55:11** Ichil leti' yaan icho'ob, yeetel palmera che'ob ichil much'o'ob.

In it are fruits, and palms in clusters.

فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ

**55:12** Yeetel neek'o'ob ichil u le'o'ob, yeetel che'o'ob ki' bok.

And grains in the blades, and fragrant plants.

وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ

**55:13** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:14** Tu beetaj le wiinik ti' luk chich, bey luk yela'an.

He created man from hard clay, like bricks.

خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ

**55:15** Yeetel tu beetaj le jinno'ob ti' k'aak' ku xak'ik u baaj yeetel k'aak'.

And created the jinn from a fusion of fire.

وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

**55:16** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:17** U Yuumtsil le ka'ap'eel lik'ino'ob yeetel U Yuumtsil le ka'ap'eel chik'ino'ob.

Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests.

رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ

**55:18** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:19** Tu xak'aj le ka'ap'eel k'aak'naabo'ob, ku nupiko'ob u baajo'ob.

He merged the two seas, converging together.

مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

**55:20** Ichil letio'ob yaan junp'eel k'alaj, ma' ku maano'ob u p'iis.

Between them is a barrier, which they do not overrun.

بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

**55:21** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:22** Ti' letio'ob ku jook'ol sak tuunicho'ob yeetel chak tuunicho'ob ti' k'aak'naab.

From them emerge pearls and coral.

يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

**55:23** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:24** Ti' Leti' u ti'al le cheemo'ob, lik'sa'ano'ob yook'ol le k'aak'naab bey noj chiikulo'ob.

His are the ships, raised above the sea like landmarks.

وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ

**55:25** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:26** Tulakal maax yaan yook'ol leti' ku xu'ulul.

Everyone upon it is perishing.

كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ

**55:27** Ba'ale' kun p'aatal u Wich a Yuumtsil, le Yaan Muuk', le Ki'ichpam.

But will remain the Presence of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.

وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

**55:28** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:29** Tulakal maax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol luum ku k'aatik ti' Leti'. Saansamal Leti' ku meyaj.

Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is managing.

يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ

**55:30** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:31** To'on kun k paakat te'ex, oo te'ex le ka'ap'eel noj muuch'o'ob.

We will attend to you, O prominent two.

سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ

**55:32** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:33** Oo te'ex, muuch' jinno'ob yeetel wiiniko'ob! Wa je'el a maane'ex ichil u xuulo'ob le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, maane'ex. Ba'ale' ma' je'el a maane'ex wa mina'an a'almajt'aan.

O society of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go ahead and pass. But you will not pass except with authorization.

يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ

**55:34** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:35** Kun tuuxta'ak yook'ole'ex k'aak' ku luubul chich yeetel ba'al ku tooka'al bey k'aak', yeetel ma' je'el a naajale'ex.

You will be bombarded with flares of fire and brass, and you will not succeed.

يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

**55:36** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:37** Ken u xet' u baaj le ka'an, yeetel ku p'aatal chak bey ba'al ku bonik.

When the sky splits apart, and becomes rose, like paint.

فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ

**55:38** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:39** Ichil le k'iin lelo', mix wiinik mix jinn kun k'a'atchi'ita'ak yo'olal u keban.

On that Day, no human and no jinn will be asked about his sins.

فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

**55:40** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:41** Le aj kebano'ob kun ila'ako'ob tumen u chiikulo'ob; kun ch'a'ako'ob tumen u tso'otsil u pool tu taan yeetel tumen u yo'oko'ob.

The guilty will be recognized by their marks; they will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ

**55:42** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:43** Lela' Mitnal, le maax le aj kebano'ob ku p'ektiko'ob ka'ach.

This is Hell that the guilty denied.

هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

**55:44** Ku xiimbalo'ob ichil leti' yeetel ichil ja' jach ku lokol.

They circulate between it and between a seething bath.

يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍ

**55:45** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:46** Ba'ale' ti' le maax tu saajkik u wa'atal tu taan u Yuumtsil yaan ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob.

But for him who feared the standing of his Lord are two gardens.

وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ

**55:47** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:48** Chuka'ano'ob yeetel jejelaas ba'alo'ob.

Full of varieties.

ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍ

**55:49** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:50** Ichil letio'ob yaan ka'ap'eel tu'ux ku jook'ol ja' ku aalkab.

In them are two flowing springs.

فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

**55:51** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:52** Ichil letio'ob yaan icho'ob tulakal u jejelaasil, ichil ka'ka'ap'eel.

In them are fruits of every kind, in pairs.

فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ

**55:53** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:54** Ku chenebaltalo'ob yook'ol chenebalilo'ob, u ichilo'ob ti' nook' jach ki'ichpam, yeetel u yich le ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob naats'.

Reclining on furnishings lined with brocade, and the fruits of the two gardens are near at hand.

مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ

**55:55** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:56** Ichil letio'ob yaan ko'olelo'ob ku kaliko'ob u paakat, mix wiinik mix jinn tu machaj letio'ob taanil.

In them are maidens restraining their glances, untouched before by any man or jinn.

فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

**55:57** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:58** Bey wa chak ki'ichpam tuunicho'ob yeetel chak tuunicho'ob ti' k'aak'naab.

As though they were rubies and corals.

كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

**55:59** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:60** U bo'olil uts chen uts wa?

Is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?

هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنُ

**55:61** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:62** Yeetel yaanal letio'ob yaan ka'ap'eel pak'alo'ob.

And beneath them are two gardens.

وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

**55:63** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:64** Jach ya'axo'ob.

Deep green.

مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ

**55:65** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:66** Ichil letio'ob yaan ka'ap'eel tu'ux ku jook'ol ja' ku jook'ol chich.

In them are two gushing springs.

فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

**55:67** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:68** Ichil letio'ob yaan icho'ob, yeetel palmera'ob, yeetel granada'ob.

In them are fruits, and date-palms, and pomegranates.

فِيهِمَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ

**55:69** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:70** Ichil letio'ob yaan uts yeetel ki'ichpam ko'olelo'ob.

In them are good and beautiful ones.

فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌ

**55:71** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:72** Yet-kuxtalo'ob ki'ichpamo'ob, kananta'ano'ob ichil najo'ob ti' nook'.

Companions, secluded in the tents.

حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ

**55:73** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:74** Mix wiinik tu machaj letio'ob taanil, mix jinn.

Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.

لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

**55:75** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:76** Ku chenebaltalo'ob yook'ol ya'ax chenebalilo'ob, yeetel nook'o'ob jach ki'ichpam.

Reclining on green cushions, and exquisite carpets.

مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ

**55:77** Bey, ba'ax ti' u nojbe'en ba'alo'ob a Yuumtsile'ex je'el a p'ektike'ex?

So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?

فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

**55:78** Bendisiionta'an u k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le Yaan Muuk', le Ki'ichpam.

Blessed be the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.

تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

## 56. The Inevitable

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**56:1** Ken u yuchul le ba'ax ma' u paajtal u puuts'ul.

When the inevitable occurs.

إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

**56:2** Mina'an maax je'el u p'ektik u yuchul.

Of its occurrence, there is no denial.

لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

**56:3** Ku luubsik, ku lik'sik.

Bringing low, raising high.

خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ

**56:4** Ken le luum ku yuuk'ul yeetel chich yuuk'ul.

When the earth is shaken with a shock.

إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا

**56:5** Yeetel le wits'o'ob ku yaach'alo'ob yeetel ku k'aaxalo'ob.

And the mountains are crushed and crumbled.

وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا

**56:6** Yeetel ku p'aatalo'ob bey pu'us ku xit'ik u baaj.

And they become scattered dust.

فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا

**56:7** Yeetel te'ex kun a p'aatale'ex ichil ooxp'eel muuch'o'ob.

And you become three classes.

وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً

**56:8** Le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj — ba'ax ti' le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj?

Those on the Right—what of those on the Right?

فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

**56:9** Le maaxo'ob ti' le ts'ik — ba'ax ti' le maaxo'ob ti' le ts'ik?

And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?

وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

**56:10** Yeetel le maaxo'ob taanilo'ob, le maaxo'ob taanilo'ob.

And the forerunners, the forerunners.

وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ

**56:11** Letio'ob le maas naats'o'ob.

Those are the nearest.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

**56:12** Ichil le Pak'alo'ob Ki' Oolal.

In the Gardens of Bliss.

فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**56:13** Jun muuch' ti' le yaax maako'ob.

A throng from the ancients.

ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**56:14** Yeetel jun chan muuch' ti' le maako'ob taal paachil.

And a small band from the latecomers.

وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**56:15** Yook'ol chenebalilo'ob jach ki'ichpam.

On luxurious furnishings.

عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ

**56:16** Ku chenebaltalo'ob yook'ol letio'ob, ku paakatiko'ob u baajo'ob.

Reclining on them, facing one another.

مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

**56:17** Kun xiimbalo'ob tu yook'ol letio'ob paalalo'ob ma' ku nojochtalo'ob.

Serving them will be immortalized youth.

يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

**56:18** Yeetel lecho'ob uk'bil, yeetel p'uulo'ob uk'bil, yeetel uk'bil saasil ku lem.

With cups, pitchers, and sparkling drinks.

بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

**56:19** Ma' ku beetiko'ob ti' letio'ob k'in pool, mix ku kaaltalo'ob.

Causing them neither headache, nor intoxication.

لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

**56:20** Yeetel icho'ob ti' ba'ax ku yeeyiko'ob.

And fruits of their choice.

وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

**56:21** Yeetel u bak'el ch'iich'o'ob ti' ba'ax ku k'aatiko'ob.

And meat of birds that they may desire.

وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

**56:22** Yeetel yet-kuxtalo'ob ki'ichpamo'ob.

And lovely companions.

وَحُورٌ عِينٌ

**56:23** Bey sak tuunicho'ob taaka'ano'ob.

The likenesses of treasured pearls.

كَأَمْثَـٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ

**56:24** Bey junp'eel bo'olil yo'olal ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

As a reward for what they used to do.

جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**56:25** Te'elo' ma' kun u yu'ubo'ob mix t'aan mina'an u jaajil, mix p'ek t'aan.

Therein they will hear no nonsense, and no accusations.

لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

**56:26** Chen le t'aan: Jets' oolal, jets' oolal.

But only the greeting: “Peace, peace.”

إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَـٰمًا سَلَـٰمًا

**56:27** Le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj — ba'ax ti' le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj?

And those on the Right—what of those on the Right?

وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**56:28** Ichil pak'alo'ob jach ya'ax.

In lush orchards.

فِى سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ

**56:29** Yeetel che'o'ob ki' bok.

And sweet-smelling plants.

وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ

**56:30** Yeetel bo'oy ku maan naach.

And extended shade.

وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ

**56:31** Yeetel ja' ku jook'ol ya'ab.

And outpouring water.

وَمَآءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ

**56:32** Yeetel icho'ob ya'ab.

And abundant fruit.

وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

**56:33** Ma' ku xu'ululo'ob, mix maax ku p'atik letio'ob.

Neither withheld, nor forbidden.

لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ

**56:34** Yeetel chenebalilo'ob lik'sa'ano'ob ka'anal.

And uplifted mattresses.

وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

**56:35** To'on k beetaj letio'ob ichil junp'eel beetajil tu juunal.

We have created them of special creation.

إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءً

**56:36** Yeetel To'on k beetaj letio'ob ko'olelo'ob ma'ili' u taaka'alo'ob.

And made them virgins.

فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا

**56:37** Uts u yoolo'ob, ma' ku nojochtalo'ob.

Tender and un-aging.

عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا

**56:38** U tia'al le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj.

For those on the Right.

لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**56:39** Jun muuch' ti' le yaax maako'ob.

A throng from the ancients.

ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**56:40** Yeetel jun muuch' ti' le maako'ob taal paachil.

And a throng from the latecomers.

وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**56:41** Le maaxo'ob ti' le ts'ik — ba'ax ti' le maaxo'ob ti' le ts'ik?

And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?

وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ

**56:42** Ichil iik' jach chokoh yeetel ja' ku lokol.

Amid searing wind and boiling water.

فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ

**56:43** Yeetel bo'oy jach ek'.

And a shadow of thick smoke.

وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ

**56:44** Ma' samal, mix ku jets'ik ool.

Neither cool, nor refreshing.

لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

**56:45** Letio'ob kuxtalo'ob ka'ach ichil ki'ichpam ba'alo'ob.

They had lived before that in luxury.

إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

**56:46** Yeetel ku p'aatalo'ob ka'ach ichil noj keban.

And they used to persist in immense wrongdoing.

وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**56:47** Yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob ka'ach: Ken k kiimilo'ob yeetel k p'aatalo'ob bey luum yeetel baako'ob, kun lik'sa'alo'on wa?

And they used to say, “When we are dead and turned into dust and bones, are we to be resurrected?

وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

**56:48** Yeetel k yaax taatao'ob xan?

And our ancient ancestors too?”

أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

**56:49** A'ale: Le yaaxo'ob yeetel le ts'ooko'ob.

Say, “The first and the last.

قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**56:50** Kun muuch'ulo'ob utia'al u k'iinil junp'eel k'iin ojela'an.

Will be gathered for the appointment of a familiar Day.”

لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

**56:51** Ka' te'ex, te'ex le maaxo'ob a sa'ataje'ex a beel, te'ex le maaxo'ob a p'ektike'ex le jaajo'.

Then you, you misguided, who deny the truth.

ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ

**56:52** Kun a janale'ex ti' le Che' K'aas Ki'.

Will be eating from the Tree of Bitterness.

لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ

**56:53** Kun a chuukbesike'ex a nak'e'ex yeetel leti'.

Will be filling your bellies with it.

فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

**56:54** Kun a wuk'ike'ex yook'ol leti' ja' ku lokol.

Will be drinking on top of it boiling water.

فَشَـٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

**56:55** A wuk'ike'ex bey camello'ob yaan uk'aaj ku uk'iko'ob.

Drinking like thirsty camels drink.

فَشَـٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ

**56:56** Lelo' u k'amo'ob ichil u k'iinil Xot K'in.

That is their hospitality on the Day of Retribution.

هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

**56:57** To'on k beetaje'ex — wa chen a oksike'ex a yool!

We created you—if only you would believe!

نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

**56:58** Ta wilaje'ex wa le puts' ja' ka jook'sike'ex?

Have you seen what you ejaculate?

أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

**56:59** Te'ex wa a beetike'ex leti', wa To'on, le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob?

Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?

ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ

**56:60** To'on k xotaj kiimil ichile'ex, yeetel To'on ma' kun maana'alo'on.

We have decreed death among you, and We will not be outstripped.

نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

**56:61** Ichil k k'eexike'ex te'ex yeetel maako'ob bey te'ex, yeetel k beetike'ex te'ex ichil ba'ax ma' a wojele'ex.

In replacing you with your likes, and transforming you into what you do not know.

عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**56:62** A wojele'ex le yaax beetajil; wa chen a k'a'ajsike'ex!

You have known the first formation; if only you would remember.

وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

**56:63** Ta wilaje'ex wa ba'ax ka pak'ike'ex?

Have you seen what you cultivate?

أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

**56:64** Te'ex wa a beetike'ex u yaantal, wa To'on, le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob u yaantal?

Is it you who make it grow, or are We the Grower?

ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ

**56:65** Wa To'on k k'aate', je'el k beetik leti' bey ba'al yaach'a'an; ka' te'ex kun a ya'alike'ex yaayajil t'aan.

If We will, We can turn it into rubble; then you will lament.

لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

**56:66** To'on ts'o'ok k bo'otik yaayajil.

“We are penalized.

إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

**56:67** Ma'; to'on ma' k ch'a'ik mixba'al.

No, we are being deprived.”

بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

**56:68** Ta wilaje'ex wa le ja' ka wuk'ike'ex?

Have you seen the water you drink?

أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ

**56:69** Te'ex wa a taasaje'ex yaanal ti' le muyalo'ob, wa To'on, le maaxo'ob k taasik yaanal?

Is it you who sent it down from the clouds, or are We the Sender?

ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

**56:70** Wa To'on k k'aate', je'el k beetik leti' bey ja' ti' k'aak'naab. Ma' wa a ts'aike'ex ki'iki' t'aan?

If We will, We can make it salty. Will you not be thankful?

لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

**56:71** Ta wilaje'ex wa le k'aak' ka tookike'ex?

Have you seen the fire you kindle?

أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ

**56:72** Te'ex wa a beete'ex u che'il, wa To'on, le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob?

Is it you who produce its tree, or are We the Producer?

ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

**56:73** To'on k beetaj leti' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj, yeetel jets' oolal ti' le maaxo'ob ku meyajtiko'ob.

We have made it a reminder, and a comfort for the users.

نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَـٰعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

**56:74** Bey ki'iki' t'aante u k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le Noj.

So glorify the Name of your Great Lord.

فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**56:75** Kin hach t'aanik yook'ol le kuuchilo'ob le eek'o'ob.

I swear by the locations of the stars.

۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ

**56:76** Lelo' junp'eel hach t'aan, wa a wojele'ex, jach noj.

It is an oath, if you only knew, that is tremendous.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

**56:77** Lelo' junp'eel Quran tsikbe'en.

It is a noble Quran.

إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ

**56:78** Ichil junp'eel Aanalte' kananta'an ma'alob.

In a well-protected Book.

فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مَّكْنُونٍ

**56:79** Mix maax je'el u machik leti' chen le maaxo'ob sakbesa'ano'ob.

None can grasp it except the purified.

لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ

**56:80** Le ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**56:81** Lelo' wa le tsikbal a ch'a'ike'ex bey ma' nojbe'en?

Is it this discourse that you take so lightly?

أَفَبِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

**56:82** Yeetel a beetike'ex a kuxtale'ex a p'ektike'ex leti'?

And you make it your livelihood to deny it?

وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**56:83** Bey ken u k'uchul tak u kaal.

So when it has reached the throat.

فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ

**56:84** Ka' te'ex ka paakatike'ex.

As you are looking on.

وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ

**56:85** To'on maas naats' ti' leti' ti' te'ex, ba'ale' te'ex ma' a wilike'ex.

We are nearer to it than you are, but you do not see.

وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

**56:86** Wa te'ex ma' a bo'otike'ex yaayajil.

If you are not held to account.

فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

**56:87** Bey sutike'ex leti', wa te'ex jaaj a t'aane'ex.

Then bring it back, if you are truthful.

تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**56:88** Ba'ale' wa leti' ichil le maaxo'ob taasajo'ob naats'.

But if he is one of those brought near.

فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

**56:89** Bey ki' oolal, yeetel che'o'ob ki' bok, yeetel Pak'al Ki' Oolal.

Then happiness, and flowers, and Garden of Delights.

فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ

**56:90** Yeetel wa leti' ichil le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj.

And if he is one of those on the Right.

وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**56:91** Bey: Jets' oolal yook'ole'ex, taal ti' le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj.

Then, “Peace upon you,” from those on the Right.

فَسَلَـٰمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**56:92** Ba'ale' wa leti' ichil le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob, le maaxo'ob tu sa'ato'ob u beel.

But if he is one of the deniers, the mistaken.

وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

**56:93** Bey junp'eel k'aamajil ti' ja' ku lokol.

Then a welcome of Inferno.

فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

**56:94** Yeetel u tooka'al ichil Mitnal.

And burning in Hell.

وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

**56:95** Lela' le jaaj jaajile'.

This is the certain truth.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**56:96** Bey ki'iki' t'aante u k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le Nojbe'en.

So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent

فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

## 57. The Iron

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**57:1** Ku ki'iki' t'aantik Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Glorifying God is everything in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.

سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**57:2** Ti' Leti' u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Ku ts'aik kuxtal, ku ts'aik kiimil, yeetel Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.

لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**57:3** Leti' le Yaax yeetel le Ts'ook, le Ku Yila'al yeetel le Ma' Ku Yila'al, yeetel Leti' Aj Ojel tulakal ba'al.

He is the First and the Last, and the Outer and the Inner, and He has knowledge of all things.

هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**57:4** Leti' Maax tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum ichil wak k'iin, ka' tu jets'aj u baaj yook'ol le Ts'am. Ku yojel ba'ax ku yokol ichil le luum, yeetel ba'ax ku jook'ol ti', yeetel ba'ax ku taal ti' le ka'an, yeetel ba'ax ku na'akal tak ti'. Yeetel Leti' yaan yeetel te'ex tu'ux je'el ka wookole'ex. Allah Aj Ilaj ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then settled over the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. And He is with you wherever you may be. God is Seeing of everything you do.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**57:5** Ti' Leti' u jalbesil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel ti' Allah kun suuta'alo'ob tulakal ba'alo'ob.

To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and to God all matters are referred.

لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

**57:6** Ku yokbesik le aak'ab ichil le k'iin, yeetel ku yokbesik le k'iin ichil le aak'ab; yeetel Leti' Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He knows what the hearts contains.

يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**57:7** Oksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, yeetel ts'aike'ex ti' ba'ax tu beetaj te'ex a ch'a'ike'ex bey a ti'ale'ex. Le maaxo'ob ichile'ex ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku ts'aiko'ob, yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel noj bo'olil.

Believe in God and His Messenger, and spend from what He made you inherit. Those among you who believe and give will have a great reward.

ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

**57:8** Ba'ax a wile'ex ma' a woksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' Allah, ka' le Tuuxtbil ku payik te'ex a woksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' a Yuumtsile'ex, yeetel Leti' ts'o'ok u ch'a'aj junp'eel promesa ti' te'ex, wa te'ex aj oksaj oolo'obe'ex?

What is the matter with you that you do not believe in God, when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has received a pledge from you, if you are believers?

وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**57:9** Leti' Maax ku e'esik chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob yook'ol U palil, utia'al u jook'sik te'ex ti' le aak'abo'ob tak tu saasil. Allah Aj Ch'a' Ool te'ex, le maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal.

It is He who sends down upon His servant clear revelations, to bring you out of darkness into the light. God is Gentle towards you, Most Compassionate.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**57:10** Yeetel ba'ax tumen ma' a ts'aike'ex ichil u beel Allah, ka' ti' Allah u ti'al ba'ax kun p'aatal ti' le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum? Ma' bey le maaxo'ob ichile'ex tu ts'aajo'ob taanil ti' le naajal, yeetel tu ba'ate'elo'ob. Letio'obo' maas ka'analo'ob ichil u kuuchil ti' le maaxo'ob tu ts'aajo'ob paachil, yeetel tu ba'ate'elo'ob. Ba'ale' Allah tu promesa'atik ti' ka'ato'olo'ob junp'eel uts bo'olil. Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

And why is it that you do not spend in the cause of God, when to God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who contributed before the conquest, and fought. Those are higher in rank than those who contributed afterwards, and fought. But God promises both a good reward. God is Well Experienced in what you do.

وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَـٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَـٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**57:11** Maax le maax kun u ts'a ti' Allah junp'eel ts'a uts, utia'al Leti' u ka' ya'abbesik ti' leti', yeetel yaan ti' leti' junp'eel bo'olil uts ool?

Who is he who will lend God a loan of goodness, that He may double it for him, and will have a generous reward?

مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ

**57:12** Ichil le k'iin ka wilik le xiibo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob yeetel le ko'olelo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob — u saasilo'ob ku jook'ol taanil ti' letio'ob, yeetel tu no'ojilo'ob: Uts k'ay te'ex bejla'a': pak'alo'ob, yaanal letio'ob ku aalkab ja'o'ob, ku p'aatalo'ob ichil letio'ob mantats'. Lelo' le noj naajal.

On the Day when you see the believing men and believing women—their light radiating ahead of them, and to their right: “Good news for you today: gardens beneath which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. That is the great triumph.”

يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**57:13** Ichil le k'iin le xiibo'ob aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob yeetel le ko'olelo'ob aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob kun u ya'aliko'ob ti' le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob: Pa'ate'ex to'on; cha'ike'ex k ch'a'ik wa p'iit ti' a saasile'ex. Kun a'ala'ak: Suunene'ex paachil, kaxtike'ex saasil. Kun lik'sa'ak junp'eel pak' ichil letio'ob, yaan ti' junp'eel jool; ichil leti' yaan yatzil, yeetel tu paachil leti' yaan yaayajil.

On the Day when the hypocritical men and hypocritical women will say to those who believed, “Wait for us; let us absorb some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back behind you, and seek light.” A wall will be raised between them, in which is a door; within it is mercy, and outside it is agony.
