يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَـٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ

**57:14** Kun u payiko'ob letio'ob: Ma' wookolo'on ta wete'ex ka'ach? Kun u ya'aliko'ob: Jaaj, ba'ale' te'ex ta tusaje'ex a pixane'ex, ta pa'ataje'ex, ta waan a yoole'ex, yeetel ta p'ataje'ex a baaje'ex tumen tukulo'ob mina'an u jaajil, tak ka k'uch u a'almajt'aan Allah; yeetel le aj nojbesaj u baaj tu tusaj te'ex yo'olal Allah.

They will call to them, “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, but you cheated your souls, and waited, and doubted, and became deluded by wishful thinking, until the command of God arrived; and arrogance deceived you regarding God.”

يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

**57:15** Bey, bejla'a' mix junp'eel bo'olil kun ch'a'aba'ak ti' te'ex, mix ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob. Le K'aak' a wotoch. Leti' a yet-kuxtal — jach k'aas le suutulo'.

“Therefore, today no ransom will be accepted from you, nor from those who disbelieved. The Fire is your refuge. It is your companion—what an evil fate!”

فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**57:16** Ma' k'uchuk u k'iinil le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob u ts'aiko'ob u puksi'ik'alo'ob ti' u k'a'ajsaj Allah, yeetel ti' le jaaj ts'o'ok u e'esa'ab, yeetel ma' u beyo'ob le maaxo'ob ts'a'ab ti' letio'ob le Aanalte'o' taanil, ba'ale' le k'iin p'aataj naach yook'ol letio'ob, bey u puksi'ik'alo'ob tu chichtajo'ob, yeetel ya'abo'ob ichilo'ob aj kebano'ob?

Is it not time for those who believe to surrender their hearts to the remembrance of God, and to the truth that has come down, and not be like those who were given the Book previously, but time became prolonged for them, so their hearts hardened, and many of them are sinners?

۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

**57:17** Ojeltike'ex Allah ku kuxtbesik le luum paachil ti' u kiimil. Bey To'on k e'esik le chiikulo'ob ti' te'ex, utia'al a na'atike'ex.

Know that God revives the earth after its death. We thus explain the revelations for you, so that you may understand.

ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**57:18** Le xiibo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob siibal yeetel le ko'olelo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob siibal, le maaxo'ob tu ts'aajo'ob ti' Allah junp'eel ts'a toh — kun ya'abbesa'ak ti' letio'ob, yeetel yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel bo'olil uts ool.

The charitable men and charitable women, who have loaned God a loan of righteousness—it will be multiplied for them, and for them is a generous reward.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ

**57:19** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah yeetel U tuuxtbilo'ob — letio'ob le aj jaajo'ob yeetel le aj testimonio'ob yaan yeetel u Yuumtsilo'ob; yaan ti' letio'ob u bo'olilo'ob yeetel u saasilo'ob. Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku p'ektiko'ob K chiikulo'ob — letio'ob le kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

Those who believe in God and His messengers—these are the sincere and the witnesses with their Lord; they will have their reward and their light. But as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Blaze.

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**57:20** Ojeltike'ex le kuxtal yook'ol kaab chen baaxal, yeetel ba'al ku sa'atik ool, yeetel ki'ichpam ba'alo'ob, yeetel u nojbesiko'ob u baajo'ob ichil letio'ob, yeetel ba'atel yo'olal ayik'al yeetel paalal. Bey junp'eel ja' ku luubul ku ts'aik paak'alo'ob, ku beetik uts u yool le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. Ba'ale' paachil ku tikintal, ka wilik ku k'ank'antak, ka' ku p'aatal bey ba'al yaach'a'an. Ka' ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' yaan yaayajil chich, yeetel sa'atesa'al ti' Allah, yeetel u ch'a'ik uts u yool. Le kuxtal ti' le yook'ol kaaba' mixba'al chen uts oolal ti' tuus.

Know that the worldly life is only play, and distraction, and glitter, and boasting among you, and rivalry in wealth and children. It is like a rainfall that produces plants, and delights the disbelievers. But then it withers, and you see it yellowing, and then it becomes debris. While in the Hereafter there is severe agony, and forgiveness from God, and acceptance. The life of this world is nothing but enjoyment of vanity.

ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ

**57:21** Maane'ex seeb tak u sa'atesa'al ti' a Yuumtsile'ex; yeetel junp'eel Pak'al u nojil bey u nojil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, jets'a'an utia'al le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah yeetel U tuuxtbilo'ob. Lelo' u siibal Allah; ku ts'aik ti' maax ku k'aat. Allah Yuumil le Noj Siibal.

Race towards forgiveness from your Lord; and a Garden as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers. That is the grace of God; He bestows it on whomever He wills. God is the Possessor of Immense Grace.

سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**57:22** Mix junp'eel talamil ku yuchul yook'ol le luum, wa ichil a pixane'ex, wa ma' yaan ichil junp'eel Aanalte', ma'ili' To'on k beetik u yuchul. Lelo' seeb ti' Allah.

No calamity occurs on earth, or in your souls, but it is in a Book, even before We make it happen. That is easy for God.

مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

**57:23** Utia'al ma' a yaj oole'ex yo'olal ba'ax ku sa'atal ti' te'ex, mix a ki'imak oole'ex yo'olal ba'ax tu ts'aaj te'ex. Allah ma' tu yaabiltik le aj nojbesaj u baaj aj ki'iki' t'aan u baaj.

That you may not sorrow over what eludes you, nor exult over what He has given you. God does not love the proud snob.

لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ

**57:24** Le maaxo'ob ku p'atiko'ob u ts'aiko'ob, yeetel ku a'aliko'ob ti' maako'ob u p'atiko'ob u ts'aiko'ob. Maax ku sutik u paach — Allah leti' le Ayik'al, le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

Those who are stingy, and induce people to be stingy. Whoever turns away—God is the Independent, the Praiseworthy.

ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

**57:25** To'on k tuuxtaj K tuuxtbilo'ob yeetel le chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob, yeetel To'on k e'esaj yeetel letio'ob le Aanalte'o' yeetel le P'iis, utia'al le maako'ob u jets'iko'ob toh. Yeetel To'on k e'esaj le maskab, ichil leti' yaan chich muuk', yeetel ba'alo'ob ku beetik uts ti' maako'ob. Yeetel utia'al Allah u yojeltik maax ku yaantik Leti' yeetel U tuuxtbilo'ob ma' ila'ano'ob. Allah Chich, Yaan Muuk'.

We sent Our messengers with the clear proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, that humanity may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, in which is violent force, and benefits for humanity. That God may know who supports Him and His messengers invisibly. God is Strong and Powerful.

لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

**57:26** To'on k tuuxtaj Noah yeetel Abraham, yeetel To'on k jets'aj ichil u paalo'ob u ch'i'ibalo'ob le profeta kuxtal yeetel le kili'ich ju'uno'. Yaan ichilo'ob aj chiikbesajil beel, ba'ale' ya'abo'ob ichilo'ob aj kebano'ob.

We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and the Scripture. Some of them are guided, but many of them are sinners.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

**57:27** Ka' To'on k tuuxtaj tu yooko'ob K tuuxtbilo'ob, yeetel To'on k tuuxtaj Jesus u paal Mary, yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' le Gospel, yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maaxo'ob tu ts'ayajo'ob leti' ch'a' oolal yeetel yatzil. Ba'ale' le kuxtal tu juunal ichil naj payalchi' ta'akbil tu beetajo'ob — ma' To'on k ts'aaj u a'almajt'aan yook'ol letio'ob — chen utia'al u kaxtiko'ob u ch'a'ik uts u yool Allah. Ba'ale' ma' tu kanantajo'ob leti' bey u k'a'abet u kananta'al. Bey To'on k ts'aaj ti' le maaxo'ob ichilo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob u bo'olilo'ob, ba'ale' ya'abo'ob ichilo'ob aj keban.

Then We sent in their wake Our messengers, and followed up with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Gospel, and instilled in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But as for the monasticism which they invented—We did not ordain it for them—only to seek God’s approval. But they did not observe it with its due observance. So We gave those of them who believed their reward, but many of them are sinful.

ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَـٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

**57:28** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! P'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah, yeetel oksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' U Tuuxtbil: Leti' kun u ts'aik te'ex ka'ap'eel jaats ti' U yatzil, yeetel kun u ts'aik te'ex junp'eel saasil ka xiimbale'ex yeetel, yeetel kun u sa'atesik te'ex. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O you who believe! Fear God, and believe in His Messenger: He will give you a double portion of His mercy, and will give you a light by which you walk, and will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**57:29** Utia'al le Maako'ob le Aanalte'o' u yojele'ob mina'an ti' letio'ob mix p'iit muuk' yook'ol u siibal Allah, yeetel tulakal siibal yaan ichil u k'ab Allah; ku ts'aik ti' maax ku k'aat. Allah Yuumil le Noj Siibal.

That the People of the Book may know that they have no power whatsoever over God’s grace, and that all grace is in God’s hand; He gives it to whomever He wills. God is Possessor of Great Grace.

لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

## 58. The Pleading Woman

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**58:1** Allah ts'o'ok u yu'ubik u t'aan le ko'olel tu ba'ateltaj teech yo'olal u watam, ka' tu ya'alaj u talamil ti' Allah. Allah tu yu'ubaj a tsikbale'ex. Allah Aj U'uyaj, Aj Ilaj.

God has heard the statement of she who argued with you concerning her husband, as she complained to God. God heard your conversation. God is Hearing and Seeing.

قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

**58:2** Le maaxo'ob ichile'ex ku beetiko'ob u watamo'ob bey ma' naats' ti' letio'ob, ku beetiko'ob letio'ob bey u na'ob — ma' u na'obi'. U na'ob chen le maaxo'ob tu siijeso'ob letio'ob. Ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob k'aas, yeetel junp'eel jaaj tus. Ba'ale' Allah Aj Sa'atesaj Sipil yeetel Aj Sa'atesaj.

Those of you who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers—they are not their mothers. Their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them. What they say is evil, and a blatant lie. But God is Pardoning and Forgiving.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ

**58:3** Le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob u watamo'ob bey ma' naats' ti' letio'ob, ku beetiko'ob letio'ob bey u na'ob, ka' ku suutiko'ob u t'aano'ob, k'a'abet u cha'iko'ob u bin jun tul palil ma'ili' u taako'ob u baajo'ob. Ti' lelo' ka t'aanbesa'ale'ex, yeetel Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Those who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers, then go back on what they said, must set free a slave before they may touch one another. To this you are exhorted, and God is well aware of what you do.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**58:4** Ba'ale' maax ma' tu kaxtik u nu'ukul, k'a'abet u suktal ka'ap'eel uj ku taalo'ob junp'eel paachil ti' u laak', ma'ili' u taako'ob u baajo'ob. Yeetel wa ma' u paajtal, u ts'aik janal ti' oox k'aal ootsil maako'ob. Lelo' utia'al a woksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil. Lelo'ob u a'almajt'aano'ob Allah. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil yaaj.

But whoever cannot find the means must fast for two consecutive months before they may touch one another. And if he is unable, then the feeding of sixty needy people. This, in order that you affirm your faith in God and His Messenger. These are the ordinances of God. The unbelievers will have a painful punishment.

فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**58:5** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil kun luubsa'alo'ob, bey luubsa'abo'ob le maaxo'ob taanil ti' letio'ob. To'on ts'o'ok k e'esaj chiikulo'ob saasilo'ob. Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku subtalbesik.

Those who oppose God and His Messenger will be subdued, as those before them were subdued. We have revealed clear messages. The unbelievers will have a demeaning punishment.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۚ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

**58:6** Ichil le k'iin Allah kun u lik'sik letio'ob tulakal, yeetel kun u ya'alik ti' letio'ob ba'ax tu beetajo'ob. Allah ts'o'ok u xokaj, ba'ale' letio'ob ts'o'ok u tu'ubeso'ob. Allah Aj Testimonio yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

On the Day when God resurrects them all, and informs them of what they did. God has kept count of it, but they have forgotten it. God is Witness over everything.

يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

**58:7** Ma' ta wilaj Allah ku yojel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel tulakal ba'ax yaan yook'ol le luum? Mina'an ta'akbil t'aan ichil oox tul wa ma' Leti' u kan tulil letio'ob; mix ichil jo' tul wa ma' Leti' u wak tulil letio'ob; mix maas p'iit ti' lelo', mix maas ya'ab, wa ma' Leti' yaan yeetel letio'ob tu'ux je'el ka wookolo'ob. Ka', ichil u K'iinil Liksajil, Leti' kun u ya'alik ti' letio'ob ba'ax tu beetajo'ob. Allah Aj Ojel tulakal ba'al.

Do you not realize that God knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? There is no secret counsel between three, but He is their fourth; nor between five, but He is their sixth; nor less than that, nor more, but He is with them wherever they may be. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. God has knowledge of everything.

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**58:8** Ma' ta wilaj le maaxo'ob a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob ma' u beetiko'ob ta'akbil t'aan, ba'ale' paachil tu suutajo'ob ti' ba'ax a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob ma' u beeto'ob? Ku beetiko'ob ta'akbil t'aan utia'al keban, yeetel k'aas yook'ol u laak'o'ob, yeetel ma' u yu'ubiko'ob le Tuuxtbil. Yeetel ka' ku taalo'ob ti' teech, ku ts'aiko'ob teech ki'imak oolal yeetel junp'eel t'aan ma' tu ts'aaj Allah ti' teech. Yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob ichil u baajo'ob: Ba'ax tumen Allah ma' ku yaayajkunsik to'on yo'olal ba'ax k a'alik? Mitnal ku p'iisik ti' letio'ob. Kun ookolo'ob ichil leti' u tooka'alo'ob. Jach k'aas le suutulo'.

Have you noted those who were prohibited from conspiring secretly, but then reverted to what they were prohibited from? They conspire to commit sin, and aggression, and defiance of the Messenger. And when they come to you, they greet you with a greeting that God never greeted you with. And they say within themselves, “Why does God not punish us for what we say?” Hell is enough for them. They will roast in it. What a miserable destiny!

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَـٰجَوْنَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**58:9** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ka' ka t'aane'ex ta'akbil, ma' a t'aane'ex ichil keban, yeetel k'aas yook'ol u laak'o'ob, yeetel ma' a yu'ubike'ex le Tuuxtbil; ba'ale' t'aane'ex ichil uts yeetel toh oolal; yeetel p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah, Leti' tu'ux kun a much'ula'ale'ex.

O you who believe! When you converse secretly, do not converse in sin, and aggression, and disobedience of the Messenger; but converse in virtue and piety; And fear God, to Whom you will be gathered.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَنَـٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

**58:10** Le ta'akbil t'aano'ob chen ti' Kisin, utia'al u yajbesik u yool le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob; ba'ale' leti' ma' kun u beetik k'aas ti' letio'ob mix p'iit, chen wa Allah ku cha'ik. Bey le aj oksaj oolo'ob u ts'aiko'ob u k'ub oolal yook'ol Allah.

Conspiracies are from Satan, that he may dishearten those who believe; but he will not harm them in the least, except by leave of God. So let the believers put their trust in God.

إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

**58:11** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ka' a'ala'ak te'ex: Beete'ex kuuchil ichil a muuch'ulo'ob, beete'ex kuuchil; Allah kun u beetik kuuchil ti' te'ex. Yeetel ka' a'ala'ak te'ex: Xit'ikene'ex a baaje'ex, xit'ikene'ex a baaje'ex. Allah ku lik'sik le maaxo'ob ichile'ex ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel le maaxo'ob ts'a'ab ti' letio'ob na'at, ya'ab kuuchilo'ob. Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

O you who believe! When you are told to make room in your gatherings, make room; God will make room for you. And when you are told to disperse, disperse. God elevates those among you who believe, and those given knowledge, many steps. God is Aware of what you do.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَـٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**58:12** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ka' ka t'aane'ex ta'akbil yeetel le Tuuxtbil, ts'aike'ex wa baax bey siibal taanil ti' a ta'akbil t'aane'ex. Lelo' maas uts ti' te'ex, yeetel maas sak. Ba'ale' wa ma' a kaxtike'ex a nu'ukule'ex — Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O you who believe! When you converse privately with the Messenger, offer something in charity before your conversation. That is better for you, and purer. But if you do not find the means—God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَـٰجَيْتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَةً ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**58:13** A saajkike'ex wa a ts'aike'ex siibalo'ob taanil ti' a ta'akbil t'aane'ex? Wa ma' a beetike'ex, yeetel Allah ku sa'atesik te'ex, beete'ex le payalchi', ts'aike'ex le siibal k'a'abet, yeetel yu'ubike'ex Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil. Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Are you reluctant to offer charity before your conversation? If you do not do so, and God pardons you, then perform the prayer, and give alms, and obey God and His Messenger. God is Aware of what you do.

ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَـٰتٍ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

**58:14** Ma' ta tuukultaj le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob u yet-maako'ob junp'eel muuch' Allah jach p'ekmaj? Letio'ob ma' ti' te'ex, mix ti' letio'ob. Yeetel ku hach t'aaniko'ob yo'olal junp'eel tus, ka' u yojeleo'ob.

Have you considered those who befriended a people with whom God has become angry? They are not of you, nor of them. And they swear to a lie while they know.

۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

**58:15** Allah ts'o'ok u jets'aj utia'al letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil chich. K'aas ba'ax ku beetiko'ob ka'ach.

God has prepared for them a terrible punishment. Evil is what they used to do.

أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**58:16** Tu ch'a'ajo'ob u hach t'aano'ob bey junp'eel ba'al ku kananik letio'ob, yeetel tu p'atajo'ob u laak'o'ob ti' u beel Allah. Yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku subtalbesik.

They took their oaths as a screen, and prevented others from God’s path. They will have a shameful punishment.

ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

**58:17** Mix u ayik'alilo'ob mix u paalo'ob kun u beetiko'ob uts ti' letio'ob mixba'al tu ts'eel Allah. Letio'ob le kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aak', ku p'aatalo'ob ichil leti' mantats'.

Neither their possessions nor their children will avail them anything against God. These are the inhabitants of the Fire, dwelling therein forever.

لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

**58:18** Ichil le k'iin Allah kun u lik'sik letio'ob tulakal — kun u hach t'aaniko'ob ti' Leti', bey ku hach t'aaniko'ob ti' te'ex, ku tuukultiko'ob yaan letio'ob yook'ol wa baax. Jaajile', letio'ob le aj tuuso'ob.

On the Day when God will resurrect them altogether—they will swear to Him, as they swear to you, thinking that they are upon something. Indeed, they themselves are the liars.

يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ

**58:19** Kisin ts'o'ok u ch'a'aj muuk' yook'ol letio'ob, bey tu beetaj u tu'ubeso'ob u k'a'ajsaj Allah. Letio'ob u muuch' Kisin. Jaajile', u muuch' Kisin letio'ob le aj sa'atalo'ob.

Satan has taken hold of them, and so has caused them to forget the remembrance of God. These are the partisans of Satan. Indeed, it is Satan’s partisans who are the losers.

ٱسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ

**58:20** Le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil letio'ob ichil le maas p'iska'ano'ob.

Those who oppose God and His Messenger are among the lowliest.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْأَذَلِّينَ

**58:21** Allah ts'o'ok u ts'iibtik: Jaaj kin naajal, Teen yeetel in tuuxtbilo'ob. Allah Chich, Yaan Muuk'.

God has written: “I will certainly prevail, I and My messengers.” God is Strong and Mighty.

كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

**58:22** Ma' a kaxtik junp'eel muuch' ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah yeetel u ts'ook k'in, ku yaabiltiko'ob le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateltiko'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, kex letio'ob u taatao'ob, wa u paalo'ob, wa u suku'uno'ob, wa u laak'o'ob naats'. Letio'oba' — Leti' ts'o'ok u ts'iibtik oksaj oolal ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob, yeetel ts'o'ok u chichkunsik letio'ob yeetel junp'eel pixan ti' Leti'. Yeetel Leti' kun u yokbes letio'ob ichil Pak'alo'ob, yaanal letio'ob ku aalkab ja'o'ob, ku p'aatalo'ob ichil letio'ob mantats'. Allah ts'o'ok u ch'a'aj uts u yool ti' letio'ob, yeetel letio'ob ts'o'ok u ch'a'ako'ob uts u yool ti' Leti'. Letio'ob u muuch' Allah. Jaajile', u muuch' Allah letio'ob le aj naajalo'ob.

You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day, loving those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they were their parents, or their children, or their siblings, or their close relatives. These—He has inscribed faith in their hearts, and has supported them with a spirit from Him. And He will admit them into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will dwell forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. These are the partisans of God. Indeed, it is God’s partisans who are the successful.

لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنْ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍ مِّنْهُ ۖ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

## 59. The Exile

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**59:1** Ku ki'iki' t'aantik Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le maas Aj Na'at ichil tulakal.

Glorifying God is all that exists in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.

سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**59:2** Leti' Maax tu jok'saj le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ichil le Maako'ob le Aanalte'o' ti' u yotocho'ob, ichil u yaax much'ula'al. Ma' ta tuukultaje'ex kun u jook'olo'ob, yeetel letio'ob tu tuukultajo'ob u pak'o'ob kun u kananiko'ob letio'ob ti' Allah. Ba'ale' Allah tu k'uchul ti' letio'ob ti' tu'ux mix bik'in tu pa'atajo'ob, yeetel tu pulaj sajkil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob. Tu k'askuuntajo'ob u yotocho'ob yeetel u k'abo'ob, yeetel u k'abo'ob le aj oksaj oolo'ob. Bey tuuno', ch'a'ike'ex junp'eel kaansajil, oo te'ex maaxo'ob yaan a na'ate'ex.

It is He who evicted those who disbelieved among the People of the Book from their homes at the first mobilization. You did not think they would leave, and they thought their fortresses would protect them from God. But God came at them from where they never expected, and threw terror into their hearts. They wrecked their homes with their own hands, and by the hands of the believers. Therefore, take a lesson, O you who have insight.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلْحَشْرِ ۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ ۖ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا۟ ۖ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ ۚ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَٱعْتَبِرُوا۟ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ

**59:3** Wa Allah ma' tu ts'aaj a'almajt'aan u jook'sa'alo'ob ti' luum ti' letio'ob, tu yaayajbesaj letio'ob ichil le kuxtala'. Ba'ale' ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' yaan ti' letio'ob u yaayajil le K'aak'.

Had God not decreed exile for them, He would have punished them in this life. But in the Hereafter they will have the punishment of the Fire.

وَلَوْلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ

**59:4** Lelo' tumen tu ba'ateltajo'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil. Maax ku ba'ateltik Allah — Allah chich ichil bo'olil paach.

That is because they opposed God and His Messenger. Whoever opposes God—God is stern in retribution.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

**59:5** Wa a xoot'ike'ex junp'eel che', wa a p'atike'ex ku wa'atal yook'ol u chuun, leti' tumen u k'aat Allah. Jaaj Leti' kun u subkuuntik le aj kebano'ob.

Whether you cut down a tree, or leave it standing on its trunk, it is by God’s will. He will surely disgrace the sinners.

مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ

**59:6** Tulakal ba'ax Allah tu ts'aaj ti' U Tuuxtbil taal ti' letio'ob; ma' ta bisa'ex mix jun tul tsimin mix jun tul camello utia'al u ba'atel letio'ob, ba'ale' Allah ku ts'aik jalbesil ti' U tuuxtbilo'ob yook'ol maax Leti' u k'aat. Allah Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Whatever God has bestowed upon His Messenger from them; you spurred neither horse nor camel for them, but God gives authority to His messengers over whomever He will. God is Able to do all things.

وَمَآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**59:7** Tulakal ba'ax Allah tu suutbesaj ti' U Tuuxtbil taal ti' le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob ichil le kaajo'ob, ti' Allah, yeetel ti' le Tuuxtbil, yeetel ti' le laak'tsilo'ob, yeetel ti' le paalo'ob mina'an u taata, yeetel ti' le ootsil maako'ob, yeetel ti' le aj ximbal mina'an u kuuchil; utia'al ma' u maan chen ichil le ayik'al maako'ob ichile'ex. Tulakal ba'ax le Tuuxtbil ku ts'aik te'ex, ch'a'ike'ex; yeetel tulakal ba'ax ku ya'alik te'ex ma' a beeto'ob, ma' a beeto'ob. Yeetel p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah. Allah chich ichil yaayajil.

Whatever God restored to His Messenger from the inhabitants of the villages belongs to God, and to the Messenger, and to the relatives, and to the orphans, and to the poor, and to the wayfarer; so that it may not circulate solely between the wealthy among you. Whatever the Messenger gives you, accept it; and whatever he forbids you, abstain from it. And fear God. God is severe in punishment.

مَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ كَىْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةًۢ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَغْنِيَآءِ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ فَٱنتَهُوا۟ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

**59:8** Ti' le ootsil maako'ob jok'sa'ano'ob ti' u yotocho'ob yeetel u ayik'alilo'ob, ka' ku kaxtiko'ob u siibal Allah yeetel u ch'a'ik uts u yool ti' letio'ob, yeetel ku yaantiko'ob Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil. Letio'obo' le aj jaajo'ob.

To the poor refugees who were driven out of their homes and their possessions, as they sought the favor of God and His approval, and came to the aid of God and His Messenger. These are the sincere.

لِلْفُقَرَآءِ ٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا وَيَنصُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ

**59:9** Yeetel le maaxo'ob, taanil ti' letio'ob, tu jets'ajo'ob u baajo'ob ichil le luumo' u yotoch, yeetel tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob. Ku yaabiltiko'ob le maaxo'ob tu p'atajo'ob u luumo'ob tak ti' letio'ob, yeetel ma' ku p'isko'ob u yoolo'ob ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob ka' ku yaantiko'ob letio'ob. Ku ts'aiko'ob ti' letio'ob taanil ti' letio'ob u baajo'ob, kex letio'ob u baajo'ob k'a'abeet ti' letio'ob. Maax Allah ku kanantik ti' le k'aas k'aat yaan ichil u pixan — letio'obo' le aj naajalo'ob.

And those who, before them, had settled in the homeland, and had accepted faith. They love those who emigrated to them, and find no hesitation in their hearts in helping them. They give them priority over themselves, even if they themselves are needy. Whoever is protected from his natural greed—it is they who are the successful.

وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ ۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

**59:10** Yeetel le maaxo'ob tu taalo'ob paachil ti' letio'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: K Yuumtsil, sa'atese to'on, yeetel K suku'uno'ob tu taalo'ob taanil ti' to'on ichil oksaj oolal, yeetel ma' a ts'aik mix p'ek ichil K puksi'ik'alo'ob yo'olal le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. K Yuumtsil, Teech Aj Ch'a' Ool yeetel le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

And those who came after them, saying, “Our Lord, forgive us, and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and leave no malice in our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord, You are Clement and Merciful.”

وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**59:11** Ma' ta wilaj le maaxo'ob aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob? Ku ya'aliko'ob ti' u suku'uno'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ichil le Maako'ob le Aanalte'o': Wa ka jok'sa'ale'ex, To'on kun k jook'ol ta wete'ex, yeetel ma' k yu'ubik mix maak tu contra'ex; yeetel wa maak ku ba'ateltike'ex, jaaj To'on kun k aantike'ex. Ba'ale' Allah Aj Testimonio letio'ob aj tuuso'ob.

Have you not considered those who act hypocritically? They say to their brethren who disbelieved among the People of the Book, “If you are evicted, we will leave with you, and will not obey anyone against you; and should anyone fight you, we will certainly support you.” But God bears witness that they are liars.

۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

**59:12** Wa ka jok'sa'ako'ob, ma' kun u jook'olo'ob yeetel letio'ob; yeetel wa maak ku ba'ateltiko'ob letio'ob, ma' kun u yaantiko'ob letio'ob; yeetel wa ku biniko'ob u yaantiko'ob letio'ob, kun u suutiko'ob u paacho'ob yeetel kun u puuts'ulo'ob; ka' ma' kun u k'amiko'ob mix aantaj.

If they are evicted, they will not leave with them; and if anyone fights them, they will not support them; and if they go to their aid, they will turn their backs and flee; then they will receive no support.

لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا۟ لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُوا۟ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

**59:13** U sajkil te'ex maas chich ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob ti' u sajkil Allah. Lelo' tumen letio'ob junp'eel muuch' ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

Fear of you is more intense in their hearts than fear of God. That is because they are a people who do not understand.

لَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ

**59:14** Ma' kun u ba'atelto'ob te'ex tulakale'ex chen ti' kaajo'ob yaan u pak'o'ob chich, wa paachil ti' pak'o'ob. U p'ek u baajo'ob ichilo'ob chich. A tuukultik letio'ob much'a'ano'ob, ba'ale' u puksi'ik'alo'ob jejelaas. Lelo' tumen letio'ob junp'eel muuch' ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

They will not fight you all together except from fortified strongholds, or from behind walls. Their hostility towards each other is severe. You would think they are united, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not understand.

لَا يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِى قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ جُدُرٍۭ ۚ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ ۚ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ

**59:15** Bey le maaxo'ob naats' taanil ti' letio'ob. Tu k'amo'ob u bo'olil u tuukulo'ob. Ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel yaayajil yaaj.

Like those shortly before them. They experienced the consequences of their decisions. For them is a painful punishment.

كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ۖ ذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**59:16** Bey Kisin, ka' ku ya'alik ti' le wiinik: Ma' a woksik a wool. Ba'ale' ka' ts'o'ok u ma' oksik u yool, ku ya'alik: Teen mina'an in sipil ti' teech; teen ku saajkinen Allah, Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

Like the devil, when he says to the human being, “Disbelieve.” But when he has disbelieved, he says, “I am innocent of you; I fear God, the Lord of the Worlds.”

كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ ٱكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**59:17** U ts'ookil ka'ato'olo'ob leti' le K'aak', tu'ux kun u p'aatalo'ob ichil leti' mantats'. Bey u bo'olil le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

The ultimate end for both of them is the Fire, where they will dwell forever. Such is the requital for the wrongdoers.

فَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدَيْنِ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**59:18** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! P'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah, yeetel tulakal pixan u yilik ba'ax tu bisaaj taanil utia'al saamal, yeetel p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah. Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

O you who believe! Fear God, and let every soul consider what it has forwarded for the morrow, and fear God. God is Aware of what you do.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

**59:19** Yeetel ma' a beyo'ob le maaxo'ob tu tu'ubeso'ob Allah, bey Leti' tu beetaj u tu'ubeso'ob u baajo'ob. Letio'obo' le aj kebano'ob.

And do not be like those who forgot God, so He made them forget themselves. These are the sinners.

وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ

**59:20** Ma' p'iisiko'ob le kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aak' yeetel le kuxtalo'ob ichil le Pak'alo'. Letio'ob, u kuxtalo'ob le Pak'alo', le aj naajalo'ob.

Not equal are the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of Paradise. It is the inhabitants of Paradise who are the winners.

لَا يَسْتَوِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

**59:21** Wa To'on k e'esaj le Quran yook'ol junp'eel wiits, tu yilaj ku xit'ik u baaj, ku luubul tumen u sajkil ti' Allah. Le tsikbalo'ob bey lelo' To'on k t'ojik utia'al le maako'ob, utia'al u tuukultiko'ob.

Had We sent this Quran down on a mountain, you would have seen it trembling, crumbling in awe of God. These parables We cite for the people, so that they may reflect.

لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَـٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

**59:22** Leti' Allah. Mina'an k'uj cheen Leti', le Aj Ojel ti' le ba'axo'ob ta'akbilo'ob yeetel le ba'axo'ob a'albilo'ob. Leti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

He is God. There is no god but He, the Knower of secrets and declarations. He is the Compassionate, the Merciful.

هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**59:23** Leti' Allah; mina'an u laak' k'uj cheen Leti'; le Ajaw, le Kili'ich, le Aj Ts'aaj Jets' Oolal, le Aj Ts'aaj Oksaj Oolal, le Aj Kanan Tulakal, le Yaan Muuk', le Yaan Muuk' Tulakal, le Maax Ku Naajaltik Yook'ol Tulakal. Kili'ich Leti', maas ka'anal ti' ba'ax ku ts'aiko'ob tu ts'eel Leti'.

He is God; besides Whom there is no god; the Sovereign, the Holy, the Peace-Giver, the Faith-Giver, the Overseer, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Overwhelming. Glory be to God, beyond what they associate.

هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**59:24** Leti' Allah; le Aj Beetaj, le Aj Meyaj, le Aj Ts'aaj Yich. Ti' Leti' le Maas Ki' K'aaba'o'ob. Tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum ku ki'iki' t'aantik Leti'. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

He is God; the Creator, the Maker, the Designer. His are the Most Beautiful Names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him. He is the Majestic, the Wise.

هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

## 60. The Examined One

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**60:1** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' a ch'a'ike'ex In p'eko'ob yeetel a p'eko'ob bey a aantajo'ob, ka' ka ts'aike'ex ti' letio'ob yaabil, ka' letio'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ti' ba'ax tu taalo'ob ti' te'ex ti' le Jaaj. Tu jok'sajo'ob le Tuuxtbil, yeetel te'ex, tumen ta woksaje'ex a yoole'ex ti' Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex. Wa ta jook'ole'ex a ba'atele'ex utia'al In beel, ka' ka kaxtike'ex In ch'a'ik uts u yool, bix je'el a yaabiltike'ex letio'ob ta'akbil? Teen in wojel ba'ax ka ta'akike'ex yeetel ba'ax ka ye'esike'ex. Maax ichile'ex ku beetik lelo' ts'o'ok u sa'atal u beel ti' le toh beelo'.

O you who believe! Do not take My enemies and your enemies for supporters, offering them affection, when they have disbelieved in what has come to you of the Truth. They have expelled the Messenger, and you, because you believed in God, your Lord. If you have mobilized to strive for My cause, seeking My approval, how can you secretly love them? I know what you conceal and what you reveal. Whoever among you does that has strayed from the right way.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ عَدُوِّى وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۙ أَن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَـٰدًا فِى سَبِيلِى وَٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِى ۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعْلَمُ بِمَآ أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَآ أَعْلَنتُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

**60:2** Wa ku k'amike'ex te'ex, ku beetiko'ob u baajo'ob a p'eko'ob, yeetel ku xit'iko'ob u k'abo'ob yeetel u t'aano'ob tu contra'ex yeetel k'aas. Ku k'aatiko'ob ka ma' a woksike'ex a yoole'ex.

Whenever they encounter you, they treat you as enemies, and they stretch their hands and tongues against you with malice. They wish that you would disbelieve.

إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا۟ لَكُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَيَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ

**60:3** Mix a laak'tsile'ex mix a paalale'ex kun u beetiko'ob uts ti' te'ex ichil u K'iinil Liksajil. Leti' kun u jaatsik ichile'ex. Allah Aj Ilaj ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

Neither your relatives nor your children will benefit you on the Day of Resurrection. He will separate between you. God is Observant of what you do.

لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**60:4** Yaan te'ex junp'eel uts ba'al a yilik ichil Abraham yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan yeetel leti'; ka' tu ya'alajo'ob ti' u kaajo'ob: To'on mina'an to'on ba'ax yeetel te'ex, yeetel ba'ax ka kultike'ex paat ti' Allah. K p'ektik te'ex. P'ek jook' ichil to'on yeetel te'ex, yeetel p'ek ichil K puksi'ik'alo'ob, mantats', tak ka a woksike'ex a yoole'ex ti' Allah chen u baaj. Chen u t'aan Abraham ti' u taata ma' ichil lelo': Jaaj kin kaxtik sa'atesa'al ti' teech, kex mina'an ti' teen mix muuk' ti' Allah utia'al in beetik mixba'al ti' teech. K Yuumtsil, ti' Teech k ts'aik K k'ub oolal, yeetel ti' Teech k suut, yeetel ti' Teech le ts'ook suutul.

You have had an excellent example in Abraham and those with him; when they said to their people, “We are quit of you, and what you worship apart from God. We denounce you. Enmity and hatred has surfaced between us and you, forever, until you believe in God alone.” Except for the words of Abraham to his father, “I will ask forgiveness for you, though I have no power from God to do anything for you.” “Our Lord, in You we trust, and to You we repent, and to You is the ultimate resort.

قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**60:5** K Yuumtsil, ma' a beetik to'on prueba utia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel sa'atese to'on, K Yuumtsil. Teech jaaj le Yaan Muuk' yeetel Aj Na'at.

Our Lord, do not make us a target for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. You are indeed the Mighty and Wise.”

رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**60:6** Yaan junp'eel uts ba'al a yilik ichil letio'ob ti' te'ex — ti' maax ku kaxtik Allah yeetel u ts'ook k'in. Ba'ale' maax ku sutik u paach — Allah leti' le Ayik'al, le maas Ki'iki' T'aanta'an ichil tulakal.

There is an excellent example in them for you—for anyone who seeks God and the Last Day. But whoever turns away—God is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised.

لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

**60:7** Waa Allah kun u ts'aik yaabil ichile'ex yeetel le maaxo'ob ichil letio'ob ka tuukultike'ex a p'eko'ob. Allah le Yaan Muuk'. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Perhaps God will plant affection between you and those of them you consider enemies. God is Capable. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

۞ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**60:8** Yo'olal le maaxo'ob ma' tu ba'atelto'ob te'ex yo'olal a culto, mix tu jok'sajo'ob te'ex ti' a wotocho'ob, Allah ma' tu ya'alik te'ex ma' a beetike'ex uts ti' letio'ob yeetel a beetike'ex toh ti' letio'ob. Allah ku yaabiltik le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob toh.

As for those who have not fought against you for your religion, nor expelled you from your homes, God does not prohibit you from dealing with them kindly and equitably. God loves the equitable.

لَّا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ

**60:9** Ba'ale' Allah ku ya'alik te'ex ma' a beetike'ex a yet-maako'ob le maaxo'ob tu ba'atelto'ob te'ex yo'olal a culto, yeetel tu jok'sajo'ob te'ex ti' a wotocho'ob, yeetel tu yaantajo'ob ichil a jok'sa'ale'ex. Maax ku ch'a'ik letio'ob bey u yet-maako'ob — letio'obo' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

But God prohibits you from befriending those who fought against you over your religion, and expelled you from your homes, and aided in your expulsion. Whoever takes them for friends—these are the wrongdoers.

إِنَّمَا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ وَظَـٰهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

**60:10** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ka' ko'olelo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' te'ex ku p'atalo'ob u luumo'ob, beete'ex prueba ti' letio'ob. Allah Aj Ojel ti' u oksaj oolalo'ob. Yeetel wa ka wile'ex letio'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob, ma' a suutbesike'ex letio'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob. Letio'ob ma' cha'abil ti' letio'ob, mix letio'ob cha'abil ti' letio'ob. Ba'ale' ts'aike'ex ti' letio'ob ba'ax tu ts'aajo'ob. Ma' yaan a sipile'ex wa ka beetike'ex kam nikte' yeetel letio'ob, wa ka ts'aike'ex ti' letio'ob u bo'olilo'ob. Yeetel ma' a p'atike'ex a baaje'ex nupa'ano'ob ti' ko'olelo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ba'ale' kaxtike'ex ba'ax ta ts'aaje'ex, yeetel cha' letio'ob u kaxtiko'ob ba'ax tu ts'aajo'ob. Lelo' u xot t'aan Allah; Leti' ku jalbes ichile'ex. Allah Aj Ojel, Aj Na'at.

O you who believe! When believing women come to you emigrating, test them. God is Aware of their faith. And if you find them to be faithful, do not send them back to the unbelievers. They are not lawful for them, nor are they lawful for them. But give them what they have spent. You are not at fault if you marry them, provided you give them their compensation. And do not hold on to ties with unbelieving women, but demand what you have spent, and let them demand what they have spent. This is the rule of God; He rules among you. God is Knowing and Wise.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ مُهَـٰجِرَٰتٍ فَٱمْتَحِنُوهُنَّ ۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَـٰنِهِنَّ ۖ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَـٰتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ ۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا۟ بِعِصَمِ ٱلْكَوَافِرِ وَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

**60:11** Wa wa baax ti' a watane'ex ku bin ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel ka xotike'ex bo'olil paach ti' letio'ob, ts'aike'ex ti' le maaxo'ob tu bino'ob u watano'ob bey p'iis ti' ba'ax tu ts'aajo'ob. Yeetel p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah, Leti' ti' Maax ka oksike'ex a yoole'ex.

If any of your wives desert you to the unbelievers, and you decide to penalize them, give those whose wives have gone away the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear God, in whom you are believers.

وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَىْءٌ مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَـَٔاتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَٰجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ

**60:12** Oo Profeta! Wa ko'olelo'ob aj oksaj oolo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' teech, ku ts'aiko'ob promesa ti' teech, yook'ol ma' u ts'aiko'ob mixba'al yet-maako'ob ti' Allah, mix u yokolo'ob, mix u beetiko'ob keban yeetel u laak'o'ob, mix u kiinsiko'ob u paalo'ob, mix u taasiko'ob junp'eel tus yo'olal u paalo'ob ichil u k'abo'ob yeetel u yooko'ob, mix ma' u yu'ubiko'ob teech ichil mixba'al toh, ch'a' u promesao'ob yeetel kaxtik sa'atesa'al ti' Allah utia'al letio'ob. Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O prophet! If believing women come to you, pledging allegiance to you, on condition that they will not associate anything with God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor commit perjury as to parenthood, nor disobey you in anything righteous, accept their allegiance and ask God’s forgiveness for them. God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَـٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَـٰنٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُۥ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِى مَعْرُوفٍ ۙ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**60:13** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' a beetike'ex a yet-maako'ob junp'eel muuch' Allah jach p'ekmaj, yeetel ts'o'ok u p'atiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le u laak' kuxtalo', bey le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ts'o'ok u p'atiko'ob u yoolo'ob ti' le maaxo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob ichil le muknalo'ob.

O you who believe! Do not befriend people with whom God has become angry, and have despaired of the Hereafter, as the faithless have despaired of the occupants of the graves.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْقُبُورِ

## 61. The Column

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**61:1** Ku ki'iki' t'aantik Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Everything in the heavens and the earth praises God. He is the Almighty, the Wise.

سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**61:2** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ba'axten ka wa'alike'ex ba'ax ma' ka beetike'ex?

O you who believe! Why do you say what you do not do?

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

**61:3** Jach p'ekbil ti' Allah ka wa'alike'ex ba'ax ma' ka beetike'ex.

It is most hateful to God that you say what you do not do.

كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

**61:4** Allah ku yaabiltik le maaxo'ob ku ba'ateliko'ob ichil U beel, jets'a'ano'ob ichil much'ulo'ob, bey junp'eel naj jach chich.

God loves those who fight in His cause, in ranks, as though they were a compact structure.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَـٰنٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ

**61:5** Ka' Moses tu ya'alaj ti' u maako'ob: Oo in maako'ob, ba'axten ka beetike'ex teen k'aas, kex a wojele'ex Teen U Tuuxtbil Allah ti' te'ex? Ka' letio'ob tu jeelbesajo'ob u baajo'ob, Allah tu jeelbesaj u puksi'ik'alo'ob. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le maako'ob aj kebano'ob.

When Moses said to his people, “O my people, why do you hurt me, although you know that I am God’s Messenger to you?” And when they swerved, God swerved their hearts. God does not guide the sinful people.

وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓا۟ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ

**61:6** Yeetel ka' Jesus, u paal Mary, tu ya'alaj: Oo paalo'ob Israel, Teen U Tuuxtbil Allah ti' te'ex, kin jets'ik jaaj ti' le Torah taal taanil teen, yeetel kin ts'aik uts t'aan yo'olal jun tul tuuxtbil kun taal paachil teen, u k'aaba' Ahmad. Ba'ale' ka' tu ye'esaj ti' letio'ob le chiikulo'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: Lela' jach saasil: chen k'aas beetajil.

And when Jesus son of Mary said, “O Children of Israel, I am God’s Messenger to you, confirming what preceded me of the Torah, and announcing good news of a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad.” But when he showed them the miracles, they said, “This is obvious sorcery.”

وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**61:7** Maax ku beetik maas k'aas ti' le maax ku tusik ba'alo'ob yook'ol Allah, ka' ku paya'al u taal ti' Islam? Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le maako'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

And who is a greater wrongdoer than he who attributes falsehoods to God, when he is being invited to Islam? God does not guide the wrongdoing people.

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**61:8** Ku k'aatiko'ob u tuupiko'ob u Saasil Allah yeetel u chi'o'ob; ba'ale' Allah kun u chuukbesik U Saasil, kex le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ma' u k'aato'ob.

They want to extinguish God’s Light with their mouths; but God will complete His Light, even though the disbelievers dislike it.

يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

**61:9** Leti' Maax tu tuuxtaj U Tuuxtbil yeetel chiikbesajil beel yeetel le jaaj culto, utia'al u naajaltik yook'ol tulakal cultoo'ob, kex le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u laak' bey Allaho' ma' u k'aato'ob.

It is He who sent His Messenger with the guidance and the true religion, to make it prevail over all religions, even though the idolaters dislike it.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ

**61:10** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! A k'aate'ex in ye'esik te'ex junp'eel koonol kun luk'sik te'ex ti' junp'eel yaayajil jach yaaj?

O you who believe! Shall I inform you of a trade that will save you from a painful torment?

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَـٰرَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**61:11** Ka oksike'ex a woole'ex ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, yeetel ka ba'atele'ex ichil u beel Allah yeetel a ayik'alile'ex yeetel a baaje'ex. Lelo' maas uts ti' te'ex, wa a wojele'ex.

That you believe in God and His Messenger, and strive in the cause of God with your possessions and yourselves. That is best for you, if you only knew.

تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**61:12** Leti' kun u sa'ates te'ex a kebane'ex; yeetel kun u yokse'ex ichil pak'alo'ob ku jook'ol ja' tu yaanal, yeetel ichil otocho'ob jach uts ichil le Pak'alo'ob ti' Eden. Lelo' le noj naajalil.

He will forgive you your sins; and will admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow, and into beautiful mansions in the Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme success.

يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَمَسَـٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**61:13** Yeetel u laak' ba'al ka yaabiltike'ex: aantaj ti' Allah, yeetel naajal naats'aan. Bey tuuno', ts'a uts t'aan ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And something else you love: support from God, and imminent victory. So give good news to the believers.

وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**61:14** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! P'aatale'ex aj aantaj ti' Allah, bey Jesus, u paal Mary, tu ya'alaj ti' le aj kaansajo'ob: Maaxo'ob in aj aantaj tak ti' Allah? Le aj kaansajo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on aj aantaj ti' Allah. Bey tuuno', junp'eel muuch' ti' le paalo'ob Israel tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel u laak' muuch' ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob. To'on k yaantaj le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob tu contra u p'eko'ob, bey tuuno' letio'ob le aj naajalo'ob.

O you who believe! Be supporters of God, as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples, “Who are my supporters towards God?” The disciples said, “We are God's supporters.” So a group of the Children of Israel believed, while another group disbelieved. We supported those who believed against their foe, so they became dominant.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ

## 62. The Congregation

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**62:1** Ku ki'iki' t'aantik Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum: le Ajaw, le Kili'ich, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

Everything in the heavens and the earth glorifies God the Sovereign, the Holy, the Almighty, the Wise.

يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**62:2** Leti' Maax tu tuuxtaj ichil le maako'ob ma' u yojelo'ob xook jun tul tuuxtbil ti' letio'ob u baajo'ob; ku xooktik ti' letio'ob U e'esa'abo'ob, yeetel ku cho'ik letio'ob, yeetel ku kaansik letio'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' yeetel na'at; kex taanil letio'ob ichil sa'atal jach saasil.

It is He who sent among the unlettered a messenger from themselves; reciting His revelations to them, and purifying them, and teaching them the Scripture and wisdom; although they were in obvious error before that.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**62:3** Yeetel u laak'o'ob ti' letio'ob, ma'ili' u much'uba'ob yeetel letio'ob. Leti' le maax yaan u nojbe'enil, le Aj Na'at.

And others from them, who have not yet joined them. He is the Glorious, the Wise.

وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا۟ بِهِمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**62:4** Lelo' u siibal Allah, ku ts'aik ti' maax Leti' u k'aat. Allah Maax yaan ti' siibal mina'an u ts'ook.

That is God’s grace, which He grants to whomever He wills. God is Possessor of limitless grace.

ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**62:5** U tsikbal le maaxo'ob ts'a'ab ti' letio'ob u kananil le Torah, ba'ale' ma' tu kuchajo'ob leti', bey le burro ku kuchik ju'uno'ob. K'aas u tsikbal le maako'ob ku p'ektiko'ob u e'esa'abo'ob Allah. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le maako'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah, but then failed to uphold it, is like the donkey carrying works of literature. Miserable is the example of the people who denounce God’s revelations. God does not guide the wrongdoing people.

مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًۢا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**62:6** A'ale: Oo te'ex maaxo'ob ti' le judio'obo', wa ka wa'alike'ex te'ex le maaxo'ob maas naats' ti' Allah, ma' ichil tulakal le maako'ob, k'aate'ex kiimil wa te'ex aj jaajo'ob.

Say, “O you who follow Judaism; if you claim to be the chosen of God, to the exclusion of the rest of mankind, then wish for death if you are sincere.”

قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓا۟ إِن زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**62:7** Ba'ale' mix bik'in kun u k'aato'ob, tumen ba'ax u k'abo'ob tu bisaajo'ob taanil. Allah jach u yojel le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

But they will not wish for it, ever, due to what their hands have advanced. God knows well the wrongdoers.

وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُۥٓ أَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**62:8** A'ale: Le kiimil ka puuts'ule'ex ti', kun u k'uchul ti' te'ex; bey tuuno' kun suunake'ex ti' le Aj Ojel ti' le ba'ax ma' yila'abe' yeetel le ba'ax yila'abe', yeetel Leti' kun u ya'alik te'ex ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

Say, “The death from which you flee will catch up with you; then you will be returned to the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will inform you of what you used to do.”

قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْمَوْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَـٰقِيكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**62:9** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ka' ku paya'al utia'al payalchi' ichil u K'iinil Much'ula'al, xiimbale'ex seeb tak u k'a'ajsajil Allah, yeetel p'atike'ex tulakal koonol. Lelo' maas uts ti' te'ex, wa a wojele'ex.

O you who believe! When the call is made for prayer on Congregation Day, hasten to the remembrance of God, and drop all business. That is better for you, if you only knew.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نُودِىَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَٱسْعَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**62:10** Bey tuuno', ka' ts'o'okok le payalchi'o', xit'ike'ex a baaje'ex yook'ol le luum, yeetel kaxtike'ex u siibal Allah, yeetel k'a'ajsike'ex Allah ya'ab, utia'al ka naajale'ex.

Then, when the prayer is concluded, disperse through the land, and seek God’s bounty, and remember God much, so that you may prosper.

فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

**62:11** Ka' ku yilo'ob junp'eel koonol wa junp'eel ba'al utia'al ki' oolal, ku xit'iko'ob u baajo'ob tak ti', yeetel ku p'atikech wa'atal. A'ale: Ba'ax yaan ti' Allah maas uts ti' le ki' oolal yeetel ti' le koonol; yeetel Allah le Maastal Aj Ts'aik Kuxtal.

Yet whenever they come across some business, or some entertainment, they scramble towards it, and leave you standing. Say, “What is with God is better than entertainment and business; and God is the Best of providers.”

وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ تِجَـٰرَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمًا ۚ قُلْ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهْوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَـٰرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

## 63. The Hypocrites

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**63:1** Ka' le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' teech, ku ya'aliko'ob: K beetik testimonio teech U Tuuxtbil Allah. Allah ku yojel teech U Tuuxtbil Leti', yeetel Allah ku beetik testimonio letio'ob le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob aj tuuso'ob.

When the hypocrites come to you, they say, “We bear witness that you are God’s Messenger.” God knows that you are His Messenger, and God bears witness that the hypocrites are liars.

إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

**63:2** Tu ch'a'ajo'ob u hach t'aano'ob bey junp'eel ba'al ku kananik letio'ob, yeetel tu p'atajo'ob u laak'o'ob ti' u beel Allah. K'aas ba'ax ku beetiko'ob.

They treat their oaths as a cover, and so they repel others from God’s path. Evil is what they do.

ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**63:3** Lelo' tumen tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob, ka' ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob; bey tuuno' u puksi'ik'alo'ob nupa'ano'ob, yeetel ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

That is because they believed, and then disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed, and they cannot understand.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ

**63:4** Ka' ka wilik letio'ob, u yila'alo'ob ku ki'imakkunsik a wool. Yeetel ka' ku t'aaniko'ob, ka yu'ubik ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob. Letio'ob bey che'o'ob wa'akbilo'ob. Ku tuukultiko'ob tulakal awat yook'ol letio'ob. Letio'ob le p'eko'ob, bey tuuno' kanant a baaj ti' letio'ob. Allah ku ts'aik k'aas p'ek yook'ol letio'ob; bix tuusbesa'abo'ob!

When you see them, their appearance impresses you. And when they speak, you listen to what they say. They are like propped-up timber. They think every shout is aimed at them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. God condemns them; how deluded they are!

۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَقُولُوا۟ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ ٱلْعَدُوُّ فَٱحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَـٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

**63:5** Yeetel ka' a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob: Taale'ex, U Tuuxtbil Allah kun u kaxtik sa'atesa'al ti' te'ex, ku jets'iko'ob u polo'ob, yeetel ka wilik letio'ob ku suuto'ob paach ka' ku nojbe'etiko'ob u baajo'ob.

And when it is said to them, “Come, the Messenger of God will ask forgiveness for you,” they bend their heads, and you see them turning away arrogantly.

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

**63:6** Junp'eelili' ti' letio'ob, wa ka kaxtik sa'atesa'al ti' letio'ob, wa ma' ka kaxtik sa'atesa'al ti' letio'ob; Allah ma' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob. Allah ma' tu chiikbesik beel ti' le maako'ob aj kebano'ob.

It is the same for them, whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them; God will not forgive them. God does not guide the sinful people.

سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ

**63:7** Letio'ob le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob: Ma' a ts'aike'ex mixba'al ti' le maaxo'ob yaan tu ts'eel U Tuuxtbil Allah, tak ka u xit'iko'ob u baajo'ob. Ti' Allah u taaka'an taak'ino'ob le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, ba'ale' le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob ma' tu na'atiko'ob.

It is they who say: “Do not spend anything on those who side with God’s Messenger, unless they have dispersed.” To God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا۟ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ

**63:8** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Wa k suut ti' le Kaajo', le maaxo'ob maas yaan u muuk' ichil leti' kun u jok'siko'ob le maaxo'ob mina'an u muuk'. Ba'ale' u Muuk' ti' Allah, yeetel ti' U Tuuxtbil, yeetel ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob; ba'ale' le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob ma' u yojelo'ob.

They say, “If we return to the City, the more powerful therein will evict the weak.” But power belongs to God, and His Messenger, and the believers; but the hypocrites do not know.

يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**63:9** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ma' a cha'ike'ex a ayik'alile'ex mix a paalale'ex u sa'atbesiko'ob te'ex ti' u k'a'ajsajil Allah. Maax ku beetik lelo', letio'ob le aj sa'atalo'ob.

O you who believe! Let neither your possessions nor your children distract you from the remembrance of God. Whoever does that—these are the losers.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ

**63:10** Yeetel ts'aike'ex ti' ba'ax To'on k ts'aaj te'ex, ma'ili' kiimil ku k'uchul ti' jun tul ichile'ex, ka' ku ya'alik: In Yuumtsil, wa chen a cha'ik in p'aatal jump'iit k'iin, utia'al in ts'aik siibal, yeetel in p'aatal ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

And give from what We have provided for you, before death approaches one of you, and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a short while, so that I may be charitable, and be one of the righteous.”

وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**63:11** Ba'ale' Allah ma' kun u cha'ik junp'eel pixan u p'aatal ka' k'uchuk u k'iinil. Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

But God will not delay a soul when its time has come. God is Informed of what you do.

وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

## 64. The Mutual Loss

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**64:1** Ku ki'iki' t'aantik Allah tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum. Ti' Leti' u jalbesil, yeetel ti' Leti' tulakal ki'iki' t'aan, yeetel Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Everything in the heavens and the earth praises God. To Him belongs the Kingdom, and to Him all praise is due, and He is Able to do all things.

يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**64:2** Leti' Maax tu beetaj te'ex. Junp'eel muuch' ichile'ex ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel junp'eel muuch' ichile'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob. Yeetel Allah Aj Ilaj ti' ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

It is He who created you. Some of you are unbelievers, and some of you are believers. And God perceives what you do.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**64:3** Tu beetaj le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum yeetel jaaj, yeetel tu beetaj a wiche'ex, yeetel tu beetaj uts a wiche'ex, yeetel ti' Leti' le ts'ook suutul.

He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He designed you, and designed you well, and to Him is the final return.

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**64:4** Ku yojel tulakal ba'ax yaan ichil le ka'ano'ob yeetel yook'ol le luum, yeetel ku yojel ba'ax ka ta'akike'ex yeetel ba'ax ka e'esike'ex. Yeetel Allah Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'ob.

He knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And God knows what is within the hearts.

يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**64:5** Ma' k'uchuk ti' te'ex u tsikbal le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob taanil? Tu yuk'ajo'ob u bo'olil u meyajo'ob, yeetel yaan ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil yaaj.

Has the news not reached you, of those who disbelieved before? They tasted the ill consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.

أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**64:6** Lelo' tumen u tuuxtbilo'ob ku taalo'ob ti' letio'ob ka'ach yeetel t'aano'ob saasilo'ob, ba'ale' tu ya'alajo'ob: Wiiniko'ob kun u chiikbesiko'ob k beel? Bey tuuno' ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel tu suutajo'ob u paacho'ob. Ba'ale' Allah mina'an u k'aat ti' mixba'al. Allah leti' le Ayik'al, le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

That is because their messengers came to them with clear explanations, but they said, “Are human beings going to guide us?” So they disbelieved and turned away. But God is in no need. God is Independent and Praiseworthy.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

**64:7** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob letio'ob ma' kun kuxtalbesa'ako'ob. A'ale: Jaaj, tumen in Yuumtsil, kun kuxtalbesa'ake'ex; ka' kun a'ala'ak te'ex tulakal ba'ax ta beetike'ex; yeetel lelo' ma' talam ti' Allah.

Those who disbelieve claim that they will not be resurrected. Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected; then you will be informed of everything you did; and that is easy for God.”

زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

**64:8** Bey tuuno' oksike'ex a woole'ex ti' Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil, yeetel ti' le Saasil To'on k e'esaj. Allah Aj Ojel ti' tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

So believe in God and His Messenger, and the Light which We sent down. God is Aware of everything you do.

فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**64:9** Le k'iin Leti' ku much'ik te'ex utia'al u K'iinil Much'ula'al, lelo' u K'iinil le Koonol Ichil Baaj. Maax ku oksik u yool ti' Allah yeetel ku beetik toh, Leti' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob, yeetel kun u yoksik leti' ichil pak'alo'ob ku jook'ol ja' tu yaanal, u kuxtal te'elo' mantats'. Lelo' le noj naajalil.

The Day when He gathers you for the Day of Gathering—that is the Day of Mutual Exchange. Whoever believes in God and acts with integrity, He will remit his misdeeds, and will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme achievement.

يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**64:10** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku p'ektiko'ob K e'esa'abo'ob, letio'ob le kuxtalo'ob ichil le K'aak', ku kuxtalo'ob te'elo' mantats'; yeetel k'aas u kuuchil p'aatalo'ob.

But as for those who disbelieve and denounce Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Fire, dwelling therein forever; and what a miserable fate!

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**64:11** Mix junp'eel talamil ku yuchul chen wa Allah ku cha'ik. Maax ku oksik u yool ti' Allah, Leti' ku chiikbesik u beel u puksi'ik'al. Allah Aj Ojel tulakal ba'al.

No disaster occurs except by God’s leave. Whoever believes in God, He guides his heart. God is Aware of everything.

مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

**64:12** Bey tuuno' yu'ube'ex Allah, yeetel yu'ube'ex le Tuuxtbil. Ba'ale' wa ka suute'ex a paache'ex, chen yaan yook'ol K Tuuxtbil u ts'aik le tsikbal saasil.

So obey God, and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away—it is only incumbent on Our Messenger to deliver the clear message.

وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

**64:13** Allah, mina'an k'uj cheen Leti'; yeetel yook'ol Allah le aj oksaj oolo'ob u ts'aiko'ob u k'ub oolal.

God, there is no god but He; and in God let the believers put their trust.

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

**64:14** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Ichil a watane'ex yeetel a paalale'ex yaan p'eko'ob ti' te'ex, bey tuuno' kanantike'ex a baaje'ex ti' letio'ob. Ba'ale' wa ka p'atike'ex, yeetel ka cha'ike'ex u maan, yeetel ka sa'atesike'ex, Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O you who believe! Among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, and overlook, and forgive—God is Forgiver and Merciful.
