يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**64:15** A ayik'alile'ex yeetel a paalale'ex chen junp'eel prueba; ba'ale' ti' Allah yaan junp'eel bo'olil jach noj.

Your possessions and your children are a test, but with God is a splendid reward.

إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

**64:16** Bey tuuno' p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil ti' Allah bey tulakal ba'ax ka beeytale'ex, yeetel u'uyike'ex, yeetel yu'ube'ex, yeetel ts'aike'ex utia'al uts ti' a baaje'ex. Maax ku kananta'al ti' le k'aas k'aat yaan ichil u pixan, letio'obo' le aj paakaalo'ob.

So be conscious of God as much as you can, and listen, and obey, and give for your own good. He who is protected from his stinginess—these are the prosperous.

فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

**64:17** Wa ka ts'aike'ex ti' Allah junp'eel ts'a uts, Leti' kun u ya'abbesik ti' te'ex, yeetel kun u sa'ates te'ex a kebane'ex. Allah Aj Ki'iki' T'aan, Aj Ch'a' Ool.

If you lend God a good loan, He will multiply it for you, and will forgive you. God is Appreciative and Forbearing.

إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

**64:18** Le Aj Ojel ti' le ba'ax ma' ku yila'al yeetel le ba'ax ku yila'al, le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Na'at.

The Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the Almighty, the Wise.

عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

## 65. The Divorce

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**65:1** Oo Profeta! Wa juntul ichile'ex ku ja'atsik ko'olelo'ob, ja'atsike'ex letio'ob ka' ma' yaan u k'iinil ko'olel ti' letio'ob, yeetel xotike'ex u k'iino'ob. Yeetel p'aatale'ex yeetel sajkil tu taan Allah, a Yuumtsile'ex. Ma' a jok'sike'ex letio'ob ti' u yotocho'ob, mix letio'ob u jok'olo'ob, chen wa tu beeto'ob k'aas sak meyaj jaaj. Lelo'obo' u xuul Allah — maax ku xotik u beel u xuul Allah tu beetaj k'aas ti' u baje'. Ma' a wojel; je'el u beetik Allah paachil junp'eel tuumben ba'al.

O Prophet! If any of you divorce women, divorce them during their period of purity, and calculate their term. And be pious before God, your Lord. And do not evict them from their homes, nor shall they leave, unless they have committed a proven adultery. These are the limits of God—whoever oversteps God’s limits has wronged his own soul. You never know; God may afterwards bring about a new situation.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا

**65:2** Ka' ts'o'ok u k'uchulo'ob u k'iin, wa p'atike'ex letio'ob yeetel uts, wa luk'sike'ex letio'ob yeetel uts. Yeetel payike'ex ka'ap'eel maako'ob toh ichile'ex utia'al u beetiko'ob testimonio, yeetel ts'aike'ex testimonio toh utia'al Allah. Yeetel lelo' ku kaanbesa'al maax ku oksik u yool ti' Allah yeetel ti' u ts'ook k'in. Yeetel maax ku p'aatal yeetel sajkil ti' Allah — Leti' kun u beetik junp'eel beel jok'ol ti' leti'.

Once they have reached their term, either retain them honorably, or separate from them honorably. And call to witness two just people from among you, and give upright testimony for God. By that is exhorted whoever believes in God and the Last Day. And whoever fears God—He will make a way out for him.

فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَـٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا

**65:3** Yeetel kun u ts'aik ti' leti' ti' tu'ux ma' tu tukultiki'. Maax ku ts'aik u k'ub oolal yook'ol Allah — Leti' chuka'an ti' leti'. Allah kun u ts'ookbesik U meyaj. Allah tu ts'aaj junp'eel p'iis ti' tulakal ba'al.

And will provide for him from where he never expected. Whoever relies on God—He will suffice him. God will accomplish His purpose. God has set a measure to all things.

وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا

**65:4** Yeetel le ko'olelo'ob ichil a ko'olele'ex ts'o'ok u xu'ulul u k'iinil ko'olel ti' letio'ob, wa yaan saajkil te'ex, u k'iino'ob ooxp'eel winal — yeetel bey xan ti' le maaxo'ob ma'ili' u k'uchul u k'iinil ko'olel ti' letio'ob. Yeetel le ko'olelo'ob yo'omo'ob, u k'iino'ob tak ken ku siijil u paalo'ob. Yeetel maax ku p'aatal yeetel sajkil ti' Allah — Leti' kun u beetik ma' talam ba'alo'ob ti' leti'.

As for those of your women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their term shall be three months—and also for those who have not yet menstruated. As for those who are pregnant, their term shall be until they have delivered. Whoever fears God—He will make things easy for him.

وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَـٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًا

**65:5** Lelo' u a'almajt'aan Allah, le tu e'esaj ti' te'ex. Maax ku p'aatal yeetel sajkil ti' Allah — Leti' kun u sa'ates u kebano'ob, yeetel kun u ya'abbesik u bo'olil.

This is the ordinance of God, which He sent down to you. Whoever fears God—He will remit his sins, and will amplify his reward.

ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا

**65:6** Cha'ike'ex letio'ob u kuxtalo'ob tu'ux ka kuxtale'ex, bey a paajtalile'ex, ma' a beetike'ex yaayajil ti' letio'ob utia'al a beetike'ex talam ti' letio'ob. Wa yo'omo'ob, ts'aike'ex ti' letio'ob tak ken ku siijil u paalo'ob. Yeetel wa ku ts'aiko'ob chu'uch ti' a paale'ex, ts'aike'ex ti' letio'ob u bo'olilo'ob. Yeetel beete'ex a meyaje'ex ichile'ex yeetel uts. Ba'ale' wa ma' a much'ik a t'aane'ex, cha'abik u laak' ko'olel u ts'aik chu'uch ti' leti'.

Allow them to reside where you reside, according to your means, and do not harass them in order to make things difficult for them. If they are pregnant, spend on them until they give birth. And if they nurse your infant, give them their payment. And conduct your relation in amity. But if you disagree, then let another woman nurse him.

أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَـٰتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ

**65:7** Le ayik'alo' ka u ts'aik bey u paajtalil; yeetel le maax ma' ya'ab u ba'ax yaan ti', ka u ts'aik bey ba'ax Allah tu ts'aaj ti' leti'. Allah ma' tu ts'aik kuuch ti' mix junp'eel pixan maas ti' ba'ax tu ts'aaj ti' leti'. Allah kun u taasik ma' talamil paachil talamil.

The wealthy shall spend according to his means; and he whose resources are restricted shall spend according to what God has given him. God never burdens a soul beyond what He has given it. God will bring ease after hardship.

لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا

**65:8** Ya'ab kaajo'ob ma' tu yu'ubajo'ob u a'almajt'aan u Yuumtsilo'ob yeetel u tuuxtbilo'ob. Bey tuuno' To'on k ch'a'aj u kuuch chich, yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil jach k'aas.

How many a town defied the command of its Lord and His messengers? So We held it strictly accountable, and We punished it with a dreadful punishment.

وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَـٰهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَـٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

**65:9** Tu yuk'aj u bo'olil u xot t'aano'ob, yeetel u ts'ook u xot t'aano'ob tu bin sa'atal.

It tasted the result of its decisions, and the outcome of its decisions was perdition.

فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا

**65:10** Allah tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil chich. Bey tuuno' kanantike'ex a baaje'ex ti' Allah, oo te'ex maaxo'ob yaan na'at te'ex, yeetel ta oksaje'ex a woole'ex! Allah tu e'esaj ti' te'ex junp'eel k'a'ajsajil.

God has prepared for them a severe retribution. So beware of God, O you who possess intellect and have faith. God has sent down to you a Reminder.

أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا

**65:11** Jun tul tuuxtbil ku xookik ti' te'ex u chiikulo'ob Allah, saasilo'ob yeetel jets'a'ano'ob, utia'al u jok'sik le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh ti' le aak'abo'ob tak tu saasil. Maax ku oksik u yool ti' Allah yeetel ku beetik toh, Leti' kun u yoksik leti' ichil pak'alo'ob ku jook'ol ja' tu yaanal, u kuxtal te'elo' mantats'. Allah tu ts'aaj ti' leti' junp'eel ts'a jach uts.

A messenger who recites to you God’s Verses, clear and distinct, that he may bring those who believe and work righteousness from darkness into light. Whoever believes in God and acts with integrity, He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, therein to abide forever. God has given him an excellent provision.

رَّسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا

**65:12** Allah Leti' Maax tu beetaj ukp'eel ka'ano'ob, yeetel ti' luum bey xan. Le a'almajt'aan ku maan ichil letio'ob, utia'al a wojele'ex Allah Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al, yeetel tulakal ba'al yaan ichil u na'at Allah.

God is He Who created seven heavens, and their like of earth. The command descends through them, so that you may know that God is Capable of everything, and that God Encompasses everything in knowledge.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا

## 66. The Prohibition

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**66:1** Oo Profeta! Ba'axten ka beetik ma' cha'bil ba'ax Allah tu cha'aj ti' teech, ka' ka kaxtik u ki'imaktal u yoolo'ob a watanilo'ob? Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

O prophet! Why do you prohibit what God has permitted for you, seeking to please your wives? God is Forgiving and Merciful.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

**66:2** Allah tu xotaj ti' te'ex u luk'sa'al a hach t'aano'ob. Allah a Yuumile'ex. Leti' le Aj Ojel Tulakal, le maas Aj Na'at ichil tulakal.

God has decreed for you the dissolution of your oaths. God is your Master. He is the All-Knowing, the Most Wise.

قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**66:3** Le Profeta tu ya'alaj junp'eel t'aan ta'akbil ti' juntul ichil u watanilo'ob. Ba'ale' ka' leti' tu ye'esaj, yeetel Allah tu ye'esaj ti' leti', tu ya'alaj jun jaats ti', yeetel tu p'ataj u laak' jaats. Ka' ts'o'ok u ya'alik ti' leti', tu ya'alaj: Maax tu ye'esaj ti' teech lelo'? Tu ya'alaj: Le Aj Ojel Tulakal, le Maax Ku Yojel Tulakal Ba'al tu ye'esaj teen.

The Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. But when she disclosed it, and God made it known to him; he communicated part of it, and he avoided another part. Then, when he informed her of it, she said, “Who informed you of this?” He said, “The All-Knowing, the All-Informed, informed me.”

وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ

**66:4** Wa ka suute'ex a woole'ex ti' Allah, a puksi'ik'ale'ex ts'o'ok u yu'ubiko'ob. Ba'ale' wa ka much'ik a baaje'ex tu contra leti', Allah yaan tu ts'eel leti', yeetel Gabriel, yeetel le aj toh ool aj oksaj oolo'ob. Yeetel xan, le angelo'ob kun u yaantiko'ob leti'.

If you repent to God, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then God is his Ally, as is Gabriel, and the righteous believers. In addition, the angels will assist him.

إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَـٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَـٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ

**66:5** Je'el u yuchul, wa ku ja'atsike'ex, u Yuumtsil kun u ts'aik ti' leti' ichil k'eexil watanilo'ob maas uts ti' te'ex: ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob ti' Allah, aj oksaj oolo'ob, aj tzico'ob, ku suutiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku kultiko'ob, ku suktalo'ob — atanilo'ob taanil, wa ko'olelo'ob ma'ili' atanilo'ob.

Perhaps, if he divorces you, his Lord will give him in exchange wives better than you: submissive, believing, obedient, penitent, devout, fasting—previously married, or virgins.

عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَـٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٍ قَـٰنِتَـٰتٍ تَـٰٓئِبَـٰتٍ عَـٰبِدَٰتٍ سَـٰٓئِحَـٰتٍ ثَيِّبَـٰتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا

**66:6** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Kanantike'ex a baaje'ex yeetel a laak'tsile'ex ti' junp'eel K'aak', u ba'al ku tooka'al ti' leti' maako'ob yeetel tuunicho'ob. Yook'ol leti' yaan angelo'ob, chicho'ob yeetel yaan u muuk'. Ma' tu p'ektiko'ob u a'almajt'aan Allah, yeetel ku beetiko'ob tulakal u a'almajt'aano'ob.

O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire, whose fuel is people and stones. Over it are angels, fierce and powerful. They never disobey God in anything He commands them, and they carry out whatever they are commanded.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

**66:7** Oo te'ex maaxo'ob ma' ta oksaje'ex a woole'ex! Ma' a kaxtike'ex a luk'sa'al bejla'a'. Chen ka bo'ota'ale'ex yo'olal ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

O you who disbelieved! Make no excuses today. You are being repaid for what you used to do.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**66:8** Oo te'ex aj oksaj oolo'ob! Suute'ex a woole'ex ti' Allah yeetel junp'eel suutul jaaj. Je'el u yuchul a Yuumtsile'ex kun u sa'ates a kebane'ex, yeetel kun u yokse'ex ichil pak'alo'ob ku jook'ol ja' tu yaanal, ichil le k'iin Allah ma' kun u subkuuntik le Profeta yeetel le maaxo'ob tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel leti'. U saasilo'ob ku jook'ol taanil ti' letio'ob, yeetel tu no'ojilo'ob, kun u ya'alo'ob: K Yuumtsil, chuukbes to'on k saasil, yeetel sa'atesto'on; Yaan a Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

O you who believe! Repent to God with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remit your sins, and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when God will not disappoint the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light streaming before them, and to their right, they will say, “Our Lord, complete our light for us, and forgive us; You are capable of all things.”

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**66:9** Oo Profeta! Ba'atelneen chich tu contra le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel tu contra le aj ka'ap'el oolo'ob, yeetel p'aatal chich yeetel letio'ob. U yotocho'ob Mitnal. K'aas u kuuchil p'aatalo'ob!

O prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Their abode is Hell. What a miserable destination!

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَـٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**66:10** Allah ku e'esik junp'eel bey ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: u watanil Noah yeetel u watanil Lot. Tu p'aatalo'ob yaanal ka'ap'eel K palilo'ob aj toh oolo'ob, ba'ale' tu beeto'ob tus ti' letio'ob. Ma' tu beetajo'ob uts ti' letio'ob mixba'al tu taan Allah, yeetel a'ala'ab: O'okene'ex ichil le K'aak' yeetel le maaxo'ob ku yokolo'ob.

God illustrates an example of those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants, but they betrayed them. They availed them nothing against God, and it was said, “Enter the Fire with those who are entering.”

ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ

**66:11** Yeetel Allah ku e'esik junp'eel bey ti' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob: u watanil Pharaoh, ka' tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, beet teen, yaanal teech, junp'eel naj ichil le Pak'alo', yeetel luk'seen ti' Pharaoh yeetel u meyajo'ob, yeetel luk'seen ti' le maako'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas.

And God illustrates an example of those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”

وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

**66:12** Yeetel Mary, u paal ko'olel Imran, tu kanantaj u baaj, bey tuuno' To'on k ts'aaj iik' ichil leti' ti' K Pixan; yeetel tu oksaj u yool ti' u jaajil u t'aano'ob u Yuumtsil yeetel U Aanalte'o'ob, yeetel tu p'aatal ichil le aj tzico'ob.

And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her womb, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit; and she believed in the truth of her Lord’s Words and His Books, and was one of the devout.

وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ

## 67. The Sovereignty

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**67:1** Bendisiionta'an le Maax tu k'ab yaan u jalbesil, yeetel Yaan u Muuk' yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and Who has power over everything.

تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

**67:2** Leti' Maax tu beetaj kiimil yeetel kuxtal, utia'al u ts'aabal prueba ti' te'ex, maax ichile'ex maas uts u meyaj. Leti' le Yaan Muuk', le Aj Sa'atesaj.

He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

**67:3** Leti' Maax tu beetaj ukp'eel ka'ano'ob, junp'eel yook'ol u laak'. Ma' a wilik mixba'al ma' p'iis ichil ba'ax tu beetaj le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil. Paakat tu ka'ateen. Je'el a wilik wa yaan k'ebano'ob wa?

He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks?

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ

**67:4** Ka' paakat tu ka'ateen, yeetel tu ka'ateen, a wich kun suut tech, xok'ol a wich yeetel k'oja'an a wich.

Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted.

ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ

**67:5** To'on k ki'ichpantaj le ka'an yaanal yeetel ba'alo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob saasil, To'on k beetajo'ob bey ba'ax ku pulbil tu contra le Kisino'obo', yeetel To'on k ts'ookbesaj ti' letio'ob u yaayajil le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**67:6** Ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool ti' u Yuumtsil yaan u yaayajil Mitnal. Jach k'aas tu'ux ku k'uchulo'ob!

For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of Hell. What an evil destination!

وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**67:7** Ka' ku pulbilo'ob ichil, kun u yu'ubiko'ob u juum bey ku wok'ol.

When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes.

إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ

**67:8** Ku naats' u p'ektal tumen u k'iinamil. Tulakal u teenel ken pulbil junp'eel muuch' ichil, u aj kanano'ob kun u k'aatiko'ob ti' letio'ob: Ma' taal jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' te'ex wa?

It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, “Has no warner come to you?”

تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ

**67:9** Kun u ya'aliko'ob: Jaaj, taal jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan ti' to'on, chen To'on ma' k oksaj k ool, To'on k ya'alaj: Allah ma' tu e'esaj mixba'al yaanal; te'ex jach a sa'at a beele'ex.

They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, ‘God did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.’”

قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ

**67:10** Yeetel kun u ya'aliko'ob: Wa To'on k yu'ubik wa k tukultik ka'ach, ma' To'on ichil le maaxo'ob ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'alo'.

And they will say, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze.”

وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**67:11** Bey tuuno' kun u ya'aliko'ob u kebano'ob jaaj. Ka' luk'uko'ob le maaxo'ob ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'alo'!

So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze.

فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

**67:12** Le maaxo'ob ku sajko'ob u Yuumtsil kex ma' ku yila'alo'ob, ti' letio'ob yaan sa'atesa'al keban yeetel junp'eel noj bo'olil.

As for those who fear their Lord in secret—for them is forgiveness and a great reward.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

**67:13** Kex a ta'akike'ex a t'aano'ob wa a ya'alike'ex tu paakat tulakal, Leti' Aj Ojel ti' le ba'ax ichil a puksi'ik'ale'ex.

Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them—He is Aware of the inner thoughts.

وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**67:14** Ma' u yojel wa, Leti' Maax tu beetaj tulakal? Leti' le Maax ku yilik le ba'ax ma' chika'ani', le Maax u yojel tulakal ba'al.

Would He not know, He Who created? He is the Refined, the Expert.

أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ

**67:15** Leti' Maax tu beetaj le luum ma' talam ti' te'ex, bey tuuno' ximbale'ex ichil u xee xee tu'uxilo'ob, yeetel jaante'ex ti' ba'ax Tu ts'aik. Ti' Leti' le Liksajilo'.

It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ

**67:16** A chuka'an a yoole'ex wa le Maax ichil le ka'an ma' kun u luubsik le luum yaanal te'ex ka' ku suut u baaj?

Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?

ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ

**67:17** Wa a chuka'an a yoole'ex wa le Maax ichil Ka'an ma' kun u taasik tu contra te'ex junp'eel chich iik' yeetel tuunich? Bey tuuno' kun a wojele'ex bey u nuuktal in k'a'ay a'almajt'aan.

Or are you confident that the One in Heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like.

أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ

**67:18** Le maaxo'ob a paachilo'ob tu ya'alajo'ob ma' jaaj lelo' xan; yeetel bey jan in p'ek ti' letio'ob?

Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval?

وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

**67:19** Ma' tu yilo'ob le ch'iich'o'ob yook'olo'ob, ku xit'iko'ob u xiik'o'ob, yeetel ku mooko'ob wa? Mix maax ku kanantik letio'ob chen le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil. Leti' ku yilik tulakal ba'al.

Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ

**67:20** Wa maax lela', junp'eel muuk' ti' te'ex, ku kanantike'ex tu contra le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil? Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool chen ichil tuus yaaniko'ob.

Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.

أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ

**67:21** Wa maax lela' kun u ts'aik te'ex ba'ax k'a'abeet ti' a kuxtale'ex, wa Leti' ku kalik ba'ax Tu ts'aik? Chen letio'ob ku p'aatalo'ob ichil ma' tzic yeetel p'ek.

Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion.

أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ

**67:22** Leti' maax ku ximbal ku luubul u wich yook'ol u tuukulil u baaj, maas uts chiikbesa'an, wa leti' maax ku ximbal toh yook'ol junp'eel toh beel?

Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?

أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**67:23** A'ale: Leti' Maax tu beetaj te'ex, yeetel Tu ts'aaj te'ex xikin utia'al a yu'ubike'ex, yeetel wich utia'al a wile'ex, yeetel puksi'ik'al. Chen jun p'iit a ts'aike'ex gracias.

Say, “It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.”

قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

**67:24** A'ale: Leti' Maax tu xit'aj te'ex yook'ol le luum, yeetel ti' Leti' kun a muuch'besa'ale'ex.

Say, “It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up.”

قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

**67:25** Yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax teenel kun ts'o'okol le promesa lela', wa te'ex aj jaaj t'aano'ob?

And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”

وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**67:26** A'ale: Le ba'ax ku yojela'al chen ti' Allah yaan, yeetel teen chen jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan saasil.

Say, “Knowledge is with God, and I am only a clear warner.”

قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**67:27** Chen ka' kun u yilo'ob u naats'atal, u wicho'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yool kun u beetiko'ob k'aas wich, yeetel kun a'ala'ak: Lela' ba'ax a k'aatik ka'ach.

But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”

فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ

**67:28** A'ale: A wilo'ob wa? Wa Allah ku beetik in kiimil, yeetel le maaxo'ob yeetelen, wa Tu ts'aik to'on U yatzil, maax kun u kanantik le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool ti' junp'eel yaayajil ku yajbesik?

Say, “Have you considered? Should God make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**67:29** A'ale: Leti' le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil. To'on k oksaj k ool ti' Leti', yeetel yook'ol Leti' k ts'aik k k'ub oolal. Ma' ya'ab u xuul kun a wojele'ex maax ichil junp'eel chika'an sa'atal.

Say, “He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error.”

قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

**67:30** A'ale: A wilo'ob wa? Wa a ja'e'ex ku bin yaanal, maax kun u taasik te'ex ja' saasil ku bin u beel?

Say, “Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ

## 68. The Pen

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**68:1** Noon. Tumen le ba'al ku ts'iibta'al yeetel, yeetel ba'ax ku ts'iibtiko'ob.

Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe.

نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ

**68:2** Tumen u siibal a Yuumtsil, teech ma' aj ch'een tuukul.

By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.

مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ

**68:3** Jaaj, ti' teech yaan junp'eel bo'olil mina'an u xuul.

In fact, you will have a reward that will never end.

وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ

**68:4** Yeetel teech jach uts a tuukul yeetel a meyaj.

And you are of a great moral character.

وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

**68:5** Kun a wilik, yeetel kun u yilo'ob.

You will see, and they will see.

فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ

**68:6** Maax ichile'ex le maax yaan u yajil.

Which of you is the afflicted.

بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ

**68:7** A Yuumtsil maas u yojel maax tu sa'at u baaj ti' U beel, yeetel Leti' maas u yojel le maaxo'ob uts chiikbesa'ano'ob.

Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided.

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

**68:8** Bey tuuno' ma' a tzic le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le jaajo'.

So do not obey the deniers.

فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**68:9** U k'aato'ob wa teech a beetik ba'ax ku p'iisik ti' letio'ob, bey tuuno' letio'ob kun u beetiko'ob ba'ax ku p'iisik ti' teech.

They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise.

وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ

**68:10** Yeetel ma' a tzic mix jun tul aj ya'ab hach t'aan, aj p'ekbil.

And do not obey any vile swearer.

وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ

**68:11** Aj t'aan paachil, aj xit'ik k'aas t'aan.

Backbiter, spreader of slander.

هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ

**68:12** Aj kalik uts, aj xot beel, aj keban.

Preventer of good, transgressor, sinner.

مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

**68:13** Aj ma' uts u t'aan, yeetel aj tuus u baaj xan.

Rude and fake besides.

عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

**68:14** Chen tumen yaan u taak'in yeetel u paalalo'ob.

Just because he has money and children.

أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ

**68:15** Ka' ku xokbil ti' leti' le chiikulo'ob To'on, ku ya'alik: U tsikbalo'ob le maaxo'ob a paachil!

When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, “Myths of the ancients!”

إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**68:16** To'on kun k ts'aik junp'eel chiikul yook'ol u ni'.

We will brand him on the muzzle.

سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ

**68:17** To'on k ts'aaj prueba ti' letio'ob, bey To'on k ts'aaj prueba ti' le maaxo'ob u yuumilo'ob le pak'alo', ka' tu ya'alajo'ob hach t'aan u luk'siko'ob u yich ja'atskaab.

We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning.

إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

**68:18** Yeetel mixba'al tu p'aatajo'ob paachil.

Without any reservation.

وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ

**68:19** Chen junp'eel k'aas ba'al taal ti' a Yuumtsil tu maan yook'ol ka' taan u wenelo'ob.

But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept.

فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ

**68:20** Yeetel ja'atskaab p'aat bey ts'o'ok u luk'sa'al tulakal u yich.

And in the morning it was as if picked.

فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ

**68:21** Ja'atskaab tu payaj u baajo'ob.

In the morning, they called to one another.

فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ

**68:22** Bin a beele'ex seeb ti' a pak'ale'ex, wa kun a luk'sike'ex u yich.

“Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest.”

أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ

**68:23** Bey tuuno' bino'ob, ku t'aano'ob ichil u baajo'ob.

So off they went, murmuring to one another.

فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ

**68:24** Mix jun tul ootsil maako'ob u yokol te'ex bejla'e'.

“No poor person is to enter it upon you today.”

أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ

**68:25** Yeetel seeb bino'ob, ts'oka'an u tuukulo'ob u beetiko'ob.

And early they went, resolved in intent.

وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ

**68:26** Chen ka' tu yilo'ob, tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on k sa'at k beel.

But when they saw it, they said, “We were wrong.

فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ

**68:27** To'on bejla'a mina'an to'on mixba'al.

We are now deprived.”

بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

**68:28** Le maax maas na'at ichilo'ob tu ya'alaj: Ma' tin wa'alaj ti' te'ex wa, wa chen ki'iki' t'aantike'ex?

The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘if only you would glorify?’”

قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

**68:29** Tu ya'alajo'ob: Ki'iki' t'aan ti' k Yuumtsil — To'on jaaj k beetaj k'aas.

They said, “Glory to our Lord—We were indeed in the wrong.”

قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

**68:30** Ka' tu sutaj u baajo'ob lak'in ti' lak'in, ku ya'aliko'ob k'aas ti' u baajo'ob.

Then they turned to one another, blaming one another.

فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ

**68:31** Tu ya'alajo'ob: K'aas ti' to'on — To'on jaaj aj chich kabo'ob.

They said, “Woe to us—we were indeed domineering.

قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ

**68:32** Je'el u beetik k Yuumtsil u ts'aik to'on junp'eel maas uts tu kuuchil lelo'. To'on k sutik k baaj ti' k Yuumtsil.

Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord.”

عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

**68:33** Bey le yaayajilo'. Yeetel u yaayajil le u laak' kuxtalo' maas noj, wa ku yojelo'ob ka'ach.

Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

**68:34** Ti' le aj toh oolo'ob yaan Pak'alo'ob ti' Siibal ti' u Yuumtsil.

For the righteous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.

إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**68:35** To'on k beetik le musulmano'ob bey le aj k'aas meyajo'ob wa?

Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains?

أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**68:36** Ba'ax yaan te'ex? Bey a xotike'ex t'aan?

What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

**68:37** Wa yaan te'ex junp'eel ju'un tu'ux ku kaanbesa'ale'ex?

Or do you have a scripture in which you study.

أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

**68:38** Ichil yaan tulakal ba'ax a yeeyike'ex wa?

Wherein there is whatever you choose?

إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

**68:39** Wa yaan te'ex hach t'aano'ob ti' To'on, ku p'aatalo'ob tak u K'iinil Liksajil, jaaj te'ex kun a k'amike'ex tulakal ba'ax a xotike'ex t'aan?

Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?

أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

**68:40** K'aat ti' letio'ob, maax ichilo'ob kun u beetik u baaj aj kanan yo'olal lelo'.

Ask them, which of them will guarantee that.

سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

**68:41** Wa yaan u lak'o'ob ti' letio'ob? Bey tuuno' ka' taaso'ob u lak'o'ob, wa letio'ob aj jaaj t'aano'ob.

Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.

أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ

**68:42** Le K'iin ken u ye'esa'al u yok, yeetel kun paybilo'ob u luubulo'ob yook'ol u piixo'ob, chen ma' kun u beeytalo'ob.

On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable.

يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

**68:43** U wicho'ob luuba'ano'ob, u p'ek kun u chuupbesik letio'ob. Tu payajo'ob u luubulo'ob yook'ol u piixo'ob ka' taan uts u kuxtalo'ob.

Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound.

خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ

**68:44** Bey tuuno' p'at teen le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le t'aana', To'on kun k maan tu contra letio'ob jun p'iit jun p'iit, ti' tu'ux ma' u yojelo'ob.

So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know.

فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**68:45** Yeetel kun in ts'aik ti' letio'ob u k'iin. In tuukul jach chich.

And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.

وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ

**68:46** Wa teech a k'aatik ti' letio'ob junp'eel bo'olil, bey tuuno' letio'ob ku chuupbesa'alo'ob tumen taak'in k'aatbo'ob?

Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt?

أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

**68:47** Wa letio'ob u yojelo'ob le ba'ax ma' yila'abi', bey tuuno' ku ts'iibtiko'ob?

Or do they know the future, and so they write it down?

أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

**68:48** Bey tuuno' p'aatal yeetel na'at tak u Xot T'aan a Yuumtsil, yeetel ma' a beyik le Maax ti' le Kay, maax tu t'aan ka' taan u k'aas oolal.

So wait patiently for the Decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.

فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ

**68:49** Wa ma' u siibal u Yuumtsil u k'uchul ti' leti' ka'ach, kun pulbil ichil le k'aax luum, p'ekbil tulakal.

Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.

لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

**68:50** Chen u Yuumtsil tu yeeyaj, yeetel Tu beetaj leti' jun tul ichil le aj toh oolo'ob.

But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.

فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

**68:51** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool ku naats' u xotiko'ob teech yeetel u wicho'ob ka' ku yu'ubiko'ob le k'a'ajsajo', yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob: Leti' aj ch'een tuukul!

Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, “He is crazy!”

وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ

**68:52** Chen lelo' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' tulakal kaabo'ob.

But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds.

وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

## 69. The Inevitable Reality

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**69:1** Le Jaaj K'uchulo'.

The Reality.

ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

**69:2** Ba'ax le Jaaj K'uchulo'?

What is the Reality?

مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

**69:3** Ba'ax kun u beetik a na'atik ba'ax le Jaaj K'uchulo'?

What will make you understand what the Reality is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

**69:4** Thamood yeetel Aad tu ya'alajo'ob ma' jaaj le K'aas K'uchulo'.

Thamood and Aad denied the Catastrophe.

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ

**69:5** Bey Thamood, letio'ob xuulsa'ano'ob tumen le Ma' Kalan Ba'alo'.

As for Thamood, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.

فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ

**69:6** Yeetel bey Aad, letio'ob xuulsa'ano'ob tumen junp'eel iik' chich yeetel ku juum jach.

And as for Aad; they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind.

وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

**69:7** Tu pulaj leti' yook'ol letio'ob ukp'eel aak'ab yeetel waxakp'eel k'iin, junp'eel paachil ti' u laak'. Je'el a wilik le maako'ob pulbilo'ob tu baaj, bey chuuno'ob che' mina'an u yoolo'ob.

He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, in succession. You could see the people tossed around, as though they were stumps of hollow palm-trees.

سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

**69:8** Je'el a wilik wa mixba'al p'aata'an ti' letio'ob?

Can you see any remnant of them?

فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ

**69:9** Ka' taal Pharaoh, yeetel le maaxo'ob taanil ti' leti', yeetel le Kaajo'ob Sutbesa'ano'ob ichil keban.

Then Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the Overturned Cities steeped in sin.

وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

**69:10** Ba'ale' ma' tu tzicajo'ob u tuuxtbil u Yuumtsil, bey tuuno' Leti' tu ch'a'aj letio'ob yeetel junp'eel ch'a' ma' kalan u muuk'.

But they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.

فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

**69:11** Ka' le ja'o'ob tu sen ya'abtalo'ob, To'on k bisaj te'ex ichil le cheem ku bin.

When the waters overflowed, We carried you in the cruising ship.

إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

**69:12** U tia'al k beetik leti' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj ti' te'ex, bey xikino'ob ku p'atiko'ob ba'ax ku yu'ubiko'ob kun u p'atiko'ob leti'.

To make it a lesson for you—so that retaining ears may retain it.

لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

**69:13** Ka' le trompeta kun juumsa'ak junp'eel teenel.

Then, when the Trumpet is sounded a single time.

فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

**69:14** Yeetel le luum yeetel le wits'o'ob kun lik'sa'ako'ob, yeetel kun yaach'alo'ob junp'eel yaach' teenel.

And the earth and the mountains are lifted up, and crushed, with a single crush.

وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً

**69:15** Ichil le k'iino', le Ba'al Kun Uchulo' kun u yuchul.

On that Day, the Event will come to pass.

فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

**69:16** Yeetel le ka'an kun u xet' u baaj; bey ichil le k'iino' kun p'aatal ma' chich.

And the heaven will crack; so on that Day it will be frail.

وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ

**69:17** Yeetel le angelo'ob kun wa'akunsa'ako'ob yook'ol u xeet'o'ob, ka waxak tul kun u kuchiko'ob u Ts'am a Yuumtsil yook'ol letio'ob ichil le k'iino'.

And the angels will be ranged around its borders, while eight will be carrying the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.

وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ

**69:18** Ichil le k'iino' kun e'esa'ake'ex, yeetel mixba'al ta'akbil ti' te'ex kun p'aatal ta'akbil.

On that Day you will be exposed, and no secret of yours will remain hidden.

يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

**69:19** Bey le maax ku ts'a'abal u aanalte' ichil u noj k'ab, kun u ya'alik: Wa'ale'ex, ch'a'e'ex in aanalte' yeetel xoke'ex leti'.

As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, “Here, take my book and read it.

فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

**69:20** Teen in wojel ka'ach kun in nupik in wa'atal.

I knew I would be held accountable.”

إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

**69:21** Bey leti' kun p'aatal ichil junp'eel kuxtal uts.

So he will be in pleasant living.

فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

**69:22** Ichil junp'eel Pak'al ka'anal.

In a lofty Garden.

فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

**69:23** U yicho'ob naats' u ch'a'abalo'ob.

Its pickings are within reach.

قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ

**69:24** Jaane'ex yeetel uk'ule'ex yeetel ki'imak oolal tumen ba'ax ta beetike'ex ichil le k'iino'ob ts'o'ok u maano'obo'.

“Eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by.”

كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

**69:25** Ba'ale' le maax ku ts'a'abal u aanalte' ichil u ts'ik k'ab, kun u ya'alik: Uts ka'ach ma' ts'a'abil teen in aanalte'.

But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, “I wish I was never given my book.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

**69:26** Yeetel ma' in wojel ka'ach ba'ax in wa'atal.

And never knew what my account was.

وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

**69:27** Uts ka'ach wa lelo' le ts'o'oko'.

If only it was the end.

يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ

**69:28** In taak'in ma' tu beeytik mixba'al utia'al teen.

My money cannot avail me.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ

**69:29** In jalbesil ts'o'ok u sa'atal teen.

My power has vanished from me.”

هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ

**69:30** Ch'a'e'ex leti' yeetel k'axe'ex leti'.

“Take him and shackle him.

خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

**69:31** Ka' eele'ex leti' ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

Then scorch him in the Blaze.

ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

**69:32** Ka' ichil junp'eel k'aan chowak, u p'iis oox k'aal yeetel lajun p'iis k'ab, k'axe'ex leti' ichil.

Then in a chain which length is seventy cubits tie him up.

ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

**69:33** Tumen leti' ma' tu oksik u yool ti' Allah, le Noj.

For he would not believe in God the Great.

إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**69:34** Yeetel ma' tu k'a'aybesik u ts'a'abal janal ti' le ootsil maako'ob.

Nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**69:35** Bey mina'an ti' leti' mix jun tul yet-maak bejla'a waye'.

So he has no friend here today.

فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ

**69:36** Yeetel mina'an janal chen le k'aas jook'ol ba'alo'.

And no food except scum.

وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ

**69:37** Le aj kebano'ob chen kun u jaantiko'ob leti'.

Which only the sinners eat.”

لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ

**69:38** Jaaj, Teen, tumen ba'ax ka wile'ex.

Indeed, I swear by what you see.

فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**69:39** Yeetel tumen ba'ax ma' ka wile'ex.

And by what you do not see.

وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

**69:40** Lelo' u t'aan jun tul tuuxtbil nojbe'en.

It is the speech of a noble messenger.

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

**69:41** Yeetel ma' u t'aan jun tul aj ki'ichpam t'aan; chan p'iit a oksike'ex a woole'ex.

And it is not the speech of a poet—little do you believe.

وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

**69:42** Mix u t'aan jun tul aj waay; chan p'iit a k'a'ajsike'ex.

Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer—little do you take heed.

وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

**69:43** Lelo' ba'ax e'esa'ab ti' U Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**69:44** Wa leti' tu tus a'alaj yaan t'aano'ob yook'ol To'on.

Had he falsely attributed some statements to Us.

وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ

**69:45** To'on k ch'a'aj leti' tumen u noj k'ab.

We would have seized him by the right arm.

لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ

**69:46** Ka' To'on k xotaj u beel u kuxtal.

Then slashed his lifeline.

ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ

**69:47** Yeetel mix jun tul ichile'ex je'el u kanantik leti' ti' To'on.

And none of you could have restrained Us from him.

فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

**69:48** Jaaj, lelo' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al le aj toh oolo'ob.

Surely, it is a message for the righteous.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

**69:49** Yeetel To'on k ojel yaan ichile'ex maaxo'ob kun u ya'aliko'ob ma' jaaj leti'.

And We know that some of you will reject it.

وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

**69:50** Yeetel lelo' jaaj junp'eel yaaj oolal utia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool.

And it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

**69:51** Yeetel lelo' le jaaj jaajili'.

Yet it is the absolute truth.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**69:52** Bey ki'iki' t'aante u k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le Nojbe'en.

So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.

فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

## 70. The Ways of Ascent

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**70:1** Jun tul aj k'aat tu k'aataj yo'olal le yaayajil ku taal.

A questioner questioned the imminent torment.

سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ

**70:2** U tia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool; mix maax je'el u sutik paach leti'.

For the disbelievers; none can repel it.

لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ

**70:3** Ti' Allah, u Yuumtsil le Beelo'ob Na'akal.

From God, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.

مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ

**70:4** Ti' Leti' ku na'akalo'ob le angelo'ob yeetel le Pixano' ichil junp'eel k'iin, u p'iis ka'ap'eel k'aal mil yeetel lajun mil ja'abo'ob.

Unto Him the angels and the Spirit ascend on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.

تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

**70:5** Bey ch'a'e muk' yeetel uts oolal.

So be patient, with sweet patience.

فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

**70:6** Letio'ob ku yilo'ob leti' naach.

They see it distant.

إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا

**70:7** Ba'ale' To'on k ilik leti' naats'.

But We see it near.

وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا

**70:8** Ichil le k'iin le ka'an kun p'aatal bey ba'al ku lokol.

On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass.

يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ

**70:9** Yeetel le wits'o'ob kun p'aatalo'ob bey tso'ots ku xit'ik u baaj.

And the mountains will be like tufted wool.

وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ

**70:10** Mix jun tul yet-maak kun u k'aat ti' u yet-maak.

No friend will care about his friend.

وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا

**70:11** Kun e'esa'ako'ob u baajo'ob. Le aj keban ku k'aatik u luk'sa'al u baaj ti' u yaayajil le k'iino' tumen u paalalo'ob.

They will be shown each other. The criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

**70:12** Yeetel u atan, yeetel u suku'un.

And his spouse, and his brother.

وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ

**70:13** Yeetel u laak'tsilo'ob tu kanantajo'ob leti' ka'ach.

And his family that sheltered him.

وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ

**70:14** Yeetel tulakal maax yook'ol luum, utia'al u luk'sik u baaj.

And everyone on earth, in order to save him.

وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

**70:15** Ma' beyi'! Lelo' junp'eel K'aak' ku tooka'al chich.

By no means! It is a Raging Fire.

كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

**70:16** Ku luk'sik u oot'el u poolo'ob.

It strips away the scalps.

نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ

**70:17** Ku payik le maax tu sutaj u paach yeetel puuts' ka'ach.

It invites him who once turned his back and fled.

تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

**70:18** Yeetel tu much'aj yeetel tu ta'akaj.

And accumulated and hoarded.

وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ

**70:19** Le wiinik beeta'ab mina'an u jets' oolal.

Man was created restless.

۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

**70:20** Ka' k'aas ba'al ku taal ti' leti', ku yaajtal u yool.

Touched by adversity, he is fretful.

إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا

**70:21** Yeetel ka' uts ba'al ku taal ti' leti', ma' tu ts'aik ti' u laak'.

Touched by good, he is ungenerous.

وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

**70:22** Chen le maaxo'ob ku payalchi'o'ob.

Except the prayerful.

إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

**70:23** Le maaxo'ob ku p'aatalo'ob mantats' ichil u payalchi'o'ob.

Those who are constant at their prayers.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ

**70:24** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ichil u ayik'alil yaan junp'eel jaats ojela'an u ti'al u laak'.

And those in whose wealth is a rightful share.

وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ

**70:25** U tia'al le aj k'aat yeetel le maax mina'an ti' mixba'al.

For the beggar and the deprived.

لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

**70:26** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob jaaj u K'iinil Xot K'in.

And those who affirm the Day of Judgment.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

**70:27** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku sajko'ob u yaayajil u Yuumtsil.

And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

**70:28** U yaayajil u Yuumtsil ma' u ti'al u tukulta'al bey mina'an.

Their Lord’s punishment is not to be taken for granted.

إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ

**70:29** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kanantiko'ob u baajo'ob toh.

And those who guard their chastity.

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ

**70:30** Chen ti' u atano'ob wa le maaxo'ob yaan tu k'ab u jalbesil, tumen ka' ma' yaan p'ek yook'ol letio'ob.

Except from their spouses or those living under their control, for then they are free of blame.

إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

**70:31** Ba'ale' maax ku kaxtik u bin maas paachil ti' lelo', letio'obo' le aj maan p'iiso'ob.

But whoever seeks to go beyond that—these are the transgressors.

فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

**70:32** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kanantiko'ob ba'ax ts'a'abil ti' letio'ob u kananto'ob yeetel u promesao'ob.

And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

**70:33** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku wa'atalo'ob tumen u testimonio'ob.

And those who stand by their testimonies.

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ

**70:34** Yeetel le maaxo'ob ku kanantiko'ob u payalchi'o'ob.

And those who are dedicated to their prayers.

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

**70:35** Letio'obo' kun p'aatalo'ob yeetel nojbe'enil ichil Pak'alo'ob.

These will be honored in Gardens.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ

**70:36** Ba'ax yaan ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool, ku xit'iko'ob u kaalo'ob ti' teech?

What is with those who disbelieve, stretching their necks towards you.

فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

**70:37** Ti' le noj ts'eel yeetel ti' le ts'ik ts'eel, bey muuch'o'ob?

From the right, and from the left, banding together?

عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

**70:38** Tulakal jun tul ichilo'ob ku tukultik wa kun okbesa'ak ichil junp'eel Pak'al Ki'imak Oolal?

Is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ

**70:39** Ma' beyi'! To'on k beetaj letio'ob ti' ba'ax u yojelo'ob.

No indeed! We created them from what they know.

كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

**70:40** Teen, tumen u Yuumtsil le lik'ino'ob yeetel le chik'ino'ob, jaaj To'on yaan k Muuk'.

I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We are Able.

فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

**70:41** U tia'al k k'eexik letio'ob yeetel maako'ob maas uts ti' letio'ob, yeetel mix maax je'el u maan yook'ol To'on.

To replace them with better than they, and We are not to be outdone.

عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

**70:42** Bey p'atike'ex letio'ob u tusiko'ob u baajo'ob yeetel u baaxalo'ob, tak ken u nupiko'ob u K'iino'ob, le k'iin ts'a'abil ti' letio'ob bey promesa.

So leave them to blunder and play, until they meet their Day which they are promised.

فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

**70:43** Le k'iin ken ku jook'olo'ob ti' le muulo'ob seeb, bey wa ku bino'ob seeb ti' junp'eel ba'al jets'a'an.

The Day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush, as though they were hurrying towards a target.

يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

**70:44** U wicho'ob luuba'ano'ob; subtal ku chuupbesik letio'ob. Lelo' le k'iin a'ala'ab ti' letio'ob ka'ach bey promesa.

Their eyes cast down; overwhelmed by humiliation. This is the Day which they were promised.

خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

## 71. Noah

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**71:1** To'on k tuuxtaj Noah ti' u kaajal: K'a'aybes a'almajt'aan ti' a kaajal taanil ti' u taal junp'eel yaayajil ku yajbesik yook'ol letio'ob.

We sent Noah to his people: “Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment.”

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

**71:2** Tu ya'alaj: Oo in kaajal, teen ti' te'ex jun tul aj k'a'ay a'almajt'aan saasil.

He said, “O my people, I am to you a clear warner.

قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**71:3** Kultike'ex Allah, yeetel sajke'ex Leti', yeetel tzice'ex teen.

Worship God and reverence Him, and obey me.

أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**71:4** Leti' kun u sa'atesik te'ex ti' a kebane'ex, yeetel kun u cha'ik te'ex a p'aatal tak junp'eel k'iin jets'a'an. U k'iinil Allah, ka' ku taal, ma' je'el u pa'atik paachil, wa a wojele'ex ka'ach.

And He will forgive you of your sins, and reprieve you until a stated term. God’s term cannot be deferred once it has arrived, if you only knew.”

يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**71:5** Tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, tin t'anaj in kaajal ak'ab yeetel k'iin.

He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day.

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

**71:6** Ba'ale' in t'aan chen tu ya'abbesaj u puuts'ulo'ob.

But my call added only to their flight.

فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا

**71:7** Tulakal u teenel tin t'anaj letio'ob utia'al a sa'atesik letio'ob, tu ts'aajo'ob u yaal k'abo'ob ichil u xikino'ob, yeetel tu pixaj u baajo'ob yeetel u nook'o'ob, yeetel tu chichkuntaj u baajo'ob, yeetel sen ka'analtal u yoolo'ob.

Whenever I called them to Your forgiveness, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves in their garments, and insisted, and became more and more arrogant.

وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا

**71:8** Ka' tin t'anaj letio'ob tu paakat tulakal.

Then I called them openly.

ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

**71:9** Ka' tin k'a'aybesaj ti' letio'ob tu paakat tulakal, yeetel tin t'anaj ti' letio'ob ta'akbil.

Then I appealed to them publicly, and I spoke to them privately.

ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا

**71:10** Tin ya'alaj: K'aate'ex sa'atesa'al ti' a Yuumtsile'ex; Leti' Aj Sa'atesaj.

I said, ‘Ask your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.

فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

**71:11** Leti' kun u k'axbesik le ka'an yook'ol te'ex yeetel ya'ab ja'.

He will let loose the sky upon you in torrents.

يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

**71:12** Yeetel kun u ts'aik te'ex ayik'alil yeetel paalal, yeetel kun u ts'aik te'ex pak'alo'ob, yeetel kun u ts'aik te'ex ja'o'ob ku bino'ob.

And provide you with wealth and children, and allot for you gardens, and allot for you rivers.

وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا

**71:13** Ba'ax yaan te'ex, ma' a p'iisike'ex u Nojil Allah?

What is the matter with you, that you do not appreciate God’s Greatness?

مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

**71:14** Kex Leti' tu beetaj te'ex jejelaas paachilo'ob.

Although He created you in stages.

وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

**71:15** Ma' a na'atike'ex wa Allah tu beetaj ukp'eel ka'ano'ob, junp'eel yook'ol u laak'?

Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers?

أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا

**71:16** Yeetel Tu ts'aaj le uj ichilo'ob utia'al saasil, yeetel Tu beetaj le k'in bey junp'eel ba'al ku ts'aik saasil.

And He set the moon in their midst for light, and He made the sun a lamp.

وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا

**71:17** Yeetel Allah tu ch'iijbesaj te'ex ti' le luum bey pak'alo'ob ku ch'iijil.

And God germinated you from the earth like plants.

وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا

**71:18** Ka' Leti' kun u sutik te'ex ichil, yeetel kun u jook'sik te'ex tu ka'ateen.

Then He will return you into it, and will bring you out again.

ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا

**71:19** Yeetel Allah tu beetaj le luum bey junp'eel ba'al xit'a'an utia'al te'ex.

And God made the earth a spread for you.

وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا

**71:20** U tia'al a ximbale'ex ichil u jejelaas beelo'ob.

That you may travel its diverse roads.’”

لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا

**71:21** Noah tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, letio'ob ma' tu tzicajo'ob teen, yeetel tu bin paachil ti' le maax u ayik'alil yeetel u paalal chen ku ya'abbesiko'ob u sa'atalil.

Noah said, “My Lord, they have defied me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition.”

قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

**71:22** Yeetel tu tukultajo'ob noj tuuso'ob.

And they schemed outrageous schemes.

وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

**71:23** Yeetel tu ya'alajo'ob: Ma' a p'atike'ex a k'ujo'ob; ma' a p'atike'ex Wadd, mix Souwa, mix Yaghoos, yeetel Yaooq, yeetel Nassr.

And they said, “Do not give up your gods; do not give up Wadd, nor Souwa, nor Yaghoos, and Yaooq, and Nassr.

وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

**71:24** Tu sa'ato'ob u beel ya'ab maako'ob, bey tuuno' ma' a ya'abbesik le aj ma' toh oolo'ob chen ichil sa'atal beel.

They have misled many, so do not increase the wrongdoers except in confusion.”

وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا

**71:25** Tumen u kebano'ob, buulo'ob ichil ja', yeetel pulbilo'ob ichil junp'eel K'aak'. Ma' tu kaxtajo'ob mix jun tul aj aantaj paachil ti' Allah.

Because of their wrongs, they were drowned, and were hurled into a Fire. They did not find apart from God any helpers.

مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

**71:26** Noah tu ya'alaj: In Yuumtsil, ma' a p'atik mix jun tul ti' le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool ku kajtal yook'ol luum.

Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth.

وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

**71:27** Wa a p'atik letio'ob, kun u sa'ato'ob u beel a palilo'ob, yeetel ma' kun u ts'aako'ob kuxtal chen ti' aj k'aas maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool.

If You leave them, they will mislead your servants, and will breed only wicked unbelievers.

إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

**71:28** In Yuumtsil! Sa'ates teen yeetel in taatao'ob, yeetel maax ku yokol tin wotoch yeetel oksaj oolal, yeetel tulakal le aj oksaj ool xiibo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob; yeetel ma' a ya'abbesik le aj ma' toh oolo'ob chen ichil sa'atalil.

My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home in faith, and all the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the wrongdoers except in perdition.”

رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

## 72. The Jinn

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**72:1** A'ale: E'esa'ab teen junp'eel muuch' jinno'ob tu yu'ubajo'ob, yeetel tu ya'alajo'ob: To'on k yu'ubaj junp'eel Quran jach ki'ichpam.

Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, ‘We have heard a wondrous Quran.

قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا

**72:2** Ku chiikbesik beel ti' toh, bey tuuno' To'on k oksaj k ool ti'; yeetel mix bik'in kun k ts'aik yet-maak ti' k Yuumtsil.

It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا

**72:3** Yeetel jach ka'anal u Nojil k Yuumtsil — Leti' ma' tu ch'a'aj atan, mix paal.

And Exalted is the Grandeur of our Lord—He never had a mate, nor a child.

وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

**72:4** Ba'ale' le aj mina'an na'at ichil to'on ku ya'aliko'ob ka'ach ba'alo'ob mina'an u jaajil yook'ol Allah.

But the fools among us used to say nonsense about God.

وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا

**72:5** Yeetel To'on k tukultaj wiiniko'ob yeetel jinno'ob mix bik'in kun u ya'aliko'ob tuus yook'ol Allah.

And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about God.

وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا

**72:6** Yaan wiiniko'ob ku kaxtiko'ob ka'ach muuk' tumen yaan jinno'ob, ba'ale' chen tu ya'abbesajo'ob u sa'atal beelo'ob.

Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion.

وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

**72:7** Letio'ob tu tukultajo'ob, bey te'ex a tukultike'ex, Allah mix bik'in kun u lik'sik mix jun tul.

They thought, as you thought, that God would never resurrect anyone.

وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا

**72:8** To'on k xak'altaj le ka'an, yeetel k kaxtaj chuup yeetel aj kanano'ob chich yeetel ba'alo'ob ku pulbil.

We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles.

وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

**72:9** To'on k ts'aik k baaj ka'ach ichil kuuchilo'ob utia'al k yu'ubik; ba'ale' maax ku yu'ubik bejla'e' ku kaxtik junp'eel ba'al ku pulbil ku pa'atik leti'.

We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him.

وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

**72:10** To'on ma' k ojel wa k'aas ba'al k'aata'an utia'al le maaxo'ob yook'ol luum, wa u Yuumtsilo'ob ku k'aatik uts ti' letio'ob.

We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them.

وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

**72:11** Yaan ichil to'on aj toh oolo'ob, yeetel yaan ichil to'on maaxo'ob yaanal ti' lelo'; To'on k bin jejelaas beelo'ob.

Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths.

وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا

**72:12** To'on k na'ataj ma' je'el k beeytik k xuulbesik Allah yook'ol luum, yeetel ma' je'el k puuts'ul ti' Leti' tumen puuts'.

We realized that we cannot defeat God on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing.

وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا

**72:13** Yeetel ka' To'on k yu'ubaj le chiikbesajil beelo', To'on k oksaj k ool ti'. Maax ku oksik u yool ti' u Yuumtsil ma' ku sajik mix sa'atal, mix kuuch.

And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden.

وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

**72:14** Ichil to'on yaan le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob u baaj, yeetel ichil to'on yaan le aj lak'o'ob. Bey le maaxo'ob tu ts'aajo'ob u baajo', letio'obo' le maaxo'ob ku kaxtiko'ob toh.

Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted—it is they who pursue rectitude.

وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا

**72:15** Ba'ale' bey le aj lak'o'obo', letio'ob kun p'aatalo'ob bey che' utia'al Mitnal.

But as for the compromisers—they will be firewood for Hell.’”

وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

**72:16** Wa letio'ob p'aata'ano'ob ka'ach jaaj yook'ol le Beelo', To'on k ts'aik ka'ach ti' letio'ob ya'ab ja' utia'al u yuk'iko'ob.

Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty water to drink.

وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا

**72:17** U tia'al k ts'aik prueba ti' letio'ob yeetel leti'. Maax ku sutik u baaj ti' u k'a'ajsaj u Yuumtsil, Leti' kun u bisik leti' ti' junp'eel yaayajil ku na'akal mantats'.

To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting.

لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

**72:18** Le kuuchilo'ob kultaj ku ti'al Allah. Bey tuuno' ma' a t'anike'ex, paachil ti' Allah, mix jun tul u laak'.

The places of worship are for God. So do not call, besides God, upon anyone else.

وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا

**72:19** Yeetel ka' le palil Allah lik'ij ku t'anik Leti', naats' tu much'besaj u baajo'ob yook'ol leti'.

And when the servant of God got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass.

وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

**72:20** A'ale: Teen chen kin payalchi' ti' in Yuumtsil, yeetel mix bik'in kin ts'aik yet-maak ti' Leti'.

Say, “I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

**72:21** A'ale: Ma' yaan tin muuk' in beetik k'aas ti' te'ex, mix in bisike'ex ti' le toh beelo'.

Say, “It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct.”

قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

**72:22** A'ale: Mix jun tul je'el u kanantik teen ti' Allah, yeetel ma' kun in kaxt mix junp'eel tu'ux in ta'akik in baaj chen ti' Leti'.

Say, “No one can protect me from God, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.

قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

**72:23** Chen junp'eel k'a'aybesaj ti' Allah yeetel U t'aano'ob. Maax ma' tu tzicik Allah yeetel U Tuuxtbil — ti' leti' yaan u K'aak' Mitnal, tu'ux kun u p'aatalo'ob mantats'.

Except for a proclamation from God and His messages. He who defies God and His Messenger—for him is the Fire of Hell, in which they will dwell forever.”

إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

**72:24** Tak ka' kun u yilo'ob ba'ax ts'a'abil ti' letio'ob bey promesa, kun u yojelo'ob maax maas mina'an u muuk' ichil aj aantajo'ob, yeetel maas p'iit u xooko'ob.

Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers.

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

**72:25** A'ale: Ma' in wojel wa ba'ax ts'a'abil te'ex bey promesa naats', wa in Yuumtsil kun u chowakbesik utia'al junp'eel k'iin.

Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.”

قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا

**72:26** Aj Ojel ti' ba'ax ma' ku yila'al; Leti' ma' tu ye'esik U ba'ax ma' yila'abi' ti' mix jun tul.

The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone.

عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

**72:27** Chen ti' jun tul Tuuxtbil Tu yeeyaj. Ka' Leti' ku tuuxtik aj kanano'ob taanil ti' leti' yeetel paachil ti' leti'.

Except to a Messenger of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him.

إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا

**72:28** U tia'al U yojeltik ts'o'ok u bisiko'ob u t'aano'ob u Yuumtsilo'ob. Leti' ku bak'pachik ba'ax yaan ti' letio'ob, yeetel Tu xokaj tulakal ba'al yeetel xook.

That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number.

لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

## 73. The Enwrapped One

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**73:1** Oo teech, le maax tu pixaj u baaj yeetel u nook'!

O you Enwrapped one.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ

**73:2** Ma' a wenel tulakal ak'ab, chen p'iit.

Stay up during the night, except a little.

قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

**73:3** U chumukil, wa a p'iitkuntik p'iit.

For half of it, or reduce it a little.

نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

**73:4** Wa a ya'abkunsik; yeetel a'al le Quran tu beelil u juum.

Or add to it; and chant the Quran rhythmically.

أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا

**73:5** To'on naats' k ts'aik ti' teech junp'eel t'aan aal.

We are about to give you a heavy message.

إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

**73:6** Le lik'il ak'ab maas chich u muuk', yeetel maas toh utia'al a'ala'al.

The vigil of night is more effective, and better suited for recitation.

إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

**73:7** Ichil k'iin, yaan ti' teech chowak meyaj a beetik.

In the daytime, you have lengthy work to do.

إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

**73:8** Bey tuuno' k'a'ajsik u K'aaba' a Yuumtsil, yeetel ts'aik a baaj ti' Leti' yeetel tulakal a puksi'ik'al.

So remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.

وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

**73:9** Yuumtsil ti' le lik'in yeetel le chik'in. Mina'an k'uj chen Leti'; bey tuuno' ch'a'a Leti' bey Aj Kanan ti' teech.

Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.

رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

**73:10** Yeetel muk'ik ba'ax ku ya'aliko'ob, yeetel luk'en ti' letio'ob utsil.

And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.

وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

**73:11** Yeetel p'at teen le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le jaajo', le maaxo'ob yaan ayik'alil ti' letio'ob, yeetel ts'aik ti' letio'ob p'iit k'iin u pa'atalo'ob.

And leave Me to those who deny the truth, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.

وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

**73:12** Yaan ti' To'on ba'alo'ob ku k'aaxiko'ob yeetel le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

With Us are shackles, and a Fierce Fire.

إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا

**73:13** Yeetel janal ku k'upik, yeetel junp'eel yaayajil ku yajbesik.

And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.

وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

**73:14** Ichil le K'iin ka' le luum yeetel le wits'o'ob kun peeksiko'ob u baajo'ob, yeetel le wits'o'ob kun p'aatalo'ob bey muuch' sa'am.

On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.

يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

**73:15** To'on k tuuxtaj ti' te'ex jun tul Tuuxtbil, aj testimonio yook'ole'ex, bey To'on k tuuxtaj ti' Pharaoh jun tul Tuuxtbil.

We have sent to you a messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا

**73:16** Ba'ale' Pharaoh tu p'ektaj le Tuuxtbil, bey tuuno' To'on k ch'a'aj leti' yeetel junp'eel ch'a' jach k'aas.

But Pharaoh defied the Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا

**73:17** Bey tuuno' bix kun a kanantike'ex a baaje'ex, wa ka p'aatale'ex ma' a woksike'ex a yoole'ex, ti' junp'eel K'iin kun u beetik le paalalo'ob sak u pool?

So how will you, if you persist in unbelief, save yourself from a Day which will turn the children gray-haired?

فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا

**73:18** Le ka'an kun jaats'pajal tumen leti'. U promesa Leti' ku beetbil mantats'.

The heaven will shatter thereby. His promise is always fulfilled.

ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا

**73:19** Lela' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj. Bey tuuno' maax ku k'aat, ts'aik u ch'a'ik junp'eel beel ti' u Yuumtsil.

This is a reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.

إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

**73:20** A Yuumtsil yojel teech ka lik'ik naats' ka'ap'eel jaats ti' ooxp'eel jaats ti' ak'ab, wa u chumukil, wa junp'eel jaats ti' ooxp'eel jaats, pa'ate' yeetel junp'eel muuch' ti' le maaxo'ob yaan ta wetele'ex. Allah tu jets'aj ak'ab yeetel k'iin. Leti' yojel te'ex ma' je'el a pa'atalike'ex ti', bey tuuno' Leti' tu sa'atesaj te'ex. Bey tuuno' xoke'ex ti' le Quran ba'ax je'el u paajtal ti' te'ex. Leti' yojel yaan ichile'ex maaxo'ob koja'ano'ob; yeetel u laak'o'ob ku ximbalo'ob yook'ol luum, ku kaxtiko'ob u siibal Allah; yeetel u laak'o'ob ku ba'atel ti' u beel Allah. Bey tuuno' xoke'ex ti' leti' ba'ax je'el u paajtal ti' te'ex, yeetel beetike'ex le payalchi'o'ob, yeetel ts'aike'ex le siibal, yeetel ts'aike'ex ti' Allah junp'eel uts p'ax. Tulakal uts a ts'aike'ex taanil utia'al a baaje'ex, kun a kaxtike'ex ti' Allah, maas uts yeetel ya'ab u bo'olil. Yeetel k'aate'ex u sa'atesa'al Allah, tumen Allah Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

Your Lord knows that you stay up nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, along with a group of those with you. God designed the night and the day.
