He knows that you are unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So read of the Quran what is possible for you. He knows that some of you may be ill; and others travelling through the land, seeking God’s bounty; and others fighting in God’s cause. So read of it what is possible for you, and observe the prayers, and give regular charity, and lend God a generous loan. Whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and generously rewarded. And seek God’s forgiveness, for God is Forgiving and Merciful.

۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

## 74. The Cloaked One

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**74:1** Oo teech, le maax tu pixaj u baaj yeetel u nook'!

O you Enrobed one.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ

**74:2** Lik'en yeetel k'a'aybes a'almajt'aan.

Arise and warn.

قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ

**74:3** Yeetel nojbes a Yuumtsil.

And magnify your Lord.

وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

**74:4** Yeetel sakbes a nook'o'ob.

And purify your clothes.

وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

**74:5** Yeetel p'at le k'aas ba'alo'obo'.

And abandon abominations.

وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ

**74:6** Yeetel ma' a ye'esik uts a beetik utia'al a kaxtik ya'ab.

And show no favor seeking gain.

وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

**74:7** Yeetel p'aatal chich utia'al a Yuumtsil.

And be constant for your Lord.

وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ

**74:8** Ka' le trompeta kun juumsa'ak.

When the Trumpet is blown.

فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ

**74:9** Le K'iin leti' kun p'aatal junp'eel talam k'iin.

That Day will be a difficult day.

فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

**74:10** U tia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool — ma' ch'a'ambil.

For the disbelievers—not easy.

عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ

**74:11** P'at teen le maax tin beetaj tu juunal.

Leave Me to him whom I created alone.

ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا

**74:12** Yeetel tin ts'aaj ti' leti' ya'ab ayik'alil.

And gave him vast wealth.

وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا

**74:13** Yeetel paalal bey aj testimonio'ob.

And children as witnesses.

وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا

**74:14** Yeetel tin jets'aj tulakal ba'al utia'al leti'.

And smoothed things for him.

وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا

**74:15** Ka' tuuno' leti' ku k'aatik teen in ya'abbesik ya'ab u laak'!

Then he wants Me to add yet more!

ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

**74:16** Ma' beyi'! Leti' chich u pool ti' K e'esajo'ob.

By no means! He was stubborn towards Our revelations.

كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا

**74:17** Teen kun in beetik leti' u na'akal talam mantats'.

I will exhaust him increasingly.

سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا

**74:18** Leti' tu tukultaj yeetel tu jets'aj u tukul.

He thought and analyzed.

إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

**74:19** Ka' kime'en, bix tu jets'aj u tukul!

May he perish, how he analyzed.

فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

**74:20** Tu ka'ateen: ka' kime'en, bix tu jets'aj u tukul!

Again: may he perish, how he analyzed.

ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

**74:21** Ka' tu paktaj.

Then he looked.

ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

**74:22** Ka' tu k'aasbesaj u wich, yeetel tu aawatnaj.

Then he frowned and whined.

ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

**74:23** Ka' tu sutaj u paach, yeetel ka'analtal u yool.

Then he turned back and was proud.

ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ

**74:24** Yeetel tu ya'alaj: Lela' mina'an u laak' chen ba'al ku beeta'al bey ka'ach.

And said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.

فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

**74:25** Lela' mina'an u laak' chen u t'aan jun tul wiinik.

This is nothing but the word of a mortal.”

إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ

**74:26** Teen kun in pulik leti' ichil Saqar.

I will roast him in Saqar.

سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

**74:27** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun u ye'esik ti' teech ba'ax Saqar?

But what will explain to you what Saqar is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ

**74:28** Leti' ma' tu p'atik mixba'al, mix tu cha'ik mixba'al.

It neither leaves, nor spares.

لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ

**74:29** Ku tookik le oot'elo'.

It scorches the flesh.

لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ

**74:30** Yook'ol leti' yaan bolonlajun.

Over it are Nineteen.

عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

**74:31** To'on k beetaj chen angelo'ob bey aj kanano'ob ti' le K'aak', yeetel To'on k ts'aaj u xooko'ob bey junp'eel prueba utia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool; utia'al le maaxo'ob ts'a'abil ti' letio'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' u yojelo'ob jaaj; yeetel le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yool u ya'abtal u oksaj oolilo'ob; yeetel le maaxo'ob ts'a'abil ti' letio'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' yeetel le aj oksaj oolo'ob ma' u yaan ka'ap'eel ool ti' letio'ob; yeetel le maaxo'ob yaan koja'anil ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob yeetel le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool u ya'aliko'ob: Ba'ax tu k'aatik Allah yeetel le beyila'? Bey Allah ku sa'atik u beel maax Leti' ku k'aat, yeetel ku chiikbesik beel ti' maax Leti' ku k'aat. Mix jun tul yojel u aj ba'atelilo'ob a Yuumtsil chen Leti'. Lela' mina'an u laak' chen junp'eel k'a'ajsaj utia'al le wiiniko'obo'.

We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve; so that those given the Scripture may attain certainty; and those who believe may increase in faith; and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt; and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say, “What did God intend by this parable?” Thus God leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is nothing but a reminder for the mortals.

وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

**74:32** Ma' beyi'! Teen, tumen le uj.

Nay! By the moon.

كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ

**74:33** Yeetel tumen ak'ab ka' ku bin paachil.

And the night as it retreats.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ

**74:34** Yeetel tumen le hats'kaab ka' ku saasiltal.

And the morning as it lights up.

وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ

**74:35** Leti' junp'eel ichil le maas nojo'obo'.

It is one of the greatest.

إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ

**74:36** Junp'eel k'a'aybesaj a'almajt'aan utia'al le wiiniko'obo'.

A warning to the mortals.

نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ

**74:37** U tia'al maax ichile'ex ku k'aat bin taanil, wa bin paachil.

To whomever among you wishes to advance, or regress.

لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

**74:38** Tulakal pixan ts'a'abil bey p'ax yo'olal ba'ax tu beetaj.

Every soul is hostage to what it has earned.

كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

**74:39** Chen ma' le maaxo'ob ti' le no'oj.

Except for those on the Right.

إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**74:40** Ichil pak'alo'ob, ku k'aatiko'ob.

In Gardens, inquiring.

فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**74:41** Yo'olal le aj kebano'obo'.

About the guilty.

عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**74:42** Ba'ax tu bisaje'ex ichil Saqar?

“What drove you into Saqar?”

مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ

**74:43** Kun u ya'alo'ob: To'on ma' To'on ichil le maaxo'ob ku payalchi'iko'ob.

They will say, “We were not of those who prayed.

قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

**74:44** Mix To'on k ts'aik janal ti' le ootsil maako'.

Nor did we feed the destitute.

وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ

**74:45** Yeetel To'on k okso'on ichil t'aan mina'an u jaajil pa'ate' yeetel le maaxo'ob ku okso'ob ichil.

And we used to indulge with those who indulge.

وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ

**74:46** Yeetel To'on k p'ektik u K'iinil Xot K'in.

And we used to deny the Day of Judgment.

وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

**74:47** Tak ka' taal yook'ol to'on le Ba'ax Ma' Je'el U P'a'atik.

Until the Inevitable came upon us.”

حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ

**74:48** Ba'ale' u t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal letio'ob le maaxo'ob ku t'aan ti' Allah yo'olal u laak' ma' kun u yaantik letio'ob.

But the intercession of intercessors will not help them.

فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ

**74:49** Ba'axten letio'ob ku sutiko'ob u paacho'ob ti' le k'a'ajsaj?

Why are they turning away from the Reminder?

فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

**74:50** Bey wa letio'ob tsimino'ob sajako'ob.

As though they were panicked donkeys.

كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ

**74:51** Ku puuts'ulo'ob ti' junp'eel ba'alche' sajbe'en.

Fleeing from a lion?

فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ

**74:52** Ba'ale' tulakal jun tul ti' letio'ob ku k'aat ts'a'abil ti' leti' ju'uno'ob xit'a'ano'ob.

Yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled.

بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً

**74:53** Ma' beyi'! Ba'ale' letio'ob ma' tu sajiko'ob le u laak' kuxtalo'.

No indeed! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ

**74:54** Kex bey, leti' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj.

Nevertheless, it is a reminder.

كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ

**74:55** Bey tuuno' maax ku k'aat, ts'aik u k'a'ajsik leti'.

So whoever wills, shall remember it.

فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

**74:56** Ba'ale' letio'ob ma' kun u k'a'ajsiko'ob, chen wa Allah ku k'aat. Leti' U Chuunil Toh, yeetel U Chuunil Sa'atesa'al.

But they will not remember, unless God wills. He is the Source of Righteousness, and the Source of Forgiveness.

وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ

## 75. The Resurrection

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**75:1** Teen, tumen u K'iinil Liksajil.

I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ

**75:2** Yeetel Teen, tumen le pixan ku k'eyik u baaj.

And I swear by the blaming soul.

وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ

**75:3** Ku tukulik wiinik wa To'on ma' k muuch'besik u baako'ob?

Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?

أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

**75:4** Jaaj, jaaj. To'on yaan k muuk' k ka' jets'ik u ts'ooko'ob u yaal u k'ab.

Yes indeed; We are Able to reconstruct his fingertips.

بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

**75:5** Ba'ale' wiinik ku k'aatik u p'ektik ba'ax yaan taanil ti' leti'.

But man wants to deny what is ahead of him.

بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ

**75:6** Ku k'aatik: Bik'ix u K'iinil Liksajil?

He asks, “When is the Day of Resurrection?”

يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ

**75:7** Ka' u wich maako'ob kun saasiltal tumen sajakil.

When vision is dazzled.

فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ

**75:8** Yeetel le uj kun sa'atal u saasil.

And the moon is eclipsed.

وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ

**75:9** Yeetel le k'in yeetel le uj kun muuch'ulo'ob.

And the sun and the moon are joined together.

وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ

**75:10** Ti' le k'iino' wiinik kun u ya'al: Tu'ux le puuts'ul?

On that Day, man will say, “Where is the escape?”

يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ

**75:11** Ma' beyi'! Mina'an tu'ux u puuts'ul.

No indeed! There is no refuge.

كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

**75:12** Ti' a Yuumtsil ti' le k'iino' le jets'el ku k'uchul.

To your Lord on that Day is the settlement.

إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ

**75:13** Ti' le k'iino' wiinik kun a'ala'al ti' tulakal ba'ax tu ts'aaj taanil yeetel tulakal ba'ax tu p'ataj paachil.

On that Day man will be informed of everything he put forward, and everything he left behind.

يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

**75:14** Yeetel wiinik kun p'aatal bey testimonio tu contra u baaj.

And man will be evidence against himself.

بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ

**75:15** Kex ku ts'aik u t'aan u p'atik u keban.

Even as he presents his excuses.

وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

**75:16** Ma' a peeksik a ak' yeetel leti', utia'al a seebkuntik leti'.

Do not wag your tongue with it, to hurry on with it.

لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

**75:17** Ti' To'on u muuch'ul yeetel u xookol.

Upon Us is its collection and its recitation.

إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ

**75:18** Bey tuuno', ka' To'on k xookaj, ts'ay a xookol leti'.

Then, when We have recited it, follow its recitation.

فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ

**75:19** Ka' tuuno' ti' To'on u e'esik u na'at.

Then upon Us is its explanation.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ

**75:20** Ma' beyi'! Ba'ale' te'ex ka kiimak a woole'ex yeetel le kuxtal ku maan seeb.

Alas, you love the fleeting life.

كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ

**75:21** Yeetel ka p'atike'ex le u laak' kuxtalo'.

And you disregard the Hereafter.

وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ

**75:22** Wicho'ob ti' le k'iino' kun saasiltako'ob.

Faces on that Day will be radiant.

وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ

**75:23** Ku paktiko'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob.

Looking towards their Lord.

إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ

**75:24** Yeetel wicho'ob ti' le k'iino' kun k'aastako'ob.

And faces on that Day will be gloomy.

وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ

**75:25** Ku tukuliko'ob junp'eel ba'al ku jaats'ik u paach kun u ts'aaj ti' letio'ob.

Realizing that a back-breaker has befallen them.

تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ

**75:26** Jaaj, ka' ku k'uchul tak u baako'ob u tseem.

Indeed, when it has reached the breast-bones.

كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ

**75:27** Yeetel ku a'ala'al: Maax le aj ts'ak?

And it is said, “Who is the healer?”

وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ

**75:28** Yeetel ku tukulik leti' le jaats'pajal.

And He realizes that it is the parting.

وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ

**75:29** Yeetel u yok ku xak'ik u baaj yeetel u laak' yok.

And leg is entwined with leg.

وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ

**75:30** Ti' a Yuumtsil ti' le k'iino' le bisaj ku k'uchul.

To your Lord on that Day is the drive.

إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ

**75:31** Leti' ma' tu oksaj u yool, mix tu beetaj payalchi'.

He neither believed nor prayed.

فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

**75:32** Ba'ale' tu p'ektaj yeetel tu sutaj u paach.

But he denied and turned away.

وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

**75:33** Ka' tuuno' tu bin ti' u otoch yeetel noj u yool.

Then he went to his family, full of pride.

ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

**75:34** K'aas utia'al teech; yeetel k'aas.

Woe to you; and woe.

أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

**75:35** Ka' tu ka'ateen: K'aas utia'al teech; yeetel k'aas.

Then again: Woe to you; and woe.

ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ

**75:36** Ku tukulik wiinik wa kun p'a'ata'al bey ma' yaan ba'ax u beetik?

Does man think that he will be left without purpose?

أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

**75:37** Ma' wa leti' jun toop' ti' le ja' ku jook'ol ti' xiib?

Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen?

أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ

**75:38** Ka' tuuno' leti' tu p'aatal bey jun xoot' k'iik'. Yeetel Leti' tu beetaj yeetel tu jets'aj u wiinkilal.

Then he became a clot. And He created and proportioned?

ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

**75:39** Yeetel tu beetaj ti' leti' le ka' tul, le xiib yeetel le ko'olel.

And made of him the two sexes, the male and the female?

فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

**75:40** Ma' wa Leti' yaan u muuk' u ka' ts'aik kuxtal ti' le kimeeno'obo'?

Is He not Able to revive the dead?

أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ

## 76. Man

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**76:1** Ma' wa k'uch junp'eel k'iin yook'ol wiinik ka' leti' mina'an ba'ax u k'a'ajesbal?

Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?

هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا

**76:2** To'on k beetaj wiinik ti' junp'eel ja' muuch'a'an, utia'al k ts'aik prueba ti' leti'; yeetel To'on k beetaj leti' ku yu'ubik yeetel ku yilik.

We created man from a liquid mixture, to test him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

**76:3** To'on k chiikbesaj ti' leti' le beel, kex ku oksik u yool ti' uts wa ma' ku oksik u yool ti' uts.

We guided him to the way, be he appreciative or unappreciative.

إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

**76:4** To'on k jets'aj utia'al le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yool suumo'ob ku k'aaxiko'ob, yeetel ba'alo'ob ku k'aaxik u kaal, yeetel le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

We have prepared for the faithless chains, and yokes, and a Searing Fire.

إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا

**76:5** Ba'ale' le aj toh oolo'ob kun uk'iko'ob ti' junp'eel luuch u xaak' ki'ibok.

But the righteous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma.

إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

**76:6** Junp'eel jool ja' ti' le palilo'ob Allah kun uk'iko'ob, ku beetiko'ob u jook'ol ya'ab.

A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush abundantly.

عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

**76:7** Ku beetiko'ob ba'ax tu promesao'ob, yeetel ku sajako'ob junp'eel K'iin u k'aasil ku ka'abetal tulakal tu'ux.

They fulfill their vows, and dread a Day whose ill is widespread.

يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا

**76:8** Yeetel ku ts'aiko'ob janal, tumen ku ya'abiltiko'ob Leti', ti' le ootsil, yeetel le mina'an u yuum, yeetel le k'aalo'an.

And they feed, for the love of Him, the poor, and the orphan, and the captive.

وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا

**76:9** To'on chen k ts'aik janal ti' te'ex tumen Allah. To'on ma' k k'aatik ti' te'ex mix bo'olil, mix kiimak oolal.

“We only feed you for the sake of God. We want from you neither compensation, nor gratitude.

إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا

**76:10** To'on k sajak ti' k Yuumtsil junp'eel K'iin k'aas u wich yeetel talam.

We dread from our Lord a frowning grim Day.”

إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا

**76:11** Bey tuuno' Allah kun u kanantik letio'ob ti' u k'aasil le k'iino', yeetel kun u ts'aik ti' letio'ob saasiltal wich yeetel kiimak oolal.

So God will protect them from the ills of that Day, and will grant them radiance and joy.

فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

**76:12** Yeetel kun u ts'aik ti' letio'ob bo'olil tumen tu muk'ajo'ob, junp'eel Pak'al yeetel seda.

And will reward them for their patience with a Garden and silk.

وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا

**76:13** Ku wenelo'ob ichil tu yook'ol le ts'amo'ob; ma' ku yilo'ob ichil mix k'in, mix ke'elil.

Reclining therein on the thrones; experiencing therein neither sun, nor frost.

مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

**76:14** U booy ku taal paachil yook'ol letio'ob, yeetel u yich ku ts'aabal naats' ti' u machbalo'ob.

Its shade hovering over them, and its fruit brought low within reach.

وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

**76:15** Ku maansa'al yook'ol letio'ob ba'alo'ob ti' plata, yeetel luucho'ob ti' kristal.

Passing around them are vessels of silver, and cups of crystal.

وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

**76:16** Luucho'ob ti' kristal ti' plata — tu p'isajo'ob tu beelil.

Crystal of silver—they measured them exactly.

قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

**76:17** Kun ts'a'abal ti' letio'ob ichil junp'eel luuch u xaak' Zanjabeel.

They will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is Zanjabeel.

وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

**76:18** Junp'eel jool ja' ichil, u k'aaba' Salsabeel.

A spring therein named Salsabeel.

عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا

**76:19** Ku maano'ob ichil letio'ob ch'upul paalalo'ob ma' tu kimo'ob. Wa ka wil letio'ob, ka tukulik letio'ob bey perla ta'aba'ano'ob.

Passing among them are eternalized youths. If you see them, you would think them sprinkled pearls.

۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا

**76:20** Tu'ux ka paktik, ka wilik uts yeetel junp'eel noj ba'al ku jalachbesa'al.

Wherever you look, you see bliss, and a vast kingdom.

وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا

**76:21** Yook'ol letio'ob nook'o'ob ti' yaax seda, yeetel saten. Yeetel kun ts'a'abal ti' letio'ob ba'alo'ob ku ts'aabal tu k'ab ti' plata. Yeetel u Yuumtsilo'ob kun u ts'aik ti' letio'ob uk'be'en ja' sakbesa'an.

Upon them are garments of green silk, and satin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will offer them a pure drink.

عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا

**76:22** Lela' junp'eel bo'olil utia'al te'ex. A meyaje'ex uts k'ama'ano'ob.

“This is a reward for you. Your efforts are well appreciated.”

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

**76:23** Jaaj To'on, To'on k e'esaj le Quran yook'ol teech, bey junp'eel ba'al ku e'esa'al p'iit p'iit.

It is We who sent down the Quran upon you—a gradual revelation.

إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا

**76:24** Bey tuuno' p'aatal chich utia'al u xot t'aan a Yuumtsil, yeetel ma' a yu'ubik le aj keban wa le maax ma' tu oksik u yool ichil letio'ob.

So be patient for the decision of your Lord, and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them.

فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا

**76:25** Yeetel k'a'ajsik u K'aaba' a Yuumtsil, tu lik'il k'in yeetel tu okol k'in.

And mention the Name of your Lord, morning and evening.

وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

**76:26** Yeetel ti' jun jaats ak'ab, xolan taanil ti' Leti', yeetel nojbes Leti' chowak ichil ak'ab.

And for part of the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him long into the night.

وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا

**76:27** Le maaxo'oba': ku kiimak u yoolo'ob yeetel le kuxtal ku maan seeb, yeetel ku p'atiko'ob paachil junp'eel Aal K'iin.

As for these: they love the fleeting life, and leave behind a Heavy Day.

إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا

**76:28** To'on k beetaj letio'ob, yeetel To'on k chichkuntaj u wiinkilalo'ob; yeetel ka' To'on k k'aat, To'on je'el k k'exik letio'ob yeetel u laak'o'ob bey letio'ob.

We created them, and strengthened their frame; and whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them.

نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

**76:29** Lela' junp'eel k'a'ajsaj; bey tuuno' maax ku k'aat, ts'aik u ch'a'ik junp'eel beel ti' u Yuumtsil.

This is a reminder; so whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.

إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

**76:30** Ba'ale' ma' je'el a k'aatike'ex, chen wa Allah ku k'aatik. Allah Aj Ojel yeetel Aj Na'at.

Yet you cannot will, unless God wills. God is Knowing and Wise.

وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

**76:31** Ku ts'aik u yokol ichil u yatzil le maax ku k'aatik. Ba'ale' utia'al le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas, Leti' tu jets'aj utia'al letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil ku yajbesik.

He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. But as for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا

## 77. Those Sent Forth

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**77:1** Tumen le maaxo'ob jok'sa'ano'ob paachil paachil.

By those unleashed in succession.

وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا

**77:2** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku sutiko'ob u baajo'ob bey iik' chich yeetel muuk'.

Storming turbulently.

فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا

**77:3** Yeetel tumen le maaxo'ob ku xit'iko'ob tulakal tu'ux.

Scattering far and wide.

وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا

**77:4** Yeetel tumen le maaxo'ob ku jaatsiko'ob yeetel jets' t'aan.

Separating decisively.

فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا

**77:5** Yeetel tumen le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob junp'eel t'aan.

Delivering a message.

فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا

**77:6** Bey junp'eel p'aat keban wa junp'eel k'a'ay sajakil.

Excusing or warning.

عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا

**77:7** Jaaj, ba'ax a'ala'ab ti' te'ex kun yuchul.

Surely what you are promised will happen.

إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

**77:8** Ka' le eek'o'ob kun sa'atiko'ob u saasil.

When the stars are obliterated.

فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ

**77:9** Yeetel le ka'an kun jaats'pajal.

And the sky is fractured.

وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ

**77:10** Yeetel le wiitso'ob kun puliko'ob bey iik'.

And the mountains are blown away.

وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ

**77:11** Yeetel le tuuxtbilo'ob kun ts'a'abal u k'iin ti' letio'ob.

And the messengers are alerted.

وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ

**77:12** Tak ba'ax k'iin p'ata'an u pa'atal?

Until which day is it deferred?

لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ

**77:13** Tak u K'iinil Jaats.

Until the Day of Decision.

لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ

**77:14** Yeetel ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax u K'iinil Jaats?

And what will teach you what the Day of Decision is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ

**77:15** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le aj tuuso'ob.

Woe on that Day to the liars.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:16** Ma' wa To'on k sa'ataj le maaxo'ob bino'ob taanil?

Did We not destroy the ancients?

أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**77:17** Ka' tu paach To'on k ts'aaj le u laak'o'ob tu paacho'ob.

Then succeeded them with the others?

ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

**77:18** Beyli' To'on k beetik ti' le aj kebano'ob.

This is how We deal with the guilty.

كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**77:19** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

Woe on that Day to the rejecters.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:20** Ma' wa To'on k beetaje'ex ti' junp'eel ja' mina'an u noj p'iis?

Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid?

أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ

**77:21** Ka' To'on k ts'aaj ichil junp'eel tu'ux jets'a'an uts.

Then lodged it in a secure place?

فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

**77:22** Tak junp'eel k'iin ojelbil.

For a known term?

إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

**77:23** To'on k p'iisaj tu beelil. To'on le maas uts ichil le aj p'iiso'ob.

We measured precisely. We are the best to measure.

فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ

**77:24** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ma' jaaj.

Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:25** Ma' wa To'on k beetaj le luum bey otoch?

Did We not make the earth a homestead?

أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا

**77:26** Utia'al le kuxtalo'ob yeetel le kimeeno'ob?

For the living and the dead?

أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا

**77:27** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj yook'ol wiitso'ob ka'analo'ob, yeetel k ts'aaj ti' te'ex ja' sakbesa'an a wuk'ike'ex?

And set on it lofty mountains, and given you pure water to drink?

وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا

**77:28** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le jaajo'.

Woe on that Day to the deniers.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:29** Bine'ex ti' ba'ax ka p'ektike'ex ka'ach.

“Proceed to what you used to deny.”

ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**77:30** Bine'ex ti' junp'eel booy yeetel ooxp'eel u jaatsilo'ob.

“Proceed to a shadow of three different masses.”

ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ

**77:31** Ma' ku ts'aik booy, yeetel ma' ku luk'sike'ex ti' le k'aak'o'.

Offering no shade, and unavailing against the flames.

لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

**77:32** Leti' ku pulik ts'its'o'ob k'aak' bey noj naajo'ob.

It shoots sparks as castles.

إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ

**77:33** Bey wa letio'ob camello'ob k'ankano'ob.

As if they were yellow camels.

كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ

**77:34** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le aj tuuso'ob.

Woe on that Day to the liars.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:35** Lela' junp'eel K'iin, ma' kun t'aanako'ob.

This is a Day when they will not speak.

هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

**77:36** Yeetel ma' kun ts'a'abal ti' letio'ob u p'atiko'ob u kebano'ob yeetel t'aan.

And they will not be allowed to apologize.

وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ

**77:37** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

Woe on that Day to the rejecters.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:38** Lela' u K'iinil Jaats; To'on k muuch'besaje'ex, yeetel le maaxo'ob maano'ob taanil.

This is the Day of Separation; We have gathered you, together with the ancients.

هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**77:39** Bey tuuno', wa yaan ti' te'ex junp'eel ba'al a tuusike'ex, tuusike'ex tu contra Teen.

So if you have a strategy, use it against Me.

فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ

**77:40** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku ya'aliko'ob ma' jaaj.

Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:41** Le aj toh oolo'ob kun yano'ob ichil booyo'ob yeetel tu'ux ku jook'ol ja'.

The righteous will be amidst shades and fountains.

إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ

**77:42** Yeetel icho'ob bey ku k'aatiko'ob.

And fruits as they desire.

وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

**77:43** Jaane'ex yeetel uk'e'ex yeetel ki' oolal, yo'olal ba'ax ka beetike'ex ka'ach.

“Eat and drink pleasantly, for what you used to do.”

كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**77:44** Beyli' To'on k ts'aik bo'olil ti' le aj beetaj utso'ob.

This is how We reward the doers of good.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**77:45** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob le jaajo'.

Woe on that Day to the deniers.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:46** Jaane'ex yeetel ki'imaktale'ex p'iit k'iin; te'ex aj kebano'ob.

“Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; you are indeed criminals.”

كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

**77:47** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le aj tuuso'ob.

Woe on that Day to the liars.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:48** Yeetel ka' ku a'ala'al ti' letio'ob: Xolane'ex, ma' ku xolantalo'ob.

And when it is said to them, “Kneel”, they do not kneel.

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

**77:49** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

Woe on that Day to the rejecters.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**77:50** Ichil ba'ax t'aan, tu paach lela', kun u yoksiko'ob u yoolo'ob?

In what message, beyond this, will they believe?

فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ

## 78. The Great News

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**78:1** Yo'olal ba'ax ku k'aatiko'ob u baajo'ob?

What are they asking one another about?

عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**78:2** Yo'olal le Noj Ba'alo'.

About the Great Event.

عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**78:3** Le yo'olal letio'ob jejelaas u tukulo'ob.

About which they disagree.

ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ

**78:4** Ma' beyi'! Kun u yojelo'ob.

Surely, they will find out.

كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

**78:5** Ka' tu ka'ateen: Ma' beyi'! Kun u yojelo'ob.

Most certainly, they will find out.

ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

**78:6** Ma' wa To'on k beetaj le luum bey tu'ux ku jets'el?

Did We not make the earth a cradle?

أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا

**78:7** Yeetel le wiitso'ob bey ts'ipilo'ob?

And the mountains pegs?

وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا

**78:8** Yeetel To'on k beetaje'ex ka' tul ka' tul?

And created you in pairs?

وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا

**78:9** Yeetel To'on k beetaj a weenel utia'al jets' oolal?

And made your sleep for rest?

وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا

**78:10** Yeetel To'on k beetaj le ak'ab bey ba'ax ku pixik?

And made the night a cover?

وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا

**78:11** Yeetel To'on k beetaj le k'iin utia'al kuxtal?

And made the day for livelihood?

وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا

**78:12** Yeetel To'on k beetaj yook'ole'ex ukp'eel ka'ano'ob chicho'ob?

And built above you seven strong ones?

وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا

**78:13** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj junp'eel ba'al ku tooka'al ku ts'aik saasil?

And placed a blazing lamp?

وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا

**78:14** Yeetel To'on k ts'aaj ja' ku kaalal ya'ab ku taal ti' le muuyalo'ob?

And brought down from the clouds pouring water?

وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا

**78:15** Utia'al k jok'sik yeetel leti' neek'o'ob yeetel ba'alo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob yook'ol luum?

To produce with it grains and vegetation?

لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا

**78:16** Yeetel pak'alo'ob ya'ab u le'o'ob?

And luxuriant gardens?

وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا

**78:17** Jaaj, u K'iinil Jaats ts'o'ok u jets'a'al u k'iinil.

The Day of Sorting has been appointed.

إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا

**78:18** Le K'iin ken juumsa'ak le trompeta, yeetel kun taale'ex muuch' muuch'.

The Day when the Trumpet is blown, and you will come in droves.

يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا

**78:19** Yeetel le ka'an kun je'ebal, yeetel kun p'aatal bey joolo'ob.

And the sky is opened up, and becomes gateways.

وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا

**78:20** Yeetel le wiitso'ob kun peeksiko'ob, yeetel kun p'aatalo'ob bey ba'ax ku yila'al chen ma' jaaj.

And the mountains are set in motion, and become a mirage.

وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

**78:21** Jaaj, Mitnal ku pa'at bey tu'ux ku ch'a'abal pa'at.

Hell is lying in ambush.

إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا

**78:22** Utia'al le maaxo'ob ku maano'ob yook'ol u p'iis, junp'eel tu'ux ku suutulo'ob.

For the oppressors, a destination.

لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا

**78:23** Tu'ux kun p'aatalo'ob ya'ab ja'abo'ob mina'an u ts'ook.

Where they will remain for eons.

لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا

**78:24** Ma' kun u tuuniko'ob ichil mix ke'elil, mix uk'ul.

They will taste therein neither coolness, nor drink.

لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا

**78:25** Chen ja' ku lokol, yeetel ba'al jach ke'el ku jook'ol.

Except boiling water, and freezing hail.

إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا

**78:26** Junp'eel bo'olil ku nupik u meyajo'ob.

A fitting requital.

جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا

**78:27** Jaaj, letio'ob ma' tu pa'atiko'ob mix junp'eel xook ka'ach.

For they were not anticipating any reckoning.

إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا

**78:28** Yeetel tu p'ektajo'ob k chiikulo'ob tulakal u muuk'.

And they denied Our signs utterly.

وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا

**78:29** Yeetel tulakal ba'al, To'on k xokaj ichil junp'eel ju'un.

But We have enumerated everything in writing.

وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا

**78:30** Bey tuuno', tuune'ex! To'on chen kun k ya'abkunsik ti' te'ex yaayajil.

So taste! We will increase you only in suffering.

فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

**78:31** Ba'ale', utia'al le aj toh oolo'ob yaan junp'eel noj naajal.

But for the righteous there is triumph.

إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

**78:32** Pak'alo'ob yeetel uva che'o'ob.

Gardens and vineyards.

حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا

**78:33** Yeetel ko'olelo'ob jach utso'ob, junp'eel u ja'abilo'ob.

And splendid spouses, well matched.

وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا

**78:34** Yeetel luucho'ob chuup yeetel uk'ul ki'.

And delicious drinks.

وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا

**78:35** Ma' kun u yu'ubiko'ob ichil mix t'aan mina'an u yool, mix tuus.

They will hear therein neither gossip, nor lies.

لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا

**78:36** Junp'eel bo'olil ti' a Yuumtsil, junp'eel siibal ku nupik.

A reward from your Lord, a fitting gift.

جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا

**78:37** Yuumtsil ti' le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum, yeetel tulakal ba'ax ichil letio'ob — le maax maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal — mix maax je'el u t'aanik tu contra Leti'.

Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them—The Most Merciful—none can argue with Him.

رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

**78:38** Ichil le K'iin ken wa'atal le Pixano' yeetel le angelo'ob ichil junp'eel tsol. Ma' kun t'aanako'ob, chen wa jun tul ts'aaba'an ti' tumen le maax maas ku ch'a'ik ootsilil ichil tulakal, yeetel kun u ya'alik ba'ax toh.

On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in row. They will not speak, unless it be one permitted by the Most Merciful, and he will say what is right.

يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا

**78:39** Lela' u K'iinil Jaaj. Bey tuuno', maax ku k'aat, ts'aik u ch'a'ik junp'eel beel suut ti' u Yuumtsil.

That is the Day of Reality. So whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.

ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

**78:40** To'on k k'a'aytaje'ex yo'olal junp'eel yaayajil naats' — le K'iin ken paktik wiinik ba'ax u k'abo'ob tu beetajo'ob, yeetel le maax ma' tu oksik u yool kun u ya'alik: U k'aat ka'ach p'aatalen bey luum.

We have warned you of a near punishment—the Day when a person will observe what his hands have produced, and the faithless will say, “O, I wish I were dust.”

إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا

## 79. Those Who Extract

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**79:1** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku ch'a'iko'ob yeetel chich muuk'.

By those who snatch violently.

وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا

**79:2** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku luk'siko'ob yeetel jets' oolal.

And those who remove gently.

وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا

**79:3** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku babalo'ob pits'il.

And those who glide smoothly.

وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا

**79:4** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku aalkabo'ob seeba'an tu taanil u laak'o'ob.

And those who race swiftly.

فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا

**79:5** Tumen le maaxo'ob ku jets'iko'ob ba'alo'ob.

And those who regulate events.

فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا

**79:6** Le k'iin ken u yaanik le Noj Yaaniko'.

On the Day when the Quake quakes.

يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ

**79:7** Yeetel junp'eel u laak' kun taal tu paach.

And is followed by the Successor.

تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ

**79:8** Le puksi'ik'alo'ob ichil le k'iino' kun jats'pajalo'ob chich.

Hearts on that Day will be pounding.

قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ

**79:9** U yicho'ob kun paakato'ob yaanal.

Their sights downcast.

أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ

**79:10** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Kun suutbesa'on wa ti' bix ka'achij?

They say, “Are we to be restored to the original condition?

يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ

**79:11** Ka' ts'o'ok k p'atal bey baako'ob mina'an mixba'al ichil?

When we have become hollow bones?”

أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً

**79:12** Ku ya'aliko'ob: Lela' junp'eel meyaj tu'ux ku sa'atal.

They say, “This is a losing proposition.”

قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ

**79:13** Ba'ale' chen junp'eel chan peeksaj kun yuchul.

But it will be only a single nudge.

فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

**79:14** Yeetel letio'ob kun ajtalo'ob.

And they will be awake.

فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ

**79:15** Ts'o'ok wa u k'uchul ti' teech u tsikbal Moses?

Has the story of Moses reached you?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

**79:16** Ka' u Yuumtsil tu t'aanaj leti' ichil le kili'ich ka'a luum Tuwa.

When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

**79:17** Binxen ti' Pharaoh — leti' ts'o'ok u maan u p'iis.

“Go to Pharaoh—he has transgressed.”

ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

**79:18** Yeetel a'alik: A k'aat wa a sakbesa'al?

And say, “Do you care to be cleansed?

فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

**79:19** Yeetel teen kun in chiikbesik a beel ti' a Yuumtsil, yeetel kun a sajak Leti'.

And I will guide you to your Lord, and you will turn reverent.”

وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ

**79:20** Leti' tu ye'esaj ti' leti' le chiikul maas noj ichil tulakal chiikulo'ob.

He showed him the Greatest Miracle.

فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

**79:21** Ba'ale' leti' tu ya'alaj ma' jaaj, yeetel ma' tu ts'ookbesaj u t'aan.

But he denied and defied.

فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

**79:22** Ka' tu suutaj u paach, yeetel tu beetaj u muuk'.

Then turned his back, and tried.

ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ

**79:23** Yeetel tu muuch'besaj, yeetel tu k'a'aybesaj.

And gathered and proclaimed.

فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

**79:24** Tu ya'alaj: Teen le Yuumtsil ti' te'ex, le maax maas ka'anal ichil tulakal.

He said, “I am your Lord, the most high.”

فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

**79:25** Bey tuuno' Allah tu ch'a'aj leti' yeetel junp'eel noj yaayajil bey ye'esajil, ichil le u laak' kuxtalo' yeetel ichil le yaax kuxtalo'.

So God seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the last and in the first.

فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

**79:26** Ichil lela' yaan junp'eel ba'al ku ka'ansik maax ku sajak.

In this is a lesson for whoever fears.

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

**79:27** Te'ex wa maas talam a beeta'ale'ex, wa le ka'an? Leti' tu beetaj leti'.

Are you more difficult to create, or the heaven? He constructed it.

ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا

**79:28** Tu ka'ankunsaj leti', yeetel tu jets'aj tu p'iis.

He raised its masses, and proportioned it.

رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

**79:29** Yeetel Leti' tu beetaj u ak'ab eek'joch'e'en, yeetel tu jok'saj u saasil u k'iin.

And He dimmed its night, and brought out its daylight.

وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا

**79:30** Yeetel le luum, tu paach lelo', Leti' tu xit'aj.

And the earth after that He spread.

وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ

**79:31** Yeetel ti' leti', Leti' tu jok'saj u ja' yeetel u janal u ba'alche'ob.

And from it, He produced its water and its pasture.

أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا

**79:32** Yeetel le wiitso'ob, Leti' tu jets'aj letio'ob chich.

And the mountains, He anchored.

وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا

**79:33** Junp'eel ki'imak oolal ti' te'ex yeetel ti' a ba'alche'ob.

A source of enjoyment for you and for your animals.

مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ

**79:34** Ba'ale' ka' kun k'uchul le Noj K'aas Ba'alo'.

But when the Great Cataclysm arrives.

فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

**79:35** Junp'eel K'iin ken wiinik u k'a'ajsik ba'ax tu beetaj yeetel u muuk'.

A Day when man will remember what he has endeavored.

يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

**79:36** Yeetel Mitnal kun ye'esa'al ti' maax ku ilik.

And Hell will be displayed to whoever sees.

وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

**79:37** Ti' le maax tu maan u p'iis.

As for him who was defiant.

فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

**79:38** Yeetel tu ts'aaj taanil u kuxtal le yook'ol kaaba'.

And preferred the life of this world.

وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

**79:39** Bey tuuno' Mitnal u yotoch.

Then Hell is the shelter.

فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

**79:40** Ba'ale' ti' le maax tu sajak u wa'atal tu taan u Yuumtsil, yeetel tu ch'a'aj u baaj ti' ba'ax u pixan ku k'aatik.

But as for him who feared the Standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ

**79:41** Bey tuuno' le Pak'alo' u yotoch.

Then Paradise is the shelter.

فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

**79:42** Ku k'aatiko'ob ti' teech yo'olal le K'intzilo': Ba'ax k'iin kun yuchul?

They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?”

يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا

**79:43** Teech ma' a wojel yo'olal leti'.

You have no knowledge of it.

فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ

**79:44** Ti' a Yuumtsil u ts'ook.

To your Lord is its finality.

إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ

**79:45** Teech chen jun tul aj k'a'ay sajakil ti' maax ku sajak leti'.

You are just a warner for whoever dreads it.

إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا

**79:46** Ichil le K'iino' ken u yilo'ob — bey wa chen junp'eel ak'ab tu p'atalo'ob, wa u ja'atskab k'iin.

On the Day when they witness it—as though they only stayed an evening, or its morning.

كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا

## 80. He Frowned

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**80:1** Tu k'aasbesaj u yich, yeetel tu suutaj u paach.

He frowned and turned away.

عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

**80:2** Ka' le maax ch'oope' naats'aj ti' leti'.

When the blind man approached him.

أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ

**80:3** Ba'ale' bix a wojel? Ma'alob wa leti' ku kaxtik u sakbesik u baaj.

But how do you know? Perhaps he was seeking to purify himself.

وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

**80:4** Wa ku k'a'ajsa'al, yeetel le k'a'ajsaj kun u yaantik leti'.

Or be reminded, and the message would benefit him.

أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ

**80:5** Ba'ale' ti' le maax ma' tu yilik u k'a'abeetil.

But as for him who was indifferent.

أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

**80:6** Teech ta ts'aaj a xikin ti' leti'.

You gave him your attention.

فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ

**80:7** Yeetel mina'an a siipil wa ma' tu sakbesik u baaj.

Though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.

وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

**80:8** Ba'ale' ti' le maax taal ti' teech ku kaxtik.

But as for him who came to you seeking.

وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

**80:9** Yeetel yaan u saajkil.

In awe.

وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ

**80:10** Ti' leti' ma' ta ts'aaj a xikin.

To him you were inattentive.

فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

**80:11** Ma' beyi'. Lela' junp'eel K'a'ajsajil.

Do not. This is a Lesson.

كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ

**80:12** Maax ku k'aat, kun u k'a'ajsik leti'.

Whoever wills, shall remember it.

فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

**80:13** Ichil ju'uno'ob tsikbe'eno'ob.

On honorable pages.

فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ

**80:14** Ka'analo'ob yeetel sakbesa'ano'ob.

Exalted and purified.

مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ

**80:15** Tumen u k'abo'ob aj ts'iibo'ob.

By the hands of scribes.

بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ

**80:16** Tsikbe'eno'ob yeetel ku ts'aiko'ob u baajo'ob.

Noble and devoted.

كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ

**80:17** Ka kiimik wiinik! Beyxan ma' tu ts'aik ki'iki' t'aan!

Perish man! How thankless he is!

قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ

**80:18** Ti' ba'ax Leti' tu beetaj leti'?

From what did He create him?

مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ

**80:19** Ti' junp'eel tutul ja', Leti' tu beetaj leti', yeetel tu ts'aaj u beeytal u kuxtal.

From a sperm drop He created him, and enabled him.

مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ

**80:20** Ka' Leti' tu beetaj le beel ma' talam ti' leti'.

Then He eased the way for him.

ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ

**80:21** Ka' Leti' tu k'iinsik leti', yeetel tu muukik leti'.

Then He puts him to death, and buries him.

ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ

**80:22** Ka', ka' Leti' ku k'aat, kun u ka' kuxtalbesik leti'.

Then, when He wills, He will resurrect him.

ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ

**80:23** Ba'ale' ma', leti' ma' tu ts'o'okbesaj ba'ax Leti' tu a'almajt'aanaj ti' leti'.

But no, he did not fulfill what He has commanded him.

كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ

**80:24** Ka wiinik u paktik u janal.

Let man consider his food.

فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ

**80:25** To'on k pulik ja' ya'ab.

We pour down water in abundance.

أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا

**80:26** Ka' To'on k jaats'ik le luum.

Then crack the soil open.

ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا

**80:27** Yeetel To'on k kuxtalbesik ichil neek'o'ob.

And grow in it grains.

فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا

**80:28** Yeetel uvao'ob yeetel xiw.

And grapes and herbs.

وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا

**80:29** Yeetel olivo'ob yeetel datilo'ob.

And olives and dates.

وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا

**80:30** Yeetel pak'alo'ob ya'ab u le'o'ob.

And luscious gardens.

وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا

**80:31** Yeetel icho'ob yeetel ba'alo'ob ku kuxtalo'ob yook'ol luum.

And fruits and vegetables.

وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا

**80:32** Junp'eel ki'imak oolal ti' te'ex yeetel ti' a ba'alche'ob.

Enjoyment for you, and for your livestock.

مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ

**80:33** Ba'ale' ka' kun taal le Noj Juum ku k'aasbesik xikin.

But when the Deafening Noise comes to pass.

فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ

**80:34** Le K'iin ken jun tul wiinik u puuts'ul ti' u suku'un.

The Day when a person will flee from his brother.

يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ

**80:35** Yeetel u na' yeetel u yuum.

And his mother and his father.

وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ

**80:36** Yeetel u atan yeetel u paalo'ob.

And his consort and his children.

وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ

**80:37** Jujun tul ti' letio'ob, ichil le k'iino', kun yaan ti' letio'ob ba'ax ku ch'a'ik tulakal u tuukulo'ob.

Every one of them, on that Day, will have enough to preoccupy him.

لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ

**80:38** Ichilo'ob ichil le k'iino' kun saasiltalo'ob.

Faces on that Day will be radiant.

وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ

**80:39** Ku che'ejiko'ob yeetel ku ki'imak ooltajo'ob.

Laughing and rejoicing.

ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ

**80:40** Yeetel ichilo'ob ichil le k'iino' kun pixbilo'ob yeetel yaayaj oolal.

And Faces on that Day will be covered with misery.

وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ

**80:41** Kun bak'bilo'ob tumen ok'om oolal.

Overwhelmed by remorse.

تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

**80:42** Letio'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, le aj k'aaso'ob.

These are the faithless, the vicious.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ

## 81. The Overthrowing

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**81:1** Ka' le k'iin kun wolbesa'al.

When the sun is rolled up.

إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

**81:2** Ka' le eek'o'ob kun sa'atiko'ob u saasil.

When the stars are dimmed.

وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ

**81:3** Ka' le wiitso'ob kun peeksiko'ob.

When the mountains are set in motion.

وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

**81:4** Ka' le ba'alo'ob ku nupiko'ob wiiniko'ob kun p'ata'alo'ob.

When the relationships are suspended.

وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

**81:5** Ka' le k'aax ba'alche'ob kun muuch'besa'ako'ob.

When the beasts are gathered.

وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

**81:6** Ka' le k'aak'naabo'ob kun t'aabalo'ob bey k'aak'.

When the oceans are set aflame.

وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ

**81:7** Ka' le pixano'ob kun nupa'alo'ob ka' tul ka' tul.

When the souls are paired.

وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ

**81:8** Ka' le xch'uup paal muuka'an kuxtal ku k'aata'al ti':

When the girl, buried alive, is asked:

وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ

**81:9** Yo'olal ba'ax keban tu k'iinsa'ab?

For what crime was she killed?

بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ

**81:10** Ka' le ju'uno'ob kun ts'a'abalo'ob chiikpajal ti' tulakal.

When the records are made public.

وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ

**81:11** Ka' le ka'an kun luk'sa'al u oot'el.

When the sky is peeled away.

وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ

**81:12** Ka' le k'aak' kun chich t'aabal.

When the Fire is set ablaze.

وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

**81:13** Ka' le Pak'alo' kun naats'besa'al.

When Paradise is brought near.

وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ

**81:14** Tulakal pixan kun u yojeltik ba'ax tu jets'maj.

Each soul will know what it has readied.

عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ

**81:15** Teen, tumen le noj muuch' eek'o'ob.

I swear by the galaxies.

فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ

**81:16** Ku bino'ob tu beelo'ob tu p'iis.

Precisely running their courses.

ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ

**81:17** Yeetel tumen le ak'ab, ka' ku bin paachil.

And by the night as it recedes.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ

**81:18** Yeetel tumen le ja'atskab, ka' ku jok'ol u iik'.

And by the morn as it breathes.

وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

**81:19** Lela' u t'aan jun tul tuuxtbil tsikbe'en.

This is the speech of a noble messenger.

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

**81:20** Yaan u muuk', nojbe'en yaan ti' Yuumtsil le Ts'amo'.

Endowed with power, eminent with the Lord of the Throne.

ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

**81:21** Ku yu'uba'al u t'aan, yeetel jaaj u yool.

Obeyed and honest.

مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ

**81:22** A yet-maake'ex ma' chich u tuukul.

Your friend is not possessed.

وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ

**81:23** Jaaj, tu yilaj leti' yook'ol le ka'an saasil.

He saw him on the luminous horizon.

وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

**81:24** Yeetel Leti' ma' tu ta'akik u yojel ba'ax ma' ku yila'al.

And He does not withhold knowledge of the Unseen.

وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ

**81:25** Yeetel ma' u t'aan jun tul Kisin p'ekta'an.

And it is not the word of an accursed devil.

وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

**81:26** Bey tuuno', tu'ux ka bine'ex?

So where are you heading?

فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

**81:27** Lela' chen junp'eel K'a'ajsajil ti' tulakal wiiniko'ob.

It is only a Reminder to all mankind.

إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**81:28** Ti' maax ichile'ex ku k'aat u bin toh.

To whoever of you wills to go straight.

لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ

**81:29** Ba'ale' ma' je'el a k'aatike'ex, chen wa Allah ku k'aat — Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob.

But you cannot will, unless God wills—The Lord of the Worlds.

وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

## 82. The Cleaving

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**82:1** Ka' le ka'an kun jaats'pajal.

When the sky breaks apart.

إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

**82:2** Ka' le eek'o'ob kun t'it'pajalo'ob.

When the planets are scattered.

وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ

**82:3** Ka' le k'aak'naabo'ob kun pa'alo'ob chich.

When the oceans are exploded.

وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

**82:4** Ka' le muknalo'ob kun t'it'besa'ako'ob tulakal tu'ux.

When the tombs are strewn around.

وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

**82:5** Tulakal pixan kun yojeltik ba'ax tu beetaj taanil, yeetel ba'ax tu p'ataj paachil.

Each soul will know what it has advanced, and what it has deferred.

عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ

**82:6** Oo wiinik! Ba'ax tu tuusikech yo'olal a Yuumtsil, le maax maas ku ts'aik siibal ichil tulakal?

O man! What deluded you concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

**82:7** Leti' Maax tu beetajech, yeetel tu ts'aj a wiinkilal, yeetel tu p'iisaj a wiinkilal?

He Who created you, and formed you, and proportioned you?

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

**82:8** Ichil je'el ba'ax wiinkilal Leti' tu k'aat, Leti' tu muuch'besajech.

In whatever shape He willed, He assembled you.

فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

**82:9** Ba'ale' te'ex ka p'ektike'ex le culto.

But you reject the religion.

كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ

**82:10** Kex yook'ole'ex yaan aj kanano'ob.

Though over you are watchers.

وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ

**82:11** Aj ts'iibo'ob jaajo'ob.

Honest recorders.

كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ

**82:12** Ku yojelo'ob tulakal ba'ax ka beetike'ex.

They know everything you do.

يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

**82:13** Le aj toh oolo'ob kun yano'ob ichil ki' oolal.

The virtuous will be in bliss.

إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

**82:14** Yeetel le aj k'aaso'ob kun yano'ob ichil Mitnal.

While the wicked will be in Hell.

وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ

**82:15** Kun okbesa'ako'ob ichil leti' ichil u K'iinil Toh.

They will enter it on the Day of Justice.

يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

**82:16** Yeetel ma' kun p'ata'alo'ob naach ti' leti'.

And they will not be absent from it.

وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ

**82:17** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax u K'iinil Toh?

But what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

**82:18** Ka' tu ka'ateen, ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax u K'iinil Toh?

Then again, what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?

ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

**82:19** Le K'iin, mix junp'eel pixan kun u yaan u yaantik u laak' pixan mixba'al; yeetel le xot t'aan ichil le k'iino' ti' Allah.

The Day when no soul will avail another soul anything; and the decision on that Day is God’s.

يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ

## 83. The Defrauders

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**83:1** Yaayajil ti' le maaxo'ob ku tuusiko'ob ichil p'iis.

Woe to the defrauders.

وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

**83:2** Letio'ob, ka' ku ch'a'iko'ob junp'eel p'iis ti' wiiniko'ob, ku ch'a'iko'ob chuuka'an.

Those who, when they take a measure from people, they take in full.

ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

**83:3** Ba'ale' ka' ku p'iisiko'ob wa ku aal p'iisiko'ob ti' u laak'o'ob, ku tuusiko'ob.

But when they measure or weigh to others, they cheat.

وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ

**83:4** Ma' wa u yojelo'ob le maaxo'obo' kun lik'sa'ako'ob?

Do these not know that they will be resurrected?

أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

**83:5** Yo'olal junp'eel Noj K'iin?

For a Great Day?

لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

**83:6** Le k'iin, tulakal wiiniko'ob kun wa'atalo'ob tu taan Yuumtsil yook'ol kaabo'ob?

The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

**83:7** Ma' beyi'! U ju'un le aj k'aaso'ob yaan ichil Sijjeen.

Not at all. The record of the wicked is in Sijjeen.

كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ

**83:8** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax Sijjeen?

But how can you know what Sijjeen is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ

**83:9** Junp'eel ju'un ts'iibta'an yeetel xooko'ob.

A numerical book.

كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

**83:10** Yaayajil le k'iino' ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

Woe on that Day to the deniers.

وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

**83:11** Le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob u K'iinil le Xooko'.

Those who deny the Day of Reckoning.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

**83:12** Ba'ale' mix maax ku p'ektik leti', chen le aj keban ku maan u p'iis.

But none denies it except the sinful aggressor.

وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

**83:13** Ka' k chiikulo'ob ku xooka'alo'ob ti' leti', ku ya'alik: U tsikbalo'ob le yaax maako'ob.

When Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Legends of the ancients.”

إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**83:14** Ma' beyi'! U puksi'ik'alo'ob ts'o'ok u k'aasbesa'alo'ob tumen ba'ax tu naajaltajo'ob.

Not at all. Their hearts have become corroded by what they used to earn.

كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**83:15** Ma' beyi'! Ichil le k'iino', kun ta'aka'ako'ob ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob.

Not at all. On that Day, they will be screened from their Lord.

كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

**83:16** Tu ts'ooke', kun tooka'alo'ob ichil Mitnal.

Then they will roast in Hell.

ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**83:17** Tu ts'ooke', kun a'ala'ak: Lela' ba'ax ka p'ektike'ex ka'ach.

Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”

ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**83:18** Ma' beyi'! U ju'un le aj toh oolo'ob yaan ichil Elliyyeen.

No indeed; the record of the righteous is in Elliyyeen.

كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

**83:19** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax Elliyyoon?

But how can you know what Elliyyoon is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

**83:20** Junp'eel ju'un ts'iibta'an yeetel xooko'ob.

A numerical book.

كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

**83:21** Ku yila'al tumen le maaxo'ob naats'besa'ano'ob ti' Allah.

Witnessed by those brought near.

يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

**83:22** Jaaj, le aj toh oolo'ob kun yano'ob ichil ki' oolal.

Indeed, the righteous will be amid bliss.

إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

**83:23** Yook'ol k'anche'ob, ku yilik.

On thrones, looking on.

عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

**83:24** A wilik tu yicho'ob u saasil ki' oolal.

You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.

تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**83:25** Kun uk'besa'ako'ob junp'eel vino ts'o'ok u k'aala'al.

They will be given to drink a sealed wine.

يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ

**83:26** U k'aalajil jach ki'ibok — lela' ba'ax k'aabet u ba'atel yo'olal le maaxo'ob ku ba'atelo'ob.

Whose seal is musk—this is what competitors should compete for.

خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ

**83:27** Ts'aamaj ichil Tasneem.

Its mixture is of Tasneem.

وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

**83:28** Junp'eel beel ja' tu'ux ku yu'uk'iko'ob le maaxo'ob naats'besa'ano'ob ti' Allah.

A spring from which those brought near drink.

عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

**83:29** Le maaxo'ob tu beetajo'ob k'aas ku che'ejtiko'ob le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

Those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

**83:30** Yeetel ka' ku maano'ob naats' ti' letio'ob, ku beetiko'ob chiikul yeetel u yicho'ob.

And when they passed by them, they would wink at one another.

وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

**83:31** Yeetel ka' ku suutko'ob ti' u lak'tsilo'ob, ku suutko'ob yeetel ki' oolal.

And when they went back to their families, they would go back exulting.

وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

**83:32** Yeetel wa ku yilo'ob letio'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob: Le maaxo'obo' saata'an u beelo'ob.

And if they saw them, they would say, “These people are lost.”

وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

**83:33** Ba'ale' ma' tuuxta'abo'ob bey aj kanano'ob yook'ol letio'ob.

Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ

**83:34** Ba'ale' ichil le k'iino', le aj oksaj oolo'ob kun che'ejtiko'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob.

But on that Day, those who believed will laugh at the unbelievers.

فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

**83:35** Yook'ol k'anche'ob jach ki'ichkelemo'ob, ku yilik.

On luxurious furnishings, looking on.

عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

**83:36** Ts'o'ok wa u bo'ota'alo'ob le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yo'olal ba'ax tu beetajo'ob?

Have the unbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?

هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

## 84. The Splitting Open

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**84:1** Ka' le ka'an kun jaats'pajal.

When the sky is ruptured.

إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ

**84:2** Yeetel ku yu'ubik u Yuumtsil, bey k'aabet u beetik.

And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.

وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

**84:3** Yeetel ka' le luum kun taaskabbesa'al.

And when the earth is leveled out.

وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

**84:4** Yeetel ku pulik ba'ax yaan ichil, yeetel ku p'atal mina'an ba'al ichil.

And casts out what is in it, and becomes empty.

وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ

**84:5** Yeetel ku yu'ubik u Yuumtsil, bey k'aabet u beetik.

And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.

وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

**84:6** Oo wiinik! Teche' ka meyaj chich tak a Yuumtsil, yeetel kun a nupik leti'.

O man! You are laboring towards your Lord, and you will meet Him.

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ

**84:7** Le maax ku ts'a'abal u ju'un tu no'oj k'ab.

As for him who is given his book in his right hand.

فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ

**84:8** Kun xooka'al ti' leti' junp'eel xook ma' talam.

He will have an easy settlement.

فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا

**84:9** Yeetel kun suut ti' u lak'tsilo'ob yeetel ki' oolal.

And will return to his family delighted.

وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا

**84:10** Ba'ale' le maax ku ts'a'abal u ju'un tu paach.

But as for him who is given his book behind his back.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ

**84:11** Kun u payik kimiil.

He will call for death.

فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا

**84:12** Yeetel kun ook ichil le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

And will enter the Blaze.

وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

**84:13** Leti' ki' oolal ka'ach ichil u lak'tsilo'ob.

He used to be happy among his family.

إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا

**84:14** Leti' tu tuuklaj ma' kun suut mix bik'in.

He thought he would never return.

إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

**84:15** Jaaj, u Yuumtsil ku yilik leti' ka'ach.

In fact, his Lord was watching him.

بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا

**84:16** Teen, tumen le chak saasil ku p'atal ka' ku ook le k'iin.

I swear by the twilight.

فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ

**84:17** Yeetel tumen le ak'ab, yeetel ba'ax ku pixik.

And by the night, and what it covers.

وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

**84:18** Yeetel tumen le uj, ka' ku chuupul.

And by the moon, as it grows full.

وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ

**84:19** Kun a maano'ob jaats jaats.

You will mount stage by stage.

لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ

**84:20** Ba'ax yaan ti' letio'ob, ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob?

What is the matter with them that they do not believe?

فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**84:21** Yeetel ka' le Quran ku xooka'alo'ob ti' letio'ob, ma' tu chiniko'ob u pool?

And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?

وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩

**84:22** Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.

بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ

**84:23** Ba'ale' Allah u yojel ba'ax ku ta'akiko'ob ichil letio'ob.

But God knows what they hide inside.

وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

**84:24** Beey tuuno', a'al ti' letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil jach yaaj.

So inform them of a painful punishment.

فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**84:25** Chen le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob uts ba'alo'ob; kun u yaantal ti' letio'ob junp'eel bo'olil ma' kun xu'ulul.

Except those who believe and do good deeds; they will have an undiminished reward.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ

## 85. The Constellations

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**85:1** Tumen le ka'an yaan eek'o'ob muuch'a'ano'ob ichil.

By the sky with the constellations.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ

**85:2** Yeetel tumen u K'iinil le promesa'ata'ano'.

And by the Promised Day.

وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ

**85:3** Yeetel tumen le aj ilaj yeetel le ba'ax ku yila'al.

And by the witness and the witnessed.

وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ

**85:4** Sa'ata'abo'ob le maako'ob tu'ux yaan le noj jool ichil luum.

Destroyed were the People of the Trench.

قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ

**85:5** Le k'aak', ts'a'aban ti' ba'ax ku tooka'al.

The fire supplied with fuel.

ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ

**85:6** Ka' letio'ob ku kulajo'ob yook'ol leti'.

While they sat around it.

إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ

**85:7** Yeetel letio'ob ku yiliko'ob ba'ax tu beetajo'ob ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob.

And were witnessing what they did to the believers.

وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ

**85:8** Ma' tu p'ektajo'ob letio'ob chen tumen tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ti' Allah, le Yaan Muuk', le Ki'iki' T'aanta'an.

They begrudged them only because they believed in God the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

**85:9** Ti' Leti' u ajawil le ka'ano'ob yeetel le luum. Allah Aj Testimonio yook'ol tulakal ba'al.

To Whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything.

ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

**85:10** Le maaxo'ob ku ts'aiko'ob prueba ti' le aj oksaj oolo'ob, xiibo'ob yeetel ko'olelo'ob, tu ts'ooke' ma' tu suutiko'ob u baajo'ob ti' Allah; ti' letio'ob yaan u yaayajil Mitnal; ti' letio'ob yaan u yaayajil le tooka'al.

Those who tempt the believers, men and women, then do not repent; for them is the punishment of Hell; for them is the punishment of Burning.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

**85:11** Le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh ba'alo'ob, ti' letio'ob yaan pak'alo'ob, yaan beel ja'o'ob ku maano'ob yanal ti' letio'ob. Lelo' le noj naajal.

Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**85:12** U chich muuk' a Yuumtsil jach chich.

The onslaught of your Lord is severe.

إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

**85:13** Leti' le Maax ku chuunp'isik, yeetel ku ka' chuunp'isik.

It is He who begins and repeats.

إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

**85:14** Yeetel Leti' Aj Sa'atesaj, le maax ku yaakuntik.

And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.

وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ

**85:15** Maax yaan ti' le Ts'am nojbe'eno'.

Possessor of the Glorious Throne.

ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ

**85:16** Ku beetik je'el ba'ax Leti' ku k'aat.

Doer of whatever He wills.

فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

**85:17** K'uch wa ti' teech u tsikbalil le muuch' ba'atelo'ob?

Has there come to you the story of the legions?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ

**85:18** Pharaoh yeetel Thamood?

Of Pharaoh and Thamood?

فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

**85:19** Jaaj, le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob.

In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.

بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ

**85:20** Yeetel Allah ku k'aalik letio'ob ti' tulakal tu'ux ku bino'ob.

And God encloses them from beyond.

وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ

**85:21** Jaaj, lela' junp'eel Quran nojbe'en.

In fact, it is a Glorious Quran.

بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ

**85:22** Ichil junp'eel ju'un ta'aka'an.

In a Preserved Tablet.

فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ

## 86. The Nightcomer

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**86:1** Tumen le ka'an yeetel at-Tariq.

By the sky and at-Tariq.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

**86:2** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax at-Tariq?

But what will let you know what at-Tariq is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ

**86:3** Le Eek' ku xotik.

The Piercing Star.

ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ

**86:4** Mix junp'eel pixan mina'an aj kanan yook'ol leti'.

There is no soul without a Protector over it.

إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

**86:5** Ka wiinik u yilik ti' ba'ax beeta'ab.

Let man consider what he was created from.

فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

**86:6** Beeta'ab ti' junp'eel ja' ku jook'ol chich.

He was created from gushing liquid.

خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ

**86:7** Ku jook'ol ichil u baakel u paach yeetel u baakel u tseem.

Issuing from between the backbone and the breastbones.

يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ

**86:8** Jaaj, Leti' yaan u muuk' u suutsik leti'.

He is certainly able to return him.

إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ

**86:9** Ichil le k'iin, le ba'alo'ob ta'aka'ano'ob kun e'esa'ako'ob.

On the Day when the secrets are disclosed.

يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

**86:10** Ma' kun u yaan ti' leti' muuk', mix aj aantaj.

He will have no strength, and no supporter.

فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ

**86:11** Tumen le ka'an ku suut.

By the sky that returns.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ

**86:12** Yeetel tumen le luum ku jaats'pajal.

And the earth that cracks open.

وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ

**86:13** Jaaj, lela' junp'eel t'aan ku xotik ba'alo'ob.

It is a Decisive Word.

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

**86:14** Yeetel ma' chen utia'al che'ej.

It is no joke.

وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ

**86:15** Jaaj, letio'ob ku beetiko'ob k'aas tuukulo'ob.

They plot and scheme.

إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا

**86:16** Ba'ale' Teen ku beetik tuukul xan.

But I plot and scheme.

وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا

**86:17** Beey tuuno', ts'aik pa'atalil ti' le maaxo'ob ku p'ek t'aaniko'ob ti' Allah; ts'aik ti' letio'ob junp'eel p'iit pa'atalil.

Therefore, give the blasphemers respite, a brief respite.

فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

## 87. The Most High

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**87:1** Ki'iki' t'aante u k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le maax maas ka'anal ichil tulakal.

Praise the Name of your Lord, the Most High.

سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

**87:2** Leti' le maax ku beetik tulakal ba'al, yeetel ku jets'ik tulakal ba'al tu beel.

He who creates and regulates.

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

**87:3** Leti' le maax ku p'iisik tulakal ba'al, yeetel ku chiikbesik beel.

He who measures and guides.

وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

**87:4** Leti' le maax ku jook'sik le suuk ku jaanta'al tumen le ba'alche'o'ob.

He who produces the pasture.

وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ

**87:5** Tu ts'ooke', ku sutik leti' ti' xoot'o'ob tikin ma' aal.

And then turns it into light debris.

فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ

**87:6** To'on kun k beetik a xookik, beey ma' a tu'ubbesik.

We will make you read, so do not forget.

سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ

**87:7** Chen ba'ax Allah ku k'aat. Leti' u yojel ba'ax ku ya'ala'al, yeetel ba'ax ta'aka'an.

Except what God wills. He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.

إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

**87:8** To'on kun k beetik a bin tu beel ma' talam.

We will ease you into the Easy Way.

وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

**87:9** Beey tuuno', k'a'ajsik, wa le k'a'ajsaj ku aantaj.

So remind, if reminding helps.

فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

**87:10** Le maax ku sajakik Allah kun k'a'ajsik.

The reverent will remember.

سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

**87:11** Ba'ale' le aj k'aas kun u p'atik leti'.

But the wretched will avoid it.

وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى

**87:12** Leti' le maax kun ook ichil le Noj K'aak'.

He who will enter the Gigantic Fire.

ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

**87:13** Tu'ux ma' kun kimik, mix kun kuxtal.

Where he will neither die, nor live.

ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

**87:14** Ku naajal le maax ku sakkuuntik u baaj.

Successful is he who purifies himself.

قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

**87:15** Yeetel ku k'a'ajsik u k'aaba' u Yuumtsil, yeetel ku payalchi'.

And mentions the name of his Lord, and prays.

وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

**87:16** Ba'ale' te'ex ku a yeeyike'ex le kuxtal bejla'.

But you prefer the present life.

بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

**87:17** Kex le u laak' kuxtalo' maas uts, yeetel maas ku p'aatal.

Though the Hereafter is better, and more lasting.

وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

**87:18** Lela' yaan ti' le yaax ju'uno'ob.

This is in the former scriptures.

إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

**87:19** Le ju'uno'ob Abraham yeetel Moses.

The Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

## 88. The Overwhelming

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**88:1** K'uch wa ti' teech u tsikbal le ba'al ku bak'pachik tulakal?

Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ

**88:2** Le k'iin lelo', le wicho'ob kun subtalo'ob.

Faces on that Day will be shamed.

وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ

**88:3** Ku meyajo'ob yeetel ku ka'analo'ob.

Laboring and exhausted.

عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ

**88:4** Kun tooka'alo'ob ichil junp'eel k'aak' jach ku kelemtal.

Roasting in a scorching Fire.

تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً

**88:5** Kun uk'besa'alo'ob ti' junp'eel jool ja' ku tooka'al.

Given to drink from a flaming spring.

تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ

**88:6** Mina'an ti' letio'ob janal, chen k'i'ix.

They will have no food except thorns.

لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ

**88:7** Le ma' ku ts'aik muuk' ti' wiinkilal, mix ku xu'ulsik wi'ijil.

That neither nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.

لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ

**88:8** Le k'iin lelo', le wicho'ob kun ki' olo'ob.

Faces on that Day will be joyful.

وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ

**88:9** Ki' u yoolo'ob tumen u meyajo'ob.

Satisfied with their endeavor.

لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ

**88:10** Ichil junp'eel Pak'al ka'anal.

In a lofty Garden.

فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

**88:11** Ichil leti', ma' kun a yu'ubik mix t'aan mina'an u jaajil.

In it you will hear no nonsense.

لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً

**88:12** Ichil leti' yaan junp'eel jool ja' ku bin mantats'.

In it is a flowing spring.

فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ

**88:13** Ichil leti' yaan k'anche'ob lik'sa'ano'ob.

In it are raised beds.

فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ

**88:14** Yeetel luucho'ob jets'a'ano'ob tu kuuchil.

And cups set in place.

وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ

**88:15** Yeetel ba'alo'ob utia'al chenebaltal jets'a'ano'ob tsool tsool.

And cushions set in rows.

وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ

**88:16** Yeetel nook'o'ob xit'a'ano'ob tulakal tu'ux.

And carpets spread around.

وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

**88:17** Ma' wa ku yilik le camello'obo', bix beeta'ano'ob?

Do they not look at the camels—how they are created?

أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

**88:18** Yeetel ti' le ka'an, bix lik'sa'an?

And at the sky—how it is raised?

وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

**88:19** Yeetel ti' le wiitso'ob, bix jets'a'ano'ob?

And at the mountains—how they are installed?

وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

**88:20** Yeetel ti' le luum, bix xit'a'an?

And at the earth—how it is spread out?

وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

**88:21** Beey tuuno', k'a'ajsik. Teech chen junp'eel aj k'a'ajsaj.

So remind. You are only a reminder.

فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ

**88:22** Ma' yaan ti' teech jalbesil yook'ol letio'ob.

You have no control over them.

لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

**88:23** Ba'ale' maax ku suutik u paach yeetel ma' tu oksik u yool.

But whoever turns away and disbelieves.

إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

**88:24** Allah kun u ts'aik ti' leti' le yaayajil maas noj ichil tulakal.

God will punish him with the greatest punishment.

فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ

**88:25** Ti' To'on u suut letio'ob.

To Us is their return.

إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ

**88:26** Tu ts'ooke', yook'ol To'on u xooko'ob.

Then upon Us rests their reckoning.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

## 89. The Dawn

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**89:1** Tumen le ja'atskaab.

By the daybreak.

وَٱلْفَجْرِ

**89:2** Yeetel tumen lajun aak'abo'ob.

And ten nights.

وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ

**89:3** Yeetel tumen le ka'ap'eel yeetel le junp'eel.

And the even and the odd.

وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
