**89:4** Yeetel tumen le aak'ab ken ku bin.

And the night as it recedes.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

**89:5** Yaan wa ichil lelo' junp'eel hach t'aan utia'al jun tul maax yaan u na'at?

Is there in this an oath for a rational person?

هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

**89:6** Ma' wa a wilaj bix a Yuumtsil tu beetaj ti' Aad?

Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Aad?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

**89:7** Erum, le kaaj yaan u yooko'ob.

Erum of the pillars.

إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ

**89:8** Le ma' beeta'ab u laak' bey leti' ichil le luumo'ob.

The like of which was never created in the land.

ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ

**89:9** Yeetel Thamood, le maaxo'ob tu xoto'ob le tuunicho'ob ichil le koomo'.

And Thamood—those who carved the rocks in the valley.

وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ

**89:10** Yeetel Pharaoh, le maax yaan u k'axbil yooko'ob.

And Pharaoh of the Stakes.

وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

**89:11** Le maaxo'ob tu beeto'ob ya'ab k'aas ichil le luumo'ob.

Those who committed excesses in the lands.

ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ

**89:12** Yeetel tu ya'abkunto'ob le k'aas ichil letio'ob.

And spread much corruption therein.

فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ

**89:13** Beey tuuno', a Yuumtsil tu pulaj yook'ol letio'ob junp'eel yaayajil.

So your Lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment.

فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

**89:14** A Yuumtsil ku paakat utia'al u yilik.

Your Lord is on the lookout.

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ

**89:15** Bey le wiinik, ken u Yuumtsil ku ts'aik prueba ti' leti', yeetel ku nojbesik leti', yeetel ku ayik'alkuuntik leti', ku ya'alik: In Yuumtsil tu nojbesajen.

As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”

فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

**89:16** Ba'ale' ken Leti' ku ts'aik prueba ti' leti', yeetel ku p'iiskuntik u kuxtal ti' leti', ku ya'alik: In Yuumtsil tu p'atajen ichil subtal.

But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”

وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ

**89:17** Ma' beey. Ba'ale' te'ex ma' a nojbesike'ex le paal mina'an u yuumo'.

Not at all. But you do not honor the orphan.

كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**89:18** Yeetel ma' a ya'alike'ex a baje'ex utia'al a ts'aike'ex janal ti' le ootsil.

And you do not urge the feeding of the poor.

وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**89:19** Yeetel a jaantike'ex le ba'ax p'ata'an ti' te'ex yeetel tulakal a k'aat.

And you devour inheritance with all greed.

وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا

**89:20** Yeetel a yaakuntike'ex taak'in yeetel ya'ab yaakunaj.

And you love wealth with immense love.

وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا

**89:21** Ma' beey. Ken le luum kun p'uya'ak, p'uya'ak yeetel p'uya'ak.

No—when the earth is leveled, pounded, and crushed.

كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

**89:22** Yeetel a Yuumtsil kun taal, yeetel le angelo'ob, tsool tsool.

And your Lord comes, with the angels, row after row.

وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا

**89:23** Yeetel le k'iin lelo', Mitnal kun taasa'ak taanil. Le k'iin lelo', wiinik kun k'a'ajsik, ba'ale' bix kun u yaantik leti' le k'a'ajsaj?

And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him?

وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

**89:24** Kun u ya'al: In k'aat ka'ach in taasik ba'al taanil utia'al in kuxtal.

He will say, “If only I had forwarded for my life.”

يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى

**89:25** Le k'iin lelo', mixmaax kun u ts'aik yaayajil bey Leti' ku ts'aik yaayajil.

On that Day, none will punish as He punishes.

فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

**89:26** Yeetel mixmaax kun u k'axik bey Leti' ku k'axik.

And none will shackle as He shackles.

وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

**89:27** Ba'ale' teech, oo pixan, jets' a wool.

But as for you, O tranquil soul.

يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

**89:28** Suut ti' a Yuumtsil, ki' a wool yeetel k'ama'anech.

Return to your Lord, pleased and accepted.

ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً

**89:29** Ook ichil In palilo'ob.

Enter among My servants.

فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى

**89:30** Ook ichil In Pak'al.

Enter My Paradise.

وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

## 90. The City

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**90:1** Teen, tumen le luum lela'.

I swear by this land.

لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

**90:2** Yeetel teech ku kuxtalech ichil le luum lela'.

And you are a resident of this land.

وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

**90:3** Tumen le yuum, yeetel ba'ax tu siijbesaj.

And by a father and what he fathered.

وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ

**90:4** To'on k beetaj wiinik ichil talamil.

We created man in distress.

لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ

**90:5** Ku tukultik wa mixmaax yaan u muuk' yook'ol leti'?

Does he think that no one has power over him?

أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ

**90:6** Ku ya'alik: Tu xu'ulsaj ya'ab taak'in.

He says, “I have used up so much money.”

يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا

**90:7** Ku tukultik wa mixmaax ku yilik leti'?

Does he think that no one sees him?

أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

**90:8** Ma' wa To'on k ts'aaj ti' leti' ka'ap'eel wicho'ob?

Did We not give him two eyes?

أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ

**90:9** Yeetel t'aan, yeetel ka'ap'eel chi'?

And a tongue, and two lips?

وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

**90:10** Yeetel To'on k e'esaj ti' leti' le ka'ap'eel beelo'ob?

And We showed him the two ways?

وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ

**90:11** Ba'ale' ma' tu beetaj u na'akal le ka'anal beelo'.

But he did not brave the ascent.

فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ

**90:12** Yeetel ba'ax kun u e'esik ti' teech ba'ax le na'akal ka'analo'?

And what will explain to you what the ascent is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ

**90:13** Le cha'ik jun tul palitsil.

The freeing of a slave.

فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

**90:14** Wa le ts'aik janal ichil junp'eel k'iin wi'ijil.

Or the feeding on a day of hunger.

أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ

**90:15** Jun tul paal mina'an u yuum, naats' ti' u laak'o'ob.

An orphan near of kin.

يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

**90:16** Wa jun tul ootsil p'ata'an ichil le luum.

Or a destitute in the dust.

أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ

**90:17** Tu ts'ooke', ku beetik u bajil ichil le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob ti' u laak'o'ob u ch'a'iko'ob muk', yeetel ku ya'aliko'ob ti' u laak'o'ob u beeto'ob uts.

Then he becomes of those who believe, and advise one another to patience, and advise one another to kindness.

ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

**90:18** Le'oba' le maaxo'ob ki' u yoolo'ob.

These are the people of happiness.

أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

**90:19** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku p'ektiko'ob K e'esa'abo'ob, le'oba' le maaxo'ob yaaj u yoolo'ob.

But as for those who defy Our revelations—these are the people of misery.

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

**90:20** Yook'ol letio'ob yaan junp'eel K'aak' k'ala'an.

Upon them is a padlocked Fire.

عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ

## 91. The Sun

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**91:1** Tumen le k'iin yeetel u saasil.

By the sun and its radiance.

وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

**91:2** Yeetel tumen le uj, ka' ku bin paachil ti' leti'.

And the moon as it follows it.

وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا

**91:3** Yeetel tumen le k'iin, ka' ku e'esik leti'.

And the day as it reveals it.

وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا

**91:4** Yeetel tumen le aak'ab, ka' ku pixik leti'.

And the night as it conceals it.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا

**91:5** Yeetel tumen le ka'an, yeetel Leti' le maax tu beetaj leti'.

And the sky and He who built it.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

**91:6** Yeetel tumen le luum, yeetel Leti' le maax tu xit'aj leti'.

And the earth and He who spread it.

وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا

**91:7** Yeetel tumen le pixan, yeetel Leti' le maax tu jets'aj leti'.

And the soul and He who proportioned it.

وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا

**91:8** Yeetel Leti' tu e'esaj ti' leti' u k'aas oolal yeetel u toh oolal.

And inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.

فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا

**91:9** Ku naajal le maax ku sakkuuntik leti'.

Successful is he who purifies it.

قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا

**91:10** Ku sa'atal le maax ku k'aasbesik leti'.

Failing is he who corrupts it.

وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا

**91:11** Thamood tu p'ektaj tumen u nojbe'enil.

Thamood denied in its pride.

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ

**91:12** Ka' tu tsaypachtaj le maas k'aas ichil letio'ob.

When it followed its most wicked.

إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا

**91:13** U Tuuxtbil Allah tu ya'alaj ti' letio'ob: Lela' le camello ko'olel ti' Allah, cha'abe'ex u yu'uk'ul.

The messenger of God said to them, “This is the she-camel of God, so let her drink.”

فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا

**91:14** Ba'ale' tu p'ektajo'ob leti', yeetel tu xotajo'ob u yooke' le camello ko'olelo'. Bey tuuno', u Yuumtsilo'ob tu p'uyaj letio'ob tumen u kebano'ob, yeetel tu jets'aj tulakal tu p'iis.

But they called him a liar, and hamstrung her. So their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled it.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

**91:15** Yeetel Leti' ma' ku sajakik ba'ax kun taal paachil ti' leti'.

And He does not fear its sequel.

وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا

## 92. The Night

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**92:1** Tumen le aak'ab, ka' ku pixik.

By the night as it covers.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

**92:2** Yeetel tumen le k'iin, ka' ku chiikpajal.

And the day as it reveals.

وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

**92:3** Yeetel tumen Leti' le maax tu beetaj le xiib yeetel le ko'olel.

And He who created the male and the female.

وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

**92:4** Jaaj, a meyaje'ex jejelaaso'ob.

Your endeavors are indeed diverse.

إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

**92:5** Bey le maax ku ts'aik yeetel toh u yool.

As for him who gives and is righteous.

فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ

**92:6** Yeetel ku oksik u yool ti' le uts.

And confirms goodness.

وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

**92:7** To'on kun k beetik u beel ma' talam utia'al leti'.

We will ease his way towards ease.

فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

**92:8** Ba'ale' le maax ku p'atik u ts'aik yeetel ku tukultik mina'an u k'aabet ti' leti'.

But as for him who is stingy and complacent.

وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

**92:9** Yeetel ku p'ektik le uts.

And denies goodness.

وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

**92:10** To'on kun k beetik u beel talam utia'al leti'.

We will ease his way towards difficulty.

فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

**92:11** Yeetel u taak'in ma' kun u yaantik leti' ka' kun luubul.

And his money will not avail him when he plummets.

وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

**92:12** Jaaj, yook'ol To'on le chiikbesajil beelo'.

It is upon Us to guide.

إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

**92:13** Yeetel ti' To'on u ti'al le Ts'ook yeetel le Yaax.

And to Us belong the Last and the First.

وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

**92:14** Teen kin a'alik te'ex taanil yo'olal junp'eel K'aak' jach ku tooka'al.

I have warned you of a Fierce Blaze.

فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ

**92:15** Mixmaax kun tooka'al ichil leti', chen le jach aj k'aas.

None will burn in it except the very wicked.

لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى

**92:16** Le maax ku p'ektik yeetel ku suutik u paach.

He who denies and turns away.

ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

**92:17** Ba'ale' le aj toh ool kun luk'sa'al ti' leti'.

But the devout will avoid it.

وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى

**92:18** Le maax ku ts'aik u taak'in utia'al u sakkuuntik u baaj.

He who gives his money to become pure.

ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

**92:19** Ma' ku kaxtik mix junp'eel uts tu k'aat u bo'olil.

Seeking no favor in return.

وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ

**92:20** Chen ku kaxtik u k'ama'al tumen u Yuumtsil, le maax maas ka'anal ichil tulakal.

Only seeking the acceptance of his Lord, the Most High.

إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

**92:21** Yeetel leti' kun ki' u yool.

And he will be satisfied.

وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

## 93. The Morning Light

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**93:1** Tumen le saastal.

By the morning light.

وَٱلضُّحَىٰ

**93:2** Yeetel tumen le aak'ab, ka' ku jets'tal.

And the night as it settles.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

**93:3** A Yuumtsil ma' tu p'atajech, mix tu tu'ubesech.

Your Lord did not abandon you, nor did He forget.

مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

**93:4** Le u laak' kuxtalo' maas uts ti' teech ti' le Yaaxo'.

The Hereafter is better for you than the First.

وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

**93:5** Yeetel a Yuumtsil kun u ts'aik ti' teech, yeetel kun ki' a wool.

And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied.

وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ

**93:6** Ma' wa tu kaxtajech mina'an a taata', yeetel tu ts'aaj teech ta'akbal?

Did He not find you orphaned, and sheltered you?

أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ

**93:7** Yeetel tu kaxtajech saatal a beel, yeetel tu chiikbesaj a beel.

And found you wandering, and guided you.

وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ

**93:8** Yeetel tu kaxtajech yaan a k'aabet, yeetel tu ayik'alkuntajech?

And found you in need, and enriched you?

وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ

**93:9** Bey tuuno', ma' a beetik k'aas ti' le mina'an u taata'o'.

Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan.

فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

**93:10** Mix a jok'sik le maax ku kaxtik aantaj.

Nor rebuff the seeker.

وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

**93:11** Ba'ale' k'aaybes u siibalo'ob a Yuumtsil.

But proclaim the blessings of your Lord.

وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

## 94. The Expansion

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**94:1** Ma' wa To'on k jets'kuuntaj a puksi'ik'al?

Did We not soothe your heart?

أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

**94:2** Yeetel To'on k luk'saj a kuuch ti' teech.

And lift from you your burden.

وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

**94:3** Le kuuch tu talambesaj a paach?

Which weighed down your back?

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

**94:4** Yeetel To'on k ka'analbesaj a k'a'ajsajil utia'al teech?

And raised for you your reputation?

وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

**94:5** Yeetel le talamo', ku taal le ma' talamo'.

With hardship comes ease.

فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

**94:6** Yeetel le talamo', ku taal le ma' talamo'.

With hardship comes ease.

إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

**94:7** Ka' ts'o'okok a meyaj, suut a wool ti' payalchi'.

When your work is done, turn to devotion.

فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ

**94:8** Yeetel ti' a Yuumtsil suut a wool utia'al tulakal ba'al.

And to your Lord turn for everything.

وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب

## 95. The Fig

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**95:1** Tumen le higo yeetel le olivo.

By the fig and the olive.

وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

**95:2** Yeetel tumen Wiits Sinai.

And Mount Sinai.

وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

**95:3** Yeetel tumen le luum lela', le jets'a'ano'.

And this safe land.

وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ

**95:4** To'on k beetaj le wiinik ichil u maas uts jets'ik.

We created man in the best design.

لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

**95:5** Ka' suutbesa'ab tak le maas kaab ichil le kaabo'obo'.

Then reduced him to the lowest of the low.

ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ

**95:6** Chen ma' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob; ti' letio'ob yaan junp'eel bo'olil mina'an u ts'ook.

Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

**95:7** Bey tuuno', ba'axten ka'achi ka p'ektik le culto?

So why do you still reject the religion?

فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**95:8** Ma' wa Allah le maas Aj Na'at ichil le aj na'ato'ob?

Is God not the Wisest of the wise?

أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ

## 96. The Clot

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**96:1** Xook: Tu k'aaba' a Yuumtsil, le maax tu beetaj.

Read: In the Name of your Lord who created.

ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ

**96:2** Tu beetaj le wiinik ti' jun xoot' k'iik'.

Created man from a clot.

خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

**96:3** Xook: Yeetel a Yuumtsil le maax maas ku ts'aik siibal ichil tulakal.

Read: And your Lord is the Most Generous.

ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ

**96:4** Leti' le maax tu ka'ansaj yeetel le ba'al ku ts'iibta'al.

He who taught by the pen.

ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ

**96:5** Tu ka'ansaj le wiinik ba'ax ma' tu yojel ka'ach.

Taught man what he never knew.

عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

**96:6** Jaajil, le wiinik ku maan naach ti' tulakal xuulo'ob.

In fact, man oversteps all bounds.

كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ

**96:7** Ka' ku tuukultik u baaj mina'an u k'a'abeetil ti' mixba'al.

When he considers himself exempt.

أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ

**96:8** Ba'ale' ti' a Yuumtsil u suut.

But to your Lord is the return.

إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ

**96:9** Ta wilaj wa le maax ku kalantik?

Have you seen him who prevents?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ

**96:10** Jun tul palil ka' ku payalchi'?

A servant when he prays?

عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

**96:11** Ka tuukultik wa yaan yook'ol chiikbesajil beel?

Do you think he is upon guidance?

أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

**96:12** Wa ku k'aaybesik u beeta'al toh?

Or advocates righteousness?

أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ

**96:13** Ka wilik wa bix ma' tu oksik u yool yeetel tu suutaj u paach?

Do you see how he disbelieved and turned away?

أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

**96:14** Ma' wa u yojel Allah ku yilik?

Does he not know that God sees?

أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

**96:15** Ma'. Wa ma' tu p'atik, To'on kun k bisik leti' tumen u taanil u pool.

No. If he does not desist, We will drag him by the forelock.

كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

**96:16** Junp'eel taanil pool, aj tuus, aj keban.

A deceitful, sinful forelock.

نَاصِيَةٍ كَـٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ

**96:17** Cha' u t'aanik u muuch'.

Let him call on his gang.

فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

**96:18** To'on kun k t'aanik le aj kanano'ob.

We will call the Guards.

سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

**96:19** Ma', ma' a tzic u t'aan; ba'ale' xolanen, yeetel naats'nen.

No, do not obey him; but kneel down, and come near.

كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩

## 97. The Decree

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**97:1** To'on k e'esaj leti' ichil le Aak'ab Xot T'aan.

We sent it down on the Night of Decree.

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

**97:2** Ba'ale' ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax le Aak'ab Xot T'aan?

But what will convey to you what the Night of Decree is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ

**97:3** Le Aak'ab Xot T'aan maas uts ti' mil winaal.

The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

**97:4** Ichil leti' ku luubulo'ob le angelo'ob yeetel le Pixano', tumen u cha'abil u Yuumtsilo'ob, yeetel tulakal a'almajt'aan.

In it descend the angels and the Spirit, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.

تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ

**97:5** Jets' oolal leti'; tak u lik'il le saastal.

Peace it is; until the rise of dawn.

سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ

## 98. The Clear Evidence

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**98:1** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksajo'ob u yoolo'ob ichil Maako'ob le kili'ich ju'uno', yeetel le aj ts'aaj yet-maako'ob, ma' jaatsa'ano'ob ka'ach, tak ka' k'uch le chiikul saasil ti' letio'ob.

Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, were not apart, until the Clear Evidence came to them.

لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:2** Jun tul tuuxtbil ti' Allah ku xookik sakbesa'ano'ob ju'uno'ob.

A messenger from God reciting purified scripts.

رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً

**98:3** Ichil letio'ob yaan aanalte'o'ob, jach uts u tojolo'ob.

In them are valuable writings.

فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ

**98:4** Le maaxo'ob ts'a'abo'ob le kili'ich ju'uno' ma' tu xa'axajo'ob u baajo'ob, chen paachil ti' u k'uchul le chiikul saasil ti' letio'ob.

Those who were given the Scripture did not splinter, except after the Clear Evidence came to them.

وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:5** Ma' a'ala'abo'ob chen utia'al u kultiko'ob Allah, ku ts'aiko'ob u oksaj oolal chen ti' Leti' tu junal, yeetel u beetiko'ob le payalchi'o', yeetel u ts'aiko'ob siibal. Lelo' le toh culto.

They were commanded only to worship God, devoting their faith to Him alone, and to practice regular prayer, and to give alms. That is the upright religion.

وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ

**98:6** Le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob ichil Maako'ob le kili'ich ju'uno', yeetel le aj ts'aaj yet-maako'ob, kun p'aatalo'ob ichil u K'aak' Mitnal, tu'ux kun u p'aatalo'ob mantats'. Letio'ob le maas k'aas ichil le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob.

Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, will be in the Fire of Hell, where they will abide forever. These are the worst of creatures.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:7** Ba'ale' le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob yeetel ku beetiko'ob toh kuxtal, letio'ob le maas uts ichil le ba'alo'ob ts'aaba'ano'ob.

As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—these are the best of creatures.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:8** U bo'olilo'ob yaan ti' u Yuumtsilo'ob: Pak'alo'ob Mantats', yaan beel ja'o'ob ku maano'ob yanal ti' letio'ob, tu'ux kun u p'aatalo'ob mantats'. Allah tu ch'a'aj uts u yool ti' letio'ob, yeetel letio'ob tu ch'a'ajo'ob uts u yool ti' Leti'. Lelo' utia'al le maax ku saajkik u Yuumtsil.

Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eternity beneath which rivers flow, where they will abide forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears His Lord.

جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

## 99. The Earthquake

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**99:1** Ka' le luumo' kun peeksa'ak yeetel u peek.

When the earth is shaken with its quake.

إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

**99:2** Yeetel le luumo' kun u taas u kuucho'ob.

And the earth brings out its loads.

وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

**99:3** Yeetel le wiiniko' ku ya'alik: Ba'ax ku yuchul ti'?

And man says, “What is the matter with it?”

وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا

**99:4** Tu k'iinile' lelo', leti' kun u tsikbalt u tsikbalo'ob.

On that Day, it will tell its tales.

يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

**99:5** Tumen a Yuumtsil ts'o'ok u e'esik ti' leti'.

For your Lord will have inspired it.

بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

**99:6** Tu k'iinile' lelo', le maako'ob kun jook'oko'ob bey much'o'ob, utia'al ka ye'esa'ak ti'ob u meyajo'ob.

On that Day, the people will emerge in droves, to be shown their works.

يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

**99:7** Maax tu beetaj uts bey u p'iisil le maas chichin ba'alo', kun u yilik.

Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it.

فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ

**99:8** Yeetel maax tu beetaj k'aas bey u p'iisil le maas chichin ba'alo', kun u yilik.

And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.

وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ

## 100. The Chargers

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**100:1** Tumen le aj aalkabo'ob ku haak'iko'ob u yiik'.

By the racers panting.

وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا

**100:2** Tumen le maako'ob ku t'abiko'ob saak' k'aak'.

Igniting sparks.

فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا

**100:3** Tumen le maako'ob ku okolto'ob tu saastale'.

Raiding at dawn.

فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا

**100:4** Tumen le maako'ob ku liiksiko'ob muyal luum.

Raising clouds of dust.

فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا

**100:5** Tumen le maako'ob ku okolto'ob ichil u chuumuk.

Storming into the midst.

فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

**100:6** Jaaj, le wiiniko' ma' tu k'a'ajsik le uts tu beetaj u Yuumtsil ti'.

Indeed, the human being is ungrateful to his Lord.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ

**100:7** Yeetel leti' ku yilik lela'.

And he bears witness to that.

وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ

**100:8** Yeetel leti' jach chich u yool tu yaakuntik taak'in.

And he is fierce in his love of wealth.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

**100:9** Ma' wa yojel? Ka' ba'ax yaan ichil le mukbilo'obo' kun pu'uksa'ak tulakal tu'ux.

Does he not know? When the contents of the graves are scattered around.

۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

**100:10** Yeetel ba'ax yaan ichil le puksi'ik'alo'obo' kun ch'a'abil.

And the contents of the hearts are obtained.

وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

**100:11** U Yuumtsilo'ob, tu k'iinile' lelo', jach yojel tulakal yo'olal letio'ob.

Their Lord, on that Day, is fully informed of them.

إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

## 101. The Striking Calamity

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**101:1** Le ku Jats'ik.

The Shocker.

ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:2** Ba'ax le ku Jats'ik?

What is the Shocker?

مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:3** Ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax le ku Jats'ik?

What will explain to you what the Shocker is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:4** Le k'iin le maako'ob kun beytalo'ob bey mejen ba'alo'ob yaan u xik'o'ob, pu'uksa'ano'ob.

The Day when the people will be like scattered moths.

يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

**101:5** Yeetel le witso'ob kun beytalo'ob bey tso'otsel taman ts'o'ok u jats' u tso'otsel.

And the mountains will be like tufted wool.

وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

**101:6** Ba'ale' le maax aal u p'iiso'ob.

As for he whose scales are heavy.

فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:7** Leti' kun yaanal ichil junp'eel kuxtal jach uts.

He will be in a pleasant life.

فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

**101:8** Ba'ale' le maax ma' aal u p'iiso'ob.

But as for he whose scales are light.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:9** U yotoch leti' le noj joolo'.

His home is the Abyss.

فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ

**101:10** A wojel ba'ax leti'?

Do you know what it is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

**101:11** Junp'eel K'aak' jach ku tooka'al.

A Raging Fire.

نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

## 102. Competition in Increase

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**102:1** Le ya'abtalo' ku tu'ubsik te'ex.

Abundance distracts you.

أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

**102:2** Tak ka a xi'ike'ex ti' le mukbilo'obo'.

Until you visit the graveyards.

حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

**102:3** Jaaj, kun a wojle'ex.

Indeed, you will know.

كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:4** Tu jaajil, kun a wojle'ex.

Certainly, you will know.

ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:5** Wa a wojle'ex yeetel u na'at le jaajo'.

If you knew with knowledge of certainty.

كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:6** A wile'ex le K'aak' ku tooka'al.

You would see the Inferno.

لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

**102:7** Te'elo' kun a wile'ex yeetel u wich le jaajo'.

Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.

ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:8** Te'elo', tu k'iinile' lelo', kun kaata'ak te'ex yo'olal le siibalo'.

Then, on that Day, you will be questioned about the Bliss.

ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

## 103. The Declining Day

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**103:1** Hach t'aan le k'iin

وَٱلْعَصْرِ

**103:2** Le maako' yaan ichil saatal.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

**103:3** Cheen le maaxo'ob ku oksiko'ob u yoolo'ob, ku beetiko'ob toh meyajo'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob le jaajo' ti' u laak'o'ob, ku ya'aliko'ob le ch'a' oolalo' ti' u laak'o'ob.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

## 104. The Traducer

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**104:1** Yaayajil ti' tulakal maax ku ya'alik k'aas t'aan yo'olal ulak', yeetel ku tsikbaltik k'aas tu paach.

Woe to every slanderer backbiter.

وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ

**104:2** Maax ku molik taak'in yeetel ku xokik.

Who gathers wealth and counts it over.

ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

**104:3** Ku tuklik u taak'in tu beetaj leti' ma' kimil.

Thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.

يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

**104:4** Ma' beeyo'. Leti' kun pu'ulul ichil le ku P'uchik.

By no means. He will be thrown into the Crusher.

كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

**104:5** Yeetel ba'ax kun ka'ansikech ba'ax le ku P'uchik?

And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

**104:6** U K'aak' Allah, le t'aba'ano'.

God's kindled Fire.

نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

**104:7** Le ku k'uchul tak ti' le puksi'ik'alo'obo'.

That laps to the hearts.

ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

**104:8** Leti' ku k'ala'al yook'ol letio'ob.

It closes in on them.

إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

**104:9** Ichil chowak ooko'ob.

In extended columns.

فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

## 105. The Elephant

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**105:1** Ma' wa a yilaj bix a Yuumtsil tu beetaj ti' le maako'ob ti' le elefanteo'?

Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

**105:2** Ma' wa tu k'aasbesaj u tuukulo'ob?

Did He not make their plan go wrong?

أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ

**105:3** Tu tuuxtaj yook'olo'ob much' ch'iich'o'ob.

He sent against them swarms of birds.

وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

**105:4** Ku pu'uliko'ob yook'olo'ob tunicho'ob ti' k'at elel.

Throwing at them rocks of baked clay.

تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

**105:5** Tu beetaj letio'ob bey le' ts'o'ok u chi'ibil.

Leaving them like chewed-up leaves.

فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

## 106. Quraysh

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**106:1** Utia'al u kananil Quraish.

For the security of Quraish.

لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

**106:2** U kananilo'ob ichil u ximbalo'ob, tu k'iinil ke'el yeetel tu k'iinil chokoj.

Their security during winter and summer journeys.

إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

**106:3** Ka kulto'ob u Yuumtsil le naj lela'.

Let them worship the Lord of this House.

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

**106:4** Maax tu ts'aaj janal ti'ob ti' wi'ijil, yeetel tu ts'aaj kananil ti'ob ti' saajkil.

Who has fed them against hunger, and has secured them against fear.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

## 107. The Neighborly Assistance

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**107:1** Ma' wa a yilaj le maax ku p'ektik le culto?

Have you considered him who denies the religion?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**107:2** Leti' le maax ku beetik k'aas ti' le mina'an u taata'o'.

It is he who mistreats the orphan.

فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**107:3** Yeetel ma' tu ka'ansik u ts'a'abal janal ti' le ootsil maako'.

And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**107:4** Bey tuuno', yaayajil ti' le maaxo'ob ku beetiko'ob payalchi'.

So woe to those who pray.

فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

**107:5** Le maaxo'ob ku tu'ubsiko'ob u payalchi'o'ob.

Those who are heedless of their prayers.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

**107:6** Le maaxo'ob ku ye'esiko'ob u baajo'ob.

Those who put on the appearance.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

**107:7** Yeetel ma' tu ts'aiko'ob le aantaj.

And withhold the assistance.

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

## 108. The Abundance

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**108:1** To'on ts'aaj teech ya'ab.

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

**108:2** Beey tuuno', payalchi'tik a Yuumtsil, ka k'iinsik ba'alche' ti' Allah.

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

**108:3** Le maax ku p'ekech, leti' le saatalo'.

إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

## 109. The Disbelievers

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**109:1** A'ale: Oo le maaxo'ob ma' tu oksiko'ob u yoolo'obo'.

Say, “O disbelievers.

قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

**109:2** Teen ma' kin kultik le ba'ax te'ex ka kultike'ex.

I do not worship what you worship.

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**109:3** Mix te'ex ka kultike'ex le ba'ax teen kin kultik.

Nor do you worship what I worship.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:4** Mix teen kin kultik le ba'ax te'ex ka kultike'ex.

Nor do I serve what you serve.

وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

**109:5** Mix te'ex ka kultike'ex le ba'ax teen kin kultik.

Nor do you serve what I serve.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:6** Ti' te'ex a beele'ex, yeetel ti' teen in beel.

You have your way, and I have my way.”

لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

## 110. The Support

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**110:1** Ken taalak u naajal Allah, yeetel u to'okol.

When there comes God’s victory, and conquest.

إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

**110:2** Yeetel ka wilik le maako'ob ku ookolo'ob ichil u culto Allah ichil ya'ab muuch'o'ob.

And you see the people entering God’s religion in multitudes.

وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

**110:3** Bey tuuno', ki'iki'tant a Yuumtsil, yeetel kaxtik u sa'atesa'al ti' Leti'. Leti' le maax ku k'amik suut ool.

Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance.

فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

## 111. The Palm Fiber

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**111:1** Xota'ano'ob u k'abo'ob Abee Lahab, yeetel leti' xota'an.

Condemned are the hands of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.

تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ

**111:2** U taak'in ma' tu yaantaj leti', mix le ba'ax tu naajaltaj.

His wealth did not avail him, nor did what he acquired.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

**111:3** Kun wenek ichil junp'eel K'aak' ku tooka'al.

He will burn in a Flaming Fire.

سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ

**111:4** Yeetel u yatan — le ko'olel ku kuchik che'.

And his wife—the firewood carrier.

وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

**111:5** Tu bak'pach u kaal yaan junp'eel suum ti' k'i'ix.

Around her neck is a rope of thorns.

فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

## 112. The Sincerity

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**112:1** A'ale: Leti' Allah, juntulili.

قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

**112:2** Allah, le maax tulaakal ku k'aatik aantaj ti', leti' ma' u k'abeet mixba'al.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

**112:3** Ma' tu siijbesik mixmaak, ma' siijbesa'ab tumen mixmaak.

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

**112:4** Mixba'al yaan bey leti'.

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

## 113. The Daybreak

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**113:1** A'ale: Tin k'aatik aantaj ti' Yuumtsil le Saastalil.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

**113:2** Ti' u k'aasil le ba'ax tu beetajo'.

مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

**113:3** Yeetel ti' u k'aasil le aak'abo' ken u much'ubaj.

وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

**113:4** Yeetel ti' u k'aasil le aj waay t'aano'ob.

وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

**113:5** Yeetel ti' u k'aasil le aj p'ek maako' ken ku p'ek.

وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

## 114. Mankind

*Basmalah* — Tu k'aaba' Allah, le maax jach ku ch'a'ik ootsilil, le maax ku ch'a'ik ootsilil.

**114:1** A'ale: Tin k'aatik aantaj ti' Yuumtsil le maako'obo'.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:2** U Ajawil le maako'obo'.

مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:3** Allah, u ti'al le maako'obo'.

إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:4** Ti' u k'aasil le maax ku t'aan ichil puksi'ik'al, le maax ku naachtal.

مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

**114:5** Le maax ku t'aan ichil u puksi'ik'alo'ob le maako'obo'.

ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:6** Ti' ichil jinno'ob yeetel ti' ichil maako'ob.

مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
